Chapter 1351: The Perfected One Upholds The Will Of Heaven

"It is like an underground reservoir beneath a desert, gathering every drop of water that seeps down over millions upon millions of years."

"Then one day, when the time is right and a torrential rain falls from the heavens, drenching the entire desert with sweet rain, the underground reservoir surges upward. It drives the accumulated waters beneath the earth into a sweeping flood that washes across the whole desert. Following the great momentum of heaven and earth, it transforms the landscape, turning the endless sands into a vast marshland in an instant."

"This is the power to reshape heaven and earth."

Li Fan's eyes flickered as though they sought to pierce through the tranquil River of Vitality before him and uncover the hidden secrets beneath it. Unfortunately, just as he had previously guessed, the creator of the River of Vitality was unquestionably an existence beyond the mortal realm. Its arrangement had clearly not been accomplished through formations. It was far beyond what the current Li Fan could comprehend.

The violent current caused by Hundred Flowers drawing away the vitality gradually subsided.

When everything finally returned to complete stillness, Li Fan's observations had yielded nothing.

The same was true for Yin Shangren and Hundred Flowers.

It was just like the High Wall itself. It stood openly before you, allowing you to inspect it by every conceivable method, yet you remained forever unable to uncover its secrets.

The gap between them was so immense that it inspired despair.

The three stood silently above the River of Vitality, saying nothing for a long while.

No one knew how much time had passed.

Li Fan gently shook his head.

"In ancient times, people sighed while gazing upon the ocean. Today, one loses all hope upon beholding this river."

"The secrets here are beyond what we can investigate at present. Since Xu Ke has become lost within it, we can only hope that fortune favors him."

Originally, Li Fan had thought searching for Xu Ke would merely be a minor task. Who could have expected that beneath the Remnant World Great Wall lay enormous earth fissures stretching across the entire Star Sea?

As a result, his plans had to change.

In truth, if Li Fan continued exploring, then with the recording ability of the Dao Deviation Stone and the movement technique of the phantom Wooden Sword, he might eventually map every Star Sea earth fissure.

However, the priority of this lifetime remained the ascension of the Xuanhuang Realm.

The vitality hidden within the Star Sea fissures was simply too immense. Even extracting only a portion of it during the Xuanhuang Realm's ascension would be more than sufficient for the areas already discovered.

"Holy Teacher, I intend to remain here for now." Hundred Flowers hesitated before finally speaking.

"The vitality here is of tremendous benefit to restoring the Wansheng Realm. Although I can only gather a small amount each time, if I persevere, then within at most half a year I will restore my homeland's vitality."

Li Fan stared at Hundred Flowers. His gaze seemed to penetrate her body and reach the miniature world at her core.

"Even if it is restored, I fear your old friends may not all return to life," Li Fan said with a frown.

He naturally saw that both the Wansheng Realm and all its living beings had been refined by Hundred Flowers into that golden glazed state.

Even if immense vitality could wash over them and restore them from their glazed condition, no one could say how many living beings would survive such a transformation.

Yet Hundred Flowers' gaze remained resolute.

"I can only do everything within my power and leave the rest to heaven's will. Before, there was no way at all to restore my world. Now that such an opportunity lies before me, how can I simply ignore it?"

Seeing her determination, Li Fan no longer attempted to dissuade her.

At this moment, Yin Shangren also spoke.

"I feel the same as Hundred Flowers. I do not wish to leave for the time being."

Li Fan raised an eyebrow.

"This vitality is useful to you as well?"

Yin Shangren shook his head.

"No. It is simply that while near this River of Vitality, I feel an incomparable peace within my heart. Those fragmented world souls that occasionally emerge within my consciousness all fall completely silent here."

Li Fan found himself speechless at this explanation.

"Very well. If you have nothing else to do, then search for Xu Ke while you remain here. It would be best if you find him. But if not, do not force the matter. Your own safety comes first."

"The ascension of the Xuanhuang Realm is a long-term undertaking. Waiting another half year makes no difference. Stay here. I will return to pick you up in six months."

The two bowed respectfully and bade Li Fan farewell.

Li Fan stepped forward as the Wooden Sword phantom enveloped his body.

A moment later, a strange fluctuation appeared around him.

It was the Ascension Formation.

It carried the overwhelming majesty of a cultivator ascending and climbing the Heavenly Gate, forcing Yin Shangren and Hundred Flowers to instinctively retreat.

Before their eyes, Li Fan's actual position had not changed.

Yet they clearly felt that he was becoming farther and farther away.

And higher.

Standing within the phantom of the Wooden Sword, Li Fan gradually became transparent.

Eventually, he faded completely and disappeared from their sight.

"What an incredible technique..."

Yin Shangren was utterly astonished.

"If the Holy Teacher does not return for us after six months, then perhaps we will remain trapped here for the rest of our lives."

Hundred Flowers did not refute him.

"Fortunately, vitality fills this place. At least we need not worry about dying while trapped."

She continued staring at the tranquil River of Vitality, quietly waiting for the next opportunity to draw upon it.

...

The Great Wall of the Remnant Worlds.

Outside the node leading to the earth fissure basin.

Without any warning, Li Fan's figure suddenly appeared.

The instant he returned to the Star Sea, he halted the Ascension Formation and used the movement technique of the phantom Wooden Sword to leave the node's range.

Within only a few breaths, he had traveled from the lowest basin back to the normal Star Sea.

The rapid change in positional elevation over such a short period caused both his body and soul to suffer an immense shock.

Blood burst forth.

His skin split apart inch by inch.

His soul felt as though countless enormous boulders had rolled over it, crushing it beneath unbearable pressure.

Even with Li Fan's extraordinary foundation, his face turned deathly pale for an instant.

"What I just experienced was like half an ascension."

"Only, instead of ascending to the Immortal Realm, I ascended from a lower level of existence into the present Star Sea."

"And even that impact was already so overwhelming. One can only imagine what a true ascension would entail."

"Without the protection of immortal spiritual qi, ordinary cultivators would have absolutely no chance of surviving."

As these thoughts passed through Li Fan's mind over several breaths, every one of his injuries had already completely recovered.

He did not leave immediately.

Instead, he quietly gazed at the extraordinary spectacle beneath the High Wall.

The invisible High Wall.

The endless Remnant World Great Wall.

The countless earth fissures at the lowest reaches of the Star Sea.

Together they formed a dreamlike and profoundly mysterious landscape.

Even though Li Fan's strength now stood close to the summit of the Star Sea, it remained filled with countless mysteries in his eyes.

Perhaps the stronger he became, and the more secrets he uncovered, the more questions would arise.

Until one day, when he surpassed a certain limit.

Everything would finally become clear.

Li Fan gave the wondrous sight one final, lingering look.

Then the Wooden Sword phantom left its sheath as he flew toward the Xuanhuang Realm.

"There is no need to rush the ceremony with the Immortal Ark. If matters proceed too quickly, suspicion will instead be aroused."

"However, as the plan advances, it is finally time to begin cultivating the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable of this lifetime."

Within the Xuanhuang Ascension Plan, the vast quantity of immortal spiritual qi required could only be mobilized after inheriting the position of the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.

The restrictions once imposed by the Immortal Realm upon that office still remained.

The scene of Sun Tianci's tragic death in his previous life was still vivid in Li Fan's memory.

It was therefore impossible for him to personally take such a risk.

Fortunately, in this lifetime, there was no longer any need to create another Sun Tianci who was born already in Dao Integration.

The Dao Teaching phantom had been continuously preaching day and night throughout multiple mortal small worlds.

It had already selected a suitable candidate.

Li Fan's figure flashed as he arrived within an unnamed mortal world.

The scale of this small world was not even worthy of comparison with Great Qi or Great Li.

It was vastly inferior even to the Spiritwood Realm.

A mountain range consisting of only thirteen peaks made up the entirety of the world.

Rather than a small world, it was more akin to a small Cave Heaven.

Yet within such a mortal small world, one that even a Foundation Establishment cultivator might not spare a second glance for, Li Fan sensed the birth of a faint World Heavenly Dao consciousness.

He also noticed a young boy whose disposition could only be described as utterly pure and genuine.

Perhaps because the world itself was so small, it was extremely difficult for its humans to bear children.

As a result, the total population remained at a consistently low level.

To them, the resources hidden within the mountains were practically inexhaustible.

There were only a handful of people spread across the thirteen mountain peaks. Everyone knew one another well, so conflicts were rare.

Most of each day was spent in leisure.

Naturally, the people of this world gradually developed curiosity about what lay beyond the mountains.

But just as the living beings of the Star Sea remained forever trapped behind the High Wall, they too could never leave the boundaries of their world, no matter how long they lived.

There was one little boy who, from the day he learned to walk, would often climb to the highest peak in the world.

Standing alone upon the summit, he gazed over this tiny world.

The entire Thirteen Peaks Mountain Range lay within his sight.

Then he would lie upon the ground and silently stare into the sky.

Li Fan had observed this little boy before.

While climbing and surveying the landscape, many random thoughts still passed through his mind.

But the moment he lay down and looked directly into the heavens, his consciousness would almost completely enter a state of absolute emptiness. Every thought became utterly tranquil.

Had Li Fan not still been able to sense his life force, he might have believed the boy had already died.

After all, as long as living beings existed in the world and interacted with their surroundings, thoughts would inevitably arise within them.

Only an extremely small number of people, whether through extraordinary fortune or exceptional innate talent, could enter such a state of complete emptiness, free from knowledge and awareness.

Yet for this little boy, a state that countless cultivators could only dream of attaining had become his natural condition.

More than that.

The Thirteen Peaks World was simply too small.

Yet by an extraordinary coincidence, it had given birth to its own Heavenly Dao consciousness.

Among its very limited number of living beings, the little boy's daily habit of lying atop the world's highest peak while staring into the sky naturally attracted the attention of this world's Heavenly Dao.

However, the Heavenly Dao consciousness of the Thirteen Peaks World was itself only in its infancy.

It merely approached the boy out of instinctive curiosity.

Thus, the little boy's soul became like a blank sheet of paper, slowly imprinting the approaching Heavenly Dao of the Thirteen Peaks World upon itself.

The traces left behind by the World's Heavenly Dao within his soul did not alter the boy's personality in the slightest.

Day after day, he continued climbing to the summit and gazing into the heavens.

Without his awareness, the Heavenly Dao consciousness descended again and again, each time leaving behind a deeper imprint.

...

Li Fan had observed countless people and countless small worlds.

Even so, he had to admit that this was nothing short of an unrepeatable miracle.

'Neither human nor Heaven, yet both human and Heaven. The union of Heaven and man, where man seizes the mysteries of Heaven!'

'Observe the Dao of Heaven. Execute the will of Heaven. Thus, all is complete!'

Without realizing it, this little boy, who did not even possess a proper name, had achieved the perfect state that ancient cultivators had only recorded in legends and longed for all their lives.

Although the world itself was far too small, and its Heavenly Dao could not possibly compare to that of the Xuanhuang Realm in terms of completeness.

There was no doubt that, in Li Fan's eyes, this little boy was the perfect seedling to become the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.

The Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable was, in essence, a Human who supervised Heaven.

Under normal circumstances, the Heavenly Dao operated naturally.

Only at certain necessary moments would the Great Celestial Venerable intervene and make adjustments.

For Li Fan, however, he merely required a puppet capable of unlocking the legacy left behind by the former Great Celestial Venerable.

The less independent that puppet was, the better.

Yet if it were merely a puppet without any initiative whatsoever, it would never be able to pass the succession trials.

The appearance of this little boy perfectly solved Li Fan's dilemma.

'Judging by his current state, after becoming the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, he will perform no actions of his own. He will simply follow the original operating principles of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, governing through noninterference.'

'And for the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao itself, a Great Celestial Venerable who does absolutely nothing is undoubtedly the most desirable outcome. Perhaps his compatibility is no lower than Mr. Bai's...'

The more Li Fan observed the little boy, the more satisfied he became.

With a single finger, he sent a trace of light and shadow silently into the boy's pure and immaculate consciousness.

It did not even disturb the nearby Heavenly Dao consciousness of this world.

This time, Li Fan did not directly implant every detail of the Great Celestial Venerable Fallen Immortal Realm trial.

He merely planted a few subtle hints and guidance at several critical decision points.

The little boy's thoughts were far too simple.

Those hints alone should be enough for him to instinctively make the correct choices and complete the trial.

'A future Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable cannot remain without a name.'

'From now on, your name shall be Wuming.'

(T/N:- Wuming translates to Nameless)

To preserve Wuming's purity, Li Fan did not even leave behind any awareness of his own existence within the boy's sea of consciousness.

Leaving the Thirteen Peaks World, performing the ritual to enter the Fallen Immortal Illusion Realm, succeeding as the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.

Then later detonating the immortal artifact, pouring immortal spiritual qi into the Xuanhuang Realm, and advancing the birth of the First Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth after its ascension.

All of it would be accomplished solely through silent guidance and subtle suggestion.

This also meant that Li Fan himself would have to adjust his own Dao Integration plan to accommodate Wuming.

However, Wuming's governing through noninterference reduced uncertainty to the absolute minimum.

'For a very long time, Wuming's own sense of existence will be almost nonexistent.'

'However, if after my Dao Integration, the ascended Xuanhuang Realm still remains...'

A strange light flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

'As countless years pass, with his body becoming one with the Heavenly Dao consciousness of the Super Xuanhuang Realm, perhaps Wuming may seize this opportunity to attain power comparable to that of a True Immortal.'

It was easy to foresee that, through the many arrangements Li Fan had made during this lifetime, the Xuanhuang Realm would almost certainly ascend into an Immortal Domain.

And to become one with the Heavenly Dao consciousness of an Immortal Domain.

Even True Immortals of ancient times might not have been capable of accomplishing such a feat.

By then, Wuming's strength would surely far surpass even the Equal Star Sea Consciousness of the Immortal Ark.

The only problem was that such a transformation would require an unimaginably long passage of time.

Only someone as pure as Wuming, whose birth itself was a miraculous coincidence, could possibly achieve it.

Had Li Fan attempted the same, it would not take long before his own self-awareness inevitably came into conflict with the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.

Therefore, from the very beginning, Li Fan had abandoned any thought of replacing Wuming himself.

'I only wonder, after the Xuanhuang Realm ascends into an Immortal Domain, what changes will occur to the position of the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable?'

'Will the shackles left behind by the ancient Immortal Realm disappear entirely, or will they instead become even stronger?'

Chapter 1352: Dao Annihilation Descends Upon The Star Sea

After receiving Li Fan's subtle guidance, the Wuming did not immediately leave the Thirteen Peaks World.

Instead, he naturally rose from where he had been lying on his back, gazing at the sky.

He stood a little closer to the Heavenly Dao of this world.

Slowly extending both arms, he reached out to touch the wind, to touch the sky.

The blue sky and white clouds remained unchanged.

None of the living beings within the Thirteen Peaks World noticed anything unusual.

Only Li Fan could see that the entire world had begun to tremble ever so slightly because of the Wuming's touch.

"It seems that sensing Wuming intention to depart, the Heavenly Dao of this world has begun merging with him even faster."

"In the future, the Heavenly Dao of this world will still remain here. Yet a duplicate copy of it will accompany the Wuming as he journeys into the greater world beyond."

"How remarkably similar."

"If one possessed the ability, who would willingly remain a bird forever trapped within a cage?"

Li Fan sighed softly before his expression turned solemn.

"Then let me give you one more push."

The phantom of the True Immortal seal script character [Creation] flashed across the sky of the Thirteen Peaks World.

This world was simply too small. Merely revealing the Creation character for an instant was enough to bring about earth-shaking changes.

Spiritual qi began to emerge throughout the world.

The Thirteen Peaks mountain range slowly rose higher.

The vegetation covering the mountains flourished with vibrant vitality.

Standing atop the highest peak, Wuming sensed something and awoke from his state of immersion. He looked around in every direction, but ultimately found nothing.

Feeling the changes taking place throughout the surrounding world, although he could not understand them, a joyful smile gradually spread across his face.

...

The transformation of the Thirteen Peaks World continued.

Li Fan, however, left behind a strand of divine sense within the world to monitor the Wuming's actions while he departed first.

After returning to the Xuanhuang Realm, he took out a jade talisman from his robes.

It was flashing rapidly, as though something extremely urgent had occurred.

It was precisely the jade talisman Mo Rubin had previously given him.

Mo Rubin had remained within the Eye of the Heavenly Beast, intending to use its power to search throughout both the Xuanhuang Realm and the Darkest Star Sea for traces of the Xuantian King. He had said the search would require at most three to five months.

Judging by the time, the results should indeed have arrived.

As soon as Li Fan's divine sense touched the jade talisman, Mo Rubin's voice immediately echoed within his mind.

It seemed to be suffering interference of some kind. The transmission broke on and off and was far from clear.

"I found... something strange..."

"Come immediately."

That was the entire message.

The jade talisman's light then dimmed, but Li Fan faintly sensed it guiding him toward the Heavenly Beast Bone Veins in Nine Mountains Prefecture.

Taking a single step, Li Fan arrived within the territory of Nine Mountains Prefecture.

The so-called Heavenly Beast Bone Veins referred to the nine mountain ranges stretching endlessly across heaven and earth.

Following the jade talisman's guidance, Li Fan arrived at the summit of Jade Prison Mountain.

Among the Nine Mountains, Jade Prison Mountain stood the tallest.

Standing upon its peak, the entire layout of the nine mountain ranges lay clearly before his eyes.

It was likely due to the blessing of the Eye of the Heavenly Beast contained within Mo Rubin's jade talisman. Although Li Fan had overlooked Nine Mountains Prefecture from high above many times before, never had his vision been so clear.

Every mountain and river that had formed upon the Heavenly Beast's remains vanished from his sight.

Within Li Fan's eyes, only the Heavenly Beast's most primordial form remained.

Just as Mo Rubin had previously said, although the Heavenly Beast had died, its bone veins still remained.

Looking through these nine mountain ranges, despite the passage of countless millennia, Li Fan could still vaguely discern the outline of that ancient colossal beast.

"The Nine Mountains are Tianchang, Tianduan, Tianxu, Tiancu, Tianjie, Tiandai, Tianlao, Tiandong, and Tianxi."

"They represent the Nine Manifestations of the Meridians."

"This Heavenly Beast was transformed from the jade pendant that the Xuantian King brought back from the Immortal Realm. Yet the meridians within its body are no different from those of a human..."

The guiding force from the jade talisman grew increasingly powerful until it suddenly seemed to pass through a thin membrane.

Li Fan offered no resistance to the force enveloping him and allowed it to carry him onward.

Moments later, he returned to the Eye of the Heavenly Beast.

The dangerous aura he immediately sensed caused him to reinforce his protective barriers once more.

Compared to when he had left, something here seemed to have changed.

Mo Rubin's condition also looked far from good.

It was not that he had suffered any obvious injuries. Rather, his entire being had become incomparably haggard.

It was as though all the essence blood within his body had been completely drained away.

For a cultivator of Mo Rubin's level, such a condition would normally occur only after suffering a fatal blow.

"Brother Mo, what happened?" Li Fan immediately asked in a low voice.

Mo Rubin waved his hand.

"It is fine now. It was caused by the strange phenomenon I mentioned."

Without wasting any time, he went straight to the point.

"Fellow Daoist, take a look."

The space within the Eye of the Heavenly Beast suddenly brightened.

The countless spherical bubbles covering the curved boundary all displayed the exact same scene.

"This is not a real-time observation by the Eye of the Heavenly Beast. It is a scene that was previously recorded," Mo Rubin reminded him.

Countless bubbles overlapped one another.

Thousands upon thousands of images merged together.

In an instant, Li Fan felt as though he had personally entered the scene.

The Star Sea lay silent, yet concealed vibrant life within.

A tiny black vortex slowly revolved without end.

It was a blackness that represented absolute destruction.

Though its expansion was slow, it advanced with unwavering determination.

The residual power of True Immortals, the restorative power of the Star Sea...

No matter what it encountered, everything was devoured and assimilated by that black vortex.

The viewpoint suddenly expanded.

From a single corner of the Star Sea, it broadened until nearly the entire Darkest Star Sea came into view.

Within the already pitch-black Darkest Star Sea, that black vortex appeared utterly inconspicuous.

Yet after witnessing the panorama of the Star Sea, Li Fan's gaze remained firmly fixed upon the vortex.

The sense of impending danger within his heart became impossible to suppress.

His heart, something that rarely happened, beat violently several times in succession.

Only then did Li Fan realize that the location of the black vortex was precisely the center of the Star Sea where he had previously gone and come into contact with the True Will of the Star Sea Origin.

Moreover, the black mist forming that vortex...

Was astonishingly similar to the black substance he had previously obtained by using the White Ring Descends into the Mortal World to decompose True Immortal flesh, as well as the substance contained within Han Zhong's body while he was trapped inside the Eye of the Heavenly Beast.

Yet the feeling each of the three gave Li Fan was clearly different.

They belonged to distinct levels.

The black vortex before him was far more dangerous.

Li Fan frowned slightly.

"What is this?" he asked.

"I do not know. But one thing is certain. It is related to the Dao Annihilation Calamity that destroyed the Immortal Realm in the past." Mo Rubin answered with utmost solemnity, saying something truly astonishing.

"What?" Li Fan's heart trembled. "The Dao Annihilation Calamity?"

Mo Rubin waved his hand. The black vortices on the countless surrounding bubbles instantly vanished, returning to their normal scenes of the Star Sea.

"I discovered these black vortices by accident while using the Eye of the Heavenly Beast to search the Star Sea for Big Brother Xuanyuan."

"At first, I paid them little attention. I thought they were simply a natural phenomenon that had formed in the Star Sea over the years. But later..."

Mo Rubin coughed lightly and extended all ten fingers toward the bubbles of the Eye of the Heavenly Beast.

In the blink of an eye, tens of millions of black threads shot out from his fingertips, each flying toward a different bubble.

Li Fan saw clearly that at the end of every black thread was a miniature Mo Rubin.

However, each of them wore a different expression. Some were ferocious, some terrified, and some completely insane.

The instant these countless miniature Mo Rubins touched the Eye of the Heavenly Beast's bubbles, it was as though they had been subjected to unimaginable torture. They all let out shrill screams simultaneously.

Yet their movements never stopped.

Both hands dug firmly into the bubbles before pulling violently.

Like peeling away a rotten and foul-smelling layer of skin, they tore away a sticky black substance from the Eye of the Heavenly Beast.

"Ahhh!"

The tiny Mo Rubins screamed even more miserably.

Their bodies rapidly became blurred as the black substance corroded them, as though they might disappear at any moment.

Yet under the control of Mo Rubin's true body, none of them loosened their grip.

They completely peeled away the black decayed layer from the Eye of the Heavenly Beast.

Gurgle. Gurgle.

Afterward, instead of storing the black substance away, they directly opened their already indistinct mouths and swallowed it in huge mouthfuls.

As the thick, decayed black substance entered their stomachs, the faces of each miniature Mo Rubin became impossible to distinguish.

"As long as the Demon Heart remains, the Immortal Body shall never perish."

At that moment, Mo Rubin's indifferent voice suddenly echoed.

A mysterious force instantly descended upon those blurred bodies.

Preventing them from completely dissipating.

They became like intact sacks that had not burst apart, merely containing those thick black substances.

Mo Rubin's expression was incomparably solemn. With extreme caution, he recalled his Demon Hearts.

Of course, he did not return them to his own body.

Instead, he produced a jade box and stored them all inside.

Only after finishing all this did Mo Rubin finally let out a long sigh of relief.

Li Fan noticed that Mo Rubin had become even weaker.

He stared intently at him, waiting for an explanation.

After resting for a while, Mo Rubin finally spoke weakly.

"This is already the fourth cleansing."

"I originally believed this black mist was merely a natural phenomenon of the Star Sea and posed no danger. But I never expected that after only observing it a few times, the Eye of the Heavenly Beast would become contaminated by it."

"Fortunately, the Eye of the Heavenly Beast originally came from the Immortal Realm. Its essence surpasses that of the lower realm Star Sea. Furthermore, it was never in direct contact with the black mist, so it can still be saved."

"Using the cleansing method I just demonstrated, I can remove the black mist attached to it."

Hearing this, Li Fan also let out a sigh of relief.

"That is fortunate amid misfortune."

However, he quickly realized something horrifying and immediately asked.

"The Dao Annihilation Calamity. You said it was the catastrophe that destroyed the Immortal Realm. Has it already appeared in the Star Sea? Even the True Immortals could not withstand it. Does that mean we are all doomed?"

"There is no need for such alarm. The situation is not quite that dire." Mo Rubin shook his head.

After pausing to choose his words carefully, he slowly continued.

"Back then, Big Brother Xuanyuan was already worried that the Dao Annihilation Calamity of the Immortal Realm would eventually spread into the lower realms."

"Although he never said it outright, I could tell."

"I also told you before. If one does not know the name of the Dao Annihilation Calamity, then even standing before it, one cannot recognize its true nature. But once its name is known, even seeing the slightest trace of it will naturally stir an instinctive realization."

"Now that you already know the name Dao Annihilation, when you observed that black mist just now, did you feel anything?"

Li Fan carefully recalled what he had just witnessed.

"No."

"Exactly." Mo Rubin said gravely. "I suspect this black mist is not the Dao Annihilation Calamity itself. Rather, it is the omen that the Dao Annihilation Calamity is about to descend."

"Just as dark clouds gather before torrential rain falls, or the earth trembles before mountains collapse. Every great disaster in the world is accompanied by certain signs. This black mist may well be the sign that the Dao Annihilation Calamity is approaching."

"And..."

Mo Rubin's expression became even more serious.

"It is more than merely an omen. As you witnessed just now, this black mist appears capable of devouring everything that approaches it within the Star Sea. If left unchecked and allowed to continue spreading, the expansion of the black mist may actually hasten the arrival of the Dao Annihilation Calamity itself."

Li Fan frowned deeply, his expression becoming equally grave.

He remained silent for a long time, seemingly digesting everything Mo Rubin had just said.

"How could this happen?"

After quite some time, those were the only words he uttered.

There was even a trace of panic in his voice.

Mo Rubin could only answer with silence.

"The affairs of the world are ever unpredictable. Or perhaps all of this had already been destined from the very day the Immortal Realm was destroyed."

Only after a long while did Mo Rubin let out a sigh.

"Is there truly no way to stop the spread of these black vortices?" Li Fan asked unwillingly.

"Even if such a method exists, it is beyond our ability to know. Big Brother Xuanyuan may have known."

Li Fan's eyes immediately lit up, as though he had grasped a lifeline.

"Right. While using the Eye of the Heavenly Beast to search the Xuanhuang Realm and the Star Sea, did you discover any trace of the Xuantian King?"

Mo Rubin smiled bitterly.

"If I had found him, I would not have needed to painstakingly cleanse this Dao Annihilation black mist myself."

"However..."

"It was not entirely fruitless."

Li Fan immediately fixed his gaze upon him.

"When Big Brother Xuanyuan mysteriously disappeared, he sent out several warnings at the final moment."

"We brothers among the Dharma Kings should all have received one."

"But there was another transmission that was sent beyond the Xuanhuang Realm, even beyond the starry sky itself."

"That transmission was extremely well concealed. Under normal circumstances, I would never have discovered it. Only by relying upon the Eye of the Heavenly Beast did it leave behind the slightest trace, allowing me to detect it."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

"Beyond the starry sky? Could it be..."

His heart shook.

"There is only one possibility. The recipient of Big Brother Xuanyuan's message should have been the Faceless Immortal," Mo Rubin answered directly.

"I remember you once mentioned that when the Xuantian King disappeared, the head of the Faceless Immortal's stone statue somehow broke off..."

Mo Rubin nodded.

"So I suspect that when Big Brother Xuanyuan encountered danger, the Faceless Immortal attempted to protect him. Yet even that was insufficient. The stone statue that served as the medium for transmitting its power was severed."

"At the final moment, Big Brother Xuanyuan must have discovered something. Thus, through the Eye of the Heavenly Beast of the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation, he sent a final message beyond the Star Sea, toward the place where the Faceless True Immortal resided."

"He wished to inform that Faceless True Immortal of his discovery."

Li Fan listened in fascination and could not help asking,

"Is it possible to use the traces left within the Eye of the Heavenly Beast to determine exactly what message the Xuantian King sent back then?"

"I'm afraid that is impossible."

Mo Rubin sighed regretfully.

"To begin with, Big Brother Xuanyuan certainly encrypted the message."

"Furthermore, whatever secret that message contained, he chose not to tell us fellow Dharma Kings and instead informed the Faceless Immortal. That clearly means that even if we had known, there was nothing we could have done."

"It is just like the true nature of the Dao Annihilation Calamity. Knowing it would only burden us with unnecessary worry."

Chapter 1353: A Single Thread Pierces The High Wall

"The Xuantian King sent a transmission..."

Li Fan assumed a thoughtful expression. After a moment, he sighed.

"It must concern a secret that only True Immortals can touch."

"Could it be information about the culprit behind the Xuantian King's disappearance?"

Mo Rubin shook his head.

"Baseless speculation is meaningless. Although we have no way of knowing the exact contents of Brother Xuanyuan's transmission back then, this transmission traced through the Eye of the Heavenly Beast may point us in the right direction."

As he spoke, Mo Rubin once again controlled the Eye of the Heavenly Beast.

The countless surrounding bubble-like scenes froze in place.

Then they rapidly flowed backward.

It was as if the Eye of the Heavenly Beast itself were flying straight through the Star Sea.

"This is the trajectory that Brother Xuanyuan's transmission traveled through the Star Sea back then."

"The High Wall has imprisoned all living beings of the Darkest Star Sea. Perhaps this transmission was the only one in ten thousand years to escape the Star Sea."

"I can calculate the exact location where the transmission broke through the High Wall. Then we can go there in person and investigate."

Mo Rubin explained slowly.

Li Fan frowned.

"At most, it would only have left a trace on the High Wall. Surely it could not have punched a hole through it?"

Mo Rubin smiled mysteriously and replied softly.

"And why not?"

"Do you know what the High Wall truly is?"

Seeing the surprise on Li Fan's face, Mo Rubin asked seriously.

Li Fan answered.

"It is called the High Wall, but in truth it is the end of the Star Sea, where no road lies ahead. Yet this end was artificially created, blocking what was once an open path. It is like a towering wall descending from heaven to seal off the Star Sea."

"Exactly. The High Wall is not a physical creation, but a rule. Since Brother Xuanyuan's transmission to the Faceless Immortal most likely broke through the High Wall and reached the starry sky beyond, that means..."

"The rule was broken."

A sharp light flashed through Mo Rubin's eyes.

Only then did Li Fan fully understand.

"If the broken rule at that point in the High Wall has not been repaired over the past ten thousand years, then it might still be an opening leading beyond the High Wall."

"But... is that really possible?"

"So much time has passed. Could such a breach truly still exist?"

Li Fan remained skeptical.

Mo Rubin smiled faintly.

"That depends on our luck. The signs of Dao Annihilation are about to engulf the Star Sea. If we still cannot find a way to cross the High Wall..."

"Then only death awaits us."

His smile carried only coldness.

Hearing this, Li Fan's expression likewise became grave.

Mo Rubin cupped his fists.

"The journey to the edge of the Star Sea is extremely long. Earlier I witnessed your unparalleled movement technique, so I would like to ask for your assistance once more."

Li Fan replied solemnly.

"Certainly."

A layer of viscous membrane enveloped the two of them. Moments later, they had already left the interior of the Eye of the Heavenly Beast and returned to the Darkest Star Sea.

The phantom of the Wooden Sword silently emerged from its sheath, enveloping both Li Fan and Mo Rubin.

Mo Rubin formed hand seals. Suddenly, the center of his forehead split open, revealing an oval brownish-yellow eye.

To Li Fan, this eye felt exactly the same as the Eye of the Heavenly Beast they had just left.

"This is one of the auxiliary formations of the Eye of the Heavenly Beast. It can attach one of its observation points to the body and serve as a guide while traveling through the Star Sea."

As he explained, Mo Rubin manipulated the brown eye, causing it to release a beam of light.

It did not illuminate the pitch-black heavens. Perhaps only Li Fan and Mo Rubin could see it, extending straight into the depths of the starry sky to guide their direction.

"You only need to follow its guidance."

"If there are dangerous regions ahead where residual True Immortal power has gathered, the Eye of the Heavenly Beast will naturally guide us around them."

As if proving his words, the originally straight beam of light suddenly curved, as though avoiding some unseen obstacle before continuing deeper into the Star Sea.

Li Fan waved his hand.

"There is no need to make things so troublesome."

The Wooden Sword phantom suddenly accelerated. Instead of avoiding the dangerous region marked by the Eye of the Heavenly Beast, it charged directly toward it.

Mo Rubin's expression changed instantly.

Before he could speak, however, he was astonished to discover that in a single instant they had already traversed an enormous distance through the Star Sea.

The dangerous region lying before them produced no effect whatsoever, even as the Wooden Sword phantom passed straight through it.

Thus an almost comical scene appeared.

The guiding beam from the Eye of the Heavenly Beast continuously twisted and bent ahead of them.

Meanwhile, the Wooden Sword phantom pressed straight forward without ever taking a detour.

The guiding beam had no choice but to keep adjusting its direction.

The Wooden Sword phantom flew so quickly that sometimes the guiding beam disappeared altogether for a short time.

Li Fan had to stop and wait for it to reappear before continuing.

Thus the two of them hurried toward the edge of the Star Sea.

"I already believed your movement technique to be extraordinary. I never imagined it would surpass my expectations to such an extent. You can actually ignore the accumulated residual True Immortal power throughout the Star Sea?"

After remaining stunned for quite some time, Mo Rubin finally sighed in admiration.

"I merely gained some new insights recently. My lifespan, which had nearly run out, has also increased somewhat because of it."

Li Fan answered calmly.

Mo Rubin studied Li Fan's face for a long while, but ultimately said nothing further.

Protected by Li Fan's movement technique, what should have been a perilous journey across the Star Sea became a completely safe highway.

After nearly a full day of travel, they had already passed through the Sea of Relics and the Remnant World Great Wall.

They finally arrived at the edge of the Star Sea.

The guiding beam of the Eye of the Heavenly Beast gradually became increasingly faint.

Li Fan therefore slowed down.

Although the core principle of the Wooden Sword phantom lay in the Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood, existing between reality and illusion, if they struck the High Wall head-on at such tremendous speed...

Even he would likely suffer severe injuries on the spot.

Using the attached Eye of the Heavenly Beast, Mo Rubin carefully observed the surroundings.

The slightest deviation would lead to an enormous error.

The distance from the Xuanhuang Realm was simply too great. Even if there had been no mistake in the initial calculations, by the time they reached the edge of the Star Sea, some deviation in the destination was inevitable.

"It should be somewhere nearby."

Before Mo Rubin had even finished speaking, the Wooden Sword phantom under Li Fan's control suddenly came to a complete stop.

"There is no road ahead. The High Wall is here."

Those eight simple words instantly caused Mo Rubin's expression to become incomparably solemn.

"I ask that you move along the boundary. The moment I detect any trace left behind by that transmission from back then, I will immediately alert you."

Li Fan nodded to show he understood.

It was not that he was deliberately acting aloof.

Rather, the residual True Immortal power gathered beneath the High Wall existed on an entirely different level from the ordinary residual power scattered throughout the Star Sea.

Moreover, without the protection and weakening effect of the Remnant World Great Wall, and relying solely on himself to withstand this overwhelming force, even Li Fan, who now possessed the supreme movement art, had to exert his full strength.

Every step was difficult as they explored along the High Wall.

No one knew how much time had passed, yet Mo Rubin still had not found the target. Meanwhile, Li Fan gradually began to feel a faint sense of dizziness.

An inexplicable feeling of panic also arose within his heart, constantly urging him to leave.

However, his instincts did not warn him of any actual danger. It was merely an unprovoked emotion. Li Fan forcibly endured it, trying to comprehend the source of this change within himself.

Not long afterward, he seemed to realize something.

"This is because I have remained beneath the High Wall for too long. It has created the illusion that the High Wall is collapsing and crashing down upon my head. It is because the difference between my own presence and the High Wall's presence is simply too vast."

After understanding this, Li Fan felt somewhat reassured.

Since there was no real danger, he simply ignored the abnormalities in his heart and continued exploring the High Wall.

However, Li Fan had clearly underestimated the oppressive power of the High Wall's presence.

After another quarter of an hour, the panic within him became even more severe.

Even the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra completely lost its effectiveness. It even began affecting the circulation of spiritual energy within his body, as well as the movement of his thoughts.

Li Fan was even more alarmed to discover that under the pressure of the High Wall's presence, his physique and height had shrunk ever so slightly.

Upon closer inspection, he found that it was not merely his physical body.

His divine soul, and even his cultivation and overall strength, were likewise being compressed and diminished.

It was as though the High Wall truly had collapsed onto him.

Li Fan no longer forced himself to continue.

He temporarily retreated, distancing himself from the High Wall.

"This is the first time I have remained beneath the High Wall at such close range for so long."

Only after his body had returned to normal did Li Fan finally let out a long sigh of relief.

Looking toward Mo Rubin, he found that the latter's condition was even worse than his own.

Perhaps because he had observed the High Wall for too long, the Heavenly Eye attached to Mo Rubin's forehead seemed to be squeezed shut by an invisible hand.

Compared to before, it was now barely half as open.

Meanwhile, Mo Rubin's body trembled uncontrollably, as though he had encountered something incomparably terrifying.

Seeing this, Li Fan felt a trace of confusion.

Given Mo Rubin's temperament, even witnessing the High Wall with his own eyes should not have frightened him to such an extent.

In the end, it was Mo Rubin himself who explained the reason.

"The countless demonic hearts all behold the High Wall. Their emotions are magnified thousands upon thousands of times and imposed upon me..."

"My apologies for making a fool of myself, Fellow Daoist."

Mo Rubin slowly returned to normal.

Li Fan did not mind.

"It is an existence that transcends the mortal world to begin with. As long as you are unharmed, that is enough."

"Did you discover any trace of the Xuantian King's message?"

To Li Fan's surprise, Mo Rubin actually nodded.

"I compared the section of the boundary we passed through. There is indeed one location that differs slightly from the others."

"But there are too few samples to be certain. Next, we must at least inspect the entire area covered by the Heavenly Eye."

"Very well."

After resting for a while and allowing both of them to recover to their peak condition, they set off once again.

Yet the moment they returned beneath the High Wall, Li Fan's expression changed dramatically.

Without any warning whatsoever, the crushing sensation from before immediately returned.

Their previous rest had done nothing to dispel the pressure brought by the High Wall's presence. The instant they returned beneath it, they directly inherited the previous burden and once again had to endure the overwhelming might of the High Wall.

Mo Rubin's body began trembling violently.

The terror on his face showed that he was experiencing exactly the same situation as Li Fan.

"Since retreating accomplishes nothing, we can only continue enduring it."

Mo Rubin spoke through chattering teeth.

Li Fan closed his eyes and forcibly suppressed every trace of discomfort within his heart.

Following the guidance of the Heavenly Eye, he slowly advanced along the High Wall with great difficulty.

Step by step, he felt himself becoming increasingly insignificant.

Meanwhile, the High Wall grew ever more vast, inspiring even greater fear within his heart.

Fortunately, the area that required investigation was not particularly large.

"As expected. The place we encountered earlier truly differs from the rest of the High Wall. Quickly."

The Heavenly Eye, now almost completely shut, emitted a faint ray of light to indicate the direction for Li Fan.

Under the suppression of the High Wall's presence, as his strength continued to diminish, even the effectiveness of the Wooden Sword phantom movement art steadily weakened.

Li Fan had a premonition that if he remained here much longer, he would eventually be unable to maintain the Wooden Sword phantom state.

Without the assistance of the movement art, he would have no means of fleeing from beneath the High Wall.

As the High Wall's pressure continued increasing with time, he would ultimately be crushed out of existence by it.

Only [Truth] would be able to save his life.

Fortunately, before reaching that point, Li Fan finally brought Mo Rubin to the target location.

It truly was only a single point.

Within the boundless Darkest Star Sea.

One point at the absolute end of infinity.

Without special guidance, finding its precise location beneath the pressure of the High Wall would have been no different from a fool's dream.

Yet the message left behind by the Xuantian King all those years ago had turned the impossible into reality.

Originally, Li Fan had intended to escape before exhausting all of his strength.

However, the moment he stepped onto that point.

The pressure of the High Wall still remained.

But...

It no longer accumulated.

It was as though they had returned to the moment they first arrived beneath the High Wall.

Li Fan and Mo Rubin looked at one another and both saw overwhelming joy in each other's eyes.

"As expected. My guess was correct. Big Brother Xuanyuan's message pierced through the High Wall's laws."

Li Fan nodded in agreement.

"This place is like a weakness, or a flaw, within the High Wall itself. At the very least, we can remain here indefinitely to study it."

"Otherwise, let alone studying it, even approaching it for an extended period would be impossible."

Mo Rubin narrowed his eyes, his face filled with fascination.

He stared at it in a daze, as though he had finally seen hope of escaping the Darkest Star Sea.

One of his demon hearts flew out from his body.

Its expression was identical to that of Mo Rubin himself as it stretched out a hand, attempting to touch the end of spacetime.

One moment.

Two moments.

Three moments.

Mo Rubin's expression gradually stiffened.

Because he felt absolutely nothing.

That was right.

After going through so much effort to finally arrive at the place where the Xuantian King had once broken through the High Wall.

Faced with this flawed section of the High Wall, Mo Rubin still sensed nothing at all.

Even a flawed High Wall was not something that beings beneath the level of True Immortals could touch.

Realizing this truth, a trace of gloom flashed across Mo Rubin's face.

Not only Mo Rubin, but even Li Fan gained no insight whatsoever from this so called flaw.

Ahead of them still lay only the end of emptiness.

Beyond comprehension.

Beyond understanding.

Whether the flaw existed or not made no discernible difference to them.

Only through the specific effects the High Wall exerted upon them could they perceive even the slightest distinction.

Naturally, Li Fan was unwilling to accept this.

The thought immediately arose of using the Ascension Formation to raise his own presence, narrowing the gap between himself and the High Wall so he could glimpse its true nature.

But he then remembered that Mo Rubin was beside him.

Activating the Ascension Formation would undoubtedly attract his attention.

Thus, Li Fan temporarily suppressed the idea.

"I will try again next time when I come here alone."

The two could only stare at the High Wall in silent resignation.

For a time, neither spoke.

Yet the pressure of the High Wall did not lessen simply because they remained silent.

Very soon, it once again reached a level they could no longer endure.

Having no other choice, Li Fan could only bring Mo Rubin back to a safe area once more.

Chapter 1354: All Living Beings Comprehend The Principles Of Immortality

Mo Rubin looked back toward the High Wall, a trace of unwillingness appearing on his face.

However, he was, after all, one of the peerless prodigies of the ancient cultivation world. It did not take long before he regained his composure.

Letting out a long breath, Mo Rubin slowly said, "Back then, I was only a single step away from ascending and becoming an immortal."

"Brother Xuanyuan was already a Half-Immortal, yet in front of us he rarely displayed his true strength. Most of the time, he simply treated us as companions."

"That gave me the illusion that the gulf between immortals and mortals was not all that vast."

"At least, for someone like me, it never seemed like an insurmountable chasm. But now... heh."

His voice was filled with endless sighs.

'One does not know the height of a mountain until reaching its summit. One does not know the depth of the sea until standing at its edge.'

"Even approaching the Immortal Ruins and personally experiencing the power of a True Immortal cannot compare to what we are doing now, truly reaching out to touch it with our own hands. To speak honestly, the might of a True Immortal far exceeds my imagination," Li Fan sighed as well.

"What do you plan to do next, Fellow Daoist? Will you remain here to continue studying the secrets of the High Wall, or leave for now and continue searching for the Xuantian King?" Li Fan asked after a moment of reflection.

After hesitating for a while, Mo Rubin once again looked back toward the High Wall.

"I am unwilling to leave just like this. I plan to... take another look."

"I will give myself thirty days. If I gain nothing during those thirty days, I will immediately turn around and leave. For the rest of my life, I will never face the High Wall again."

His expression was conflicted and somewhat lost.

Li Fan understood his feelings completely.

One could die upon hearing the Dao.

The secret of the True Immortal lay right before their eyes. Even if it could neither be seen clearly nor touched, who could truly look only once before turning away without hesitation? Especially when the secrets of the High Wall concerned the hope of escaping the Darkest Star Sea.

Li Fan spoke solemnly, "In that case, I shall leave behind a phantom of my Wooden Sword to assist you."

As he spoke, he separated a small sword phantom that enveloped Mo Rubin.

"You are actually choosing to leave instead of continuing your research?" Mo Rubin asked in astonishment.

Li Fan smiled faintly.

"Fellow Daoist is different from me. Back then, you were someone with the hope of ascending."

He first praised Mo Rubin without changing his expression, then sighed softly.

"As for me, I know my own aptitude. Even if I stared at it ten million more times, nothing substantial would change. I simply cannot unravel the secrets of the High Wall."

Mo Rubin fell silent.

After looking at the phantom Wooden Sword circling around him, he was about to speak again.

Yet Li Fan's voice suddenly became passionate.

"But my temporary departure does not mean I am giving up."

"Since someone as untalented as I cannot accomplish it, then let the people of the world all have a chance to try."

"Hm?" Mo Rubin's eyes widened. He thought he had misheard.

"You intend to bring everyone in the world here to comprehend the Dao beneath the High Wall?" His tone carried a trace of disbelief.

"Even with our cultivation, surviving beneath the High Wall is already extremely difficult. Those with lower cultivation would be crushed instantly by its pressure. How could they possibly comprehend anything?"

Li Fan laughed freely.

"My eyes shall become the eyes of all living beings. My hands shall become the hands of all living beings. Wherever I arrive shall be as if all living beings had personally arrived..."

"I shall borrow my own body so that all living beings beneath heaven may together comprehend the principles of the High Wall."

As those words echoed like sacred scripture, another phantom emerged from Li Fan's body.

Its aura was almost identical to the phantom Wooden Sword, yet its appearance resembled Li Fan himself.

Li Fan had separated a strand of his divine soul and fused it with his movement technique phantom. He then reinforced it with formations, amplifying the phantom's senses hundreds or even thousands of times.

"This phantom shall remain here and accompany Fellow Daoist in comprehending the Dao. Meanwhile, I shall return to the Xuanhuang Realm and share everything this phantom experiences with all the people beneath heaven."

Li Fan smiled.

Mo Rubin opened his mouth to speak but hesitated.

Li Fan continued.

"Do not worry. I will not directly reveal the existence of the High Wall to the world. Nor will I explain that what they are experiencing is actually the flaw within the High Wall."

"I shall merely synchronize the sensations experienced by my Dao-comprehending phantom with everyone."

"Millions of people produce millions of thoughts. Every person will arrive at a different answer. Even if none of them discovers the correct one, they should still provide us with some inspiration."

His expression was filled with confidence.

"...It is indeed a viable method."

After remaining silent for a long while, Mo Rubin could only answer like this.

"I am leaving."

Before his words had fully faded, Li Fan's figure had already vanished, following the Wooden Sword that pierced through the Star Sea, disappearing from Mo Rubin's sight.

Mo Rubin shook his head slightly and temporarily set Li Fan aside.

After resting quietly for a moment, he once again controlled the phantom Wooden Sword and advanced toward the flaw in the High Wall.

At the same time, even though Li Fan had not yet returned to the Xuanhuang Realm...

A tremendous transformation had already begun upon every Dao Lecture Platform standing throughout the countless small worlds of the Xuanhuang Realm.

The Holy Teacher phantoms, which had lectured day and night without rest, suddenly stopped teaching.

They raised their heads toward the heavens, appearing deep in thought.

Then an earth-shaking roar erupted from every Dao Lecture Platform.

The living beings within the small worlds had no idea what was happening. They were filled with uncertainty as discussions spread everywhere.

Suddenly, beams of pitch-black light descended from beyond the heavens.

They spread across the sky like corruption, staining everything they touched. In less than the time it took to drink a cup of tea, the originally azure heavens had been completely dyed black.

The entire world plunged into endless darkness.

No matter how brilliantly the great sun shone high above, it could no longer illuminate this darkened world.

It was as though every small world had become the Darkest Star Sea itself, engulfed by absolute darkness.

Only the Dao-comprehending phantom standing upon the Dao Lecture Platform continued to emit a faint radiance.

It became the world's last remaining light.

How could ordinary mortals have ever witnessed such a terrifying scene where even light itself was devoured?

They all believed the apocalypse had arrived.

In an instant, panic and despair spread throughout every corner of the world.

Had it not been for the faint light emitted by the Dao Lecture phantom, preventing the world from falling into complete darkness, countless living beings would likely have taken their own lives in despair within those brief moments.

Thus, the Dao Lecture phantom, shining with the light of salvation, became the only hope left in the hearts of all living beings.

Previously, only mortals aspiring to cultivate would visit the Dao Lecture Platform to listen to its teachings.

But now, simply to survive, nearly every living being instinctively rushed toward the Dao Lecture Platform at the center of their world, like moths drawn toward a flame.

More and more people gathered beneath the platform.

The Dao Lecture Platform expanded accordingly.

Growing millions of times larger than before, it eventually encompassed nearly the entire small world.

The people knelt upon the ground, desperately pleading for the Holy Teacher phantom above to save them.

The Holy Teacher phantom remained motionless.

The people continued begging bitterly.

Since the Holy Teacher never responded, none of them dared to stand.

Finally, a single sorrowful sigh filled with boundless compassion echoed throughout heaven and earth.

At that very moment, the pitch-black heavens began to change.

The Holy Teacher phantom flew toward the sky.

Brilliant radiance erupted from its body, briefly illuminating the darkened world once more.

Its figure transformed into a magnificent rainbow that stretched across the heavens.

It covered the entire sky, temporarily holding back the invading darkness.

As though a curtain of light had been draped across the heavens, the world became slightly brighter.

That slight brightness gave every living being the hope to continue living.

Cheers erupted throughout the world.

They loudly praised the glorious name of the Holy Teacher.

Yet their celebration did not last long.

Before much time had passed, every cheer came to an abrupt halt.

It seemed that another tide of rolling darkness descended from beyond the heavens.

Like a towering High Wall, it pressed down across the sky.

The little light the Holy Teacher had brought was extinguished once more, with more than half of it vanishing.

The people of the world fell into panic again. Despairing cries echoed across mountains and plains.

Upon the glowing heavenly curtain, the resolute face of the Holy Teacher appeared.

He seemed to gather the last trace of his strength and charged toward the wall of darkness beyond the world.

He sought to shatter the darkness that threatened to destroy the world.

The collision between the Holy Teacher and the darkness was utterly silent.

In the end, the Holy Teacher disappeared completely.

As for the rolling wall of darkness beyond the world...

It seemed to have become slightly different.

Everyone stared fixedly at the point where the Holy Teacher's face had struck the wall of darkness.

In their ears, they seemed to hear the final words the Holy Teacher wished to leave behind.

"The path to salvation lies within."

The people wept bitterly.

With the catastrophe of world destruction looming before them, some abandoned themselves completely and gave up all hope of survival.

But the vast majority did everything within their power to ponder the Holy Teacher's final words.

It was obvious that the method to break the wall of darkness and save the world lay within that tiny point, invisible yet truly existing, created by the Holy Teacher's desperate final strike.

Just as the living beings upon the earth attempted to sense the true nature of that point, something unimaginable happened.

The preaching platform left behind by the Holy Teacher emitted a faint radiance that drifted onto their bodies. In an instant, it was as if they had crossed the distance between earth and heaven, arriving personally beneath the vault of the sky.

As though they were truly present, they experienced the existence of that tiny point firsthand.

Only then did the people understand.

This was the final method the Holy Teacher had left behind to save the world and save themselves.

Driven by the desire to survive, the living beings of the world unleashed astonishing potential.

One after another, they quickly established a connection with the Dao Lecture Platform and, with mortal bodies, began comprehending that tiny point hidden within the wall of darkness.

...

The same scene unfolded in every small world where Dao Lecture Platforms had been established.

Naturally, the one responsible for all of this was Li Fan.

At this moment, Li Fan's true body had already returned to the Xuanhuang Realm.

Using the power of formations, he manifested endless darkness that sealed the skies of countless small worlds.

He could feel the resistance coming from the Heavenly Daos of those small worlds.

Although the strength of a single world was negligible to Li Fan now, when the power of many worlds joined together, dealing with them became somewhat laborious.

Even so...

It was merely somewhat laborious.

After spending some effort, Li Fan suppressed them all.

In any case, according to his plan, these small worlds would eventually return to the Xuanhuang Realm as nourishment for elevating the Super Xuanhuang Realm.

The consciousnesses of their Heavenly Daos would inevitably be devoured as well.

Using formations, Li Fan linked together these small worlds that served as nourishment.

He quietly observed the situation within them.

"Based on my experience, only when people face a mortal crisis do they unleash their greatest potential. If I merely asked them to help comprehend it without that sense of impending doom, their efficiency would inevitably be much lower."

"The current arrangement..."

"Is quite satisfactory."

Feeling the countless thoughts of comprehension transmitted simultaneously through the Dao Lecture Platforms, Li Fan nodded with satisfaction.

The gap between mortals and cultivators was already as vast as heaven and earth.

The gap between mortals and True Immortals was even greater.

But precisely because True Immortals stood so incomparably high above all others...

In the eyes of a True Immortal, there was virtually no difference between mortals and ordinary cultivators.

Therefore, when it came to comprehending that flaw within the High Wall, cultivators and mortals were essentially no different.

"The advantage lies in the sheer number of mortals. The sample size is sufficiently large."

"Moreover, during this period, the small worlds beneath the Dao Lecture Platforms have gradually evolved toward cultivation civilizations under their subtle influence. Many cultivators have already emerged among these people."

After analyzing the countless thoughts of comprehension from all living beings, Li Fan found that almost all of them were useless.

However, he was not discouraged.

This had only just begun.

He split off a personality generated through formations, assigning it the sole task of categorizing and processing these countless thoughts.

The overwhelming majority of worthless information would be filtered out.

Only those worthy of Li Fan's personal review would be retained and transmitted to him.

"This is merely another arrangement."

"I never truly expected that the countless living beings alone could unravel the secret of the High Wall."

"In the end, I will most likely still have to rely on myself."

Li Fan sensed the experiences continuously transmitted by the projection of enlightenment at the distant edge of the star sea.

"The High Wall is a creation of True Immortals. Studying it alone is truly difficult."

"Besides all living beings, perhaps those immortal treasures can also lend me a hand."

"It is a pity that I already fed the Boundless Mirror to the Xuanhuang Realm. If this life yields no results, I can consider trying that in the next life."

In truth, the flaw in the High Wall discovered through Mo Rubin had been an unexpected delight.

Li Fan's current priority remained achieving Dao Integration with the Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth.

As for crossing the High Wall, it was not yet an urgent matter.

"Even if I truly uncover the secret of the High Wall, I absolutely will not risk entering it myself."

"The world beyond the High Wall is simply far too dangerous."

The scenes from his previous life resurfaced before his eyes once again.

Cat Treasure devouring immortals.

The collapse of the High Wall.

There was no longer any fear in his heart.

He merely let out a cold snort and suppressed all distracting thoughts.

Taking a single step, he arrived within the true Xuanhuang Realm.

He raised his head and gazed toward the heavens.

Having obtained the promise of the Star Sea, Li Fan now established contact with the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao with almost effortless ease.

Moreover, the Heavenly Dao was no longer as indifferent as before.

Instead, it clearly carried a hint of eagerness to please him.

"This Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao..."

Li Fan let out a cold snort, finding the situation both amusing and exasperating.

Setting these matters aside for the moment, through his communication with heaven and earth, Li Fan began gaining an even deeper and more precise understanding of every change occurring within the Xuanhuang Realm.

It was much like conducting a thorough examination before performing a critical operation on a gravely ill patient.

Although Li Fan could investigate everything himself, it would never be as convenient or as accurate as directly asking the consciousness of the Xuanhuang Realm's Heavenly Dao.

At the same time, throughout this exchange, Li Fan continuously transmitted to the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao the insights he had gained in this life from the True Will of the Star Sea Origin and from beneath the High Wall.

He gave freely and completely of his own accord, with no intention of asking for anything in return.

This step was meant to strengthen his affinity and bond with the Xuanhuang Realm.

Just as it is easiest to build affection during childhood, Li Fan intended to reinforce their connection before the Xuanhuang Realm completed its ascension.

That way, when the time came to devour the Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth, everything would proceed far more smoothly.
