Chapter 1355: Elevating The World’S Heavenly Mandate

The skies of the Xuanhuang Realm underwent a sudden transformation.

Whether it was the power of the Star Sea's revival or the sights revealed after ascending and looking down from above, both were secrets that had originally been beyond the reach of the Xuanhuang Realm's Heavenly Dao.

It instinctively absorbed them without end. Corresponding changes quietly spread throughout heaven and earth. However, just like the Star Sea's revival, this was destined to be an extremely lengthy process. It had only just begun, still in its infancy, and almost no one in the Xuanhuang Realm could perceive these changes.

As the source of this transformation, and while still connected to the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm, Li Fan naturally witnessed every change occurring throughout heaven and earth with perfect clarity.

This was a power of evolution that stood in complete opposition to the Xuanhuang Realm's World Destruction Transformation.

Yet it was equally vast and surging, enough to stir the hearts of all who beheld it.

Li Fan also sensed the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm's rapidly increasing favor toward him.

Carrying the might of the Star Sea's origin, together with the tangible benefits of generously imparting the Dao, kindness and authority worked hand in hand. The rate at which this favor increased far surpassed even that which the Holy Emperor had achieved in his previous life.

Only after the increase in favor gradually slowed did Li Fan temporarily end this round of instruction.

The Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm was reluctant to part with him.

Li Fan, however, departed without hesitation.

He returned directly to the Great Qi Small World, completely severing the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm's perception of him.

As Li Fan's place of origin and the first location where he preached the Dao in this lifetime, the skies above Great Qi were not shrouded by the Wall of Darkness as the other small worlds were.

Nevertheless, the Dao Lecture Platform still stood majestically, its immense scale covering nearly all regions inhabited by humanity.

While living beings listened to the Holy Teacher expound the Dao, their thoughts and insights were simultaneously recorded within the Dao Lecture Platform and transmitted to Li Fan.

It was as if countless billions of living beings were helping Li Fan comprehend the Dao at the same time.

The contents of their enlightenment encompassed everything imaginable.

At present, however, aside from the Great Qi Dao Lecture Platform, all miscellaneous thoughts and insights from the living beings of the other small worlds were directed toward the breach in the High Wall.

This was also why Li Fan had chosen to preserve Great Qi's original state.

It guaranteed the diversity of Dao comprehension.

Within the Dao Lecture Heaven floated the simulated Heavenly Mandate, resembling a silver eye.

Though it appeared motionless, in every instant it completed more than a billion rotations.

It observed the Great Qi cultivators comprehending the Dao, the mountains and forests of the small world, its flowing rivers, clouds, and everything within it.

Compared to when this simulated Heavenly Mandate had first been created, the Silver Eye had now become far more lifelike.

It no longer resembled a creation crafted by cultivators, but instead appeared like a genuine living creature.

'What exactly is a world's Heavenly Dao?'

The behavior of the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm still lingered vividly in Li Fan's memory. It feared power and submitted to strength, much like a pet dog. This prompted him to ponder the question.

Opening his left hand, a golden spherical prison floated above his palm, containing strands of invisible consciousness.

These were the Heavenly Dao wills of the various small worlds that had dared resist when Li Fan previously raised the Wall of Darkness across them.

Li Fan had extracted every one of them and imprisoned them here. He then replaced them with the simulated Heavenly Mandate, maintaining the normal operation of each small world.

"What I extracted was not the complete Heavenly Dao of those worlds. It should merely have been the Heavenly Mandates that gradually formed over countless years, each possessing its own unique temperament. After they were extracted, the small worlds returned to their original state, operating solely according to instinct. If not for my simulated Heavenly Mandate filling the void..."

"The temperament of a world's Heavenly Mandate should be influenced by factors such as the world's size, available resources, and many other conditions."

"For example, this one originated from a small world plagued by endless disasters. Therefore, it gives me the impression of being extremely cautious and highly wary of everything beyond itself. As for this one, it came from a mortal world roughly the same size as Great Qi. That world possesses all the necessities of life, giving it an upright and dignified character. Setting aside differences in scale, it even feels more like the legitimate Heavenly Dao than the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm itself..."

Li Fan carefully distinguished the various World Heavenly Mandates imprisoned before him.

Then, without haste, he fed them one after another to the Silver Eye floating before him.

Although he still did not know exactly how a World Heavenly Mandate was born or what conditions were required for its formation, Li Fan was certain of one thing.

The birth of a World Heavenly Mandate itself represented a form of power.

Almost visibly, as the Silver Eye slowly devoured these World Heavenly Mandates from the small worlds, it too became increasingly lifelike.

The impression it gave Li Fan was that it had become increasingly vivid.

Previously, although it resembled a living creature, it still fell far short of its current state. Now it was almost indistinguishable from a pet possessing a genuine soul.

Before devouring the World Heavenly Mandates, the Silver Eye had merely carried out Li Fan's commands faithfully, monitoring and perceiving the thoughts of the living beings within the Great Qi Small World.

Now, however, it occasionally observed Li Fan in secret.

Its divine eye clearly conveyed a desire to please him.

Whenever Li Fan met its gaze, it seemed encouraged. Its pupil rotated in a circle before acting as though it were showing off and asking for praise.

"Interesting."

From its eyes, Li Fan could clearly perceive its longing for even more World Heavenly Mandates.

Li Fan remained unmoved and simply beckoned with one finger.

The Silver Eye immediately floated over of its own accord.

It gently leaned its body against Li Fan's outstretched hand.

In an instant, countless thoughts from the Great Qi Small World, both present and past, appeared around Li Fan, carefully categorized.

Moreover, the Silver Eye had meticulously organized every category for Li Fan's convenience.

With merely a thought, the Silver Eye immediately understood Li Fan's intentions, rapidly sorting, organizing, and presenting exactly what he wished to examine.

"Compared to before, it has undoubtedly become much more intelligent and useful."

"No wonder the cultivators of the ancient cultivation era were so fond of refining entire worlds into dharma treasures. A World Heavenly Mandate is practically the ultimate version of an artifact spirit."

Li Fan gazed thoughtfully at the Silver Eye before him.

"Unfortunately, even after devouring so many World Heavenly Mandates, this Silver Eye still feels considerably inferior to the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm."

"Using it as a replacement still seems unrealistic."

"What exactly is the factor that determines its qualitative transformation?"

If he could replace the Heavenly Dao consciousness of the Xuanhuang Realm with one of his own creations, it would undoubtedly be of tremendous significance to Li Fan.

Only after completely transforming the Xuanhuang Realm into an impregnable fortress under his own control could it serve as a bridgehead for exploring beyond the High Wall.

While comprehending the countless thoughts transmitted by the silver eye, Li Fan continued contemplating the matter.

Suddenly, a piece of information specially highlighted by the Silver Eye emerged before him.

Li Fan's eyes narrowed slightly.

It was the synchronized perception of the experiences of Sun Erlang, Wang Xuanba, and Yue Zhenwei.

Previously, following Li Fan's subtle guidance, they had journeyed into the territory of the Five Elders Association in search of the Nascent Soul Cave Heaven. After overcoming numerous twists and turns, they had accidentally entered the Carefree Paradise.

They became trapped within a dream world filled with man-eating demons. After great difficulty, they finally discovered a method to shatter that world and successfully escaped.

However, they had not yet left the paradise itself.

To uncover the secrets of the Carefree Paradise, they had no choice but to continue toward the remaining two dream realm boundaries.

"So much time has passed. They should have discovered something by now."

"The Carefree Paradise..."

With a single thought, countless streams of light instantly surged toward Li Fan.

Everything that Sun Erlang and the others had experienced during this period appeared before him in an instant.

Having successfully completed the first dream world, Sun Erlang and his companions originally believed that the remaining two worlds would be much easier.

Reality proved that they had greatly underestimated the dangers of the Carefree Paradise.

The second dream world they entered was a terrifying apocalyptic world unlike anything they had ever heard of.

Across the boundless Star Sea, civilization had withered away and all vitality had faded. A terrifying species of alien insects had become the true rulers of the Star Sea. Wherever the insect swarm passed, every living creature upon the land was devoured.

Only indigestible stones remained behind.

When Sun Erlang and the others descended, what greeted them was a desolate land devoid of all life.

Their mission was to survive for six months while being besieged by the insect army that had yet to leave the surface.

The second dream world was completely different from the first.

There were no puzzles to solve. The moment they entered, the mission objective, the method for leaving the world, and even the mission rewards automatically appeared in their minds.

At first, Sun Erlang and the others did not think the mission would be particularly difficult.

But once they truly clashed with the endless sea of insects, they realized they had been gravely mistaken.

Even after receiving the teachings of the Holy Teacher's phantom and mastering numerous divine combat techniques, they experienced true helplessness for the first time before the overwhelming numbers of the swarm.

The insects simply could not be exterminated. No matter how many they killed with their divine abilities, more would emerge from somewhere beneath the earth to fill the empty space.

After suffering repeated setbacks, the three quickly changed their strategy.

They fought while retreating.

However, the insect swarm covered nearly every corner of the world. No matter where they fled, endless swarms relentlessly pursued them.

In less than seven days, the three had nearly been driven into a dead end.

Wang Xuanba even cursed loudly, declaring that the mission was impossible to complete.

Fortunately, during the previous dream world, Sun Erlang had learned the Spirit Devouring cultivation technique from the Pig Demon statue.

During the fierce battle, he finally reached the beginner level of mastery.

From then on, he devoured the corpses of the insects, sustaining himself through battle.

With an endless source of resources replenishing his strength and eliminating concerns over exhaustion, the situation of the three immediately improved considerably.

Sun Erlang managed to stabilize the battlefield.

Soon afterward, Wang Xuanba encountered an unexpected stroke of fortune.

Inside the stomach of one of the alien insects, he discovered an incredibly powerful treasure.

It could summon a gigantic mechanical puppet over thirty zhang tall.

At first, the puppet remained completely motionless after being summoned.

However, after careful study, Wang Xuanba discovered its true method of use.

His body transformed into a stream of illusory light and entered the puppet.

His consciousness then merged completely with the giant puppet's body.

Using the puppet's overwhelming power, he slaughtered the insect swarm.

Although the situation appeared to improve somewhat, the endless sea of alien insects still filled Sun Erlang and the others with despair.

They struggled on for nearly three months.

By then, both their bodies and their wills had nearly reached their limits.

Since they would not truly die within the dream, all three had almost given up.

At the final critical moment, Yue Zhenwei, whose mind was the most meticulous, discovered something unusual.

Although the insect swarm appeared to move purely by instinct, every movement actually followed a mysterious pattern.

It was as though some hidden existence was directing them from the shadows.

This discovery instantly revitalized the spirits of all three.

After confirming that Yue Zhenwei's observation was highly likely to be correct, they decided to make one final desperate gamble.

Using themselves as bait regardless of the cost, they finally lured out the true master behind the swarm.

They had originally assumed it would be some superior member of the insect race.

Yet when the ruler finally appeared, all three were utterly stunned.

Because the commander of the swarm was actually something that resembled a cultivator's creation.

It was a purple-gold gourd covered with countless unknown talismans.

Standing atop the gourd was a small wooden puppet boy.

He pointed toward the three who were surrounded by the swarm.

The purple-gold gourd beneath him emitted all kinds of strange radiance.

Instantly, the countless alien insects went completely berserk and charged fearlessly toward Sun Erlang and the others.

The three immediately realized that if they defeated the wooden puppet boy and seized control of the purple-gold gourd, they would be able to command the insect swarm themselves.

Surviving for six months would then become effortless.

Thus, they risked everything.

Wang Xuanba transformed into the giant mechanical puppet to draw away the attention of the swarm.

Sun Erlang shot forward like an arrow, disregarding his own safety as he charged directly toward the wooden puppet boy.

Meanwhile, hidden in the shadows, Yue Zhenwei, the weakest among them, launched the decisive final strike.

In the end, he shattered the wooden puppet.

When the great battle came to an end, all three were gravely injured and on the verge of death, trapped within the endless sea of insects.

But when Yue Zhenwei grasped the purple-gold gourd in his hand, all the savage alien insects froze completely, as though encased in ice.

From that moment onward, there was no longer any suspense regarding the survival mission.

Two months later, the second dream world was successfully completed.

After leaving the dream, not only were all of their injuries completely healed,

Yue Zhenwei had even brought the purple-gold gourd back with him.

Contained within the gourd were exactly 9,999,900,000,000 Star Devouring Insects.

Naturally, as only a Golden Core cultivator, Yue Zhenwei could not yet unleash the treasure's full power.

He could currently command only the weakest 900,000,000 Star Devouring Insects.

As his cultivation realm increased, both the number and the strength of the Star Devouring Insects under his command would continue to grow.

Although they had obtained such a supreme treasure, Yue Zhenwei and the others showed little joy.

Instead, endless confusion and fear filled their hearts.

Nearly ten trillion Star Devouring Insects would be a force capable of destroying heaven and earth even in the real Xuanhuang Realm.

Yet now, such terrifying power had fallen into the hands of a mere Golden Core cultivator.

Although this had happened only within a dream, and they did not know whether it could truly be brought back into reality, they still found the entire situation utterly absurd.

They had spent only a short time within the dream realm, yet they had already obtained such tremendous rewards.

It was almost impossible to imagine what kind of accumulation those who had remained in the dreams for countless years had achieved.

Filled with unease, they rested briefly before setting out toward the third dream world.

With a supreme treasure like the purple-gold gourd, and nine hundred million Star Devouring Insects at their command, the third world should at least be much easier to overcome.

Yet reality dealt them another devastating blow.

The instant they entered the third dream world, all three were transformed into straw figures.

Unable to move.

Unable to speak.

All of their spiritual power and treasures vanished without a trace.

They could only communicate through the faint power provided by the dream world itself.

This time, there were no demon beasts.

No insect swarms.

Nor was there any mission prompt.

There were only three straw figures lying quietly upon a black stone that resembled the summit of a towering mountain.

Exposed endlessly to wind and sunlight.

Lashed by rain.

Struck by lightning.

Unable to move, the three initially spent each day wondering what conditions were required to complete the mission.

But as day after day passed, their mental state gradually began to collapse.

Chapter 1356: An Initial Understanding Of The Mysteries Of The Paradise

At first, the three of them would occasionally exchange their thoughts on how they had completed their tasks.

However, they gradually realized that all of their guesses and speculation were completely meaningless.

The three straw figures were like beings isolated from the world itself.

Only the wind, rain, thunder, and lightning descending from the heavens above could come into contact with them.

Other than that, everything in the mortal world seemed completely unable to perceive their existence.

Birds, beasts, and swarms of insects flew past them without ever lingering.

Even the dust of the world never settled upon their bodies.

Thus, the three of them slowly fell silent.

They lay helplessly on their backs, watching the world change.

The sun rose and the moon set. The years flowed onward.

It was as if time itself had been accelerated as one day after another slipped away.

The mountain peak where they rested gradually became thinner and sharper under the endless erosion of rain and windblown sand.

The once majestic and towering mountain slowly lost its fullness until only a solitary jagged peak remained.

It stood alone between heaven and earth.

The surrounding landscape also transformed from rolling green mountains into magnificent canyons carved by countless ravines.

While the seas became fields and the fields became seas, only the black stone upon which Sun Erlang and the others lay remained eternally unchanged.

As the wind and rain continued to batter them, even their consciousness was gradually eroded by the power of time, becoming worn and indistinct.

They slowly stopped reacting to the outside world altogether.

If this continued, perhaps one day their consciousness would completely fade away.

Just as they were about to sink into eternal oblivion.

A majestic and sacred figure suddenly bloomed within their minds, radiating countless streams of divine light.

It seemed even greater than heaven and earth themselves, shielding them from the eroding wind and rain.

"The Holy Teacher..."

Although their memories had already become blurred.

These two words seemed engraved into the depths of their souls, emerging instinctively.

"The Holy Teacher. The Holy Teacher. The Holy Teacher."

The three repeated those words like men possessed.

It was as though a spring burst forth from the earth, allowing memories from the past to once again fill their dried and withered minds.

"Ah!"

It felt as though they had awakened from an endless nightmare.

They knew that the Holy Teacher had saved their lives through unseen means.

But if they could not find a way to escape, they would ultimately still sink into oblivion.

Therefore, seizing this rare moment of clarity, the three of them began discussing without pause.

During their conversation, they were surprised to discover that it truly felt as though they had been tempered through tens of millions of years.

Their temperaments had become incomparably steadier.

Even with disaster looming over them, none of them retained the panic they once possessed.

"This dream trial cannot possibly be a dead end. When the mountain beneath us is finally eroded apart by rain and wind, and the black stone falls, that will probably mark our liberation. As long as we endure until then, we will complete the mission."

After much discussion, they reached this conclusion.

Holding onto it as their final conviction, they gritted their teeth and persevered.

Countless more years passed.

The image of the Holy Teacher within their minds had already become nearly imperceptible.

Only the obsession they repeated endlessly remained as the reason they continued to endure.

Then one day.

The mountain, which had already become impossibly thin and was supported by only a slender stone pillar, could no longer bear the weight of the black stone at its summit.

After a gentle breeze swept past.

It collapsed with a thunderous crash.

As the three straw figures fell from the mountaintop into the mortal world below, time itself seemed to freeze before their eyes.

The clear sky suddenly darkened.

It was as though a black membrane had covered the heavens.

A gigantic black bird's beak pierced through the sky, descending from beyond the heavens.

Merely half of its head was already larger than the entire world.

Its two enormous, razor-sharp eyes filled the sky.

As they slowly shifted, they locked onto the three falling straw figures.

Within the eyes of this indescribably gigantic ferocious bird, Sun Erlang and the others saw unmistakable satisfaction.

With one terrifying cry.

The entire world began shattering inch by inch.

From the foreheads, hearts, and lower abdomens of the three straw figures respectively, three orbs of light flew out.

They slowly rose into the sky, drifting toward the monstrous bird.

Although their consciousness still remained within the straw figures, Sun Erlang and the others could vaguely see scenes of time flowing and mountains and rivers changing within those three light orbs.

Boom!

The next instant, the world plunged into endless darkness.

Even the simulated Heavenly Mandate system responsible for monitoring them could not determine how much time had truly passed.

When Sun Erlang and the others regained consciousness.

They had successfully escaped from the dream.

Not only were they completely unharmed, they had even obtained a divine ability called [Contemplation of Mountains Rivers Epochs].

After transforming oneself into the straw figure upon the mountaintop, time around one's own body would seemingly become frozen.

Meanwhile, one could observe the changes of the world as countless years passed in the blink of an eye.

It was somewhat similar to when Li Fan transformed into the Canghai Pearl and witnessed the seas becoming fields and the fields becoming seas.

However, the truly powerful aspect of Contemplation of Mountains Rivers Epochs was that once activated, the user's lifespan was placed into an almost completely frozen state.

Even if tens of millions of years passed in the outside world, the effect upon the user would be almost negligible.

Of course, this was merely what the dream had indicated in theory.

As for whether this divine ability truly possessed such miraculous effects.

Sun Erlang and the others had no intention of testing it.

Having completed all three, and indeed all of the dream boundaries, the environment around them finally changed once again.

They were still within Qiuxi Prefecture of the Five Elders Association.

However, unlike before when the region had been sparsely populated, the present Qiuxi Prefecture was bustling with people.

Not only were cultivators everywhere throughout the cities, but even the previously desolate wilderness had suddenly become filled with countless buildings.

Moreover, each of those buildings appeared to be inhabited by cultivators.

The changes did not occur only in the outside world.

They also occurred within Sun Erlang and the others themselves.

"Sun Erlang. Golden Core Perfection. Number of Deaths: 1."

"Paradise Experience Level: 2."

"Current Unlockable Dream World Level: 3."

"Carefree Coins: 2000."

...

This was the personal information that Sun Erlang and the others could all view.

When the pink progress bar finally filled, their so called Paradise Experience Level was finally promoted to Level 2.

A new option became available, allowing them to unlock Dream Worlds.

Aside from that, many other detailed descriptions also appeared.

Moreover, when they focused their thoughts on those lines of text, detailed explanations would finally appear in their minds.

They no longer had to rely entirely on guesswork.

Sun Erlang carefully read every entry, afraid of overlooking some crucial piece of information.

"So it turns out that native cultivators of the Five Elders Association also have to undergo the trial of three Dream Worlds before entering the Carefree Paradise. However, the difficulty is nothing like what we experienced. According to the Carefree Paradise's classification, the world difficulty we encountered had already reached Level 3."

"The reason our experience was so unusual is because we are not members of the Five Elders Association. We are outsiders who entered without the permission of the Carefree Heavenly Sovereign."

"However, the Heavenly Sovereign is merciful and does not expel intruders outright. Instead, a Dream Trial is bestowed. Those who successfully pass may officially join the Dream Paradise. Those who fail are permanently banished from the Carefree Paradise. As punishment for the power consumed in constructing the trial dream, more than half of their soul strength will also be drained..."

Sun Erlang's expression darkened.

After exchanging glances with Wang Xuanba and Yue Zhenwei, he continued reading.

"So the place where we first arrived was the transit area leading to the trial dream. Every cultivator entering the Carefree Paradise for the first time appears there."

"Within the Dream Paradise, cultivators are forbidden from harming one another. If someone ignores this rule and attacks by force, the victim will immediately be transferred to a safe area. Depending on the severity of the offense, the attacker will have Paradise Coins deducted."

"Carefree Coins, also known as Paradise Coins, are obtained through exploration and activities within the Dream Paradise. They can be exchanged in the Heavenly Sovereign Treasury for all kinds of resources to strengthen oneself."

"The Heavenly Sovereign Treasury contains everything imaginable."

Seeing the two thousand Paradise Coins he possessed, Sun Erlang's heart stirred as he opened the detailed page of the Heavenly Sovereign Treasury.

An instant later, he stood there completely stunned.

Even with only Paradise Experience Level 2 authority, the number of items he could view was limited. Even so, the inventory of the Heavenly Sovereign Treasury was utterly unbelievable.

Not to mention ordinary heavenly treasures, medicinal pills, and magical artifacts.

Even cultivation techniques were considered commonplace within the treasury.

Furthermore, unlike the cultivation techniques commonly circulated in the Xuanhuang Realm, the weakest techniques here could all be cultivated up to the Soul Transformation realm.

According to the Carefree Paradise's description, there was no need to worry about a technique being too profound to comprehend.

The moment an exchange was completed, the cultivator would instantly reach the introductory stage.

By spending Paradise Coins, the cultivation technique itself could continue advancing.

"Once you learn an exchanged technique, it can no longer be shared with others. However, before learning it, it may be gifted."

"In that case, although the Paradise has no restriction against cultivating multiple techniques simultaneously, the difference is not significant. Cultivation still requires paying the exchange cost."

"A cultivator's cultivation and techniques in the real world are synchronized only once upon first entering the Paradise, becoming the starting point of their Paradise self."

"However, under normal circumstances, future progress made inside the Paradise cannot be brought back into reality, that is, into the Xuanhuang Realm."

Sun Erlang frowned upon seeing this.

After thinking it over briefly, however, he quickly accepted it.

After all, everything within the Paradise was simply too heaven defying. If every achievement there could be synchronized back into reality...

Then the scale of the Paradise would unquestionably exist on an entirely different level from the Xuanhuang Realm.

"As its name suggests, the Paradise is constructed under the power of the great Carefree Heavenly Sovereign, composed of countless different Dream Worlds."

"The foundations of these Dream Worlds may originate from historical events that once occurred within the Xuanhuang Realm, from the dreams of living beings, or from even deeper great thoughts. Therefore, they are not permanently safe but instead filled with every imaginable danger."

"To facilitate exploration, Dream Experience Levels and Dream World Levels were established."

Sun Erlang nodded slightly.

With their strength at the peak of the Golden Core realm, exploring a Level 3 Dream World was already their limit.

Going any further would certainly mean death.

Having a rough understanding of danger levels prevented dream explorers from throwing away their lives needlessly.

"Death exists within the Paradise."

"A cultivator's number of deaths is not unlimited."

"The Death Count is one of the most important indicators of a cultivator's status within the dream, second only to the Dream Experience Level."

"Cultivators with similar Death Counts generally exist within the same layer of the Paradise. The broad divisions are one to three deaths, three to five, five to ten, and ten to fifteen."

"The upper limit of deaths should be fifteen. If you die again after that..."

"Then you truly die."

"In reality as well."

Sun Erlang's heart shuddered.

"As Death Count increases, it not only changes the people one encounters but also causes one's Spirituality to decline."

"Spirituality is a hidden attribute that is not displayed, yet it truly exists within the Blessed Land. It directly affects actual combat and cultivation efficiency."

"The more often you die, the lower your Spirituality becomes, making further progress increasingly difficult."

"It seems Spirituality also has other effects."

Sun Erlang pondered silently.

"Death Count can also be reduced through certain methods. Besides spending Paradise Coins in the Heavenly Sovereign Treasury, some special items obtained within dreams can also remove deaths."

"Of course, all of them are extremely valuable."

"From this alone, it is clear that the Carefree Paradise is filled with dangers. Yet the reason every member of the Five Elders Association longs for it is because this dream truly deserves the name 'Carefree.'"

"Every cultivator need only pay a certain number of Paradise Coins to create a Dream World that belongs solely to themselves."

"Whether becoming an unrivaled emperor whose every word is law, or an immortal emperor who controls all existence, everything can be realized within the dream."

"Within the dream, everything is almost indistinguishable from reality. The more Paradise Coins one spends, the richer every detail becomes."

"However, aside from the initial cost of creating the dream, maintaining its existence also requires Paradise Coins."

"This is also the driving force behind cultivators exploring Dream Worlds."

"The higher the Dream World level, the greater the risks, but the greater the rewards as well."

"Dream exploration may be undertaken alone or with companions."

"At regular intervals, free Dream Worlds become available for exploration. Naturally, they may also be unlocked early by spending Paradise Coins."

...

Sun Erlang gradually gained a comprehensive understanding of every aspect of the Carefree Paradise.

What truly caught his attention, however, was the information revealed at the very end.

"Under normal circumstances, nothing obtained within dreams can be brought back into reality."

"However, there are exceptions."

"First, through the protection of the Carefree Heavenly Sovereign's power. This requires almost no cost, but throughout the entire history of the Paradise, it has happened only a handful of times."

"Second, through key items. By surrendering them, one may choose to bring a portion of their dream power back into reality."

"Third, by venturing deep into unexplored Dream Worlds."

"Fourth, by turning in an enormous amount of Paradise Coins."

Sun Erlang and the others exchanged glances once again before discussing among themselves.

"This Paradise has truly exceeded our expectations."

"Even the Holy Teacher may not fully understand it. The strength of that Carefree Heavenly Sovereign, who created such an extraordinary Paradise, is truly beyond imagination."

"Still, dreams are ultimately dreams. They are illusions. We must eventually return to reality."

"But now it seems that will not be easy. Among the countless billions of beings in the Paradise, only a handful manage to return to reality each year," Yue Zhenwei said thoughtfully.

"Actually, I think staying here would not be bad even if we never return. Just look at all the Dream World templates in the Heavenly Sovereign Treasury. Every single one seems fascinating."

Wang Xuanba stared at the countless items within the Heavenly Sovereign Treasury as he spoke.

Sun Erlang remained silent.

Chapter 1357: The Secret Of Severing Xuanhuang

Unable to find a way to escape the dream within a short time, Sun Erlang and the others discussed the matter and decided that their first priority should be strengthening themselves inside the dream world.

Among the three, Yue Zhenwei possessed the Purple Gold Gourd, and Sun Erlang had the Spirit Devouring Art. Only Wang Xuanba had yet to obtain anything in the dream world, making him their weakest link.

Thus, the three pooled all of their Paradise Coins together and purchased a protective divine ability for Wang Xuanba.

"Indestructible Samsara Body, Initial Stage."

"An supreme art of the ancient Samsara Sect of the Xuanhuang Realm. After achieving minor mastery, neither yin and yang nor the five elements can harm the cultivator in the slightest. Upon achieving great mastery, one becomes virtually undying and indestructible, untouched even by countless tribulations."

Just these few lines of description were enough for Wang Xuanba to choose the divine ability without hesitation.

Sun Erlang wore a somewhat strange expression as he muttered quietly, "If this Samsara Sect divine ability is really as incredible as the description says, then how was the sect wiped out so easily back then?"

Yue Zhenwei smiled.

"It only costs five thousand Paradise Coins. It cannot really be that overpowered. But for our current stage, it should be more than enough for self-defense."

After completing the exchange, Wang Xuanba carefully sensed the changes taking place within his body before saying,

"There was actually another protective divine ability that seemed quite good, called [Unfettered Free Intent]. Unfortunately, it does not appear to originate from the Xuanhuang Realm, so I know nothing about its background. Besides, the intent conception of that divine ability does not really suit my tastes."

Sun Erlang fell into thought.

"I noticed that many items in the Heavenly Sovereign Treasury do not seem to originate from the Xuanhuang Realm at all. Could it be that this Carefree Dream Paradise actually encompasses things that exist beyond the Xuanhuang Realm?"

The three exchanged glances, gaining an entirely new appreciation for the power of that Carefree Heavenly Sovereign.

Their remaining Paradise Coins were insufficient to purchase another entry into the dream world, so they could only wait for the next free dream session.

It had to be said that the words "Paradise" were no exaggeration.

Even outside one's personally customized dream, the ordinary regions of Paradise were already a vast world where cultivators could indulge themselves to their hearts' content.

"It includes not only the normal territory of the Five Elders Association. One can also freely travel throughout the territory of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance. The only difference is that within Dream Paradise, neither the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor nor the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance organization exists. Cultivation resources are inexhaustible, there is no fighting or conflict, and cultivators can freely enjoy the magnificent scenery of heaven and earth. As long as one spends a tiny amount of Paradise Coins, a cave abode can be established anywhere throughout the Xuanhuang Realm."

"Moreover, through the reflection of the Heavenly Sovereign's supreme power, even within the exact same location, countless cave abode can overlap one another. There is no longer any need to compete for land, and cultivators entering or leaving their own dwellings will never encounter anyone else."

A miniature projection of the entire Xuanhuang Realm appeared before Sun Erlang and the others.

Any location displayed within the image could be reached instantly by spending only a single digit amount of Paradise Coins.

Even more astonishing...

"It is even possible to leave the Xuanhuang Realm and live in other cultivation worlds among the stars?"

"Every cultivation world possesses magnificent scenery of its own, no less spectacular than that of the Xuanhuang Realm."

A look of yearning immediately appeared on Sun Erlang's face.

"It is a pity that only those whose Paradise Experience Rank has reached Level 6 are qualified."

He attempted it anyway, only to fail.

The three could not help but feel disappointed.

...

The Silver Eyes displayed every experience Sun Erlang and the others had within Paradise.

Just like Li Fan's own eyes, they allowed him to observe everything inside Paradise without personally entering it.

"So it can survive beneath the All Things Return to Void Grand Formation, and even retain enough strength to shelter others. This Carefree Paradise truly is extraordinary."

"Its dream realm actually extends beyond the Xuanhuang Realm and spreads into the Darkest Star Sea?"

This genuinely exceeded Li Fan's expectations.

Standing within the Great Qi Small World, he gazed toward the territory of the Five Elders Association, his eyes flickering.

"What Carefree describes within the dream is probably not fabricated. Some of the cultivation worlds it depicts even match what I already know."

"The Star Sea should already be nothing but emptiness and death."

"And yet Carefree can recreate the scenes of those ancient cultivation worlds..."

"There are several possibilities. First, Carefree personally visited those cultivation worlds."

"Second, it simply reconstructed them based upon ancient records."

"Or perhaps..."

Li Fan's thoughts suddenly stirred.

"Perhaps that Carefree Heavenly Sovereign used the countless world remnants within the Great Wall of Remnant Worlds as templates. If that speculation is correct, then the power of Carefree, or Dream Paradise itself, may have already reached beneath the High Wall."

"The deeper unknown dreams..."

At this thought, Li Fan's expression immediately became serious.

"The blockade of the High Wall, Xuantian King's transmission, the flaw in the High Wall."

"The Dao Deviation Stone Mother, the Taiyan Sect's indestructible information, the entire sect escaping."

"Carefree Dream Paradise."

Countless known pieces of information converged within Li Fan's mind.

Not long afterward, a bold speculation suddenly emerged.

"Could it be that through the power of Dream Paradise, the Carefree Heavenly Sovereign has already begun making contact with the flaw in the High Wall?"

Had this been before, Li Fan would never have considered such a possibility.

After all, someone whose Reversal Longevity had been suppressed beneath the Immortal Ancestor for thousands of years suddenly possessing the means to cross the High Wall sounded utterly absurd.

But when combined with Dream Paradise's performance against the world destroying immortal formation in his previous life...

The speculation suddenly became much more reasonable.

"Perhaps it is precisely because, under the constraints of the New Cultivation Method, they could never surpass the Immortal Ancestor in reality."

"That the people of the Five Elders Association chose to seek another path."

"If they truly possess such capability, then it also explains why those five Longevity Immortals have remained so quiet all these years."

"They are merely trying to buy time."

Li Fan knew these were nothing more than speculations without substantial evidence.

But for him, concrete proof was unnecessary. As long as there was even the slightest suspicion, it was well worth verifying.

"In any case, Carefree Paradise welcomes everyone."

"One only needs to pass the so called dream trial."

"And what I possess in greatest abundance is cultivators."

In an instant, Li Fan's gaze passed through the Dao Lecture Platform and fell upon suitable candidates throughout the many small worlds.

Silently, they received the Holy Teacher's invisible guidance.

Vanishing from where they stood, they set out toward Carefree Paradise.

They would become Li Fan's eyes and ears within Paradise.

"Though Paradise is vast, a single thought can traverse it."

Li Fan was not worried that the Carefree Heavenly Sovereign would turn hostile simply because he was openly investigating Paradise's secrets.

In this life, he had remained hidden behind the scenes from beginning to end.

The methods with which he controlled these cultivator pawns originated from the Nine Star Red Beads of the Immortal Realm and the power of an ancient immortal formation.

Li Fan simply did not believe Carefree could discover him.

Even if Carefree somehow discovered that he was the mastermind, so what?

The current Li Fan possessed countless divine abilities.

Unless a True Immortal descended personally, no one else posed any threat to him.

There was no longer any need to remain overly restrained.

Li Fan created yet another simulated personality, assigning it the sole responsibility of constantly supervising all the intelligence gathered from Paradise.

Paradise concealed far too many secrets.

His pawns could never uncover them all overnight.

Li Fan then shifted his attention toward the Final Dissociation Disc.

In this life, its long standing mission of simplifying immortal formations had finally achieved a breakthrough.

Previously, the Final Dissociation Disc had progressed very slowly.

Being capable of deducing immortal formations was one matter.

Simplifying them while preserving most of their power was an entirely different challenge.

Everything changed after Li Fan repeatedly ascended and overlooked the Star Sea from a higher elevated perspective.

"The projection of the Great Dao descends from above, like an inverted cone."

"The principles of the Immortal Realm are indeed profoundly mysterious, beyond the comprehension of mortals."

"But mortals themselves are the foundation of the Great Dao."

"There is common ground between the two."

This was the realization that had emerged within Li Fan's heart as he studied the Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood.

Using this theory as its foundation, the Final Dissociation Disc finally found a breakthrough by exploiting the shared principles between immortals and mortals, successfully completing the preliminary deduction for simplifying immortal formations.

Naturally, the very first immortal formation chosen for simplification and practical testing was Immortal Descents, All Things Return to Void.

After all, in this life, the immortal spiritual qi left behind by the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable was needed to elevate the Xuanhuang Realm.

If this world destroying immortal formation could no longer be activated, Li Fan's deterrence would be greatly weakened.

Furthermore, once the plan to elevate the Xuanhuang Realm succeeded, if he lacked the ability to overturn the table, he would immediately fall into an extremely passive position.

The phantom Wooden Sword flickered.

Li Fan arrived within the Darkest Star Sea and began his experiment.

With a gentle point of his finger, countless golden threads instantly appeared.

Like innumerable brushes, they painted profound formation nodes throughout the void.

The All Things Return to Void Formation used for this experiment covered only an area roughly one zhang in radius.

Accordingly, the required consumption of source power essence was not particularly great.

As more and more details of the formation were completed, the world destroying immortal formation gradually took shape.

Simplifying an immortal formation did not mean reducing its quality or destructive power.

Rather, by making carefully calculated sacrifices, it allowed forms of mortal energy to activate an immortal formation.

Golden light spread everywhere.

The instant the formation was completed, every trace of light vanished completely.

Sensing the terrifying destructive force concealed within the pitch black region ahead, Li Fan silently layered a phantom sword barrier around himself.

Only after ensuring no accidents could occur did he retrieve a black starstone and toss it toward the All Things Return to Void Formation.

This black starstone was one of the treasures Li Fan had taken from the first level of the Xuan Immortal Ark's hidden treasury before departing.

It had formed from the indestructible impurities left behind after the destruction of an entire cultivation world.

It was essentially the physical manifestation of a world's ghost.

The fact that it had survived the power of a True Immortal was enough to demonstrate just how incomparably hard this black stone truly was.

After the black stone entered the Grand Formation of All Things Return to Nothingness, it was as if it were being struck simultaneously by countless sharp carving blades.

Distinct gouges instantly appeared across the surface of the black stone.

The carving marks appeared faster and faster.

With a muffled pop, the black stone split apart, sliced into pieces by the Immortal-grade formation.

However, the world destroying storm did not weaken in the slightest.

It continued to rage violently.

Those tiny fragments were cut smaller and smaller until they were nearly invisible to the naked eye.

"Compared to the world destroying Immortal-grade formation from my previous life, its power has indeed weakened."

"But since it is driven by source power essence, this level of power is already more than acceptable."

After completing the test, Li Fan immediately deactivated the formation. He then collected the black stone fragments, which had already been reduced to grains no larger than fine sand.

"Such an excellent forging material cannot be wasted. It can withstand True Immortal power for a short time. At critical moments, it is something capable of saving one's life."

Next, Li Fan conducted downgraded verification tests on the other Immortal-grade formations he had mastered, such as the Desolate Fall, Flowers Bloom in an Empty Room formation.

Without exception, every single one was successfully completed.

The Immortal-grade formations that had previously existed only in the Final Dissociation Disc's theoretical deductions could finally manifest in reality before Li Fan had truly mastered the power of a True Immortal.

Naturally, he was delighted.

After quietly savoring the profound mysteries of the Immortal-grade formations for a while, Li Fan immediately returned to the Xuanhuang Realm.

He quietly began arranging formations throughout every corner of the world that had yet to undergo ascension.

With Li Fan's current attainment in formations, coupled with the assistance of the Final Dissociation Disc, even without the help of the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, deploying formations was no longer particularly difficult.

The true limitation lay in the supply of raw materials and source power essence.

Although the number of You Clansmen in this life had already accumulated to a considerable level, their production of source power essence was still insufficient to satisfy Li Fan's needs in every aspect.

He had to reserve part of it for unexpected emergencies.

Once his accumulated supply was exhausted, Li Fan could only wait for the You Clansmen to produce more source power essence before slowly continuing the deployment of his formations.

During this period, Li Fan did not forget to proactively inquire about Mo Rubin, who was still beneath the High Wall comprehending that tiny flaw.

"Brother Mo, thirty days have already passed. Have you gained anything?"

Only after a long while did Mo Rubin's reply slowly arrive.

"Not yet... However, I feel that true comprehension is not far away."

"Brother Mo, you previously promised that if there were no results within thirty days, you would immediately turn back and never look into the secrets of the High Wall again." Li Fan sighed as he reminded him.

Mo Rubin remained silent for a while.

Then, almost obsessively, he declared with absolute conviction, "Give me another thirty days. I am only one step away now. If I leave at this moment, I fear I will regret it for the rest of my life. Just thirty more days."

"After thirty days, I... I will definitely make a decision."

Mo Rubin gave no further response.

Li Fan smiled faintly.

To Mo Rubin, the secrets of the High Wall were like the murals on Hero Island were to the martial artists.

Their attraction even surpassed the value of his own life.

It simply was not something that could easily be abandoned.

Even if Li Fan asked again thirty days later, he would undoubtedly receive exactly the same answer.

"If not for that strange black mist vortex appearing in the center of the Star Sea, Mo Rubin probably would never have imposed even this thirty day limit upon himself."

Thinking of that mysterious black mist, a trace of gloom flashed across Li Fan's eyes.

He had already guessed that the appearance of the black mist was most likely related to his reckless use of the Ascension Formation.

However, Li Fan had already revisited every location where he had previously used the Ascension Formation.

Not every location had produced black mist.

Li Fan speculated that it was probably closely related to whatever had fallen from "above."

"It is much like water splashing upward when something falls into its surface. Only when the object sinking beneath the water reaches a certain size will the splash become obvious."

"My own shortcut, falling from a higher level of momentum, is insignificant."

"But if an entire world..."

"The force of its fall would be sufficient to generate black mist."

"The center of the Star Sea, however, is an exception. Perhaps it has something to do with the unique nature of that particular surface."

Li Fan silently pondered.

He had already observed the rate at which the black mist spread throughout the Star Sea.

He confirmed that before he completed his Xuanhuang Realm Ascension Plan in this life, the black mist would have no impact whatsoever upon the Xuanhuang Realm.

Therefore, leaving it alone for the time being would not cause any serious problems.

"The only real concern is that if the amount of black mist increases further, it may alarm the Enlightenment True Immortal within the Immortal Ruins."

The facts had already proven that the True Immortal was not completely indifferent to changes in the outside world.

If something appeared that affected or even threatened It, It would certainly emerge from Its state of Dao Enlightenment.

The previous reincarnation, when It was disturbed by the Medicine King Cauldron and the Grand Formation of All Things Return to Void, was the clearest proof.

"The omen of the Dao Annihilation Calamity approaching?"

Li Fan softly repeated Mo Rubin's speculation regarding the black mist.

His divine sense, however, focused upon a mass of black mist sealed within golden light inside his own body.

It was precisely the black mist obtained after he used the White Ring Descends into Mortal World to decompose the flesh of the True Immortal.

The level of power contained within this black mist was clearly not on the same level as the black mist generated by falling after ascension.

Yet it still caused Li Fan's heart to race with unease.

"What exactly gave rise to the Dao Annihilation Calamity that destroyed the Immortal Realm all those years ago?"

Naturally, this was not something Li Fan needed to concern himself with at present.

Yet as his strength continued to grow, it had become a reality from which he could no longer escape.

Li Fan's ascension and subsequent fall were absolutely not the fundamental cause behind the birth of the black mist. At most, they merely served as a fuse, prematurely triggering the world destroying calamity hidden beneath the seemingly tranquil surface.

Li Fan was convinced that even if he had not acted as he did in this life, the lower realm Star Sea would eventually follow in the footsteps of the former Immortal Realm.

"It truly presses forward at every step, leaving no room to breathe."

"To attain true eternal freedom and longevity is unimaginably difficult."

For now, Li Fan had no means of resisting the black mist. He merely let out a cold snort and firmly engraved its existence into his memory.

It took nearly an entire month before Li Fan finally completed the deployment of the Grand Formation of All Things Return to Void in this life.

The formation's veins quietly lay hidden beneath the land of the Xuanhuang Realm.

After the source power essence merged into one, as long as the formation remained inactive, no living being within the world could detect its existence.

The instant the formation was completed, only a tiny handful of living beings within the Xuanhuang Realm suddenly felt an overwhelming sense of impending catastrophe.

But the feeling disappeared almost immediately.

As though it had merely been an illusion.

Even the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm only vaguely sensed Li Fan's actions and was far from certain.

This could be seen from the fact that the Heavenly Dao's favorability toward Li Fan barely declined.

Li Fan's eyes remained utterly devoid of emotion as he watched the countless living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm recover from fear and return to calm.

"Sometimes, people really should trust their instincts."

After quietly uttering those words, Li Fan was about to return to Great Qi when his gaze suddenly settled upon one of the living beings within the Xuanhuang Realm.

This person was no stranger to Li Fan.

It was Zhang Haobo.

At the beginning of the reincarnation, Li Fan had interacted with him and He Zhenghao for a time.

However, as Li Fan's strength continued to rise, people like them had gradually faded from his attention.

This time, it was merely a casual glance after completing the formation before departing.

Yet it was precisely this casual glance that caused Li Fan to become interested in Zhang Haobo once again.

In this life, Li Fan had habitually begun deploying the Immortal Descends Formation and the Grand Formation of All Things Return to Void from the familiar Congyun Sea.

A month ago, when he first began arranging the formations, Zhang Haobo was still an ordinary mortal living on Liuli Island in the Congyun Sea.

Yet now, after only a month had passed, Zhang Haobo had already brought his entire family away from the Congyun Sea.

"Has the Crimson Flame Scorching the Sea arrived ahead of schedule?" Li Fan was slightly startled.

He calculated with his fingers, yet discovered no sign that the sea scorching calamity had advanced.

"Then why did he leave?"

Li Fan could not help becoming intrigued. His divine sense immediately locked onto Zhang Haobo.

After escaping the Congyun Sea, he discovered that he still could not eat or sleep in peace. From the way he spoke, it seemed he still wanted to take everyone and continue fleeing.

However, the entire family was already utterly exhausted. Under their unanimous opposition, Zhang Haobo finally compromised and abandoned the idea.

Even so, he still looked deeply worried. From time to time, he would look up at the sky, seemingly anxious about something unknown.

Naturally, his family could not understand this behavior.

Day after day, Zhang Haobo remained gloomy and troubled.

Perhaps in the entire Xuanhuang Realm, the only person who understood the source of his anxiety was Li Fan.

"So he can actually sense the world ending killing intent I laid down?"

Li Fan's expression turned absent-minded, as though he had returned to many years ago, when Zhang Haobo, then still a fisherman, had told him about the calamity that befell the Congyun Sea before fleeing with his entire family.

Li Fan gently waved his hand.

Zhang Haobo instantly appeared before him, frozen in place like an ice sculpture.

If Zhang Haobo's ability to sense the disaster in the Congyun Sea had merely been the intuition of a fisherman, then the fact that he could vaguely sense the impending destruction after the Grand Formation of All Things Return to Void had already been completed was definitely no ordinary matter.

"Could it be that this old acquaintance of mine has been hiding some secret all along?"

Li Fan's divine sense swept across Zhang Haobo's body in an instant.

He was still an ordinary mortal who had never cultivated. There was no possibility of concealing anything from Li Fan.

Inside Zhang Haobo's brain, almost completely fused with his brain tissue, was a shimmering mirror fragment.

It was only about one third the size of a fingernail.

The aura emanating from it was not unfamiliar to Li Fan.

"This is..."

"A fragment of the Boundless Mirror?"

After examining it carefully, Li Fan immediately understood the reason.

The Boundless Mirror spirit, Sun Luyao, had once mentioned that there were still scattered fragments of the Boundless Mirror remaining throughout the Xuanhuang Realm.

In his previous life, they had searched together and recovered most of them.

Yet a number still remained undiscovered. They had perhaps already been absorbed by the Xuanhuang Realm itself and entered the cycle of reincarnation of Heaven and Earth Wonders.

The reason Zhang Haobo possessed such extraordinary premonitions was precisely because of one of these Boundless Mirror fragments.

The Boundless Mirror possessed the ability to deduce the future. Accordingly, Zhang Haobo had also gained the ability to sense approaching disasters.

"A single fragment can actually detect the grand formation I laid down?" Li Fan frowned.

He removed the mirror fragment, held it in his palm, and carefully examined it.

"So that is the reason. This fragment serves as the core component of the Boundless Mirror responsible for external perception and gathering information. It is even more sensitive than the Boundless Mirror's main body that Sun Luyao recovered."

"As an immortal artifact, being able to sense an Immortal Formation is only natural."

Li Fan looked toward the motionless Zhang Haobo standing nearby.

"Unfortunately, this immortal artifact fragment is simply too small."

"When Zhang Haobo was still a mortal, this immortal artifact fragment could influence him."

"But once he embarked upon cultivation, especially after reaching the Foundation Establishment realm and obtaining his own Foundation Establishment Wonder, the influence of this fragment was instead weakened."

"It probably even felt some resentment and desire for revenge toward Zhang Haobo. Instead of merging with its own immortal artifact fragment, he had chosen to merge with another Heaven and Earth Wonder."

Li Fan smiled faintly.

Within his palm, the Xuanhuang World Destruction Transformation unfolded.

Time flowed, ages passed, seas became mulberry fields.

The mirror fragment seemed to sense something. It flashed continuously, its light flickering more and more rapidly.

But now that it had fallen into Li Fan's hands, how could it possibly escape?

As time flowed like the alternating brilliance of sunrise and sunset, the mirror fragment dissolved into countless streams of light.

Scattered by the wind, they disappeared into Heaven and Earth.

Just like its main body, it met the same fate.

Li Fan used it as nourishment to feed the Xuanhuang Realm.

Feeling that the Xuanhuang Realm's favorability, which had slightly declined due to the deployment of the grand formation, had now fully recovered, Li Fan nodded in satisfaction.

With another wave of his hand, he returned Zhang Haobo to his original place.

Without the Boundless Mirror fragment hidden within his mind causing trouble, the endless anxiety that had plagued him would disappear forever.

From this day onward, he would live peacefully with his family upon the lands of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Whether that was a blessing, or a misfortune, no one could truly say.

This incident involving Zhang Haobo did, however, remind Li Fan of something.

Although the Immortal Formation had already been completed, making it impossible for the living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm to perceive it, immortal artifacts such as the Tianxuan Mirror, even if they could not directly sense the Immortal Formation itself, might still detect the crisis brought about by it.

"I should take one more precaution."

"But there is no need to worry too much. Even if they sense it, what can they actually do?"

A trace of disdain flashed across Li Fan's eyes.

"If they truly dare to jump out..."

"Then I will simply burn every last one of them into nourishment for the Xuanhuang Realm!"

Now that Li Fan had mastered the method of downgrading Immortal Formations and could deploy them whenever he wished, he indeed had the qualifications to say such words.

"And besides..."

Li Fan's gaze once again swept across the countless living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm that had flashed before his eyes earlier.

His attention focused especially on those who, despite the Immortal Formation remaining concealed, could still vaguely sense the Grand Formation of All Things Return to Void.

After a careful inspection, he really did discover several beings who were still in the process of assimilating fragments of immortal artifacts.

They had all reached the final stage of the world's assimilation process, with only a very small portion remaining.

To Li Fan, they were all useless.

So he simply fed every one of them to the Xuanhuang Realm.

Afterward, he inspected the surroundings once more.

In the end, there were no further discoveries.

Li Fan slowly withdrew his gaze.

"It seems that within the Xuanhuang Realm, very few useful secrets still remain hidden from me."

"As for the ones that are left..."

"I will have to wait until I advance with the Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth before I can explore them." Li Fan could not help but sigh softly.

While preparing for the Xuanhuang Realm's ascension, Li Fan also had no missions to carry out on the Xuan Immortal Ark's side.

He first used the ritual to designate a small world with a population of thirty million as his completed assignment.

Then Li Fan temporarily paused.

Because he sensed that Wuming of the Thirteen Peaks World was about to be born into the world.

With a thought, the scene within that small world instantly appeared before his eyes.

Having already completed his fusion with the Heavenly Dao of the small world, Wuming joyfully descended the mountain.

After bidding farewell one by one to the few remaining relatives in that world, Wuming took a single step and left the Thirteen Peaks World.

What appeared before him was a herd of more than a hundred World Rift Whales swimming through the dark void.

The World Rift Whales traveled together in great groups, playfully opening paths through the void.

This magnificent and awe inspiring scene deeply captivated the heart of Wuming, who had never seen anything beyond mountains and rivers.

Only after many days had passed did he finally recover from his daze.

Then, with some reluctance, he slowly walked toward the Xuanhuang Realm.

Strictly speaking, Wuming had not yet embarked upon the path of cultivation. He was merely a frail mortal.

However, having fused with the Heavenly Dao of a small world, he was no ordinary powerless mortal.

With the guidance Li Fan had secretly arranged beforehand, the Immortal Severing Grand Formation naturally could not trap Wuming.

Step by step, just like Li Fan in the past, Wuming broke through layer after layer of formations.

At last, he descended into the Xuanhuang Realm.

A vast sky.

White mist stretching endlessly across heaven and earth.

The blazing sun.

A gentle breeze drifting through the world.

Feeling scenery that far surpassed everything he had ever known, Wuming became completely immersed in it.

He stood there motionless for a long time.

Just as he had once quietly lain atop the mountain, comprehending the Heavenly Dao of his own world.

A profound and mysterious aura emerged from Wuming's body.

In the blink of an eye, he successfully drew Qi into his body and stepped into the Qi Condensation realm.

His aura continued to rise.

But suddenly, it was as if a rushing river had struck a great dam.

It came to an abrupt halt.

Wuming, who had been quietly comprehending with his eyes closed, slowly opened them, his face filled with confusion.

When he raised his head toward the heavens once again, he immediately saw the countless shackles that the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor had left within this world.

Had this been the past, like Mr. Bai, he could have stepped directly into Soul Transformation.

But now, the era had already changed.

Even so, Wuming did not become discouraged.

Like Heavenly Dao Bai whom Li Fan had once summoned, he followed the cultivation rules that now governed the Xuanhuang Realm.

He began wandering across the Xuanhuang Realm, searching for the materials required for cultivation.

Wuming stretched out his hand and felt the wind blowing across the Xuanhuang Realm.

Searching for the heavenly treasures needed to break through to Foundation Establishment.

He remained motionless for a long time.

Then he suddenly opened his eyes and began walking forward.

...

"So he did not immediately begin the ritual to enter the Fallen Immortal Realm. Instead, he chose cultivation first." Li Fan watched Wuming's every movement from the shadows and commented with great interest.

Li Fan was not worried that Wuming's actions would interfere with his plans.

Because he had already sensed that the suggestion he left behind was still taking effect.

"It is simply that, because it is only a suggestion, compared to someone like Sun Tianci who acts like a puppet, his subjective initiative is much stronger."

"If he wishes to cultivate, then let him cultivate."

"The Path to Immortality lies ahead, yet it cannot be trodden. for the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor stands above. No matter how extraordinary one's talent, no one can surpass the Immortal Ancestor through cultivation."

"Even if the Immortal Ancestor personally arrived, he would still have to sit down and negotiate with me."

Although he said this, Li Fan still separated a simulated personality to constantly monitor Wuming's every action.

The plans for this life could not be allowed to fail.

Shifting his attention away from Wuming, he looked once more at the Silver Eye before him, which behaved like a pet.

During this period, after being fed an enormous number of World Heavenly Mandate fragments, this simulated Heavenly Mandate that Li Fan had personally created seemed to be approaching its final transformation.

Its aura surged unpredictably.

The eyeball itself spun continuously, yet its center always remained fixed upon Li Fan.

After some thought, Li Fan carefully selected the World Heavenly Mandate of another medium sized small world.

He fed it to the silver eye.

A ray of light immediately burst forth from it.
