Chapter 1358: The Immortal Puppet Finally Descends Into The World

The burst of light erupted so suddenly and brilliantly that even Li Fan instinctively narrowed his eyes.

What Li Fan sensed was not merely the radiance itself. Rather, it was a mysterious rhythm that descended from nowhere and gathered upon the Silver Eye.

Li Fan had witnessed something similar during his past reincarnations.

It was exactly the same as the phenomenon that appeared from the vortex beyond the heavens whenever a small world underwent ascension.

However, the rhythm now appearing upon the Silver Eye was far more powerful and far more unfathomable.

Even with Li Fan's current cultivation and understanding of the Great Dao, he was unable to comprehend its true essence.

Enveloped by this rhythm, it was as though an invisible brush was rapidly painting upon the Silver Eye, adding countless intricate details.

Although it was still the very same eye, in Li Fan's eyes as its creator, it became increasingly "alive."

By the end, even Li Fan himself, the creator of the Eye, felt a sense of unfamiliarity toward his own creation.

Once this vitality reached its peak within the evolving Silver Eye, it began spreading throughout the Great Qi small world.

A spring breeze swept across the earth. Gentle thunder rumbled. A light rain nourished all things without a sound.

The power of "ascension" quietly nurtured every inch of the Great Qi small world.

Even after Li Fan had already used the power of [Creation] and the transformations of heaven and earth to push this small world through one evolution, this new force was still capable of elevating it even further.

"This is true power of Creation. It is not driven by the True Immortal seal script character of Creation."

"It is a natural phenomenon produced by the circulation of the Great Dao itself."

"It is the very law described by the True Immortal seal script character of Creation."

"Or perhaps only a portion of it. It will be of tremendous use when I elevate the Xuanhuang Realm in this lifetime."

Li Fan stared fixedly at everything unfolding within the Great Qi small world, trying to engrave every detail into his memory.

The rhythm of Creation lasted for less than ten breaths from its descent until its disappearance.

Within the entire small world, only Li Fan could perceive this transformation of heaven and earth.

When the surging rhythm finally subsided, the changes it had brought continued endlessly, unfolding throughout the world without any of its inhabitants noticing.

Li Fan immersed himself in what he had just witnessed, savoring it endlessly.

After calming himself, he looked once more toward the simulated Heavenly Mandate embodied by the Silver Eye and immediately noticed its transformation.

Unlike before, when it would occasionally stare at him in an almost flattering manner.

Now, for most of the time, the eye remained closed. Only occasionally would it open, and when it did, its gaze was no longer fixed upon Li Fan but upon the various happenings throughout the Great Qi small world below.

It seemed that even Li Fan, its creator, was no longer so important to it.

"Interesting..."

Its newfound unruliness instead piqued Li Fan's interest. After a thorough examination, he confirmed that this simulated Heavenly Mandate still remained entirely under his control.

It was simply that, after devouring so many Heavenly Mandate from small worlds, the eye had naturally gained an additional sense of purpose.

The purpose of maintaining the normal operation of the small world.

The priority of this mission ranked only beneath Li Fan's authority over it.

Thus, whenever Li Fan issued no commands, the Silver Eye instinctively operated in the manner of a world's Heavenly Dao.

Compared to its previous state as merely a simulated Heavenly Mandate, it was now far closer to a naturally born world's Heavenly Dao.

Or rather, the Silver Eye had truly become the Heavenly Dao of this small world.

It had completed the transformation from "simulated" to "real."

Moreover, the Heavenly Dao embodied by the Silver Eye had already surpassed the level of an ordinary small world.

As a result, the world itself had also undergone further transformation.

"If my previous use of the Creation seal script character and immortal spiritual power to elevate the world was a crude external modification forced from the outside."

"Then what has occurred to the Silver Eye is a silent transformation that gradually changes the world from within."

"Both methods can ultimately achieve the same goal. However, the latter is clearly far more ingenious."

A thoughtful expression appeared in Li Fan's eyes.

While comprehending the entire process, he simultaneously revised and improved his plans for elevating the Xuanhuang Realm in this lifetime.

"World ascension can essentially be regarded as the process of climbing toward a higher realm."

"The method of forcing it from the outside relies upon external strength dragging the world upward. Once that external force disappears, the world risks falling instantly. Without some means of anchoring it, the entire world would shatter upon impact."

"The method of growing from within relies upon the world's own foundation, advancing steadily step by step. There is no danger of collapse."

"But the drawback is that the process is simply too slow. It often requires millions of years. I cannot afford to wait."

A flash of understanding appeared in Li Fan's eyes.

"However, perhaps I can employ both methods simultaneously."

His divine sense entered the Silver Eye.

The entire process through which the simulated Heavenly Mandate had transformed unfolded within Li Fan's mind.

Combined with his previous external observations, the two perspectives verified each other. In only a short time, Li Fan gained tremendous insight.

"It seems that the optimal method for elevating the Xuanhuang Realm is actually to create a Heavenly Mandate and replace the original."

"But with my current means, imitating the Heavenly Mandate of a small world is still possible."

"As for creating the Heavenly Mandate of the Xuanhuang Realm..."

Li Fan slowly shook his head.

The reason was not merely because the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm had devoured countless cultivation worlds over the past ten thousand years.

More importantly, the new cultivation system of the Immortal Ancestor, which defied natural law, had bound every Longevity Immortal Realm cultivator to the Xuanhuang Realm itself.

To destroy the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm and replace it with a simulated Heavenly Mandate would require slaughtering every one of those Longevity Immortal Realm cultivators at the same time.

Not to mention the Immortal Ancestor. The Carefree Heavenly Sovereign who controlled the Carefree Paradise had survived even the World Destruction Immortal Formation.

Li Fan currently possessed no means of killing such an existence.

"However, over these past ten thousand years, the Heavenly Doctor and the Immortal Ancestor have been patching together the Xuanhuang Realm using the corpses of other worlds."

"They have actually been using the second method, nurturing the Xuanhuang Realm from within."

"Feeding other worlds to the Xuanhuang Realm."

"As expected, the Heavenly Doctor's objective has never been merely to revive the Heavenly Law Realm by borrowing another world's corpse."

"He also intends to push the resurrected Heavenly Law Realm one step further, allowing it to advance toward the Immortal Realm itself."

"This is exactly what was once mentioned in the Mending Heavens Record."

"Breaking free from the cocoon and ascending through metamorphosis."

A cold light flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

"Unfortunately..."

"Everything they have prepared is destined to become my wedding garment."

His consciousness instantly focused upon the fragment of the Immortal Realm hidden deep within his body, formed from the fusion of six Go pieces.

"If one speaks of devouring..."

"Even countless lower worlds combined cannot compare to a complete Immortal Realm."

"So long as the final Go piece returns from beyond the heavens, the entire Immortal Realm fragment should finally become complete."

"Then, when the Xuanhuang Realm undergoes ascension, I will merge it into the process."

"I shall be the one in control."

His thoughts raced as he deduced every possible source of interference.

"The preparations are already nearly complete."

"What remains now is to determine how to prevent the ascension process from being interrupted."

"The Heavenly Doctor and the Immortal Ancestor will certainly return from the Star Sea."

"That True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins may also awaken once more."

"And then..."

"The Grand Mage of Heavenly Capital."

"The Faceless Immortal."

Every one of these names had once been enough to force Li Fan to immediately begin another reincarnation.

Yet now, he was already planning how to hold them back.

...

Half a month later.

A disturbance originating from the Xuanhuang Realm awakened Li Fan from his contemplation.

It came from the mark he had previously left beside Tianyang's puppet body.

In this lifetime, because he had secretly advanced the ascension of the Xuanhuang Realm, as heaven expanded and earth broadened, certain hidden things within the Xuanhuang Realm also quietly evolved alongside it.

For example, the ancient mutated Immortal Mortal Miasma hidden beneath the underground cavern of Qiling Prefecture.

Or Tianyang, whose puppet body lay buried beneath the Congyun Sea, continuously tempered by the Earthfire Return to Origin Formation.

The power of the earthfire was now far more violent than it had been in the previous lifetime.

As a result, Tianyang faintly showed signs of awakening ahead of schedule.

Li Fan instantly appeared beneath the Congyun Sea.

Looking at the puppet body buried beneath the earth, he recalled the scene from his previous lifetime when Tianyang's puppet had single-handedly stood against the Immortal Ancestor.

Although it had possessed almost no ability to fight back, it had remained firmly standing before the Immortal Ancestor until the very end.

"Tianyang is indeed a valuable helper."

"In the previous lifetime, the Immortal Ancestor beat you far too badly."

"In this lifetime..."

"I will help you reclaim your honor."

Li Fan's divine sense instantly passed through the blazing earthfire and reached Tianyang's puppet body buried deep underground.

Because Tianyang was now awakening naturally from a perfect state, rather than being forcibly disturbed, the remaining fragment of his consciousness was no longer as irritable as before.

He did not immediately declare, "Tianyang Life Is Inferior To No One."

Instead, he merely felt confused after awakening into this new era following countless ages.

"Even after absorbing ten thousand years of earthfire..."

"This body is still too weak."

"At best, it has only reached the peak of Soul Transformation."

"Can it truly live up to the words, 'Inferior to no one?'"

Li Fan's voice instantly echoed throughout Tianyang's sea of consciousness.

Tianyang, who was gradually awakening from his slumber, was immediately provoked by those few words.

The earth rumbled.

Earthfire erupted violently.

The gigantic puppet body prepared to leap from the seabed.

"Tianyang Life..."

Tianyang's deep, muffled voice rumbled like distant thunder. It declared the eternal conviction that had remained unchanged and continued to shine across ten thousand years.

However, the violent emotions within him, like a volcano on the verge of eruption, instantly subsided after hearing Li Fan casually call out, "Junior Brother."

That form of address instinctively filled him with familiarity, sorrow, and guilt.

His anger vanished. Instead, he desperately wanted to confirm the identity of the one who had spoken.

"Your Senior Brother will lend you a hand!"

Li Fan's indistinct figure suddenly descended.

"Nine Heavens..."

"Descending Mortal Finger!"

As Li Fan spoke softly, the entire Congyun Sea seemed to fall silent in an instant. Its surface became as smooth as a flawless mirror, without the slightest ripple.

A single finger slowly descended from the heavens.

Though it was only one slender finger, it possessed a might that blotted out the sky.

It descended with perfect precision, pressing down upon Tianyang's enormous puppet body.

After ten thousand years of refinement within the earthfire, Tianyang's puppet body had long surpassed the limits of any heavenly treasure.

Yet beneath Li Fan's single finger, every component of the puppet was effortlessly crushed into powder.

Tianyang was stunned.

His unyielding will froze, then began to dissipate completely into heaven and earth.

At that moment, the voice of his master, Guang Yangzi, seemed to echo gently through his fading consciousness.

'Transform the body into an object. Cross through eternity!'

Appearing together with that voice was a body tightly bound by countless golden chains.

When Tianyang looked upon that body, it was as though he were seeing his former self.

"Go, Tianyang."

"Become the strongest being in this world!"

Master Guang Yangzi's aged voice echoed without end.

Tianyang's remaining consciousness instinctively drifted toward that body.

At the same time, he unconsciously circulated the Body Transformation Embodiment, Freedom Beyond Self cultivation technique that had long since been engraved into the depths of his instincts.

There was almost no resistance.

Tianyang successfully attached himself to that body. At the same time, he discovered another consciousness inside it.

It shared the same origin as himself, yet possessed no independent awareness.

Without requiring any control, that mass of consciousness voluntarily approached him, nourishing his consciousness that was on the verge of collapse.

For a brief moment, Tianyang seemed to witness everything that had happened within the Body Transformation Dao all those years ago.

His long-sealed memories surged back.

A nameless fire was reborn from the ashes.

Tianyang once again roared the words that had accompanied him throughout his life.

"TIANYANG'S Life!"

"Is Inferior To No One!"

His thoughts and will became one.

His remaining consciousness completely stabilized within this new body. Tianyang soon realized that this body was less a fleshly body and more a puppet.

A puppet forged from an extraordinary metal fused together with flesh containing terrifying and unknown energy.

"Master was right. This puppet body is far stronger than the one I forged with earthfire before."

"Master... I truly am still this useless."

A trace of guilt flashed through his heart.

Then Tianyang's final remaining consciousness quietly merged into the flesh puppet.

...

The instant Tianyang's consciousness transferred into the flesh puppet, Li Fan immediately brought both of them into the Great Qi Minor World.

The upgraded simulated Heavenly Mandate, together with countless immortal formations that were deployed in an instant, completely sealed away the flesh puppet.

Even Li Fan had to temporarily avoid its edge.

The aura surging from the puppet was an overwhelming force that originated from True Immortal flesh, a terrifying power that far surpassed the mortal realm.

This puppet was precisely the one Li Fan had previously created using the bronze-cast immortal crane as its skeleton, attaching True Immortal flesh to it, then fusing it together with Tianyang's Eternal Remnant Will.

Until now, it possessed only flesh, without life or soul.

It had always been waiting for Tianyang to awaken.

Before handing it over this time, Li Fan had also mixed a large amount of black starstone powder into it.

Simply judging by the hardness of this puppet body alone, it could probably completely ignore the terrifying attraction of the Immortal Ruins and walk through them with its physical body alone.

Tianyang's consciousness slowly merged with the True Immortal flesh puppet.

From a distance, Li Fan carefully observed the constantly changing expressions upon the puppet's face.

"With the support of the Eternal Remnant Will, it should be able to endure without being completely corrupted by the power contained within the True Immortal flesh."

"But after all, he is merely a mortal. When resisting immortal power, not much of his consciousness will ultimately remain."

"Just like the previous Tianyang puppet, he will only act instinctively in a vague manner."

"With my previously forged identity as Guang Yangzi, that is enough to make him obey every command."

"But this puppet is far stronger than the original Tianyang puppet."

Li Fan watched the changes taking place within the Immortal Puppet with great satisfaction.

The bronze-cast immortal crane originated from the hidden treasury of the Immortal Ark. According to its records, it had been forged from fragments of an immortal artifact.

The True Immortal flesh had been reconstructed by Li Fan from the True Immortal skeletal hand using the [Ancient] Character Art.

The black starstone powder consisted of the smallest fragments left behind after the remains of destroyed worlds had been sliced apart by an Immortal World Destruction Formation.

All three materials were capable of contending against immortal power.

Afterward, they were fused together with Tianyang's Eternal Remnant Will.

The puppet before Li Fan truly deserved to be called an [Immortal Puppet].

Previously, the True Immortal flesh had merely adhered to the bronze skeleton.

After Tianyang's consciousness merged into it, it seemed to gain a central will.

Countless tiny roots sprouted from the flesh and penetrated deep into the bronze skeleton.

Bone and flesh completely fused into one.

Within the sea of consciousness, Tianyang's Eternal Remnant Will shone like an indestructible diamond.

The puppet's appearance became increasingly vivid and lifelike.

Its surging aura gradually calmed.

The reborn Tianyang stood silently in place. His eyes remained tightly closed.

Li Fan did not remove the protection of the immortal formations.

Instead, using his identity as Guang Yangzi of the Body Transformation Dao, he attempted to issue Tianyang a command.

As expected, Tianyang obeyed without hesitation.

Unfortunately, just as Li Fan had anticipated, Tianyang's independent consciousness had suffered severe losses while merging with and resisting the True Immortal flesh.

Far less instinct remained than Li Fan had originally expected.

"What a pity."

"Still, now that I have gained experience in this life, during the next reincarnation I can further strengthen Tianyang's consciousness before beginning the fusion."

Bringing the Tianyang Immortal Puppet with him, Li Fan headed toward the depths of the Star Sea.

He began testing the strength of the Immortal Puppet's body.

His first attack was a Great Five Elements Annihilation Sword.

It was a divine ability Li Fan had personally comprehended, though he had not used it for a long time after coming into contact with near-immortal power.

The black light that once seemed capable of annihilating all things struck Tianyang's Immortal Puppet.

It failed to leave even the faintest scratch.

Li Fan raised an eyebrow.

The next moment, countless black sword lights poured down like rain.

They completely surrounded Tianyang's Immortal Puppet.

Yet despite the overwhelming momentum, the attack did not even trigger Tianyang's instinctive self-defense.

Tianyang stood motionless, allowing the countless black sword lights to bombard his body.

It was as though he were not facing a deadly attack at all, but merely a gentle breeze.

After a long while, Li Fan nodded in satisfaction and finally ceased activating the Five Elements Annihilation Sword.

"The Immortal Puppet's body has indeed reached the point where all mortal powers are completely ineffective against it."

"But..."

"That does not mean my Great Five Elements Annihilation Sword has become useless."

"The circulation of the Five Elements, advancing without retreat and annihilating everything. The intent behind this divine ability is by no means inferior. It is simply that when facing immortal-level existences, relying solely on the essence of the Five Elements to achieve annihilation is still far too weak."

Li Fan fell into thought.

"But if I could merge it with the Transformation of [Truth Is Also False]..."

Li Fan raised a finger, intending to slash toward the distant starry sky.

Yet after pondering for a long time, he never brought his finger down.

"My comprehension is still too shallow."

"Being able to incorporate it into movement techniques is already the limit."

"If I wish to use it to kill..."

"I will probably need another two or three reincarnations."

"Or perhaps the assistance of that miraculous object capable of allowing [Truth] to perform reincarnation simulations on its own."

Li Fan gently shook his head.

His thoughts settled, and he slowly lowered his finger.

Then he resumed testing the Tianyang Immortal Puppet.

The next test would be the power of the various True Immortal seal script characters.

Using source power essence as ink, Li Fan unleashed everything he had learned.

The Immortal formation sealed the surrounding area, preventing the energy fluctuations from leaking out.

Layers upon layers of True Immortal power descended upon the Tianyang Immortal Puppet.

Only when faced with pseudo Immortal level destructive power did the Tianyang Immortal Puppet finally react.

The True Immortal flesh swelled and contracted like a bellows, releasing an invisible force field.

It isolated all the effects brought about by the True Immortal seal script characters.

This was not because Li Fan had ordered Tianyang to do so.

It was entirely the Tianyang Immortal Puppet's instinctive response to danger.

Li Fan sensed the invisible force field, and his pupils suddenly contracted.

Yet he never stopped activating the True Immortal seal script characters in his hand.

One after another, the powers of the True Immortal laws were absorbed and neutralized the moment they approached the force field.

The storm of True Immortal seal script characters was like a violent gale.

It merely caused the Tianyang Immortal Puppet's robes to flutter.

Not the slightest damage was inflicted.

"So this is the power of a True Immortal?"

"And this is only the instinctive defense of True Immortal flesh..."

A brilliant light flashed in Li Fan's eyes. He wished to comprehend and study this invisible True Immortal force field.

To his disappointment, however, the force field was exactly like the flaw in the High Wall.

It clearly existed.

It was clearly right before his eyes.

Yet he still could not touch it. It was invisible and unknowable.

A scene suddenly appeared before Li Fan.

A mighty eagle soared through the sky, looking down upon its prey on the ground. Stretching out its sharp talons, it dived rapidly.

Just as it was about to seize its prey, it crashed headfirst into an invisible pane of protective glass.

The eagle became dizzy and disoriented before finally regaining its balance.

It clawed desperately at the transparent barrier before it, unable to understand why, despite the prey being right before its eyes, it could not move even a single inch closer.

It could not comprehend the existence of glass.

Just as the current Li Fan could not comprehend the existence of the High Wall or this force field.

"The power of a True Immortal is still beyond my reach."

"But as the saying goes, a gentleman excels not because he is different, but because he knows how to make use of external things. Being able to temporarily wield it through the Tianyang Immortal Puppet is already sufficient."

"With this, even when facing the Immortal Ark, I now possess the ability to overturn the table."

Li Fan stopped wasting his efforts.

He began his final attempt.

With a solemn expression, he softly chanted, "The will of the Nine Heavens soaring through the clouds. A True Immortal descends into the mortal world!"

Once again, he executed the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger.

This time, however, he went all out.

Burning a mass of True Immortal flesh, and empowered by the Ascension Formation, Li Fan's perspective rose rapidly.

In an instant, it felt as though he stood atop the Star Sea itself.

The High Wall seemed to lie just ahead.

Meanwhile, the Tianyang Immortal Puppet before him possessed the word "Immortal" in its name.

Yet it only possessed Immortal flesh, not Immortal spiritual power.

Thus, it still remained beneath the mortal world.

From Li Fan's elevated perspective, the Tianyang Immortal Puppet had become as insignificant as an ant.

The caution and vigilance he had previously felt completely vanished.

Within his heart arose the feeling of a True Immortal seated high above the heavens, gazing down upon the countless living beings below.

Locking onto the Tianyang Immortal Puppet, his face filled with arrogance, he pressed down with a single finger.

Boom!

A terrifying storm erupted within the sealed Immortal formation.

The lofty will that crushed all living beings, combined with the overwhelming momentum of descending from the highest heavens, manifested as a gigantic phantom index finger.

Originally no larger than a soybean, it instantly expanded until it resembled a collapsing sky.

Like the heavens themselves falling, it came crashing down.

Faced with such an overwhelming divine ability, the Tianyang Immortal Puppet instinctively sensed a trace of danger.

Its eyes shone with crimson light.

It raised one hand and held up the heavens.

Li Fan let out a muffled groan.

His finger felt as though it had struck an indestructible mountain. It trembled violently before finally being unable to advance even another inch.

Fortunately, the Tianyang Immortal Puppet only defended instinctively and did not seize the opportunity to counterattack.

Otherwise, Li Fan would certainly have suffered severe injuries.

Li Fan did not fare well.

But after directly enduring Li Fan's strongest divine ability, the Tianyang Immortal Puppet was not in much better condition either.

After all, it was not a true Immortal Puppet, but merely a fusion of several near immortal objects.

The force of descending from such a great height directly caused portions of its True Immortal flesh to collapse.

Its bronze skeleton emitted continuous sizzling sounds, clearly having suffered an enormous impact.

Li Fan's purpose was merely to test the Tianyang Immortal Puppet's true combat strength, not to destroy it.

Seeing that it had nearly reached its limit, Li Fan finally withdrew his divine ability.

Dispelling the Ascension Formation, Li Fan slowly descended from the summit of the Star Sea back into the mortal world.

He quietly adjusted his breathing and eliminated the abnormalities within his body.

Looking at the Tianyang Immortal Puppet, Li Fan frowned slightly.

"After all, it is merely a puppet, not a true living being. It possesses no ability to repair itself."

"The True Immortal flesh consumed during battle cannot recover on its own..."

Just as Li Fan was thinking this, it seemed Tianyang sensed his thoughts.

Driven by the Eternal Remnant Will core, the True Immortal flesh attached to the bronze skeleton suddenly surged once more.

Like one giving birth to two, two giving birth to three, and three giving birth to all things.

The wounds sustained during the previous test vanished in the blink of an eye.

The battered Immortal Puppet instantly returned to its peak condition.

Witnessing this scene, Li Fan was momentarily stunned.

His thoughts recalled the earlier scene when he had used the [Ancient] Character Art to stimulate the True Immortal flesh, causing it to multiply endlessly from nothing.

He remained silent for a long time.

Only after quite a while did he sincerely sigh.

"The divine might of a True Immortal truly contains endless mysteries. It cannot be underestimated."

He then frowned.

"If not for Tianyang's Eternal Remnant Will serving as the core to suppress this mass of True Immortal flesh, even the slightest carelessness could cause the Immortal Puppet to lose control."

At the same time, Li Fan realized that it was not that the Immortal Puppet lacked the ability to repair itself.

Rather, its autonomy was simply too weak. It had no initiative to repair itself. Only after Li Fan reminded or directed it would it carry out the repair.

"The Tianyang remnant will invested within it has simply been worn down too severely."

"Its durability is more than sufficient."

"But asking it to restrain the Immortal Ancestor, the Heavenly Doctor, or even the True Immortals of the Immortal Ruins is asking too much."

"It seems that if I want it to display its greatest combat strength, I must further enhance its initiative."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

"I remember that Qiao Gong still possesses the combat experience of Ancestor, the Immortal Puppet of the Heavenly Mechanism Realm."

"Although that fellow should have been swept into the depression within the Star Sea Rift together with Xu Ke."

Li Fan turned toward the edge of the Star Sea and sensed the mark he had left upon Qiao Gong from afar.

Just as before, Qiao Gong's aura remained exceptionally stable.

Unlike Xu Ke, whose location constantly drifted.

Moreover, compared to before, he seemed to have moved somewhat closer.

"Interesting."

"It looks like I won't need to search for him."

"He will return on his own."

"That works perfectly."

Li Fan swept his gaze across the surroundings.

The sealed Immortal formation suddenly transformed into the Grand Formation of All Things Returning to Void, generating a howling storm.

Every trace of the previous battle was completely erased.

"The downgraded Immortal formation truly is convenient."

After finishing everything, Li Fan did not leave immediately.

Instead, he quietly stood in place, as if waiting for something.

Within the Star Sea there was only eternal darkness and deathly silence.

Li Fan waited patiently for more than half a month.

Yet what he expected never appeared.

"It seems my guess was correct. An ordinary individual's fall after Ascension does not attract the black mist."

"Only when the weight of an entire world is involved, or when the fall occurs in a special region such as the center of the Star Sea, does the black mist appear."

"This is merely an observed phenomenon. But what exactly causes it?"

"The Dao Annihilation Calamity..."

Li Fan softly muttered to himself as he returned together with the Tianyang Immortal Puppet to the Xuanhuang Realm.

Although the eagle initially could not comprehend the existence of the glass.

Once it began trying to touch it and study its properties, change would inevitably occur.

Chapter 1359: Star Sea Plague Of Life And Death

Within the Great Xuan Small World, at the Dao Lecture Platform.

The Tianyang Immortal Puppet stood silently behind him with its eyes closed.

Li Fan sat cross-legged, reviewing the insights that the Simulated Heavenly Mandate had selected from the countless living beings across billions of small worlds regarding the flaws in the High Wall.

'Is it before us? No. It is truly above us. Like a great river dam rising into the heavens. It severs our hope of survival and cuts off our path forward.'

'The might of the Darkest High Wall is unfathomable. Without sacred immortal power, how could it ever be destroyed? Yet even a thousand-mile dike collapses from a single ant nest.'

'One man's body, ten million souls, hundreds of millions of wills. A blazing fire illuminates the deepest darkness.'

...

It had to be said that when faced with the crisis of extinction, people truly could unleash unimaginable potential.

Among these mortals, whose cultivation reached no higher than Golden Core, there were indeed some who had vaguely touched upon the truth. Some of their insights and thoughts even inspired Li Fan after reading them.

However, the gap between their level and the High Wall was simply too vast.

Even with thoughts numbering in the billions, wishing for them to accumulate into a qualitative transformation capable of uncovering the High Wall's secrets...

Was by no means an easy task.

At the very least, Li Fan saw no sign whatsoever of success in the short term.

But Li Fan was not in a hurry.

He temporarily stopped reviewing them, flicked his finger, and sent forth a sword shadow, packaging all of these useful thoughts together before transmitting them to Mo Rubin.

"I hope this peerless genius of the ancient cultivation world truly gains something from them."

Li Fan gazed toward the starry sky with an unreadable expression.

Although this life had already produced the Tianyang Immortal Puppet, according to Li Fan's deductions, Tianyang alone was still insufficient to protect him while he integrated with the Celestial Spirit Heaven and Earth of the Super Xuanhuang Realm.

"Besides those I encountered during previous reincarnations, I must also account for what lies beyond the High Wall..."

Li Fan once again recalled the ending of his previous life, when Cat Treasure descended, the High Wall collapsed, and even the image of [Truth] began flickering unstably.

"When the Xuanhuang Immortal Domain is born, will the High Wall still be able to isolate the inside from the outside? If unknown forces beyond the High Wall can sense it and descend, then the time left to me will truly be very limited."

Based on what he experienced in his previous life, Li Fan estimated the available buffer period.

"Prepare for defeat before seeking victory. It may never happen, but I cannot afford to ignore the possibility."

"My greatest strength remains [Truth]."

"Second is my array formation mastery that surpasses the Star Sea."

"Third are Ascending and Overlooking and Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger."

"After that come the many True Immortal seal script characters."

Within Li Fan's sea of consciousness, the Final Dissociation Disc had just completed its deduction of Immortal Formation degradation, yet it did not rest for even a moment.

Instead, it was now deducing an formation that could truly be called world-shaking.

This formation would combine every bit of formation knowledge Li Fan currently possessed.

Using mortal means to walk the path of a True Immortal.

Li Fan reviewed every immortal formation currently within his grasp.

From the Grand Formation of the Primordial Mystic Spirit came the formations Astral Mechanism, All Spirits Return to Numbers, Desolate Fall, Flowers Bloom in an Empty Room, and Boundless, Primal Chaos Reveals in Form.

Inspired by the ancient Xuanhuang World-Protecting Grand Formation, Li Fan had independently deduced the formations Simulated Creation, Diverse Forms of Sentient Beings and Immortal Descent, All Things Return to Void.

One represented creation, the other destruction. Their might was no weaker than orthodox immortal formations.

Now, Li Fan intended to combine all of these immortal formations together.

Taking the Infinite Dao as the core concept. To create the ultimate defensive immortal formation.

Li Fan still vividly remembered how, in his previous life, the Holy Emperor had used the Bright Moon Starlight Grand Formation to imprison the Four Central Prefectures of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

Regardless of cultivation level, anyone who stepped into it fell into an endless Star Sea and became forever trapped.

This life, he intended to do the same. But the target he wished to imprison...

Was the entire Xuanhuang Realm.

Outside the Xuanhuang Realm, he would construct another High Wall formed entirely of formations.

"If I can delay every unstable factor for just a little longer..."

"Then that will be victory."

The Final Dissociation Disc shone brightly.

Countless fragments formed, combined, and evolved within it.

After successfully establishing the foundation of Immortal Formation degradation, the barrier separating immortal and mortal formations had already been broken.

The deduction progressed exactly as Li Fan had anticipated.

"The Boundless, Primal Chaos Reveals in Form formation can analyze anyone who enters according to the circumstances."

"Using Flowers Bloom in an Empty Room together with Diverse Forms of Sentient Beings, it can create countless worlds that are almost indistinguishable from reality."

"Astral Mechanism, All Spirits Return to Numbers can modify any aspect of those formation worlds in an instant."

"Every form of energy and every type of life has environments where it thrives and environments where it cannot survive. By combining the essence of these immortal formations, I can create countless ever-changing inverse worlds tailored specifically to each intruder's weaknesses."

"Trap them with worlds."

"Kill them with worlds."

Just like Li Fan himself.

Even possessing the heaven-defying treasure [Truth], he still remained trapped within the world of the Xuanhuang Realm and the Star Sea.

More than one hundred reincarnations had already passed, and it was obvious that many more would be required before he could transcend them.

The formation currently being deduced by the Final Dissociation Disc would create, for every future intruder, a personalized Xuanhuang Realm.

Fundamentally speaking, the principles behind this formation were similar to the countless lifetimes of illusion Li Fan had experienced after leaving Great Xuan within the Immortal Severing Grand Formation.

However, the worlds created by this immortal formation possessed a degree of realism and intricacy that ordinary illusions could never hope to match.

"Using the nightmare difficulty version of the Xuanhuang Realm as the foundation..."

"I shall simulate endless variations of the Xuanhuang Realm."

"This formation shall be called..."

"Illusory Xuanhuang, Multitudinous Living Beings."

The moment its name was established, its intent condensed.

The formation was born.

The constantly flashing light within the Final Dissociation Disc suddenly froze.

Then it burst outward violently.

A perfect spherical mass of light appeared, seemingly composed of billions of fragments.

Within every fragment played out a world that resembled the Xuanhuang Realm, yet differed from it in subtle ways.

At the center of these billions of fragmented worlds rested the Xuanhuang Realm, surrounded by the High Wall and quietly floating within the Darkest Star Sea. Its faint radiance illuminated every surrounding world fragment.

Even Li Fan, as the creator of this formation, stood frozen after witnessing this magnificent sight.

Within that brief glimpse, Li Fan saw the countless worlds constructed by the Final Dissociation Disc.

Despite spending so many years struggling within the Xuanhuang Realm, cold sweat still covered his forehead as he found himself startled by his own creation.

"If I were to accidentally lose myself within it..."

"I would likely be suppressed there for several hundred lifetimes."

"As long as one remains beneath the True Immortal Realm, even if they realize the true nature of the world surrounding them, they would still lack the ability to escape."

"In a certain sense..."

"This Illusory Xuanhuang, Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation truly is the High Wall of array formations."

As Li Fan remained deep in thought, the fragmented sphere surrounding the Final Dissociation Disc slowly collapsed inward.

Eventually, everything returned to the core of the Final Dissociation Disc.

At present, the Final Dissociation Disc had only deduced the core portion of the Illusory Xuanhuang, Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation.

There was still an extremely long road ahead before every detail could be perfected.

However, even this incomplete core was enough for Li Fan to begin preparing in advance.

"The amount of source power essence required to complete this grand formation covering the entire Xuanhuang Realm..."

"Is simply unimaginable."

After making a rough estimate, Li Fan frowned deeply. Given the current number of You Clansmen, no matter how diligently they worked, they could never satisfy his needs.

"It seems I must think of another solution."

"Either resume the flesh factory breeding method using exotic beasts."

"Or find another energy source equivalent to source power essence."

With this thought, Li Fan separated a strand of divine sense and descended beneath Great Xuan.

The You Clansmen living there had multiplied to three times their original population since Li Fan captured and raised them.

Every day, they did nothing except eat, sleep, and pray to the great Holy Teacher.

Curiously, instead of growing weaker from their lack of activity, they had become significantly healthier than when they had constantly hidden from the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

This phenomenon differed from Li Fan's previous experiences.

In the past, after being exploited, the You Clansmen always became extremely frail.

Their lifespans shortened.

Their reproductive abilities plummeted.

If not carefully managed, their entire race could easily face extinction.

But judging from the current situation, it seemed as though they had broken free from this cursed destiny.

Li Fan compared the differences between this life and previous ones.

"Their method of reproduction has not changed significantly."

"Although I have not overworked them and have allowed sufficient time for rest, the Holy Emperor in my previous life did exactly the same."

"The You Clansmen within Great Qi also remained short-lived..."

"Could it be..."

Li Fan recalled how, earlier in this life, he had used the Dao Pill technique to possess a You Clansman in an attempt to uncover the hidden True Immortal seal script character within the bloodline of the First Great Celestial Venerable.

"Could it be related to that character involving the Transformation Between Immortal and Mortal?"

Li Fan speculated.

"The You Clansmen were the creation of the Xuantian King."

"Their bloodline is both the source capable of producing source power essence and the origin of their original sin."

"Now the curse upon them has weakened..."

Li Fan gradually reached an understanding.

"Given the Xuantian King's temperament, he would never leave matters completely without hope."

"While punishing the You Clansmen, he likely left behind a path to survival."

"If one of them could awaken and discover the secret hidden within their bloodline, then the shackles weighing upon the entire race would weaken."

To verify his theory, Li Fan acted immediately. The Holy Teacher's phantom, worshipped by the You Clansmen, silently released several rays of dark light.

These descended into the bodies of several randomly selected You Clansmen.

As though receiving divine revelation, they suddenly froze.

Countless visions emerged within their sea of consciousness.

Filled with overwhelming excitement, they first kowtowed repeatedly toward the Holy Teacher's phantom before completely immersing themselves in the enlightenment they had received.

Their prayers and murmurs became louder.

Faster.

Exactly like the You Clansman Li Fan had once possessed.

Their bodies rapidly aged. Some instantly became white-haired. Others transformed into dry skeletons within moments.

Such horrifying scenes failed to frighten the surrounding You Clansmen. Instead, they looked upon them with immense envy.

Their faith became even more fervent.

Finally, amid countless prayers, every You Clansman who had received Li Fan's revelation burned away their lives during enlightenment.

Each of them turned into drifting ashes.

In exchange, Li Fan sharply sensed that the curse shackling their race had weakened once more.

The remaining You Clansmen had indeed grown stronger again.

Not only their physiques.

Even their souls and comprehension had improved across every aspect.

It was as though...

They were slowly returning to what the bloodline of the original Great Celestial Venerable of Xuanhuang had always been meant to be.

"For someone chosen by a True Immortal of the upper realm to become the first Great Celestial Venerable of Xuanhuang..."

"How could such an existence possibly have been weak?"

"And how could his descendants possess such an inferior bloodline?"

Li Fan narrowed his eyes and once again had the Holy Teacher's phantom spread several more revelations.

Given the current overall population of the You Clansmen, they could still withstand this life-burning method of enhancement.

"However, I must be careful when loosening these shackles."

"I have no desire to face the sudden resurrection of the Great Celestial Venerable again at a critical moment."

Having already suffered once before, Li Fan was naturally far more cautious in this regard.

Next, the You Clansmen, who were gradually returning to their ancestral form and original appearance, demonstrated to Li Fan their astonishing vitality and reproductive ability.

Their rate of reproduction was not much slower than the creations once produced by the flesh factories.

Moreover, there were no defective offspring. Every descendant born possessed inhuman physical strength.

Rather than belonging to the human race, they were more like the demon beast race.

As the seals on the You Clansmen were gradually lifted, the amount of source power essence generated through each of their prayers also increased severalfold.

This somewhat relieved Li Fan's urgent need.

However, as he looked at the You Clansmen, whose population had doubled again within such a short time, an unusually rare chill rose in Li Fan's heart.

"Even while bound by layer upon layer of shackles, they are already like this. If they were restored to their peak state..."

"I'm afraid their reproductive ability would not be inferior to the legendary insect race. The key point is that every single You Clansman possesses such terrifying physical strength. It completely defies common sense."

With this thought in mind, Li Fan quietly reduced and controlled the somewhat excessive population of the You Clansmen.

Only after the numbers looked acceptable did he stop.

"It seems I will have to keep watching them constantly before I can feel at ease."

Li Fan separated a simulated personality and quietly implanted it into the phantom of the Holy Teacher worshipped by the You Clansmen.

He also deployed the newly deduced Xuanhuang Grand Formation throughout the region where the You Clansmen lived, ensuring they were completely sealed inside before finally feeling satisfied.

"I truly cannot let my guard down for even a moment."

He controlled the population growth of the You Clansmen in a steady rhythm, allowing it to increase only linearly.

He then used the source power essence they produced to construct the Illusory Xuanhuang, Multitudinous Living Beings Formation.

Time passed swiftly like this.

Until one day.

Li Fan suddenly raised his head and gazed into the heavens.

The Medicine King Cauldron had finally separated from the Immortal Ruins and was falling toward the Xuanhuang Realm from its outer edge.

The fused Immortal Realm fragment within his body resonated more and more intensely, as if urging him to hurry over and receive it.

A flash of sword light streaked across space as Li Fan left the Xuanhuang Realm.

He arrived beyond the world itself and watched as the genuine Medicine King Cauldron grew larger and larger in his field of vision while slowly tumbling downward.

With a wave of his hand, he directly collected it. His departure and return were completed in one smooth motion.

From beginning to end, not a single person within the Xuanhuang Realm noticed anything.

Seemingly sensing Li Fan's suppression from outside, the genuine Medicine King Cauldron continuously released faint fluctuations of energy, attempting to escape his control.

But it was nothing more than futile struggling.

On the outside was a layer of the Illusory Xuanhuang, Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation.

Within was a layer of the All Things Return to Void Formation.

Suppressed by the power radiating from the Immortal formations, the Medicine King Cauldron immediately became obedient.

It stood motionless in silence. Li Fan separated a strand of divine sense and entered the cauldron.

Completely familiar with the route, he advanced directly toward the core control center of the genuine Medicine King Cauldron.

Looking at the completely empty core control center, Li Fan let out a faint cold laugh.

He reached out with his right hand, then clenched it. The entire space seemed to twist beneath that single grasp.

A blurry figure was forcibly dragged out by Li Fan.

"Senior, spare my life!"

That figure was naturally the hidden Medicine King Sect Master, Liu Ruchen.

The moment Li Fan pulled him out, he completely abandoned the bearing expected of a sect master and immediately cried out in panic.

It was not because Liu Ruchen lacked composure.

Rather, the methods Li Fan displayed at this moment were simply unfathomable.

He had advanced all the way through the Medicine King Cauldron without triggering a single restriction, heading directly to its core control center.

He had even seen through Liu Ruchen's concealment technique at a glance.

Liu Ruchen's thoughts raced as he tried to determine which great expert from the Ten Great Immortal Sects stood before him.

Yet Li Fan appeared just like an ordinary mortal, with not the slightest trace of aura leaking from his body.

Liu Ruchen could not see through him at all.

Only Li Fan's calm expression and casual glance caused Liu Ruchen's spiritual instincts to issue frantic warnings, leaving his limbs icy cold.

Just as he was about to speak, Li Fan extended a finger and pressed it against the center of his forehead.

An incomparably powerful force surged into his soul like a roaring tidal wave.

Already barely clinging to life while heavily injured, Liu Ruchen suffered another devastating blow. He immediately became barely alive, with only a wisp of remnant soul remaining.

Under normal circumstances, Li Fan rarely used soul searching techniques.

But since this involved clues that the Medicine King Sect's ancestor, Sun Piaomiao, had secretly left behind concerning the Immortal Realm fragment, Li Fan could not afford to be careless.

Countless scenes of light and shadow flooded in as Liu Ruchen's memories poured forth.

Li Fan examined every detail one by one.

Anything related to Sun Piaomiao received especially careful attention.

By Liu Ruchen's era, the name Sun Piaomiao already existed only in ancient legends.

Even though Liu Ruchen had inherited the leadership of the Medicine King Sect, most of what he knew about Sun Piaomiao came from a travel journal left behind by the ancestor.

Previously, Li Fan had only heard descriptions of that travel journal from members of the Medicine King Sect. Now, within Liu Ruchen's memories, he was able to read it word for word.

Already knowing the answer, when he revisited certain details in the travel journal, Li Fan indeed noticed several suspicious points.

The journal began after Sun Piaomiao established the Medicine King Sect.

Without any warning, as the sect master of the newly founded Medicine King Sect, Sun Piaomiao decided to leave the Xuanhuang Realm and travel throughout countless worlds.

It should be known that at that time, the Medicine King Sect had only just been established. Its foundations were unstable, and countless complicated matters still required the Medicine King's personal attention.

Yet Sun Piaomiao simply walked away, leaving behind a complete mess without hesitation.

Had the few personal disciples he accepted not been dependable, and had the Medicine King Sect not been devoted to healing and saving lives, rarely coming into conflict with other sects, the Medicine King Sect likely would not have survived until Sun Piaomiao's return.

Sun Piaomiao's sudden departure could certainly be explained by his free spirited nature and unconventional personality.

But in Li Fan's view, it seemed more like he had suddenly received some kind of mission that forced him to leave.

One had to remember that, with Sun Piaomiao's strength at the time, the starry sky was far from a safe journey.

His encounter with the anomaly in the Star Sea, where he was nearly killed before falling heavily injured into the Unfettered Free Realm, proved exactly that.

With this prior understanding, Li Fan once again carefully read through Sun Piaomiao's travel journal.

Logically speaking, since it was a travel journal, it should have recorded the unforgettable moments of the entire journey. Yet Sun Piaomiao did not mention a single word about his own experiences. He did not even mention the severe injuries he had once suffered. Every page was devoted solely to describing the unique characteristics of the cultivation worlds he had passed through.

It was as if he were nothing more than an emotionless recording device.

Almost as though he feared that those who came after him would be unable to find those cultivation worlds if they ever wished to retrace his journey.

"The most important thing is, what was the purpose of the Go pieces he left behind?"

"Since he deliberately left such obvious clues for future generations, it makes no sense for him not to mention them at all."

Li Fan carefully searched through the travel journal but failed to find what he was looking for, causing him to frown slightly.

To make sure he had overlooked nothing, he searched through it once more.

After still finding nothing, Li Fan turned his attention to the rest of Liu Ruchen's memories.

His efforts were finally rewarded. Within an anecdote that Liu Ruchen had heard during his childhood, Li Fan found what might be a crucial clue.

It had merely been a casual story once mentioned by Liu Ruchen's master. Even Liu Ruchen himself had long since forgotten it.

"Back then, a grievously wounded guest came to the Medicine King Sect seeking help."

"His injuries were simply too severe. Everyone in the sect was powerless to save him. Even after the Ancestor personally examined him, the conclusion was the same."

"Ordinarily, there has never been such a thing as perfect medical arts in this world. Our Medicine King Sect truly did everything we could to save him. Yet, in his despair, that guest suddenly began cursing our Medicine King Sect. He even used the last of his strength to launch a frenzied attack against our disciples. Although our Medicine King Sect devotes itself to healing the world, we are by no means fools without tempers."

"The disciples immediately moved to kill him. However, the Ancestor stopped everyone. He walked over to the dying guest, raised a finger toward the heavens, and said something."

"The guest's body trembled slightly, and all of his murderous fury instantly disappeared. He stopped resisting, looked up at the sky, and the savage expression on his face transformed into two streams of tears. Then, as though finally finding peace, he quietly passed away."

"The Ancestor sighed softly and ordered us to give him a proper burial."

The young Liu Ruchen, just like everyone else who heard the story, naturally asked in curiosity, "Master, what exactly did the Ancestor say to him? How could he so easily dissolve such frenzied killing intent?"

Liu Ruchen's master answered in a distant tone, "Birth, aging, sickness, and death are the eternal laws of the Great Dao. Even this starry sky cannot escape them. How much less can you?"

"Those were the Ancestor's exact words."

The young Liu Ruchen could not comprehend the weight behind those words. He simply nodded innocently.

"That's right. If you're going to die, then just die. Throwing a tantrum is pointless. He deserved it."

But now, Li Fan could taste a very different meaning hidden within Sun Piaomiao's words from back then.

"At that time, the path to immortality had not yet been severed. Everyone cultivated with the goal of ascending to become immortals. Those words do not sound like something the Medicine King, who dedicated himself to healing and saving lives, would ever say."

"They align far more closely with my previous speculation. The worldview of an Immortal Realm pessimist."

Li Fan pondered silently and continued searching through Liu Ruchen's memories for more clues.

Sure enough, good fortune often came in pairs. He really did uncover another incident that appeared rather suspicious.

Ordinarily, cultivation sects would erect statues of their founding ancestors for later generations to worship.

Yet throughout the entire Medicine King Sect, there was not a single statue of Sun Piaomiao.

"Master, Master, what did the Ancestor actually look like? Why isn't there even a single portrait of him?"

"Heh. The Ancestor once said that rather than worshipping him, it would be better to worship our sect's true Medicine King Cauldron. Everything we have, our alchemy, our healing arts, our mission to save the world, all came from this cauldron. Without the cauldron, there would be no Medicine King, and there would be no future."

...

"The Medicine King Cauldron. The future."

Li Fan let out a long breath as he slowly withdrew from Liu Ruchen's memories and stood there deep in thought.

Liu Ruchen's remnant soul trembled nearby, not daring to disturb him.

"Perhaps this is only my speculation, but in my opinion, the hints Sun Piaomiao left behind are already quite obvious."

"However, that is only after knowing that the Medicine King Cauldron is very likely a fragment of the Immortal Realm."

"If my guess is correct, then Sun Piaomiao must have left hints about the Medicine King Cauldron's uniqueness elsewhere as well. Unfortunately, his disciples never noticed them, and those clues disappeared into the river of history."

"If I had not stumbled upon the abnormalities within Sun Piaomiao's relics aboard the Immortal Ark by pure coincidence, this secret would probably have remained buried forever."

Li Fan looked toward the Medicine King Cauldron.

Activating the Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood, he separated a trace of power belonging to the World Saving Longevity Scripture from the spiritual energy within his body.

Li Fan had cultivated this technique before. Combined with his current strength, which far surpassed that of ordinary Dao Integration cultivators, reproducing it required almost no effort. It was virtually indistinguishable from the genuine World Saving Longevity Scripture.

Under Liu Ruchen's utterly shocked gaze, Li Fan effortlessly broke through the restrictions on the Medicine King Cauldron and simultaneously seized control of it.

"The disciples of the Medicine King Sect have truly fallen to such depths."

"The world faces catastrophe, yet instead of saving it, you choose only to flee."

"Utter fools!"

Li Fan let out a cold snort of anger. To Liu Ruchen, those words struck like heavenly thunder.

His complete familiarity with every aspect of the Medicine King Sect, along with the tone of an elder reprimanding his juniors...

In an instant, a bold guess surfaced within Liu Ruchen's mind.

"Senior... are you..."

Li Fan ignored him completely. He simply grabbed Liu Ruchen and flashed outside the Medicine King Cauldron.

With a single thought, he directly shut down the Great Dream Spring and Autumn Formation within the cauldron.

Then, as if shaking a sieve, he violently shook the Medicine King Cauldron.

All the sleeping disciples of the Medicine King Sect were immediately thrown out.

In an instant, the Medicine King Sect cultivators rained down from the sky like countless falling droplets.

Fortunately, they had already awakened earlier, sensed that something was wrong, and hurriedly stabilized themselves in midair.

The Medicine King Sect cultivators, having only just awakened from their great dream, were completely bewildered.

As they exchanged words with one another, their attention gradually focused on the only unfamiliar person present.

Especially the faint figure of Liu Ruchen, who was nearly fading away while being held in Li Fan's hand.

"Sect Master!"

"Master!"

The disciples, elders, and Liu San all cried out in alarm, glaring furiously at Li Fan.

Li Fan completely ignored the countless hostile auras locking onto him and continued shaking the Medicine King Cauldron.

Only after all of the Medicine King Sect's hidden treasures, supplies, precious spiritual herbs, and medicinal plants had flown out as countless balls of light did he finally stop.

He extended his hand.

The All Things Return to Void Grand Formation materialized within his palm.

It descended upon the Medicine King Cauldron.

Silently, the Medicine King Cauldron, which had once been capable of resisting the Immortal Ruins for a time, crumbled inch by inch into fine dust.

"The Medicine King Cauldron!"

Watching the Medicine King Sect's supreme treasure destroyed before their very eyes, every member of the Medicine King Sect felt their eyes split with rage.

They were just about to charge at Li Fan in vengeance.

Then, the aura of the world destroying Immortal Formation that casually leaked from Li Fan's fingertips washed over them.

Every cultivator instantly felt as though they had fallen into an icy abyss.

They froze completely in place.

There was no longer even the courage to move.

Chapter 1360: The Mortal Cauldron Transforms Into An Immortal Go Piece

The anger and unwillingness were gone.

Whether Dao Integration, Soul Transformation, or Nascent Soul cultivators.

Under the Immortal Descends, All Things Return to Void Grand Formation, every cultivator of the Medicine King Sect displayed the same reaction.

Fear. Only endless fear filled their hearts.

Only after Li Fan withdrew the overwhelming might of the world destroying formation did the members of the Medicine King Sect gradually recover from that extreme state of mind.

Yet with Li Fan remaining silent, none of them dared move in the slightest.

The power of the immortal formation continued to circulate. Though its destructive force had been withdrawn, the formation itself remained. It created an independent space that enveloped the entire Medicine King Sect.

While suppressing everyone present, it also isolated the rules of the Xuanhuang Realm that prevented different cultivation paths from being cultivated simultaneously, preventing the newly awakened Medicine King Sect cultivators from falling into mutual slaughter.

Li Fan then ignored them completely and focused on the tiniest particles of the Medicine King True Cauldron.

Just as he had expected, they eventually gathered together and formed the shape of a single Go piece.

However, unlike the Go pieces Li Fan had previously collected, this one was not covered in a layer of gray.

Instead, it was unmistakably...

White.

Along the edge of its white surface was even a ring of colors that closely resembled the fused Go piece.

Li Fan reached out and drew the white Go piece into his hand. Gazing at it carefully, he sensed boundless vitality contained within its tiny form.

The Go pieces he had previously subdued within his body, including the already fused Immortal Realm fragment, all began to tremble gently.

It was as if they had finally welcomed their true core, erupting in waves of joyful celebration.

An even stronger urge than before radiated from the Go pieces inside him. They could hardly wait to merge with this white Go piece.

That urging gradually transformed into Li Fan's own desire.

The longing became so intense that even continuously operating the Immortal Heart Mantra could barely suppress it.

But Li Fan's willpower was extraordinary.

With immense determination, he forcibly suppressed the restless movement of the Go pieces within his body.

Calming his mind, he carefully examined the white Go piece in his hand and compared it with the six Go pieces sealed within his body.

Inside Li Fan's body were one large Go piece and five smaller ones.

The large one shone with seven colors, formed from the fusion of six ordinary gray Go pieces. The five smaller Go pieces revolved around the colorful one.

The white Go piece before him, although only a single piece, gave Li Fan the same feeling as that fused seven colored Go piece.

"It seems the piece Sun Piaomiao left behind in the Xuanhuang Realm was the most crucial one."

"A complete Immortal Realm..."

"The only remaining piece is the one inside the Xuan Immortal Ark."

At the thought that, years from now, he would once again witness a fragment of the long destroyed Immortal Realm, even Li Fan could not suppress the excitement rising in his heart.

"Does this fused Immortal Realm contain immortal spiritual qi?"

"Can it be used to ascend and become an immortal?"

"Are there relics left behind by the True Immortal who forged these Go pieces?"

"Or perhaps... is there even a True Immortal inside, waiting to be reborn together with this Immortal Realm?"

Countless questions flooded Li Fan's mind like a tide.

An ordinary cultivator, even after obtaining an Immortal Realm fragment, would undoubtedly hesitate in the face of its unknown dangers and mysteries, never daring to activate it lightly.

But Li Fan, who possessed [Truth], had no such concerns.

Especially in this lifetime, now that his immortal formation had finally been completed, [Truth]'s charging efficiency and protective power had doubled, giving him ample means of protection.

...

The white Go piece transformed from the Medicine King Cauldron possessed an irresistible attraction, drawing the gaze of every cultivator present.

They could vaguely sense that an enormous secret lay behind it.

Yet after witnessing Li Fan's overwhelming display of power, none of them dared approach. They could only watch from afar.

In the end, it was Liu Ruchen, who had finally recovered somewhat, who gathered his courage and spoke.

"Senior, may I ask, is this Go piece a relic left behind by Ancestor Sun Piaomiao?"

The reason Liu Ruchen dared speak was because, before destroying the Medicine King Cauldron, Li Fan had deliberately released all the Medicine King Sect cultivators imprisoned within it.

He had shown sufficient goodwill.

Li Fan sealed the white Go piece separately from the others within his body before letting out a cold laugh.

"Sun Piaomiao entrusted this object to you descendants for so many years. He even left countless hints both openly and secretly. Yet none of you ever discovered its true nature."

"You truly are a group of useless fools."

Li Fan's merciless rebuke also indirectly answered Liu Ruchen's question. Most of the Medicine King Sect disciples lowered their heads in shame.

Liu Ruchen smiled awkwardly and was about to ask more when Li Fan cut him off.

"This matter is no longer something you are qualified to participate in."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes as he looked at Liu Ruchen.

"Although you violated the founding principles of the Medicine King Sect, by leading the entire sect away from the Xuanhuang Realm, you accidentally accomplished a great deed."

With a flick of his finger, countless scenes instantly appeared before everyone.

They depicted the tremendous changes that had occurred throughout the Xuanhuang Realm and the Star Sea during the ten thousand years that the Medicine King Cauldron had been trapped within the Immortal Ruins.

The entire Medicine King Sect immediately erupted into an uproar.

When Li Fan slightly relaxed the immortal formation's suppression, they immediately felt overwhelming killing intent erupt from within themselves toward their relatives, friends, masters, and fellow disciples.

Only then did they realize that Li Fan had spoken the truth. Their faces turned deathly pale as despair overtook them.

Li Fan ignored their reactions and instead summoned the seven Dao Integration cultivators of the Medicine King Sect, including Liu Ruchen.

"Do you know what this Go piece formed from the Medicine King Cauldron truly is?"

"It is one of the fragments of the former Immortal Realm left behind by Sun Piaomiao."

His opening statement alone left the Dao Integration cultivators completely stunned.

Li Fan then slightly released a trace of the aura from the seven colored Go piece sealed within his body.

Even that tiny fragment of Immortal Realm laws was enough to leave the Medicine King Sect Dao Integration cultivators utterly intoxicated.

"The Immortal Realm's great calamity showed signs long ago. Back then, Sun Piaomiao received the mandate of the immortals and left behind preparations for the revival of the Immortal Realm."

Li Fan calmly recounted what he claimed to be the truth, though it was merely his own speculation.

"Now that Sun Piaomiao has disappeared, you, as his disciples, naturally have the duty to assist me in restoring the Immortal Realm."

Li Fan looked down upon them as though it were the most natural thing in the world.

Liu Ruchen and the others had only just been immersed in the mysteries of Immortal Realm laws.

Now, hearing Li Fan's words, they were completely dumbfounded.

They all stared at him with disbelief.

"Restore the Immortal Realm? Us?"

"I have already gathered all the fragments of the Immortal Realm."

"We are merely waiting for the proper opportunity."

"When the time comes, you need only assist from the side."

Li Fan spoke calmly.

Faced with the request of someone who was seemingly a True Immortal, how could the Dao Integration cultivators of the Medicine King Sect dare refuse?

Still, they were filled with doubt.

Such a terrifying expert could destroy their entire sect with a casual wave of his hand. Why would he need their assistance?

Yet since Li Fan did not explain, they did not dare ask. Were these members of the Medicine King Sect useful?

To Li Fan, they certainly were.

However, not for rebuilding the Immortal Realm.

Instead, they would serve as catalysts for merging the various powers together when the time came to elevate the Xuanhuang Realm.
