Chapter 1361: The Immortal Puppet Secretly Boards The Ark

So far, the process of searching for and merging the Immortal Domain Go pieces had gone far too smoothly.

So smoothly that even Li Fan could not help but grow suspicious. Could the real obstacle instead appear at the final moment when the Immortal Domain law fragments merged together?

If Sun Piaomiao had truly left behind some restrictive measures, then as his descendants, the cultivators of the Medicine King Sect should be able to bypass those restrictions to a certain extent.

That was only the first consideration.

Li Fan's gaze swept across the seven Dao Integration cultivators of the Medicine King Sect present.

"Your cultivation may once have been considered among the very strongest. But ten thousand years have passed, and the world has changed. Now, your strength is somewhat lacking. You can barely even assist me."

"So, in a short period of time, I will help all of you increase your strength."

Upon hearing this, Liu Ruchen cautiously asked, "Senior, when you speak of increasing our strength, what exactly do you mean?"

"Modern cultivators cultivate by devouring heaven and earth. Because they transform the power of heaven and earth into their own, every movement carries the might of the world itself. That is why the scale of spiritual energy they can wield far surpasses that of ancient cultivators."

As Li Fan spoke, every aspect of the cultivation method that defied the principles of heaven and earth unfolded before them.

The expressions of the Medicine King Sect Dao Integration cultivators immediately became unpleasant.

"No wonder the calamity of the incompatible Heavenly Laws descended. This cultivation method is nothing less than a demonic path," Liu San muttered softly.

Li Fan let out a cold snort.

"What is demonic? What is righteous? In the cultivation world, there is only strength and weakness. If the strong declare the New Law to be righteous, then it becomes righteousness."

Although the Medicine King Sect members disagreed with his words, under Li Fan's overwhelming pressure, none dared to refute him.

Li Fan shook his head slightly.

"So be it. Only after personally experiencing the wonders of the New Law will you perhaps change your views."

With a casual wave of his hand, detailed information regarding the Spirits of Heaven and Earth instantly appeared before everyone.

"Each of you, choose one. I will help you undergo Dao Integration once more using the New Law."

All seven of them shuddered.

"I choose this one, Crimson Silk."

Jiang Yushan was the first to speak.

As the former warden of the Indeterminate Prison, she had slaughtered countless enemies. She had never cared about the distinction between righteousness and evil. As long as it increased her strength, she was willing to try it.

"Excellent. A wise choice. Crimson Silk possesses balanced and stable power. It will suppress the lingering side effects caused by the murderous intent within your body."

Li Fan nodded approvingly.

With someone taking the lead, the remaining Dao Integration cultivators of the Medicine King Sect exchanged glances before finally abandoning their hesitation.

One after another, they selected their own Spirits of Heaven and Earth. Very soon, all seven Spirits of Heaven and Earth had been assigned.

"There is no time to waste. Next, I will take you hunting."

The phantom of the Wooden Sword left its sheath and enveloped everyone present. In the next instant, they had already arrived within the Xuanhuang Realm.

Even through the protection of the sword shadow, Liu Ruchen and the others could still sense the faint influence exerted by the law of incompatible techniques.

"I cannot protect you forever. Only Liu Ruchen needs to continue cultivating the World-Saving Longevity Scripture. The rest of you may switch to different Dao Integration cultivation methods."

As he spoke, Li Fan displayed information on several thousand Dao Integration cultivation arts.

The power of every single one rivaled the World-Saving Longevity Scripture.

The Medicine King Sect cultivators were almost dazzled.

"You can decide after completing Dao Integration and returning."

"For now, stay focused."

Li Fan floated above everyone.

He raised his head toward the heavens and casually formed a spell seal.

Dark clouds churned.

Wind and thunder roared.

A gigantic vortex immediately appeared high in the sky.

Like a crack torn open across the heavens, countless bolts of lightning flashed endlessly within it.

Speaking in a voice only he himself could hear, Li Fan murmured softly.

"Reverse the Principles of Heaven and Earth."

The five-character True Word echoed backward toward the heavens.

Borrowing the Mandate of Heaven, Li Fan invoked its authority.

Not long afterward, seven indistinct figures simultaneously answered the summons and appeared within the vortex.

They were precisely the seven Spirits of Heaven and Earth previously chosen by the Medicine King Sect cultivators.

The instant the seven Spirits of Heaven and Earth manifested, the eyes of the Medicine King Sect cultivators immediately turned bloodshot.

Each Spirit of Heaven and Earth possessed an attraction comparable to the elixir of immortality.

Now, all seven stood together.

Had Li Fan not firmly suppressed them with his power, these Dao Integration cultivators would likely have already lost their minds and charged forward without hesitation, just as others had done before.

Faced with such overwhelming temptation, Li Fan's expression remained completely unchanged.

The moment the Spirits of Heaven and Earth appeared, an Immortal Formation had already silently sealed the surrounding region.

The perception of the Spirits of Heaven and Earth was exceptionally sharp.

The instant they noticed their connection with the world's origin had been severed, they immediately awakened from their confusion.

But before they could react...

A gigantic hand formed from dark clouds had already descended above them.

Li Fan casually pressed down with a single palm.

Yet to the seven Spirits of Heaven and Earth, it felt as though the weight of the entire world had fallen upon them.

In an instant, none of them could move.

Moreover, the invisible restraints weighing upon them continued growing heavier.

Li Fan slowly curled his fingers, transforming his palm into a claw.

Bang. Bang. Bang.

The sound of the law bodies of the Spirits of Heaven and Earth shattering echoed continuously.

Under the terrifying force, their figures were forced into crouched postures.

At the brink of death, the power of the laws within them erupted in one final struggle, surging violently as they attempted to escape Li Fan's control.

Yet like waves endlessly crashing against an immovable dam, their resistance could never shake his absolute suppression.

Every struggle was destined to fail.

Their desperate final outburst not only failed to loosen the invisible shackles but instead accelerated their destruction.

Even while consumed by overwhelming greed, witnessing Li Fan suppress seven Spirits of Heaven and Earth with a single palm shook the Medicine King Sect Dao Integration cultivators to their very souls.

Only when Li Fan's stern voice rang out did they recover from their shock.

"What are you standing around for?"

The restraining force upon Liu Ruchen and the others vanished.

No longer suppressing the greed within their hearts, they immediately rushed toward their designated targets.

Each unleashed their strongest killing techniques against the suppressed Spirits of Heaven and Earth.

Only after truly engaging them did the Medicine King Sect cultivators fully understand the terrifying power of the world's might.

Although the Spirits of Heaven and Earth could not retaliate and could only endure their attacks...

Although Li Fan had already gravely wounded them beforehand...

The Medicine King Sect cultivators still nearly exhausted every last trace of spiritual energy before finally managing to kill them.

"So even among all Spirits of Heaven and Earth, the ones Senior selected for us must already belong to the very strongest."

This realization naturally appeared within their minds.

"And yet such powerful beings possessed absolutely no ability to resist before Senior..."

Once again, the Medicine King Sect cultivators gained an even clearer understanding of Li Fan's terrifying strength.

As each Spirit of Heaven and Earth perished, Li Fan released the Immortal Formation's blockade.

Having inherited the power of the Spirits of Heaven and Earth, the origin power of the Xuanhuang Realm's laws poured downward from the enormous vortex in the sky.

Like clouds collapsing from heaven itself, it descended upon the Medicine King Sect cultivators.

Their auras multiplied continuously.

Seven newly advanced Dao Integration Immortal Sages descended upon the Xuanhuang Realm.

At the very same time, another heavenly phenomenon appeared.

The death of even a single Spirit of Heaven and Earth was enough to shake the world.

Now seven had fallen simultaneously.

The same heavenly phenomena that accompanied the death of cultivators illuminated the entire sky.

The Medicine King Sect cultivators immediately sensed the terrifying malice of heaven and earth surrounding them from every direction.

Although Li Fan had not personally killed the Spirits of Heaven and Earth, he had twisted the principles of heaven and earth and suppressed them.

He was the true culprit behind their deaths.

The hostility directed toward him exceeded that aimed at the Medicine King Sect cultivators by hundreds or even thousands of times.

All previous goodwill had vanished.

It was as though heaven and earth regarded him as an irreconcilable mortal enemy. The malice of heaven and earth condensed into tangible whispers surrounding him.

For the Medicine King Sect cultivators, who had always upheld the ideal of saving the world and protecting all living beings, such hostility felt deeply uncomfortable.

But asking them to return the strength they had just obtained...

That was absolutely impossible.

They would rather wage war against heaven itself.

Faced with such circumstances, Li Fan remained completely calm.

He had long anticipated this.

Standing before the Medicine King Sect cultivators, he looked directly toward the heavens and calmly explained why he had acted in this manner.

The process of the Xuanhuang Realm's ascension would receive assistance from several different powers.

For example, the power of the Star Sea's revival. Or the residual power preserved from other cultivation worlds. Or the immortal spiritual power contained within the inheritance of the Great Celestial Venerable.

So many immense and complicated powers resembled one powerful medicine after another.

With the Xuanhuang Realm currently riddled with countless wounds, its frail body might not be able to endure them all.

Therefore, it required medicinal catalysts to serve as a buffer.

The Medicine King Sect Dao Integration cultivators who had devoured the Spirits of Heaven and Earth would become those catalysts.

Li Fan would first channel the power meant to restore the Xuanhuang Realm into their bodies through various methods.

Not to grant that power to them. Rather, to use them as temporary vessels and buffers. When the Xuanhuang Realm finally underwent ascension, the Dao Integration Immortal Sages would perish.

All those accumulated powers would then return to heaven in a single instant. Medicine applied both externally and internally. Treating both symptoms and root cause simultaneously.

The cure would be complete.

The world's ascension would finally arrive.

...

Li Fan's explanation could essentially be summarized in just a few words.

"I am doing this for your own good."

However, these were not fabricated excuses.

Everything he said was genuinely true.

Even the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm could perceive it.

The current Xuanhuang Realm remained far too distant from its fully ascended state.

The total amount of power it intended to absorb even slightly exceeded what the Xuanhuang Realm itself could endure.

There truly existed the danger of being overwhelmed by excessive nourishment.

The rapidly growing malice of heaven and earth suddenly stopped.

The Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm seemed to be contemplating. After a brief stalemate, the hostility gradually faded away.

To the Medicine King Sect cultivators, this scene appeared as though Li Fan had single-handedly confronted heaven and earth itself before somehow dispersing all of heaven's hostility.

Such methods were truly unprecedented. Their reverence toward Li Fan deepened even further.

After successfully completing New Method Dao Integration, all of their strength increased dramatically.

Liu Ruchen especially not only fully recovered from his injuries, but also gained fresh insights during the Dao Integration process.

Back within the Great Xuan small world, Liu Ruchen respectfully reported his new understanding to Li Fan.

"According to Senior's earlier explanation, advancing further after New Method Dao Integration requires defying the principles of heaven and earth."

"However, during Dao Integration, we already devoured Spirits of Heaven and Earth. What are Spirits of Heaven and Earth? They are manifestations of the world's laws and continuations of the principles of heaven and earth."

"So the easiest way to begin defying those principles is to follow the trail back to the source. Trace the Spirit of Heaven and Earth that you devoured back to the principle of heaven and earth behind it."

Liu Ruchen spoke confidently.

"For example, the Spirit of Heaven and Earth I devoured, Green Silk, actually represents the continuation of the Principle of Vitality."

"Once there is a clear direction, the principles of heaven and earth are no longer vague and intangible. Through continuous cultivation and comprehension, one can gradually find their source. But attempting to reverse those principles..."

He paused.

"One can already imagine how unimaginably difficult it would be."

"It is like grabbing your own hair and lifting yourself into the air. Without borrowing any external force, it is virtually impossible."

Li Fan quietly listened to Liu Ruchen's explanation.

It had to be said that someone capable of succeeding as the sect master truly possessed extraordinary comprehension.

The other newly advanced Dao Integration cultivators of the Medicine King Sect listened attentively, each revealing a thoughtful expression.

At last, when Liu Ruchen had nothing more to say, everyone turned their gaze toward Li Fan.

"To comprehend this much on your very first day after stepping into the New Method Dao Integration path. Very good."

Li Fan's casual praise left Liu Ruchen both surprised and honored.

"However, your thinking is still too simplistic. Throughout the thousands of years of the Xuanhuang Realm, only a handful have managed to attain the Longevity Immortal Realm by going against the natural order."

"And for a very long time now, not a single new Longevity Immortal Heavenly Sovereign has appeared. Why do you think that is?"

"Think it over carefully."

Li Fan ended his guidance abruptly.

The members of the Medicine King Sect immediately changed expressions, their thoughts racing in every direction.

The following days were extremely fulfilling for the seven Dao Integration cultivators of the Medicine King Sect.

They converted to the new Dao Integration cultivation method and steadily consolidated their newly advanced foundations.

From time to time, they sat beneath the preaching platform, listening to the Holy Teacher's projection expound the Dao.

They also sparred with a mysterious senior whose aura was unfathomable and whose words were few.

Even if this senior merely stood still without moving, no matter how the Medicine King Sect Dao Integration cultivators exhausted their full strength, they could not inflict the slightest injury upon him.

Thus, they were free to unleash everything they had learned and verify their cultivation without restraint.

As for the rest of the Medicine King Sect disciples...

Li Fan looked at the silver eye before him.

Beside it had appeared a smaller pink eye.

Countless Dao threads converged into a massive bridge, linking the silver and pink eyes together.

"The power of Forgetting Sorrow exists throughout the Xuanhuang Realm. It is not confined solely to the Five Elders Association's territory."

"So there is no need to travel to the Five Elders Association in order to enter the Carefree Paradise. Previously, we simply had no method of finding the entrance."

"But now, I have already dispatched a total of nine thousand six hundred and thirty-two advance scouts..."

"My simulated heavenly mandate remains perfectly synchronized with all of their perceptions. Through their thoughts, it is enough to lock onto the Carefree Paradise."

The countless threads serving as the bridge belonged to the cultivators Li Fan had sent ahead into the Carefree Paradise.

Within the pink eye slumbered vast numbers of Medicine King Sect disciples below the Dao Integration Realm.

Their actual bodies remained under Li Fan's control. Combined with the sect master's orders, these Medicine King Sect disciples could still obey commands with absolute discipline even while inside the Carefree Paradise.

Moreover, since they all belonged to the Medicine King Sect, they naturally possessed exceptional coordination and deep mutual bonds.

Their exploration within the Carefree Paradise was therefore much more efficient.

Besides the Medicine King Sect disciples, the pink eye also contained a great number of Great Xuan cultivators.

Packed together in endless ranks, they continuously charged into the Carefree Paradise to explore it.

The appearance of the pink eye did not mean that the mysteries of the Carefree Paradise had been unraveled.

Rather, by relying on those cultivators who had already entered the Carefree Paradise, Li Fan had established an entrance to the Carefree Paradise within the Great Xuan small world.

The instant the pink eye came into existence, Li Fan had secretly hoped that the power of the Carefree Heavenly Sovereign would descend personally.

Unfortunately, Carefree seemed completely unconcerned with such a trivial matter.

Unable to lure Carefree into appearing, Li Fan was somewhat disappointed.

"I hope these people can bring me some pleasant surprises."

Li Fan always had an intuition.

The secrets hidden within the Carefree Paradise were perhaps even more important than he had imagined.

...

Only the final Go piece remained before recreating the Immortal Realm.

Li Fan first sealed away all the pieces he had already collected within the Great Xuan small world using an immortal formation.

He then instructed the Medicine King Sect Dao Integration cultivators to establish the Equal Heaven Ritual within the mortal small world, creating the illusion that he still remained deep within Great Qi, occupied with overseeing the ritual.

Meanwhile, his true body continued guarding Great Xuan without moving.

He projected a phantom of the Wooden Sword and quietly sent Tianyang outside the Immortal Ark.

A strand of divine sense attached itself to Tianyang's immortal puppet, directing all of its actions.

The reason Li Fan did not personally carry out the theft was because he had previously accepted the Equal Heaven Ritual performed by the elders of the Immortal Ark.

Although the Immortal Ark had never explained the details, Li Fan could vaguely infer that every elder participating in the Equal Heaven Ritual could constantly sense his approximate location.

This perception was not especially strong. Once he left the Immortal Ark, it no longer functioned.

However, if he approached them at close range, his identity would certainly be exposed immediately.

The people of the Immortal Ark were still useful to Li Fan. It was not yet time to turn against them.

Therefore, Li Fan decided to send Tianyang instead. With a single thought, Tianyang's immortal puppet body expanded several hundred times in an instant.

It lay quietly floating within the dark void.

Then it suddenly accelerated and smashed directly toward the Immortal Ark.

Not a trace of aura leaked from Tianyang's immortal puppet.

It resembled nothing more than a gigantic meteor hurtling straight toward the Immortal Ark.

Such an enormous object charging forward so openly naturally drew the Immortal Ark's attention immediately.

Because Tianyang's speed was not especially fast, they initially assumed it was merely an ordinary drifting boulder.

A casual beam of light was fired toward it, intending to shatter the rock.

However, when the beam struck Tianyang's body, it failed to create even the slightest ripple.

The collision continued unabated.

Only then did the Immortal Ark suddenly realize something was wrong.

Several figures appeared one after another.

Leading them was none other than the Immortal Ark elder, Jian Daosheng.

Working together, they finally managed to slow the charging Tianyang immortal puppet.

The Immortal Ark intercepted it before it could drift any closer.

“What is this?”

Jian Daosheng asked with a strange expression.

Without any instructions from Li Fan, Tianyang kept his eyes closed and remained completely motionless, allowing the Immortal Ark cultivators to inspect him at will.

Meanwhile, a strand of Li Fan's divine sense remained hidden within the Eternal Remnant Will at the core of the Immortal Puppet, concealed by an immortal formation.

“It seems to be... the corpse of some giant?”

“No, this aura is extraordinary. And these bones...”

It did not take long before they discovered the extraordinary nature of the Tianyang Immortal Puppet.

Jian Daosheng did not dare neglect the matter and immediately sent out a transmission.

Not long afterward, the other elders of the Immortal Ark arrived one after another upon receiving the news.

As expected of a civilization that had survived since the Ancient Era, the Immortal Ark's knowledge was truly extraordinary.

It did not take them long to roughly determine the Tianyang Immortal Puppet's origins.

“Its bones are forged from the remains of an immortal artifact, and its flesh is formed from the flesh and blood of a True Immortal. Hiss...”

“This is an Immortal Puppet?”

The gathered elders were filled with uncertainty and froze in shock.

“How could it just happen to drift here?”

“There is definitely something suspicious about this. We must proceed with caution.”

All of them sensed the scent of a conspiracy.

“What should we do?” the elders asked as they turned toward Zhong Daogong.

Zhong Daogong pondered for a moment before casting the True Immortal seal script character [Reveal] toward the Tianyang Immortal Puppet.

He intended to use the power of the True Immortal seal script to uncover the puppet's true origins.

Yet to his surprise, although the Immortal Puppet remained dormant, an incomparably mysterious force field surrounded it.

Even the immensely powerful True Immortal seal script could not affect the sleeping Immortal Puppet in the slightest.

This discovery caused every Immortal Ark elder to change expression.

“This...”

The greatest foundation of the Immortal Ark was its mastery of the various True Immortal seal script characters.

Now, a being had suddenly appeared that was naturally immune to the power of the True Immortal seal script. How could they not be alarmed?

Zhong Daogong raised his hand, signaling everyone to remain calm. He stared solemnly at the Tianyang Immortal Puppet.

He then returned to the Immortal Ark. When he emerged again, he held a jade-green dagger that flowed like water.

Lights continuously flickered around him as Zhong Daogong deployed layer upon layer of protective measures before cautiously approaching the Tianyang Immortal Puppet.

He attempted to use the green dagger to cut away a piece of its flesh.

Li Fan had previously visited the first and second layers of the Immortal Ark's secret treasury, yet he had never seen this dagger before.

Nor did he know what kind of power it contained, but it was actually capable of slowly breaking through the force field surrounding the Tianyang Immortal Puppet.

However...

Clang!

The dagger struck the flesh of the True Immortal, producing the sound of metal colliding with metal.

It failed to leave even the slightest mark.

Ripples spread across the dagger's green radiance, as though it had suffered an enormous impact. A trace of pain flashed through Zhong Daogong's eyes. Knowing the attempt was futile, he immediately withdrew the dagger and rapidly retreated.

After wiping away the cold sweat on his forehead, he said to the others present, “It is indeed an Immortal Puppet. The pressure emanating from the flesh and blood of a True Immortal, along with the protective force capable of ignoring the power of the True Immortal seal script...”

The expressions of the Immortal Ark elders changed once more.

After a lengthy discussion, they tried every method they could think of.

Yet they were ultimately unable to break through the Tianyang Immortal Puppet's defenses.

They could not even cut away a single piece of True Immortal flesh.

The elders stared unwillingly at the Immortal Puppet before them.

Then, after reaching some unknown decision, the majority of the Immortal Ark elders departed together.

Only three elders remained behind, standing guard over the Immortal Puppet from a distance.

One day.

Two days.

Time passed day after day.

The Tianyang Immortal Puppet continued to lie silently within the dark void, completely motionless.

The elders assigned to guard it were replaced again and again.

At first, the handovers proceeded smoothly.

Later, arguments gradually began to erupt.

Thus, half a year passed.

The Immortal Ark elders once again gathered around the Tianyang Immortal Puppet.

“We cannot just leave this Immortal Puppet here forever.”

“Indeed. Someone has to keep watch over it. It mysteriously arrived from the depths of the starry sky. If we do not stop it, perhaps one day it will simply drift back into the Star Sea.”

“The only option is to continue guarding it. What else can we do? Bring it back to the Immortal Ark? That risk is far too great.”

“Exactly. This Immortal Puppet's appearance is simply too strange...”

The elders continued arguing endlessly.

Yet throughout their discussion, every one of them kept their eyes fixed on the Tianyang Immortal Puppet in the distance.

Finally, Zhong Daogong interrupted them.

“Over the past six months, our research into the force field surrounding this Immortal Puppet has yielded some results.”

“But it is obvious that if we could completely dismantle the Immortal Puppet...”

A trace of greed flashed through the eyes of every Immortal Ark elder.

“Bringing the Immortal Puppet aboard the Immortal Ark certainly carries enormous risk. However, I believe it is worth attempting. Judging from the current situation, only that object is capable of breaking through this Immortal Puppet's defenses.”

As soon as these words were spoken, the entire gathering fell silent.

A short while later, the elders nodded one after another. After exchanging silent glances, they gradually reached a unanimous agreement.

Working together, the elders formed something like a massive net. They dragged the Tianyang Immortal Puppet along and pulled it into the Immortal Ark.

Chapter 1362: Immortal Realm Dao-Burning Calamity

The Xuan Immortal Ark carried a civilization that had endured for ten thousand years.

Yet its internal space was actually not very large. Otherwise, the people aboard the Immortal Ark would not have constantly suffered from a lack of resources.

Just as Li Fan had expected, the Tianyang Immortal Puppet was dragged by the elders of the Immortal Ark deeper into the ark's hidden treasury.

The first layer.

The second layer.

Heavenly Star Light Lotuses bloomed across the heavenly canopy.

Countless rays of light flickered as spheres of light appeared one after another, weaving themselves into a massive gateway.

All of the elders cast their techniques together, and the gateway rumbled open.

From within the passage came an eerie green radiance.

All kinds of ominous auras spread together with the green light, attempting to expand outward and corrode everything around them.

The Heavenly Star Light Lotus was stimulated into action, splitting into countless starlight lotuses that gathered before the gateway.

The sea of lotuses stretched endlessly.

Although every lotus touched by the green radiance withered instantly, the endless sea of flowers prevented the green light from breaking through for the time being.

"Hurry!" Zhong Daogong urged anxiously, seemingly extremely fearful that the green radiance might break through.

The elders all understood the danger.

Together, they slowly transported the dormant giant puppet into the third layer of the hidden treasury.

Among all the elders, only Jian Daosheng followed it inside. He wore armor formed from starlight, held a seven-colored light bowl above his head, and stood upon a tiny flat boat beneath his feet.

Although the combination looked somewhat ridiculous, it fully demonstrated how seriously Jian Daosheng regarded the situation.

The gateway slowly closed.

Only a strip of light extending from Jian Daosheng's starlight armor remained connected to the outside world.

The entrance was not completely sealed.

Through Jian Daosheng's perspective, the appearance of the third layer of the Immortal Ark treasury, the third layer of the Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales, gradually appeared before everyone.

Inside a massive spherical cavern, countless masses of viscous green flesh constantly writhed, producing chilling sounds.

They grew and clung to every wall.

A gigantic gray stone statue stood in the center of the cavern.

Judging from the growth patterns of the green flesh covering the entire cavern, it appeared that everything originated from that gray statue. The green sea submerged over half of the statue's body.

Thousands of green trails extended outward from the statue's head. Each trail originated from one of the hollow eye sockets within its head.

No one knew what kind of bizarre creature this gray statue represented.

It possessed a human body.

Yet its head had no facial features whatsoever.

Instead, it was covered entirely with eyes.

The moment the Tianyang Immortal Puppet entered the third layer of the treasury, despite releasing no aura whatsoever, it immediately attracted the attention of the green masses throughout the cavern.

Like countless tentacles, they leaped through the air and attacked Tianyang from every direction.

Taking advantage of the opportunity, Jian Daosheng hid inside one of the hollow eye sockets in the gray statue's head.

The green tentacles were blocked by the invisible force field surrounding Tianyang.

However, perhaps because they had drawn closer and sensed the scent of True Immortal flesh upon Tianyang's body, the green tentacles became even more excited.

The entire cavern was awakened. Every trace of green surged frantically toward Tianyang. In the blink of an eye, the Tianyang Immortal Puppet was completely submerged beneath endless green.

It disappeared into a sea of green radiance. The surroundings were filled with sounds resembling countless silkworm larvae gnawing endlessly.

Li Fan observed the sensations transmitted by his strand of divine sense within Tianyang.

"Hm? He cannot see these green creatures at all?"

The information Tianyang transmitted left Li Fan somewhat surprised.

"It merely feels... like wind and rain beating against the body..."

Li Fan fell into thought.

His divine sense no longer observed the outside world. Instead, he completely isolated his own senses and perceived everything solely through Tianyang.

The surroundings instantly became silent. It was as though he had arrived upon an open wilderness.

Upon towering mountains.

Within deep valleys.

The flowing streams became blades, endlessly carving through stone and splitting mountains day after day.

The howling winds and falling rain became axes, continuously hacking away and reshaping the landscape.

Meanwhile, Tianyang himself had become those mountains, that earth, those valleys.

He was being relentlessly eroded by the invisible power of the passage of time.

Slowly.

Yet irresistibly.

The Tianyang Immortal Puppet instinctively activated its protective power.

But according to the thoughts Tianyang transmitted, under the erosion of this green force, he could endure for at most half a year.

That was assuming he did not launch a counterattack.

Li Fan made no rash move for the moment.

From Tianyang's perspective, none of the writhing green flesh actually existed.

Thus, the entire third layer of the Immortal Ark treasury could be seen clearly.

The bizarre gray statue with a human body and a thousand eyes caused Li Fan's mind to tremble.

Meanwhile, the faint treasure light flickering within the thousand hollow eye sockets of the statue's head immediately made Li Fan understand.

"The aura of the final Go piece."

"So these hollows are actually the Immortal Ark's treasury."

"They are far from full. At a glance, there appear to be fewer than five treasures."

"It certainly cannot be as defenseless as it appears. There must be unknown protective measures."

"Jian Daosheng... has disappeared?"

"Hm. This gray statue seems somewhat different from before."

Li Fan rapidly analyzed the current situation.

The third layer of the Immortal Ark treasury truly was extraordinary. It even concealed a power capable of harming an Immortal Puppet.

However, at present, Tianyang possessed not only his own strength. He also carried the power of an Immortal Formation that Li Fan had prepared beforehand.

Even if he could not win, escaping would absolutely pose no problem. Therefore, Li Fan had no intention of acting immediately.

Instead, he chose to continue observing.

After Jian Daosheng fused with the gray statue through some unknown method, the speed of the green corrosion suddenly increased.

Within Tianyang's perception, hurricane-force winds roared while torrential rain poured endlessly.

Amid the storm, every power composing his body was gradually being washed away and weakened.

"Interesting."

Although Li Fan had never encountered this green force before, he somehow sensed a faint familiarity from it.

Especially because he and Tianyang saw completely different scenes despite observing the same place.

This made Li Fan think of something. The sounds of wind and rain grew increasingly violent.

Faced with the encirclement and erosion of this bizarre force, Li Fan remained completely calm.

He quietly contemplated.

After an unknown amount of time...

Like a bolt of lightning illuminating the night sky.

Li Fan suddenly came to a realization.

"The Obliterating Wind Calamity?"

He did not mean the Obliterating Wind Calamity itself.

Rather, their auras were nearly identical in origin.

The Obliterating Wind Calamity that Li Fan had sensed within the Boundless Mirror was even several times stronger than the green corrosive force before him.

It was as though the wind and rain he perceived had been amplified to their absolute limit.

Thinking this, Li Fan shifted his gaze toward the gray statue standing within the great cavern.

"This green corrosive force is specifically used to erode powers belonging to the Immortal level."

"If that is the case, then this statue..."

The words spoken by the Immortal Ark elders throughout the cavern soon confirmed Li Fan's speculation.

Through the strip of starlight cloth Jian Daosheng had left extending beyond the gateway, communication remained possible between the elders inside and outside the treasury.

However, the voices sounded somewhat indistinct.

It was as though they were separated by an entirely different world.

"Elder Jian must not remain within the Desolate God for too long."

"Although the Desolate God has already died, and even its consciousness has been completely erased, it was still an existence beyond the mortal realm..."

It sounded like a routine reminder.

At regular intervals, different elders repeated the warning, reminding Jian Daosheng after he had merged with the Desolate God.

Only after every elder had spoken once did Jian Daosheng finally reappear. Yet after disappearing for only this short period of time, his appearance had noticeably changed.

Li Fan was certain it was not merely his imagination.

The Desolate God statue had influenced Jian Daosheng.

"The Desolate God..."

Li Fan's thoughts raced.

In the ancient Xuanhuang Realm, there had once existed an immensely powerful sect known as the Desolate God Sect.

It controlled the Desolate God Seal.

Using it, they could summon twelve Desolate Gods from the upper realm to descend and annihilate all enemies.

To the Desolate Gods, cultivators were no different from ants.

Thus, the Desolate God Sect had been unrivaled in its era, suppressing nearly every other force.

However, for reasons unknown, the Desolate Gods gradually ceased responding to mortals.

They no longer descended into the lower world.

Without their greatest support, the Desolate God Sect eventually fell into ruin.

"Could these Desolate Gods be the same beings?"

"The Desolate Gods are not Immortals. Otherwise, they would never have served mortals, no matter how sincerely they were worshipped or summoned."

"And yet they possess power belonging to Immortals..."

"Servants of the Immortals?"

A bold speculation surfaced within Li Fan's mind. As he looked once more at the statue, his thoughts had already changed.

After separating from the Desolate God statue, Jian Daosheng still remained hidden inside one of its hollow eye sockets.

He responded to the elders outside.

First, he uttered a string of strange rhythms that resembled some sort of secret code.

Only then did he speak.

"This Immortal Puppet is unquestionably of extremely high quality. Even after enduring the Desolate God's power of decay for so long, it still shows no signs of collapsing."

"Should I increase the guidance?"

Zhong Daogong immediately stopped him.

"No. Proceed slowly."

"Otherwise, once too much decay accumulates, even the Heavenly Star Light Lotus may not be able to contain it."

"Besides, you may not be able to endure it either."

Jian Daosheng nodded somewhat regretfully.

"Has the Immortal Puppet shown any signs of awakening?" Zhong Daogong asked again.

"No."

"It appears that it truly is a puppet that has lost its control core."

"Otherwise, faced with such a life-threatening danger hanging directly above its head, it would never remain this quiet."

"Good."

"Then all we need to do is wait."

"Once the corrosion reaches about half its full extent, immediately pull the Immortal Puppet back out."

As the elders of the Immortal Ark discussed among themselves, they seemed to have already decided the fate of the slumbering immortal puppet.

Meanwhile, Tianyang, whose body was being consumed by the surrounding decayed green aura, suddenly sent Li Fan a reminder.

"We can temporarily retract the True Immortal flesh back into the Immortal Bronze Bones."

"The corrosive decay will become far less effective against the immortal artifact remains."

Li Fan pondered for a moment before temporarily stopping Tianyang from doing so.

He even instructed Tianyang to voluntarily withdraw the protective force field and use its own flesh to personally experience the erosion of the decayed green aura.

"Do not worry. True Immortal flesh can regenerate. I can even reforge your immortal bones if necessary. As long as the core is unharmed, everything else is insignificant."

Only Tianyang, having lost nearly all independent will as an immortal puppet, could endure such a fatal threat while faithfully obeying Li Fan's orders.

Tianyang voluntarily dismissed its force field.

The green aura instantly came into direct contact with the True Immortal flesh. The speed of the decay was far faster than Li Fan had imagined.

It was like a pile of dry grass being set ablaze in an instant. Only what ignited the True Immortal flesh was not fire, but the decayed green aura.

Green light spread wildly. After it burned away everything, nothing remained except ashes covering the ground.

The once vibrant flesh had become a stone-like statue.

The transformation happened in an instant, causing even Li Fan, who merely observed from the sidelines, to feel a chill.

What shook him even more was the sensation transmitted by Tianyang when the vitality within its flesh was completely exhausted.

It was unlike ordinary aging or the gradual fading of life. Instead, the very vitality that formed one of the fundamental components of life was ignited and completely consumed in an instant.

Words could not accurately describe the experience.

Only by personally undergoing it could one truly understand the terror of having one of life's fundamental elements directly stripped away.

When the rabbit dies, the fox grieves. One mourns those of the same kind.

The instant vitality was extracted, all the other elements that composed life also reacted.

They collapsed in panic.

Li Fan seemed to see the countless intertwined lines of Great Dao principles that formed Tianyang's immortal puppet. The moment one thread was pulled away, all the others collapsed one after another.

In the blink of an eye, the mighty Immortal Puppet was reduced to ashes.

His thoughts raced as he controlled Tianyang at the final moment, retracting a small portion of the flesh back into the immortal bones.

When the decayed green aura encountered the immortal bones forged from the remains of an immortal artifact, it was as though it had struck an impenetrable wall. Its unstoppable advance immediately came to a halt.

Li Fan saw the truth clearly.

The greatest reason the green aura failed to continue eroding was because the puppet's immortal bones contained none of the Dao of Vitality.

"If it had instead been the Obliterating Wind Calamity from the Immortal Realm catastrophe, the result would have been completely different. These so called immortal bones would probably have turned into dust in an instant."

"So the various catastrophes of the Immortal Realm are manifestations of different Great Dao principles? Each specifically targets a different Dao?"

"The Dao Obliteration Calamity..."

Li Fan fell into deep thought.

Inside the Great Void, Jian Daosheng saw the immortal puppet's defenses disappear instantly and watched it nearly be consumed in the blink of an eye. He could not help but cry out in alarm.

"How could it happen so quickly?"

Almost instinctively, he merged with the Desolate God Statue once again.

He attempted to control the decayed green aura and slow its advance.

Li Fan had not forgotten the purpose of this journey.

With a thought, the long slumbering Tianyang immortal puppet finally opened its eyes.

The force field reappeared, forcing the green aura clinging to its body backward.

True Immortal flesh surged out once more from within the immortal bones, restoring it from a skeleton into the appearance of a complete puppet.

Its body, however, was no longer as enormous as before.

With a single flicker, it had already arrived before the head of the gray statue.

Faced with the puppet's sudden eruption, Jian Daosheng appeared completely unsurprised.

Several dozen of the thousand eyes upon the giant head suddenly focused on Tianyang and unleashed blazing beams of scorching light.

These beams were not only immensely destructive, causing the puppet's protective force field to tremble violently.

They also resembled countless ropes, binding the Tianyang Immortal Puppet in place.

Within the Great Void, flashes of light continuously appeared.

One after another, the elders of the Immortal Ark descended.

Zhong Daogong's voice echoed repeatedly.

"We originally prepared this only as a precaution against accidents. I never expected our caution to prove correct."

"Did you really think the Immortal Ark is full of fools? You delivered it to us so openly and expected us to fall for it?"

"Heh. Our Immortal Ark has hidden itself from the world for ten thousand years. The only thing that could possibly attract outsiders is the gray Go piece left behind by Sun Piaomiao. We have been waiting all this time for someone to come for it. Who would have thought you would choose such a foolish method?"

Mocking laughter echoed throughout the space.

Then the elders of the Immortal Ark flew one after another into the eyes of the Desolate God.

After being occupied by the elders, the previously dim eyes lit up once more.

They released blazing white rays of light.

As more and more beams appeared, the chains wrapped around Tianyang became increasingly heavy.

The immortal puppet struggled to move, only to discover that the restraining power exerted by the Desolate God was unexpectedly overwhelming.

Even taking a single step became extraordinarily difficult.

"So this is not the third layer of the Hidden Immortal Compendium of the Hundred Tales."

"It is simply a trap prepared for those who walked into it."

The puppet spoke in a low voice as it looked toward the Desolate God, whose vitality seemed to be rapidly returning after merging with the Immortal Ark elders.

The gray coloration faded from its body, while the decayed green aura occupying most of its form retreated below its knees.

The ancient Desolate God fixed all one thousand of its eyes upon Tianyang.

After all, Tianyang had merely been pieced together by Li Fan using every bit of immortal power at his disposal.

It was not a genuine puppet forged by a True Immortal.

Against the fully awakened Desolate God, it gradually fell behind in their contest of strength and was slowly suppressed.

Seeing victory already within reach, the elders of the Immortal Ark finally spoke proudly.

"Exactly. How could we possibly leave such a slumbering immortal puppet inside the Immortal Ark's most important location without first awakening it?"

"We originally thought we would have to spend considerable effort luring you out. Who knew you would lose your patience so quickly?"

"You actually thought a single immortal puppet could invade the Immortal Ark alone and steal our treasures? You think far too little of us."

...

Their mocking voices rose one after another.

Yet the restraining force exerted by the Desolate God did not weaken in the slightest.

Instead, it grew increasingly powerful.

Furthermore, Li Fan sensed that as the Desolate God's vitality steadily recovered, another unique aura gradually emerged from within its body.

Creak. Creak.

Besides the countless beams emitted by the thousand eyes, an invisible pressure descended upon Tianyang in an instant.

For a brief moment, Li Fan truly felt as though an ancient Desolate God had appeared before him.

Its face was ferocious.

Its thousand eyes stared directly at him.

"I underestimated you."

"I simply never imagined that your Immortal Ark would actually use that Go piece as bait. The aura originating from an Immortal Realm fragment cannot be forged."

"Were you not afraid that one mistake would allow the Go piece to fall into my hands?"

The Tianyang immortal puppet admitted its mistake in a low voice before asking with genuine surprise.

"We only have this final Go piece left anyway. Without a complete set, this single piece is worthless."

"Hmph. You cannot catch the wolf without sacrificing the bait. If we did not deceive you into acting, we would never have activated this Desolate God so easily."

"Heh. Not only is the Go piece genuine. Even the other treasures are genuine. If you are going to put on a performance, it has to look convincing."

"Enough talking. Capture him first."

Buzz. Buzz. Buzz.

Amid the overlapping voices of the Immortal Ark elders, the ancient Desolate God slowly raised its right hand.

It appeared ready to seize Tianyang with a single grasp.

The enormous hand descended.

The surrounding space was completely sealed by countless beams of light.

The Tianyang Immortal Puppet appeared to have reached a dead end.

Yet for some reason, there was not the slightest trace of despair on its face.

"Your plan..."

"...was very good."

"But unfortunately, everything ends here."

The Tianyang Immortal Puppet looked toward the ancient Desolate God within the Great Hollow.

"Today, I will teach you a lesson."

"In the cultivation world, the strong reign supreme. Before absolute power, all schemes are nothing more than a joke."

A faint glimmer suddenly appeared on the Tianyang Immortal Puppet's forehead. A violent wind abruptly rose within the Great Hollow.

"This is bad. Stop him!"

The elders of the Immortal Ark instantly sensed that something was wrong.

The thousand eyes of the Desolate God suddenly erupted with unprecedented brilliance.

Its vitality grew even more vigorous, and its movements became several times faster.

But it was already too late.

The Immortal Descent Formation. All Things Return to Void.

A world destroying storm burst forth from the point of light on the Tianyang Immortal Puppet's forehead.

It then swept across everything around it.

What surprised Li Fan was that the decaying green aura, which had previously been suppressed by the Desolate God's vitality, was not affected by the Immortal Formation's power to annihilate all existence.

Instead, like a fish entering water, it borrowed the strength of the world destroying Immortal Formation and once again began eroding the Desolate God's body.

The Return to Void Immortal Formation and the Decaying Green aura. Under the combined assault of these two disasters, the lower half of the Desolate God's body was engulfed by overwhelming destructive power.

Only its thousand eyed head remained.

"Ancient Desolate God, bearer of the Immortal Mandate."

"Shelter Against Calamities."

"Condense!"

The elders of the Immortal Ark shouted in unison.

Within the head, the eyes that still shone with light suddenly began moving rapidly.

In an instant, they merged into one.

A gigantic hollow eye immediately appeared in the very center of the ancient Desolate God's face.

A sacred power manifested, forcefully suppressing the destructive energy surging upward below.

Seeing this, the Tianyang Immortal Puppet did not retreat. Instead, it charged forward.

Wrapped in the power of the World Destroying Immortal Formation, it confronted the one eyed Desolate God head on.

Behind it, countless streams of green aura surged like dragons, flood serpents, and giant snakes, rolling forward in an overwhelming tide.

The two powers originating from the Immortal Realm collided.

Facing the Desolate God's single eye directly, the Tianyang Immortal Puppet's remaining True Immortal flesh melted away like snow beneath the sun.

Yet its Immortal bones remained, and its momentum did not diminish.

Relying on the remaining power of the Immortal Formation, it advanced under the gaze of the Desolate God's eye.

It smoothly reached the side of the head, where the remaining hollow eyes were located.

The frantic shouts of the Immortal Ark elders echoed through the air.

The Tianyang Immortal Puppet locked onto the final Go piece.

It reached inside, intending to remove it.

Li Fan immediately sensed a binding force identical to the blazing beam previously fired from the Desolate God's eye.

In fact, it was even stronger. It was enough to block the probing of almost every cultivator in existence.

But compared to the strength of the Immortal Puppet, it was insignificant. With only a slight exertion of force, the final gray Go piece was taken into its hand.

Li Fan quickly turned his attention to the nearest target.

After retrieving another item, he sensed that the storm generated by the Immortal Formation was beginning to fade, and that the Desolate God was about to react.

Li Fan hesitated no longer and immediately urged the Tianyang Immortal Puppet to retreat at full speed.

"Close the entrance!" Nangong Lie's somewhat crazed voice could vaguely be heard.

"Have you gone mad? Do you want us to be buried together with the Desolate God?"

The majority of the elders still retained their reason.

The exit formed by the Heavenly Star Light Lotus therefore remained open.

Li Fan passed through it and swept his gaze across the treasures stored on the second layer of the hidden vault.

He attempted to take some of them away, only to discover that every treasure was wrapped within a Light Lotus. Without a special method to unlock the Light Lotus, the only option was to destroy the entire lotus itself.

Since Li Fan's true body had not personally arrived, the Immortal Formation's power he had left behind had already been completely exhausted.

The Tianyang Immortal Puppet no longer lingered.

It transformed into a streak of light and fled.

Every protective restriction within the Immortal Ark was treated as though it did not exist. Before leaving, Li Fan looked through the doorway once more.

He seemed to see endless waves of green aura surging forward like a tide, completely surrounding the Desolate God's head.

A short while later.

The Tianyang Immortal Puppet did not immediately return to the Great Xuan small world to hand the Go piece over to Li Fan's true body.

Instead, it quietly stood in the void, watching the Immortal Ark in the distance.

The Immortal Ark shook slightly.

Yet in the end, it gradually settled down once again.

"As expected, they really do have some ability."

"They even managed to suppress the decaying green aura that had been awakened by the World Destroying Immortal Formation."

"The Desolate God..."

Li Fan's expression became somewhat solemn.

Judging from their brief exchange just now, the Desolate God hidden within the Xuan Immortal Ark, even without fully releasing its strength, was already evenly matched with the Tianyang Immortal Puppet.

Its peak strength in ancient times was easy to imagine.

"It is merely a servant of a True Immortal."

"Yet the Xuan Immortal Ark can actually control such an ancient Desolate God."

"They truly have pushed the path of borrowing external power to its absolute limit."

Li Fan praised them slightly.

"In my previous life, I never saw this Desolate God appear when the World Destroying Immortal Formation was unleashed."

"It seems that Great Hollow is not actually located within the Immortal Ark."

"Instead, it is merely a passage opened whenever the Heavenly Star Light Lotus descends."

While Li Fan was still contemplating this, the Immortal Ark, which had just calmed down, began moving once more.

It was not pursuing the Tianyang Immortal Puppet.

Instead, it changed its hidden position within the Star Sea.

"From the Immortal Ark's perspective, after losing the Go piece, the enemy has also lost the means to locate its position."

"As long as it hides itself again, it should regain its peace."

"As for the loss of that other Immortal treasure..."

Li Fan's divine sense swept over the second item in the Tianyang Immortal Puppet's hand besides the gray Go piece.

It was an ancient bronze coin.

The patterns on its front and back were completely different.

However, regardless of what method Li Fan used, he was unable to clearly discern what was actually engraved upon it.

Temporarily shifting his attention away from the Immortal treasure bronze coin, Li Fan cast one final glance at the Xuan Immortal Ark.

"These losses are actually still acceptable for an organization as wealthy as the Xuan Immortal Ark."

"Their true trouble will most likely still come from the Desolate God."

"After all, the power of a True Immortal is not so easily borrowed."

Li Fan smiled faintly as he directed the Tianyang Immortal Puppet toward the Inch Apart, Worlds Away Teleportation Formation.

Not long afterward, it had already returned to the Great Xuan small world.

Li Fan's true body had long since prepared new True Immortal flesh and immediately reequipped the puppet with it.

The Tianyang Immortal Puppet handed the two treasures it had obtained to Li Fan before beginning to adapt to its new body.

During its battle with the Thousand Eyed Desolate God, Tianyang had instinctively gained some insights.

After remaining silent for a period of time, it gradually entered secluded cultivation.

Seeing this, Li Fan did not disturb it.

He first began examining the bronze coin.

Now using his true body, whose divine soul was vastly stronger, he was finally able to vaguely make out the patterns engraved upon it.

One side depicted an immense, magnificent complex of palaces. The other side contained countless overlapping scenes that changed continuously.

"No wonder my split divine sense could not see it clearly before."

"The speed of these changes..."

Li Fan's expression shifted slightly.

Holding the bronze coin tightly, he narrowed his eyes and attempted to observe every fleeting image as it flashed past.

At the same time, the Dao Deviation Stone within his mind emitted a faint glow.

It recorded every single image.

Then reconstructed them.

In this manner, sixteen full days passed before Li Fan finally managed to completely record every scene engraved upon what appeared to be only a tiny bronze coin.

"So this bronze coin records the scenery of a certain star region within the upper Immortal Realm?"

Before Li Fan slowly unfolded a magnificent reconstructed scroll.

"There is not a single True Immortal visible."

"It contains only natural landscapes."

"And scattered buildings."

Li Fan carefully examined the scenery depicted within this Immortal Realm.

The instant he fully understood the entire image of this Immortal domain, a name naturally surfaced in his mind.

"Beilin."

"The palace engraved on the other side of the bronze coin should belong to the ruler of Beilin."

Recalling the memories he had previously witnessed within the True Immortal flesh, Li Fan fell into thought.

"I wonder what the structure of the Immortal Realm was truly like in the past."

"Judging from this, could there really have been an Immortal Emperor?"

"If so, then what status did the Nameless True Immortal hold?"

Li Fan's expression became somewhat strange as countless thoughts raced through his mind.
