Chapter 1363: The Immortal Formation Traps The Heavenly Doctor

After gathering his thoughts, Li Fan tightly gripped the "Beilin" bronze coin from the immortal domain, attempting to uncover its true function.

'Surely it cannot really be nothing more than an ordinary currency?'

Li Fan always had the vague feeling that this immortal coin concealed other secrets.

He first attempted to infuse it with source power essence to activate it.

However, source power essence was merely the form of energy in the lower realm that came closest to immortal spiritual power. That did not mean it was truly equivalent to immortal spiritual power.

When faced with the Beilin immortal coin, a genuine artifact of the Immortal Realm, it naturally proved ineffective.

The surging source power essence crashed against the surface of the immortal coin like an endless tide, yet it could not penetrate into it.

Li Fan withdrew the source power essence, pondered for a moment, then arrived in the void outside the Xuanhuang Realm.

He activated the Ascension Formation and once again observed it from an elevated dimensional perspective.

Sure enough, it appeared different from what he normally saw.

As the level of his own "momentum" continued to rise, the constantly changing scenes upon one side of the bronze coin gradually slowed. At the same time, the complete panorama visible to him became increasingly larger.

Moreover...

Above the heavens of the complete Beilin Immortal Domain, a vague shadow unexpectedly appeared.

He could not make out its appearance. Yet after only a single glance, the spiritual energy throughout Li Fan's body began boiling uncontrollably.

In an instant, he could no longer maintain his elevated state and fell back into the ordinary mortal realm.

However, the boiling spiritual energy within his body did not cease.

Li Fan frowned slightly and attempted to mobilize greater power to forcibly suppress the abnormality.

But this decision was like pouring firewood onto a blazing fire.

As though ignited by an invisible flame, it burned ever more fiercely without stopping, until every trace of spiritual energy and even his physical body had been completely reduced to ashes.

Only then did it finally end.

Not long afterward, accompanied by a strange fluctuation, Li Fan's body once again materialized within the void.

Within a few breaths, both his vitality and spiritual energy had returned to full.

"It was not only my spiritual energy and body. Even my divine soul was nearly affected."

"Fortunately, I acted decisively and immediately severed the connection between my divine soul and my body."

After inspecting the condition of his new body, Li Fan's expression turned solemn.

"I merely glanced at that figure once..."

"Is this the punishment for a mortal lifeform attempting to gaze upon the face of a True Immortal?"

"If it were not for my exceptional means of preserving my life, any Dao Integration cultivator in the current Xuanhuang Realm would likely have perished under that punishment."

"That figure is certainly no ordinary True Immortal. The Nameless Realm..." Li Fan murmured thoughtfully.

Temporarily sealing away the Beilin immortal coin, Li Fan did not rush to merge the fragment of the Immortal Realm.

Instead, after suppressing it within the Great Qi small world, his true body leisurely headed toward the Xuan Immortal Ark.

At the same time, he did not forget to halt the preparations for the Equal Heaven Ritual to avoid arousing the Xuan Immortal Ark's suspicions.

Along the way, Li Fan carefully sensed the recent changes occurring within his body.

Although they were extremely slight, his control over himself had already reached the level where every detail was as clear as observing fire in the palm of his hand. Naturally, he noticed them immediately.

Touching his face, he muttered, "It is actually beginning to transform toward the appearance of that Thousand-Eyed Desolate God... Is this the price of using the Desolate God's power?"

"I never personally participated. I was merely affected by the previous Equal Heaven Ritual."

A trace of interest flashed across his face.

Determined to see the act through to the end, Li Fan first returned to the place where the Xuan Immortal Ark had originally been stationed.

Finding no trace of it, he stood there blankly for a while.

Only afterward did he use the connection between the Equal Heaven Rituals to locate the Ark's new hiding place.

The Ark's gates remained tightly shut. Not a single elder emerged to receive him.

A look of anxiety appeared on Li Fan's face. He immediately released his own aura as a signal. After waiting for some time and still receiving no response from the Ark, he prepared to force his way inside.

Only then did Zhong Daogong's somewhat weakened voice finally arrive.

"There is no need to worry. We are fine."

"It is simply inconvenient for us to meet for the time being..."

Li Fan first let out a sigh of relief. But after hearing Zhong Daogong's explanation, indignation appeared on his face.

"After the Equal Heaven Ritual, we are already bound together in life and death. Do you still not trust me?"

Zhong Daogong sighed.

"Not at all, not at all. Have you not noticed the changes in your own body?"

Li Fan appeared stunned. After examining himself, his body trembled violently.

"What exactly happened?"

Only then did Zhong Daogong slowly recount everything that had occurred previously with the mysterious Immortal Puppet.

Li Fan's expression shifted repeatedly. He wanted to speak, yet stopped himself.

"Fortunately, that puppet was also heavily injured. In the end, it only managed to seize the final Go piece and one immortal bronze coin. It did not inflict even greater damage upon the Ark. Otherwise, I truly would deserve death ten thousand times over."

"The greatest mistake was underestimating the power that Immortal Puppet could unleash. I never imagined that in today's Star Sea there would still exist something capable of contending against the Desolate God." Zhong Daogong coughed lightly.

After a long silence, Li Fan finally spoke.

"Even if I had been present, I fear I would still have fallen into its trap. After all, it was an Immortal Puppet. It was immune to the power of the True Immortal seal script and possessed genuine True Immortal flesh and blood."

"Could it be that somewhere within the Star Sea there still exists a civilization that completely surpasses both the Xuan Immortal Ark and Great Qi?" Li Fan deliberately displayed a shocked expression.

"I fear that is indeed the truth." Zhong Daogong replied before changing the subject.

"Now that that civilization has gathered all the Go pieces, it will likely devote all its efforts to recreating the former immortal domain. For the time being, it should have no interest in targeting us again."

"They left behind no tracking method at all? To lose such a supreme treasure so easily truly leaves one unwilling to accept it."

"Even if we could not defeat them, we could at least track them down, investigate their true strength, and create some trouble. At the very least, they should know that our Xuan Immortal Ark is not so easily bullied." Li Fan snorted.

Zhong Daogong did not refute him.

"It is simply because our skills were inferior. The Xuan Immortal Ark has always placed survival above all else. We do not fight out of pride. Besides, among us, no one has yet comprehended the astonishing movement technique that you possess."

Li Fan was left speechless.

"This Thousand-Eyed Desolate God is also one of the Xuan Immortal Ark's ultimate trump cards. Although it can unleash immortal level power, it requires an extremely lengthy preparation beforehand. Furthermore, afterward we must endure the Desolate God's backlash."

"The reason we are not allowing you to meet us for the moment is because, as one part of the Equal Heaven Ritual, you were not affected by the Thousand-Eyed Desolate God. You are like an anchor that helps slow our gradual transformation." Zhong Daogong briefly explained.

"By remaining outside, you are actually helping us recover."

Li Fan nodded, accepting the explanation.

"Is there anything I can help with? I remember that Great Qi once had a Dao Venerable who researched the transformations caused by the influence of True Immortal power..."

Zhong Daogong paused, seeming somewhat hesitant.

In the end, however, he still declined Li Fan's offer.

"There is no need to worry. We have dealt with the power of the True Immortal seal script for many years. We have considerable experience."

Li Fan appeared somewhat disappointed.

"Very well. I only came here despite the enormous risk because I was worried about the Ark's safety. After all, I have been secretly carrying out the ritual..."

"At present, the ritual has already spread across three hundred million people. If everything proceeds smoothly, that number should still increase another three to five times."

Li Fan reported his accomplishments.

A trace of joy finally entered Zhong Daogong's voice.

"Excellent. That should reduce the Star Sea's backlash to the minimum."

"It is merely a minor interruption. It will not have much effect. The greater plan remains the priority. There cannot be the slightest mistake with the ritual. You should return as soon as possible."

As he spoke, he was clearly asking Li Fan to leave.

'It seems they have ultimately become suspicious of me. They are currently in an extremely weakened state and dare not allow me to enter.'

'However, because they still require me to gather sacrifices for the Equal Heaven Ritual, they cannot openly fall out with me.'

Li Fan understood the situation perfectly. Just as he was about to bid farewell.

Boom!

A tremendous shockwave like a towering tidal wave suddenly swept over from the distant High Wall.

Its speed was far too great. Moreover, since he still needed to conceal his true abilities before the Ark, Li Fan deliberately pretended that he had failed to react in time.

Caught within the shockwave, he was dragged several thousand li through the Star Sea before finally managing to stabilize himself.

Meanwhile, the Xuan Immortal Ark, which had been hidden, was directly forced out of concealment by the strange and overwhelming impact.

Like a tiny boat tossed upon a stormy sea, it rocked violently without end.

"What happened?"

Li Fan returned near the Ark in a somewhat disheveled state. Looking toward the direction of the High Wall from which the shockwave had come, he asked with complete astonishment.

The people aboard the Xuan Immortal Ark were equally shocked.

"According to the records of our Ark, a phenomenon like this has occurred only three times before..."

"As for its origin, we have no clue."

"What a pity. If we were not currently recovering from serious injuries, we would certainly investigate its source."

After this disturbance, the other Elders of the Immortal Ark all emerged one after another. Each of them appeared somewhat weak and lacking vitality.

Li Fan sensed the fluctuations spreading into the distance and discovered that their power diminished drastically as they propagated through the Star Sea. It seemed that the residual power of the True Immortals permeating the Star Sea acted as an obstacle to their transmission.

"I'll go take a look!" Li Fan cupped his fists toward the Immortal Ark and volunteered.

"Do not worry. If I cannot find the source, I will return immediately."

Without waiting for a response from the others aboard the Immortal Ark, Li Fan controlled the Wooden Sword phantom and shot toward the direction from which the disturbance had come.

He swiftly crossed the Remnant World Great Wall, following the lingering energy fluctuations through the Star Sea until he was about to reach their source.

However, Li Fan's expression gradually became grave. He suddenly realized that this terrifying disturbance had originated from the breach in the High Wall.

This discovery caused his heart to skip a beat.

He immediately increased his speed.

A few breaths later, when Li Fan arrived at the breach in the High Wall, he found that Mo Rubin, who should have been comprehending the secrets of the High Wall, had been reduced to only half a head and had fallen unconscious.

The Wooden Sword and dao comprehension phantom that Li Fan had left behind were still there.

They seemed completely unaffected by the previous disturbance.

'No wonder I didn't notice anything...'

'What exactly happened? Can the High Wall actually strike back and injure people? Could it be that Mo Rubin truly comprehended something?'

Li Fan's thoughts raced. After examining him, he found that although Mo Rubin was gravely injured, he had not died. Only then did Li Fan feel somewhat relieved.

Just as he was about to inspect the breach in the High Wall again, his expression suddenly changed.

He faintly sensed a familiar aura rapidly approaching.

'The Heavenly Doctor?!'

'He also noticed that disturbance and came here?'

Li Fan pondered briefly before quickly making a decision.

There was no need to confront the Heavenly Doctor head on yet. If the Heavenly Doctor discovered his secret plan to elevate the Xuanhuang Realm, it would only introduce unnecessary complications.

The Wooden Sword phantom flashed.

It immediately carried away Mo Rubin's half head and fled the scene.

'Strange. The Xuan Immortal Ark previously mentioned that it had observed this kind of mysterious fluctuation several times.'

'If this disturbance was caused by Mo Rubin comprehending the breach in the High Wall, then that means someone must have done the same thing before.'

Recalling how quickly the Heavenly Doctor had arrived this time, Li Fan suddenly understood.

'The Heavenly Doctor actually discovered the breach in the High Wall long ago?'

'He has even comprehended it more than once and gained something from it?'

'He truly cannot be underestimated. Even now that I possess an Immortal-grade formation, the same remains true.'

Li Fan was inwardly shaken.

He continued flying past the Remnant World Great Wall until he reached an empty region of the Star Sea.

Only then did he begin treating Mo Rubin's injuries.

With vast amounts of spiritual energy and soul power flowing into him, Mo Rubin gradually awoke from his unconscious state.

His flesh slowly regenerated as well.

"Uh..."

Mo Rubin opened his eyes in confusion. Upon seeing Li Fan's concerned expression, he froze for a moment.

Then he abruptly turned his head to look around.

"Hm? Wasn't I beneath the High Wall?"

"You suffered severe injuries. Fortunately, I arrived in time." Li Fan briefly explained.

His words seemed to awaken a missing fragment of Mo Rubin's memory. His entire body suddenly trembled violently, as if struck by lightning.

"What exactly happened? Your condition just now was utterly miserable. Whatever injured you to that extent..." Li Fan stared fixedly at him.

Mo Rubin opened his mouth but found himself unable to speak.

"When you were unconscious, a strange fluctuation swept across the entire Star Sea."

"And there have already been three previous records of identical fluctuations."

"Do you know what that means?"

Li Fan's words immediately filled Mo Rubin with disbelief.

After thinking for a long while, he slowly spoke.

"Actually... I am not entirely sure either."

"I only remember that while I was comprehending the secrets of the High Wall, I suddenly seemed to understand something."

"I cannot clearly describe what I comprehended."

"I only felt that, in that instant, it was like a fish leaping out of the sea or a bird breaking free into the sky. It was as though I witnessed scenery completely different from anything before..."

Mo Rubin's voice became somewhat distant as he frowned, trying to recall the feeling.

"Then I lost consciousness and fainted."

Li Fan could not help asking, "You were unable to resist at all?"

Mo Rubin shook his head.

'That strange fluctuation weakened rapidly as it spread through the Star Sea. By the time it reached the vicinity of the Immortal Ark, its power was already so terrifying. One can only imagine the earth-shattering force at its point of origin near the High Wall. If what Mo Rubin said is true, then could this be the High Wall's self-defense mechanism triggered by Dao comprehension?'

Li Fan silently pondered.

At this moment, Mo Rubin also realized something.

"You carried me away... Does that mean someone went to investigate the breach in the High Wall?"

"Correct. Moreover, that person's strength is extraordinary. They are likely even stronger than the two of us." Li Fan replied solemnly.

Mo Rubin's expression shifted repeatedly.

"No. I must immediately return to the breach in the High Wall. I have a premonition that my previous enlightenment is fading away like the receding tide. If I cannot rely on the aura of the High Wall to preserve that enlightenment, then all my previous efforts will be completely wasted."

He spoke with absolute determination.

Without waiting for Li Fan's reaction, he charged straight toward their destination.

Even knowing that an unknown and powerful enemy lay ahead, he still acted this way. This was completely unlike Mo Rubin's usual style.

It clearly demonstrated just how irresistible the secrets of the High Wall were to cultivators.

They could even influence one's mind to a certain extent.

After pondering briefly, Li Fan decided to follow.

The Wooden Sword phantom enveloped the two of them, while an Immortal-grade formation formed from source power essence concealed their auras.

"In fact, returning now is a good opportunity. After the other party investigated and found no one there, they would naturally spend some time tracking us. They would never expect us to return immediately..."

While speaking, the two had already arrived back at the breach in the High Wall.

As expected, the Heavenly Doctor was nowhere to be seen.

Just as Mo Rubin was about to step forward, Li Fan suddenly reached out to stop him.

After carefully observing the area, they discovered countless threads spread through the empty space ahead like a giant spider web.

They clung to the invisible High Wall, layer upon layer, completely covering the location of the breach.

The sight caused both Li Fan and Mo Rubin to involuntarily inhale sharply.

"This..."

The two of them had personally experienced the transcendent nature of the High Wall.

Mo Rubin especially had spent month after month comprehending Dao beneath it.

He knew better than anyone that merely remaining beneath the High Wall for a prolonged period was already extraordinarily difficult with his strength.

Leaving behind his own energy or traces upon the High Wall was simply impossible.

"So there is actually someone in the Star Sea capable of this?"

After his initial shock, Li Fan quickly calmed down.

"It is only a temporary method. Those golden threads are naturally fading away."

"We only need to wait."

Mo Rubin replied in a deep voice, "The problem is that we cannot wait."

"The person who set up these measures must have experienced the same kind of Dao comprehension that I did. They know that merely delaying me for this period of time is enough."

"And..."

Mo Rubin glanced around.

"I am afraid that person has not gone far. They are probably waiting nearby for us to take the bait."

Although he spoke that way, Mo Rubin had already begun to drift involuntarily toward the breach in the High Wall surrounded by golden threads.

The aura he could no longer suppress made it clear that his reason was gradually being overwhelmed by desire.

Li Fan frowned. After pondering for a long while, he finally let out a long sigh.

"So be it. Then I shall risk my life alongside yours."

"I will hold the opponent back."

"You must act quickly. I may not be able to delay them for long."

Before his words had even finished, countless golden threads flew out from Li Fan's body.

Within the void, they wove together into an incomparably mysterious and beautiful pattern.

"Let the Heavenly Doctor test the might of my Illusory Xuanhuang, Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation."

Li Fan snorted inwardly.

Although he did not wish to come into conflict with the Heavenly Doctor ahead of time, he was by no means afraid of him.

With both his movement techniques and Immortal formation supporting him, Li Fan was confident he could suppress the Heavenly Doctor for a short period of time.

Having obtained Li Fan's promise, Mo Rubin no longer restrained himself.

"Demonic Heart, Immortal Intent."

He let out a low shout.

In an instant, countless faces emerged from his body, like enormous storm clouds gathering before a torrential rain.

Each face bore a different expression.

Like moths flying into a flame, they surged toward the golden threads left behind by the Heavenly Doctor.

Hidden beneath the cover of the countless demonic souls, Mo Rubin's true body quietly approached the High Wall.

"Hmm..."

A sound like the vibration of a zither string suddenly echoed throughout the Star Sea.

Before the army of demonic souls could even reach the Heavenly Doctor's golden threads, great numbers of them melted away as though snow exposed to blazing sunlight.

They did not disappear completely. Instead, each left behind a faint, blurry figure.

Looking closely, every one of those figures contained a slender golden thread.

The golden threads linked all the demonic souls together, and in an instant they turned against their former master. They crashed into the demonic souls still controlled by Mo Rubin.

"A mere mortal path dares contend with Immortal arts?"

Mo Rubin shouted coldly. His eyes instantly sank into a strange, deathly darkness.

An invisible mirror silently appeared under his gaze.

It reflected every demonic soul that had fallen under the Heavenly Doctor's control.

The mirror erupted with black light, turning from illusion into reality.

Then the demonic souls within the mirror once again transformed, each bearing Mo Rubin's own face.

Although golden threads still controlled them internally, they were forcibly possessed by Mo Rubin once more.

Relying upon the cover of his immortal and indestructible demonic souls, Mo Rubin successfully broke through the outer layer of the Heavenly Doctor's defenses.

Just as the breach in the High Wall came within arm's reach, Mo Rubin suddenly realized he could no longer move.

Transparent needles had somehow been driven into his body.

At first there was only one.

Then one became two.

Two became four.

As though they possessed consciousness of their own, they multiplied instinctively, quickly piercing every acupoint across his body.

The savage expression on Mo Rubin's face gradually froze as well.

While continuing to arrange the formation and observing the battle, Li Fan witnessed this scene and considered whether he should intervene.

Yet he discovered he had still underestimated this ancient Dharma King of the Xuantian Sect.

The instant Mo Rubin became motionless, every invisible needle was quietly stained with a trace of pitch-black color.

Like a muddy swamp, the darkness steadily spread upward.

If magnified, one would discover that the blackness consisted of manifestations of Mo Rubin's demonic souls.

Compared to the ones he had released earlier, these possessed even less reason.

Only endless madness and destruction remained in their eyes as they continuously devoured the sealing needles.

Once a needle was completely consumed by the demonic souls, it was pulled free from Mo Rubin's body.

It immediately flew toward the remaining needles, helping erode them.

As a result, the sealing needles collapsed faster and faster. After only a few breaths, every one of them had been destroyed by Mo Rubin.

"The Innumerable Calamities Undying Demon Heart Immortal Art truly lives up to being an Immortal Realm cultivation technique personally chosen for Mo Rubin by the Xuantian King. It is indeed extraordinary."

Having witnessed the entire assault, Li Fan could not help but praise it inwardly.

After forcing back the sealing needles, only the Heavenly Doctor's final layer of defense remained before Mo Rubin.

Meanwhile, Li Fan had already completed the formation.

He also sensed the Heavenly Doctor's aura approaching from not far away.

"No matter if you are the strongest in the Star Sea, you will still have to walk through my Illusory Xuanhuang, Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation."

A fierce light erupted from Li Fan's eyes.

Looking at the white-haired figure in the distance, Li Fan seemed to recall the scene of his very first encounter with this peerless expert of the Heavenly Law Realm.

Source power essence poured out continuously.

The Final Dissociation Disc simultaneously operated at its absolute limit.

All the knowledge regarding the Heavenly Law Realm that Li Fan had accumulated through over a hundred reincarnations flashed through his mind in an instant.

"Taste the perfect world I have specially crafted for you."

"Formation, activate!"

Li Fan roared.

An invisible ripple instantly enveloped the Heavenly Doctor as he flew through the void.

A trace of astonishment flashed across his face.

Then everything before his eyes turned black, and he lost consciousness.

When he awoke once more, he remained dazed for a moment.

Then an incomparably innocent voice called out to him.

"Venerable. Venerable."

The Heavenly Doctor turned toward the source of the voice.

It was an exceedingly adorable little girl.

She appeared to be only around ten years old, yet she had already reached the Nascent Soul realm.

"Su Xiaomei."

Information about the little girl instantly surfaced within the Heavenly Doctor's mind.

"The fusion of two worlds. Two Heavenly Dao consciousnesses attached separately to a mother and daughter."

"Exceptionally gifted. Born free from the immortal mortal miasma. A perfect physique desired by countless living beings."

"Immortal Mortal Miasma?"

The Heavenly Doctor suddenly felt something was slightly out of place.

However, after a brief dizziness, memories of everything that had happened over the past ten thousand years flooded back into his mind.

Back then, during the life-and-death war between the Heavenly Law Realm and the Xuanhuang Realm, the Heavenly Law Realm had ultimately managed to seize victory by the narrowest of margins.

The Heavenly Law Realm successfully devoured the Xuanhuang Realm, gaining the resources of an entire cultivation world and temporarily distancing itself from the Immortal Ruins.

The price, however, had been unimaginably devastating.

Among the Venerables of the Heavenly Law Realm, aside from himself, Tian Jue, Tian Yin, Tian Yu, and the others had all fallen in battle.

Meanwhile, in their final moment of despair, the cultivators of the Xuanhuang Realm sacrificed the world itself to unleash a fatal counterattack.

The Immortal Mortal Miasma, the law that different cultivation methods could not be cultivated together, and many other heaven and earth laws were quietly implanted into the Heavenly Law Realm like deadly poison.

Even the very foundation of cultivation itself was subtly altered. Because of his grievous injuries, the Heavenly Doctor had fallen unconscious and failed to notice the changes in time.

By the time he awoke, the Heavenly Law Realm had already undergone earth-shaking transformation.

Since different cultivation methods could no longer be practiced together, cultivators began slaughtering one another.

Already left desolate after the great war, the Heavenly Law Realm had nearly lost its entire cultivation heritage.

Fortunately, after a prolonged period of bloodshed, the surviving cultivators eventually accumulated enough cultivation techniques to continue cultivating.

The killing finally ceased.

Yet trust between cultivators had vanished forever.

Upon the barren wasteland, they survived only through mutual vigilance and complete isolation.

During this period, surviving cultivators drifting through the Star Sea also discovered the remnants of the Heavenly Law Realm.

Their original homes had already been destroyed by the Star Sea catastrophe.

One after another, they settled here. Over the following ten thousand years, the Star Sea itself continued to change.

The attraction of the Immortal Ruins constantly pulled everything within the Star Sea toward itself.

The Heavenly Law Realm, which had barely escaped back then, had now become the final sanctuary remaining in the Star Sea.

Even so, it inevitably drifted to the very edge of the Immortal Ruins.

It stood on the verge of collapse, always facing the danger of complete destruction.

When the Heavenly Doctor awoke, this was the reality before him.

Although deeply shaken, he immediately began taking remedial measures.

Through every method available, he finally persuaded several Longevity Immortal Realm experts across the Heavenly Law Realm to temporarily unite.

Together, they formed a loose alliance.

They gathered the remaining cultivators of the Heavenly Law Realm and supported mortals in beginning cultivation.

The Heavenly Law Realm gradually recovered some vitality.

However, every Longevity Immortal cultivator harbored ambitions of their own.

Faced with the Heavenly Law Realm, a colossal vessel that was slowly sinking, each had already begun planning an escape.

And this was the Heavenly Law Realm the Heavenly Doctor now sought to save.

Chapter 1364: The Great Venerable Of All Laws

"Venerable, Venerable!"

Su Xiaomei's cheerful voice pulled the Heavenly Doctor out of his memories.

"Venerable, look. What do you think of this new divine ability I just comprehended?"

As she spoke, Su Xiaomei opened her tiny mouth and spat out a streak of black sword light filled with the aura of annihilation, shooting straight toward the Heavenly Doctor.

The black sword light was founded upon the ceaseless circulation and endless vitality of the Five Elements. It was driven by an unstoppable resolve to advance without regard for life or death. Its edge carried the devouring power that extinguished all things and reduced all existence to silence.

With a single strike, it seemed to possess the might to destroy an entire world.

It was truly difficult to imagine that a divine ability of such terrifying power had come from the hands of a child not even ten years old.

A trace of admiration flashed through the Heavenly Doctor's eyes. Yet when faced with the annihilation sword light, he neither dodged nor defended.

He simply allowed it to strike him directly in the face.

In an instant, the flesh on the Heavenly Doctor's face transformed into countless intersecting lines.

Like an enormous net, it sank inward ever so slightly before effortlessly blocking the Great Five Elements Annihilation Sword.

Threads of golden light then emerged from the countless lines of the giant net.

They surged toward the Five Elements Annihilation Sword and completely engulfed it.

Like ice melting into water, the sword light quietly disappeared.

Seeing this, the previously excited Su Xiaomei immediately puffed out her cheeks.

"Venerable, you're really too strong. I achieved the Nascent Soul realm by using the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven as my foundation, yet I'm still nowhere near your match."

The Heavenly Doctor smiled.

"You little girl, how many days have you been cultivating? If you could already catch up to me, where would this old man put his dignity?"

He gently patted Su Xiaomei's head before his expression turned serious.

"Your divine ability is indeed excellent. It can be considered invincible among cultivators of the same realm. But..."

Su Xiaomei immediately raised her head and listened attentively.

"There is still quite a distance between it and the true meaning of the Great Dao. For example, what exactly is annihilation?"

The Heavenly Doctor raised a finger.

Black light also emerged from his fingertip.

However, compared to the black light contained within the Great Five Elements Annihilation Sword, it was far deeper and even more unfathomable.

"True annihilation does not exist within the world's own cycle."

"What people call extinction merely exists to prepare for a better rebirth."

"If you truly wish to touch genuine destruction, you must journey into the depths of the starry sky."

"You are still too young. Grow stronger first. Perhaps when you reach Dao Integration, you may give it a try."

The Heavenly Doctor stroked his beard as he spoke.

Su Xiaomei immediately wore a bitter expression.

"I have to wait until Dao Integration? Who knows how long that will take. Forget it. I'm going to play with Senior Sister Zhao!"

Before her words had even finished, she had already vanished in a blur.

"Zhao Ruoxi..."

Quietly repeating the name, a trace of gloom flashed across the Heavenly Doctor's face.

She had originally been the Sect Master of the Grand Dao Sect in the Xuanhuang Realm.

Although the ancient war between the two worlds ended with the Heavenly Law Realm emerging victorious, that did not mean every cultivator of the Xuanhuang Realm had perished.

Just as the Xuanhuang Realm itself had ultimately merged into the Heavenly Law Realm, a small number of Xuanhuang cultivators had likewise become members of the Heavenly Law Realm.

In truth, the Heavenly Law Realm's ultimate victory had been closely connected to these cultivators.

Unfortunately, they were the sort who could share prosperity but not hardship.

The past ten thousand years had been acceptable. Although the Heavenly Law Realm had suffered countless calamities, these cultivators had long stood at the pinnacle of the cultivation world, so the disasters had little effect on them.

But now...

The Heavenly Law Realm was about to fall into the Immortal Ruins.

Every one of these cultivators harbored their own schemes. Not a single one sincerely wished to save the Heavenly Law Realm.

The Heavenly Doctor let out a cold snort inwardly.

At present, these people had not completely torn away all pretenses, so it was not yet appropriate for him to strike first.

Let them wait.

For now, the most important matter was to continue increasing his own cultivation.

The Heavenly Doctor's bright eyes gazed into the heavens, as though he could see the True Immortal currently comprehending the Great Dao within the Immortal Ruins.

"The overwhelming majority of my strength comes from the Heavenly Dao of the Heavenly Law Realm. Although I remained in deep slumber for nearly ten thousand years because of my injuries, the Heavenly Law Realm has since devoured the Xuanhuang Realm, more than doubling the overall strength of the world. Naturally, my own cultivation has risen along with it."

"Especially after every Venerable perished. The Eternal Dao of the Heavenly Law Realm have all returned to me."

With a single thought, the Heavenly Doctor's consciousness instantly seemed to rise above the nine heavens.

He became one with the vast firmament itself, overlooking the mortal world through the Heavenly Dao of the Heavenly Law Realm.

Unlike other cultivation worlds, the Heavenly Law Realm possessed neither Heavenly Dao consciousness nor world consciousness.

Only the Eternal Dao of the Heavenly Law Realm existed.

Like an unfeeling machine, they had operated on their own since the creation of heaven and earth, never influenced by the will of any living being.

As the saying went, the Heavenly Laws were absolute, honoring only rules and order.

The Heavenly Laws could never be violated.

Only after intelligent life appeared between heaven and earth did certain beings become capable of resonating with these Eternal Dao.

Through that resonance, they gained the authority to enforce the Heavenly Laws on behalf of the world.

The people of the Heavenly Law Realm called such individuals Venerables.

Tian Jue, Tian Yin, and Tian Yu had all been Venerables of the Heavenly Law Realm.

However, the ancient war between the two worlds had been far too brutal. Every Venerable fell in battle.

Before their deaths, they passed all the resonance and comprehension they had accumulated over countless years with the Eternal Laws to the sole survivor.

That survivor was the Heavenly Doctor.

Thus, when the Heavenly Doctor awakened from his long slumber, he discovered that he had become the unprecedented Great Venerable of All Laws.

In any other cultivation world, he would unquestionably have been the incarnation of the Heavenly Dao itself.

With but a single thought, the Heavenly Doctor could reshape the mountains and rivers of the Heavenly Law Realm at will, summon storms, and alter the heavens.

"And unlike ordinary incarnations of the Heavenly Dao, my strength does not originate solely from the Heavenly Dao itself."

"After ten thousand years of resonating with the Eternal Dao, the world's power has long since seeped into the depths of my soul and become one with me. Even if I leave the Heavenly Law Realm and travel into the outer starry sky, I can still display eighty percent of my strength."

"With my current power, escaping the Immortal Ruins alone would be effortless. Even bringing several hundred or several thousand people with me would not be difficult."

"But taking the entire Heavenly Law Realm with me..."

A deep sense of helplessness arose within the Heavenly Doctor.

"Unless I can obtain power equal to that of a True Immortal."

During the years since his awakening, the Heavenly Doctor had already attempted to accomplish this in two ways.

The first was by studying the residual power of the True Immortals scattered throughout the Star Sea.

From it, he had comprehended several True Immortal seal script characters.

These had become powerful trump cards, but they brought no substantial improvement to his own cultivation.

The second method was to borrow the power of ancient immortal artifacts.

The Xuanhuang Realm possessed an incomparably profound foundation. It was even said that before the destruction of the Immortal Realm, many of its sects had maintained contact with the upper realm.

Had the Immortal Realm still existed, the Heavenly Law Realm likely would never have been a match for the Xuanhuang Realm.

Fortunately, by the time the war between the two worlds began, many years had already passed since the destruction of the Immortal Realm.

Even so, the Xuanhuang Realm had still deployed several immortal artifacts, inflicting devastating losses upon the Heavenly Law Realm.

After the war ended, those immortal artifacts became scattered across the world.

Most were devoured by the Eternal Dao of the Heavenly Law Realm, transforming into heavenly treasures that nourished the world itself.

However, a small number still remained.

"The Boundless Mirror."

"The Great Sun Golden Bell."

"The Primordial Five Elements Wheel."

These were the three immortal artifacts the Heavenly Doctor had collected over the years.

However, compared to their former peak condition, all three had become badly damaged.

They could still be used to comprehend the power of the True Immortals.

But if they were actually activated...

They would probably shatter completely after a single use.

Unless the Heavenly Doctor could obtain immortal spiritual power and restore these immortal artifacts.

The three immortal artifacts transformed into three points of light, continuously flickering within the Heavenly Doctor's sea of consciousness.

Insights into the Immortals flowed into the Heavenly Doctor's mind like a gentle stream.

"The attraction of the Immortal Ruins is, in truth, also a kind of power derived from a True Immortal seal script."

"Only an Immortal can contend against an Immortal."

"Perhaps I can gather every remaining immortal artifact within the Heavenly Law Realm, then detonate them all at once."

"Fight poison with poison. By using the storm of immortal spiritual power released in that instant, it should be possible to push the Heavenly Law Realm out of the Immortal Ruins."

As the Heavenly Doctor contemplated this, he suddenly sensed that something was amiss.

His eyes narrowed as his gaze drifted beyond the starry sky.

"Escape the Immortal Ruins... and then what?"

The Heavenly Doctor vaguely felt that an even greater secret was hidden deep within the Star Sea.

Once the thought arose, it could no longer be suppressed.

"The Heavenly Law Realm can still endure for a while."

"One must plan before acting. I must personally explore the depths of the starry sky."

After pondering for a moment, the Heavenly Doctor made up his mind.

He transformed into an almost imperceptible golden thread and flew into the Darkest Star Sea.

After leaving the Heavenly Law Realm, he was drawn by the attraction of the Immortal Ruins, causing his flight path to bend.

Yet in the end, he traced a graceful arc and successfully escaped the region covered by the Immortal Ruins' attraction.

He sped across the Star Sea.

Within the Darkest Star Sea, everything in sight was silent and shrouded in darkness.

No matter how far he traveled, the scenery around him seemed completely unchanged.

Occasionally, traces of immortal power drifted through the void, but they posed no threat to the Heavenly Doctor.

After an unknown amount of time, an endless Sea of Relics suddenly appeared before him.

While astonished by the magnificent sight, he also realized that so many remnants of destroyed cultivation worlds had gathered in a single place within the starry sky.

Such an abnormal phenomenon immediately put the Heavenly Doctor on guard.

He continued deeper.

When he saw the endless fragments of shattered worlds, and sensed an increasingly obvious force that seemed to share the same origin as the attraction of the Immortal Ruins, the Heavenly Doctor could no longer suppress the shock in his heart.

Countless once flourishing cultivation worlds had all become ruins and fragments.

They lay buried here in eternal solitude.

A wave of sorrow suddenly surged within the Heavenly Doctor, and he stood motionless for a long time.

Only after finally regaining his composure did he resist the tide-like force that permeated every corner of the Star Sea and arrive at the very end of the Darkest Star Sea.

Here, his footsteps were forcibly halted.

The road ahead had ended.

There was nowhere left to go.

The Darkest Star Sea was a prison of eternal confinement.

"There is no path forward..."

Even the Heavenly Doctor himself was somewhat surprised that he accepted this reality so quickly.

An invisible High Wall sealed off the entire Darkest Star Sea.

Every living being trapped within had nowhere to escape.

Standing before the High Wall, he sensed that absolute "nothingness."

After a brief moment of despair, countless thoughts flashed through his mind.

"The existence of the High Wall must never become known to the living beings of the Heavenly Law Realm. Otherwise, despair will spread, and catastrophe will inevitably follow."

"This High Wall..."

"Even I cannot glimpse its true nature for now. I fear that only a True Immortal can cross it."

Thinking of the future of the entire Heavenly Law Realm resting upon his shoulders, the Heavenly Doctor took a deep breath.

"The power of a True Immortal may indeed be able to cross the High Wall. But to bring the entire Heavenly Law Realm across with it..."

"Impossible. Impossible. Impossible."

His heart was shaken.

Faced with a power beyond all comprehension, the Heavenly Doctor could not help but lose himself for a brief moment.

Yet for some reason, not much despair arose within him.

It seemed as though this invisible High Wall was not an insurmountable obstacle in his eyes.

The Heavenly Doctor once again released several golden threads, attempting to probe the mysteries of the High Wall.

In the end, however, he gained nothing.

Sensing that he had already remained at the edge of the Star Sea for too long, and fearing unforeseen changes within the Heavenly Law Realm, the Heavenly Doctor decided to return.

During the journey back, as he looked at the endless Great Wall of Remnant Worlds, a thought suddenly appeared in his mind.

"Perhaps these corpses of worlds can nourish the Heavenly Law Realm."

"They are not completely lifeless ruins. A small amount of worldly vitality still remains within them."

"Just as living beings eat, once the Heavenly Law Realm devours them, it will inevitably become stronger."

The Heavenly Doctor's decisiveness required no further explanation.

The instant the thought appeared, countless golden threads shot outward, attempting to drag one of the world fragments away.

But just as the golden threads had completely wrapped around their target and were about to pull it free, the Heavenly Doctor suddenly stopped.

He carefully observed the Great Wall of Remnant Worlds once more.

A moment later, realization dawned upon him.

"So this endless chain of remnant worlds can withstand the True Immortal power accumulated beneath the High Wall because of the natural formation created between them. If I recklessly remove one of these fragments, the balance will likely be broken."

"It would be like a riverbank collapsing or a dam bursting. The accumulated True Immortal power of countless years would sweep across the entire Darkest Star Sea."

"And the Heavenly Law Realm would inevitably be caught in the disaster."

The Heavenly Doctor frowned slightly before quickly relaxing.

"It is not impossible to take one. I simply need to choose the proper moment and the correct target."

After another careful observation, the Heavenly Doctor finally selected a suitable world fragment.

Sensing that the tides of True Immortal power beneath the High Wall had entered a temporary low point, he seized the opportunity.

Countless golden threads wrapped around the fragment like chains.

Then he dragged it through the Star Sea toward the Heavenly Law Realm.

After another unknown span of time, he finally returned.

The attraction of the Immortal Ruins suddenly intensified.

The Heavenly Doctor tightly grasped the world fragment, preventing it from falling into the Immortal Ruins.

His thoughts raced.

"Ever since the Heavenly Law Realm devoured the Xuanhuang Realm ten thousand years ago, it has never fed again."

"Not only that, it has remained in a state of being consumed by cultivators. More than half of its very foundation has already been hollowed out, leaving it extremely weak."

"If I recklessly implant this remnant world into it, the Heavenly Law Realm may be too weak to withstand the nourishment."

After pondering for a moment, the Heavenly Doctor nodded slightly.

"It needs a medicinal catalyst."

"Cultivators of the Xuanhuang cultivation system greedily devour heaven and earth. Yet because their bodies have merged with the world itself, they make the finest possible medicinal catalyst."

"The few Longevity Immortals cannot be touched for now."

"But sacrificing a few Dao Integration cultivators will have little impact."

Five transparent threads extended from the Heavenly Doctor's left hand.

Guided by his thoughts, they shot toward five different corners of the Heavenly Law Realm.

The five Dao Integration cultivators had no ability to resist.

They instantly fell unconscious.

Layer after layer of transparent threads tightly bound them.

There was not the slightest trace of pity upon the Heavenly Doctor's face.

He raised his index finger and lightly tapped each of them in turn.

Without experiencing any pain, the five Dao Integration cultivators all crumbled into fine dust.

With a sweep of his sleeve, the Heavenly Doctor gathered all of the powder.

He then immediately scattered it across the remnant world he had brought back.

After receiving nourishment from the Spirit of Heaven and Earth, traces of vitality seemed to reappear within the destroyed world.

It emitted a faint humming sound.

Only then did the Heavenly Doctor slowly stitch it into the Heavenly Law Realm.

Chapter 1365: The Heavenly Demon Finally Awakens

Under normal circumstances, forcibly implanting fragments from another world into the Heavenly Law Realm, even fragments from a world that had already perished, would inevitably provoke resistance and rejection from the Heavenly Dao of the Heavenly Law Realm.

This was the so called rejection response.

However, this time, the world fragment implanted by the Heavenly Doctor first merged with the remains of the five Dao Integration cultivators. The power of Spirits Heaven and Earth within those Dao Integration cultivators had originally come from the Heavenly Law Realm.

As a result, the degree of rejection during the fusion process was extremely low.

The Heavenly Law Realm smoothly completed the absorption of the fragment.

Sensing a faint trace of vitality slowly flowing from the fragment of the ruined world into the Heavenly Law Realm, the Heavenly Doctor finally let out a long sigh of relief.

"My long journey was not in vain."

He quietly observed for some time. Perhaps because the Heavenly Law Realm had remained in a state of starvation for so long without feeding, this fragment proved exceptionally effective.

It not only replenished its energy, but also revived the vitality that the Heavenly Dao had previously suppressed because of the cultivators' endless greed.

"In the future, there will be no need to go through so much trouble whenever it feeds again. I can simply connect the next fragment to the remnants of this first one."

"However, before this world completely digests it, I must return to the edge of the Star Sea and bring back another world fragment to continue the process."

Thinking of this, the Heavenly Doctor frowned slightly.

Although with his strength he could travel rapidly through the Star Sea and ignore nearly all dangers along the way.

The Star Sea was simply too vast. A round trip required nearly an entire year.

Moreover, according to his estimates, the Heavenly Law Realm would need about two years to fully digest this world fragment.

"By this calculation, I will have no spare time for anything else. I simply cannot free up my hands."

The Heavenly Doctor sighed softly, feeling for the first time that he alone could no longer shoulder everything.

Although he had cultivated several promising successors over the years, they were still far from being capable of bearing such great responsibilities.

This made him miss the old friends who had once fought alongside him.

One familiar figure after another flashed through the Heavenly Doctor's mind before suddenly stopping on one particular figure.

"The Heavenly Demon..."

The Heavenly Doctor's expression became rather complicated.

Back then, before the war between the two worlds had even begun, the Heavenly Demon had already wandered beyond the heavens. Even during the fiercest and most brutal stages of the war, the Heavenly Demon never returned.

However, the Heavenly Doctor could faintly sense that the Heavenly Demon had not perished.

Instead, it still existed somewhere within the Star Sea.

Originally, the Heavenly Doctor had no intention of contacting this most unique existence among all the Venerables of the Heavenly Law Realm.

The various Venerables were born from the living beings of the Heavenly Law Realm, comprehending and resonating with the Eternal Dao.

The Heavenly Demon alone was the exception.

It was like the single discordant note within a magnificent symphony. The Heavenly Demon was the autonomous manifestation of the Eternal Dao governing Heart Demons within the Heavenly Law Realm.

It was the Heart Demon Heavenly Dao itself.

Although it had communicated with the other Venerables before, those interactions were few.

The Heavenly Demon was born from the Heavenly Law Realm, but from the very moment of its birth, it had already separated itself from the Heavenly Law Realm. It severed all ties with the mother world that had given birth to it.

It cared little for the affairs of the Heavenly Law Realm.

Its only pursuit was to advance further and seek the elusive Supreme Realm.

Remaining within the Heavenly Law Realm meant it could never transcend mortality. Therefore, the Heavenly Demon departed without hesitation.

Even when the Heavenly Law Realm stood on the brink of destruction, the Heavenly Demon never returned to help. It could be said that it no longer possessed even the slightest bond with the Heavenly Law Realm.

"I wonder whether the Heavenly Demon has now touched the threshold of the Supreme Realm."

The Heavenly Doctor's gaze became distant. After pondering for a long time, he finally decided to search the Star Sea for the Heavenly Demon's whereabouts.

Looking toward the heavens, his body transformed into a gentle breeze and merged into the heaven and earth of the Heavenly Law Realm.

The Eternal Dao rumbled while the laws operated day and night like an incomparably precise machine.

Although the Heavenly Demon had already severed its connection with the Eternal Dao, it had ultimately been born from this world.

As the Great Venerable of All Laws, the Heavenly Doctor temporarily assumed the role of the Heavenly Dao itself and extended his perception across the distant Star Sea.

After nearly half a day, he finally discovered the Heavenly Demon's approximate location.

It was actually at the edge of the Star Sea, beside the endless Great Wall of Ruined Worlds.

The Heavenly Doctor's heart shook as he pondered why the Heavenly Demon would be there.

Without departing immediately, he first summoned all six Longevity Immortal Heavenly Venerables of the Heavenly Law Realm before setting off.

To discuss the future of the Heavenly Law Realm.

Although only their projections arrived rather than their true bodies, it did not hinder communication.

"We shall certainly follow the Great Venerable's leadership. After all, the Heavenly Law Realm is the homeland we all share. If it truly falls into the Immortal Ruins, then no matter how vast the Star Sea may be, there will no longer be any place for us." The first to speak was a middle aged Confucian scholar.

This man had attained the Dao during the final era of the cultivation wasteland. Seeing how cultivators had become suspicious of everyone after endless years of mutual slaughter, no longer daring to trust anyone, he reversed the principles of heaven and earth so that lies could no longer exist in the world. The people respectfully called him the True Speech Heavenly Venerable.

"Hehehe..."

Before the True Speech Heavenly Venerable had even finished speaking, a strange laugh rang out.

"What does the survival of the Heavenly Law Realm have to do with me? I would much rather it fall into the Immortal Ruins as soon as possible!"

The Heavenly Doctor looked toward the figure concealed beneath a black hood. Unconcealed killing intent flashed across his eyes.

If there was anyone among the Venerables whom the Heavenly Doctor wished to eliminate above all others.

It was undoubtedly the person before him, the Reverse Fusion Heavenly Venerable.

This man had originally been a cultivator who had reached the pinnacle of medical arts. He comprehended the process by which the Heavenly Law Realm devoured the Xuanhuang Realm and reversed its underlying principles.

As a result, whenever the Great Dao of the Heavenly Law Realm attempted to devour another world, it would naturally generate a force of resistance.

Through this reversal, the Reverse Fusion Heavenly Venerable attained the Longevity Dao Fruit.

Had it not been for his interference, the Heavenly Law Realm would have completely devoured and digested the Xuanhuang Realm long ago.

Nor would implanting fragments from other worlds now require such a lengthy process.

The Reverse Fusion Heavenly Venerable showed no fear toward the Heavenly Doctor and continued mockingly.

"If the Heavenly Law Realm falls into the Immortal Ruins, it will surely be torn into countless pieces. That will be the very moment when I complete my Great Dao. Of course I eagerly await it!"

The other Heavenly Venerables all turned their eyes toward him.

Only the One Heart Heavenly Venerable, Zhao Ruoxi, spoke with both resentment and affection.

"So Brother Li dislikes this little sister after all. You cannot wait to escape from my side."

As she spoke, sparkling tears seemed to fall from her face.

The Reverse Fusion Heavenly Venerable immediately fell silent. Almost instinctively, he moved a little farther away from the One Heart Heavenly Sovereign, his eyes filled with caution.

The Heavenly Doctor let out a cold snort before solemnly declaring.

"I will not force any of you to contribute."

"But if anyone dares interfere from the shadows."

"Even if it means damaging the Eternal Dao of the Heavenly Law Realm, I will uproot them completely."

"Do not say I failed to warn you."

The words of the Great Venerable of All Laws carried tremendous authority.

After this warning, even the previously arrogant Reverse Fusion Heavenly Venerable no longer dared object openly and could only nod in agreement.

While reversing the principles of heaven and earth, the Reverse Fusion Heavenly Venerable had himself become part of the Eternal Dao.

As long as heaven and earth endured, the Heavenly Venerable could not die.

Hence the title of Longevity.

But longevity did not mean eternal indestructibility.

As long as one forcibly extracted and destroyed the principle represented by the Reverse Fusion Heavenly Venerable from the Heavenly Law Realm itself.

Even a Longevity Immortal Heavenly Venerable could be slain.

However, carrying out this method required two conditions.

First, only a great cultivator whose understanding and mastery of the principles of heaven and earth had reached the absolute pinnacle, such as the Heavenly Doctor, the Great Venerable of All Laws, could accomplish it.

Second.

Even if it succeeded, extracting those principles of heaven and earth would inevitably affect the other natural laws of the world.

The Heavenly Law Realm was destined to suffer severe damage as a result.

The already greatly weakened Heavenly Law Realm simply could not withstand such another ordeal.

This was also the reason why the Heavenly Doctor had delayed taking action all this time.

'However, after I complete several more rounds of nourishment and restore some of the Heavenly Law Realm's vitality, I should be able to remove these parasites.' The Heavenly Doctor looked at Reverse Fusion Heavenly Venerable and temporarily suppressed the killing intent in his heart.

"A few days ago, I left the Heavenly Law Realm and ventured into the Immortal Ruins to investigate. There, I vaguely caught sight of a figure sitting cross-legged..."

Just as the atmosphere fell into silence and stalemate, a voice suddenly rang out, drawing everyone's attention.

The Heavenly Doctor turned his gaze toward the speaker.

It was Dao Attainment Heavenly Venerable, Su Bai.

Moved by the fact that all mortals suffered under the Immortal Mortal Miasma and could scarcely cultivate or attain the Dao, he had reversed this principle. He took the suffering of the Immortal Mortal Miasma upon himself in place of all living beings. As long as ordinary mortals sincerely recited the name of Dao Attainment Heavenly Venerable day and night, the Immortal Mortal Miasma would naturally dissipate.

Su Bai smiled faintly before continuing.

"I also caught sight of a seal script character within the Immortal Ruins."

Using his finger as a brush, Su Bai instantly wrote the True Immortal seal script character.

[Hunger]

"I only saw it vaguely, so this is as much as I could reconstruct." Su Bai shook his head with some regret.

Although Su Bai said so, the waves of power radiating from the character before everyone clearly demonstrated the terrifying might of the True Immortal seal script.

"I believe this character is the true culprit behind everything falling into the Immortal Ruins."

"Only a True Immortal can truly wield the power of a True Immortal."

"There is no shortage of residual True Immortal power remaining throughout the Star Sea. My suggestion is that we study these remnants and use them to reverse deduce their original True Immortal seal script. We shall use True Immortal seal script to oppose True Immortal seal script." Su Bai spoke with complete seriousness.

His proposal immediately caused all the Heavenly Venerables present to fall into deep thought.

Even the Heavenly Doctor frowned as he considered its feasibility.

Seeing this, Su Bai revealed an even greater revelation.

"To be honest with all of you, I have secretly researched this for many years and have already achieved some success. Your talents all surpass mine. If we work together..."

"Using True Immortal seal script to control the Immortal Ruins will only be a matter of time."

As he spoke, Su Bai wrote another seal script character.

Compared to the one he had witnessed within the Immortal Ruins, however, this character that he had comprehended himself was clearly much weaker.

The Heavenly Doctor looked at the other Great Venerables and saw the unmistakable excitement in their expressions. Concern inevitably arose within his heart.

He already understood the power of the True Immortal seal script.

These people were already difficult enough to deal with. If they also mastered the True Immortal seal script...

Then once a battle broke out, even the Heavenly Law Realm would be caught in the aftermath and reduced to ruins.

Thinking of this, the Heavenly Doctor became even more anxious.

During the discussions that followed, everyone eventually reached a consensus.

Their actions would be divided into three groups.

The first group would assist the Heavenly Doctor in nourishing the Heavenly Law Realm and strengthening its vitality.

The second group would study the True Immortal seal script and rely on external power to resist the Immortal Ruins.

The third group would simply remain uninvolved.

After dismissing everyone, even the Heavenly Doctor, the Great Venerable of the Heavenly Law Realm, could not help feeling mentally exhausted.

With six Longevity Immortal Heavenly Venerables guarding the realm, the Heavenly Law Realm would remain safe for the time being.

The Heavenly Doctor immediately gathered his spirits and hurried toward the location where he sensed the Heavenly Demon.

'If I can obtain the Heavenly Demon's assistance, I can quietly possess these Longevity Immortal Heavenly Venerables without anyone noticing.'

'That would minimize unnecessary casualties to the greatest extent possible.'

The more he thought about it, the stronger his desire became to find the Heavenly Demon.

He traveled through the Star Sea day after day.

At last, he once again arrived at the frontier of the Star Sea.

After searching throughout the range of his senses for a long time, the Heavenly Doctor finally found the Heavenly Demon.

The Heavenly Demon was indeed still alive.

But he had been frozen inside a strange crystal.

"[Resplendent Wind Crystal]?"

The Heavenly Doctor did not approach to retrieve the Heavenly Demon immediately. Instead, he observed from a distance.

He recognized the strange force responsible for sealing the Heavenly Demon in ice.

"Star Sea phenomena have become exceedingly rare."

"It seems that not long after the Heavenly Demon left the Heavenly Law Realm, he encountered disaster."

"Perhaps I wrongly blamed him. It was not that he refused to save us. He simply could not."

Seeing an old acquaintance frozen for ten thousand years in such a miserable state, the Heavenly Doctor could not help feeling pity.

"It is said that when the Resplendent Wind Crystal appears, it can freeze vast regions of the Star Sea. It is one of the most terrifying Star Sea phenomena."

"Even an existence as powerful as the Heavenly Demon had absolutely no ability to resist before such overwhelming power."

The Heavenly Doctor's expression grew solemn.

"After all this time, the freezing power does not seem to have weakened much."

"That bone-piercing cold is capable of freezing even nearby True Immortal power..."

But the Heavenly Doctor truly lived up to his title.

After contemplating on the spot for a long time, he eventually devised a solution.

He produced hundreds upon thousands of golden threads and wrapped them around the crystal.

Then he dragged it rapidly toward the invisible High Wall.

When it was almost upon the High Wall, he violently hurled it forward.

The rapidly flying crystal suddenly stopped in midair.

It was as though it had struck something with tremendous force, trembling violently.

The Heavenly Doctor's eyes immediately lit up. He keenly sensed that the freezing power had weakened slightly from the collision.

"Only the High Wall may be capable of shaking this lifeless freezing force."

The Heavenly Doctor sighed in admiration as more golden threads shot forth.

He pulled the crystal away from the High Wall for some distance.

Then he repeated the process.

Boom. Boom. Boom.

With every collision, the crystal became smaller and smaller.

When only a thin layer remained, the Heavenly Doctor also reduced the force of his strikes.

Although in theory, the Heavenly Demon was virtually immortal.

The High Wall was still an unfathomable existence.

He had to proceed with extreme caution.

Otherwise, if this old acquaintance survived the calamities of the Star Sea only to die by his own hands...

The Heavenly Doctor would surely feel deeply guilty.

Of course, more importantly, he would lose an indispensable ally.

The Heavenly Doctor's control over his strength had reached an astonishingly meticulous level.

In the end, using this rather unconventional method, he finally awakened the Heavenly Demon.

A transparent and indistinct figure stared fixedly at the Heavenly Doctor.

He remained completely silent.

"Heavenly Demon..." Knowing that the Heavenly Demon had retained some awareness of the outside world even while frozen, the Heavenly Doctor awkwardly spoke first.

The Heavenly Demon's figure suddenly disappeared.

A moment later, he had already appeared within the Heavenly Doctor's mind.
