Chapter 1366: The Secret Hidden Within The Heavenly Doctor’S Heart

The Heavenly Doctor's pale hair and beard fluttered without wind.

His wrinkled face constantly shifted between countless different visages.

For some unknown reason, the Heavenly Demon, which had been frozen for ten thousand years, attempted to possess the Heavenly Doctor the moment it escaped its seal.

However, the Heavenly Doctor was now the Great Venerable of All Laws. The weakened Heavenly Demon was simply incapable of taking over his body.

With his left hand, he drove a long golden needle straight into the crown of his head.

His constantly changing face instantly returned to normal, while the Heavenly Demon's illusory figure was forced out of his body.

At the same time, countless golden threads intertwined into a vast net, as though weaving an actual world.

The Heavenly Demon, which had just been expelled from the Heavenly Doctor's body, found itself unable to resist. It was slowly drawn into the golden net world.

The Heavenly Demon let out repeated growls before finally being completely subdued by the Heavenly Doctor.

Yet there was not the slightest trace of joy on the Heavenly Doctor's face.

"It cannot communicate with me at all? Has it been frozen for too long and completely lost its intelligence?"

After carefully examining it, his tightly furrowed brows gradually relaxed.

"That is fine as well. Its ability to corrupt the hearts of others still remains. That actually makes things much easier for me."

With a soft sigh, he lamented the passing of an old acquaintance before quickly returning to the task at hand.

He brought the sealed Heavenly Demon, together with another suitable world fragment, back to the Heavenly Law Realm.

Naturally, the year-long journey was not wasted.

As he sped through the Star Sea, countless golden threads resembling tentacles danced around his body.

They continuously sensed the residual power of the True Immortals encountered along his path.

He had ultimately been persuaded by the suggestion made by the Dao Attainment Heavenly Venerable Su Bai.

"If properly utilised, the power unleashed by these True Immortal seal script characters may truly be capable of shaking the Immortal Ruins..."

Thinking this, the Heavenly Doctor used his hand as a brush and consecutively traced several characters through the air.

Although they were merely phantoms, the moment the characters appeared, waves of immense power immediately rippled through the surrounding space.

Moreover, the intensity of those fluctuations continued increasing as the Heavenly Doctor drew closer to the Heavenly Law Realm.

This was merely the result of less than a year of comprehension.

The Heavenly Doctor's terrifying talent was fully evident.

When the Heavenly Law Realm finally came into view in the distance, the Heavenly Doctor casually dispersed the True Immortal seal script characters he had comprehended.

He then completely released his own aura and openly fed the world fragment to the Heavenly Law Realm.

While attracting the attention of nearly all the Longevity Immortals within the Heavenly Law Realm, he silently separated a phantom clone from himself, carrying the sealed Heavenly Demon toward the location of the Reverse Fusion Heavenly Venerable.

Whether this Heavenly Venerable possessed absolute confidence in his own strength or was simply too foolish, no one knew.

The other Longevity Immortals within the Heavenly Law Realm all concealed their auras and constantly changed their locations.

Only Reverse Fusion made no attempt whatsoever to hide himself.

Thus, the Heavenly Doctor smoothly infiltrated his vicinity.

At that moment, Reverse Fusion seemed to be cultivating in seclusion. He had just been awakened by the Heavenly Doctor feeding the Heavenly Law Realm. Looking upward at the sky, a trace of hatred flashed through his eyes.

Before Reverse Fusion floated a phantom image of the Heavenly Law Realm, which immediately caught the Heavenly Doctor's attention.

Several locations were marked within the phantom image.

Surprisingly, even as the Great Venerable of All Laws, those locations lay completely outside his perception.

The Heavenly Doctor's heart trembled slightly. After careful observation, he immediately understood.

"So these are actually remnants of the Xuanhuang Realm."

"This Reverse Fusion Heavenly Venerable unknowingly prolonged the Xuanhuang Realm's survival when he attained the Dao. As a result, the remaining consciousness of the Xuanhuang Realm's Heavenly Dao sought him out."

"You are courting death!"

Murderous intent instantly surged within the Heavenly Doctor's heart.

The Heavenly Law Realm was his homeland. It carried the memories of himself and countless relatives and friends.

He would never allow anyone to covet or destroy it.

"The Eternal Dao of Heavenly Law. Solidify!"

The Heavenly Doctor no longer hesitated. He immediately unleashed his strongest killing technique.

Within the Heavenly Law Realm, the wind ceased.

The rain stopped.

Everything in existence, including the operation of heaven and earth itself, became completely motionless.

Even the Longevity Immortals, who themselves embodied the laws of heaven and earth, were no exception.

The Heavenly Doctor appeared behind Reverse Fusion.

He slowly raised his hand and placed it upon the other's head.

As ghostly light erupted violently, the subdued Heavenly Demon was poured directly into Reverse Fusion's body.

Just as had happened to the Heavenly Doctor earlier, countless different faces rapidly flickered across Reverse Fusion's own face.

It seemed that freezing the operation of the Heavenly Law Realm's Eternal Dao was an extremely exhausting burden even for the Heavenly Doctor.

The moment he successfully implanted a portion of the Heavenly Demon into Reverse Fusion's body, the Heavenly Doctor immediately restored the world's normal operation.

In that single instant, his hair became noticeably whiter.

Even the brilliance within his eyes gradually became clouded.

The Heavenly Doctor was the Great Venerable of All Laws of the Heavenly Law Realm.

The abnormalities upon his body likewise manifested throughout the entire world.

Thousands of miles became scorched wasteland.

Glaciers melted.

Countless living beings withered and perished.

It was as though the entire world had suffered grievous damage merely because of that brief moment of complete suspension.

Yet as he watched Reverse Fusion's previously ferocious expression gradually calm, the countless changing faces finally settled.

Faced with the Heavenly Doctor, the one who had attacked him, Reverse Fusion displayed not the slightest trace of hatred.

Instead, he even nodded politely.

Only then did the Heavenly Doctor finally let out a long sigh of relief.

Thanks to the return of the Heavenly Demon's Dao, together with the nourishment provided by the newly absorbed world fragment, the vitality lost by the Heavenly Law Realm was quickly replenished.

No one within the Heavenly Law Realm realised that the Heavenly Doctor had successfully used the Heavenly Demon to seize control of the Reverse Fusion Heavenly Venerable.

To ensure absolute safety, the Heavenly Doctor inserted eighty-one golden needles into Reverse Fusion's body.

This completely eliminated any possibility of Reverse Fusion's original consciousness awakening, or of the Heavenly Demon losing control.

Once successful once, success could be repeated.

Over the following thirty years, the Heavenly Doctor used the same method to completely seize control of every Longevity Immortal within the Heavenly Law Realm except for the One Heart Heavenly Venerable.

The One Heart Heavenly Venerable, Zhao Ruoxi, possessed countless incarnations spread throughout every corner of the Heavenly Law Realm.

Eliminating and possessing her would have been far too troublesome.

Moreover, she posed no immediate threat.

Thus, the Heavenly Doctor temporarily left her alone.

After unifying the Tianfa Realm under his sole authority, the Heavenly Doctor could finally devote himself entirely to his plan of saving the Heavenly Law Realm.

Time passed swiftly.

In the blink of an eye, another hundred years went by.

The Heavenly Law Realm devoured nearly one hundred carefully selected world fragments gathered by the Heavenly Doctor.

Its overall size expanded to more than twice its former scale.

The endless stream of life force also enabled it to completely digest the Xuanhuang Realm.

There were no longer any hidden dangers remaining within the entire world.

The Heavenly Doctor's own strength likewise rose accordingly.

He gradually touched the very limit that this starry sky could support.

He seemed capable of advancing another step at any moment.

Yet there was no path ahead.

That final and most crucial step simply could not be taken.

Even someone with the Heavenly Doctor's temperament could not help but feel faint frustration and despair.

"So this is the so-called Supreme Realm?"

The Heavenly Doctor remained silent for a long time.

Only after a long while did he let out a cold laugh.

"Supreme..."

"What a pity. It is nothing more than self-comfort for those unable to become immortals."

'Before me lies the Immortal Path that cannot be tread.'

'Before me lies the Immortal Path that cannot be tread.'

Feeling himself completely shackled by an incomparably profound Great Dao law, the Heavenly Doctor suddenly recalled his years of studying the High Wall.

"The two seem somewhat similar."

"And yet fundamentally different."

As this thought arose, the Heavenly Doctor's perspective suddenly rose higher and higher.

The enormous Heavenly Law Realm became little more than a toy resting in the palm of his hand.

Meanwhile, the High Wall at the edge of the Star Sea was now clearly visible, no longer impossibly distant.

Taking a single step, the Heavenly Doctor vanished from where he stood.

When he reappeared, he had already crossed an enormous distance through the miniature Darkest Star Sea.

This technique of shrinking the earth into a single step was one of the insights he had gained during the past century.

Having travelled constantly through the Star Sea while accompanied by the High Wall and the power of the Immortal Ruins, although his cultivation realm had not changed significantly, his actual strength had grown to an utterly unimaginable level.

Originally, crossing the star sea required more than a year.

Now, it required less than two days.

Moreover, the Heavenly Doctor had a premonition that his speed could continue increasing as his comprehension of the Star Sea's 'Momentum' deepened.

Perhaps one day, he would be able to traverse the entire Star Sea in the blink of an eye.

Arriving before the High Wall, the Heavenly Doctor skillfully released countless golden threads.

Like liquid mercury pouring across the ground, they spread outward, attempting to make contact with and perceive the invisible High Wall.

Over the years, he had repeated this process countless times.

Even though he had never gained anything from it, he continued this seemingly futile effort.

Because the Heavenly Doctor had always possessed a vague intuition that he would eventually discover something within the High Wall.

As if responding to the patience he had shown all these years, on this very day, the countless golden threads sweeping across the High Wall like a cascading golden waterfall suddenly came to a simultaneous halt.

The Heavenly Doctor's body trembled slightly. His eyes, which had long since become completely clouded, suddenly erupted with a brilliant light.

It was as though an opening had appeared within the boundless ocean.

Every one of the golden threads surged toward it like seawater rushing into a breach.

"What a pity. It is not an opening."

"It is merely a flaw."

"And it even bears traces of artificial intervention..."

After examining it carefully, the Heavenly Doctor could not help but feel regret.

"Perhaps it was left behind long ago by some mighty cultivator of the Star Sea."

As his perception sank deeper into the flaw, every distracting thought vanished from his mind.

He devoted himself completely to comprehending this flaw within the High Wall.

If, during the past century, the Heavenly Doctor had been unable to glimpse the true nature of the High Wall despite constantly exploring it.

Then now, through this single flaw.

He had finally caught sight of the true High Wall.

Creak. Creak.

No one knew what kind of scene he had witnessed, but two streams of tears unconsciously flowed from the Heavenly Doctor's eyes.

Even his body, that of a supreme powerhouse, could not withstand the pressure of the unknown force. His back gradually bent lower and lower.

Far away, within the world of Heavenly Law, heaven and earth suddenly rumbled violently for no apparent reason.

The sky itself seemed to have been slashed apart by invisible blades as countless cracks spread across the heavens.

At this critical moment.

Between continuing his enlightenment and the life or death of the Heavenly Law Realm, the Heavenly Doctor ultimately chose the latter.

His figure rapidly retreated, instinctively breaking free from his state of comprehending the High Wall.

The strange phenomena within the Heavenly Law Realm instantly disappeared.

The Heavenly Doctor touched the tear stains on his cheeks, confusion flashing through his eyes.

To his horror, he discovered that everything he had just seen and comprehended. Slowly faded away the moment his connection with the High Wall was severed.

Furthermore, an intuition arose within him, telling him that if he wished to preserve those memories, he had to reconnect with the High Wall before the sensations within his body completely faded.

He had to continue engraving them into himself.

"But the Heavenly Law Realm has already reached its limit. It cannot endure any more..."

For one of the few times in his life, hesitation and struggle appeared in the Heavenly Doctor's eyes.

In the end...

The Heavenly Doctor let out a long sigh.

He did not step forward again, allowing the sensation of enlightenment within his body to disappear completely.

Pfft.

Having acted against his own heart that pursued the Dao, the Heavenly Doctor's mind suffered devastating damage. He suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood.

Golden needles continuously flew from his hand, piercing the vital acupoints throughout his body.

Yet they were completely unable to suppress the injuries that originated from the depths of his soul. He spat out several more mouthfuls of blood.

"A physician cannot heal himself..."

He remained standing motionless within the void for nearly half a month before fully recovering.

Still unwilling to give up, he attempted to explore the flaw in the High Wall once again.

But it was ultimately a case of 'once lost, lost forever.'

No matter how he looked, it was now no different from observing an ordinary section of the High Wall.

The Heavenly Doctor stood there blankly, his heart filled with a profound sense of loss.

He understood that he had forever missed the secret of the High Wall.

But the Heavenly Doctor was, after all, the Heavenly Doctor.

After another dozen days, he regained his spirits.

"My desire to become a True Immortal has always been for the sake of saving the Heavenly Law Realm."

"If I were to pursue the Dao while allowing the Heavenly Law Realm to be destroyed, that would never be my wish."

"Besides..."

"Although I cannot uncover the secret of the High Wall, I can still obtain its power."

With a single thought from the Heavenly Doctor, countless golden threads wove themselves into a towering wall before him.

Yet the instant it took shape, every golden thread shattered apart, dispersing into countless motes of golden light.

"The flaw in the High Wall has left its mark upon me."

"From this day onward, the High Wall is no longer something invisible to my eyes."

A sudden realization emerged within the Heavenly Doctor's heart.

"Perhaps..."

"I can build a High Wall outside the Heavenly Law Realm and isolate it from the attraction of the Immortal Ruins."

After attaining enlightenment beneath the High Wall, the Heavenly Doctor's strength advanced another step.

Over the following century, he wove together countless golden threads.

He actually succeeded in wrapping the entire Heavenly Law Realm into a giant golden cocoon, slowly dragging it away from the edge of the Immortal Ruins.

Just as it seemed that the Heavenly Law Realm was truly about to escape, this act of snatching prey from a tiger's jaws finally attracted the attention of the True Immortal cultivating within the Immortal Ruins.

That majestic figure suddenly appeared above the Heavenly Law Realm.

Looking at the Heavenly Doctor standing before him, as well as the tightly wrapped golden cocoon behind him.

His expression remained utterly indifferent.

The pressure radiating from the True Immortal caused even the Heavenly Law Realm, despite being protected within the cocoon, to tremble violently as mountains collapsed and the land split apart.

Yet the Heavenly Doctor, standing before this True Immortal...

For some unknown reason, felt not the slightest fear.

Instead, a trace of confusion arose within his heart.

"So..."

"This is a True Immortal?"

The phantom of the True Immortal slowly extended one hand.

Boundless suction surged from within his palm.

At that moment, the entire Darkest Star Sea was drawn toward the True Immortal's hand.

Even light itself was no exception.

Yet it was as though an invisible stake had firmly nailed the Heavenly Doctor in place, preventing him from moving in the slightest.

Holding onto the Heavenly Law Realm, the Heavenly Doctor resembled a kite tossed about by a violent storm.

He was flung back and forth endlessly, yet he never lost his grip.

The confusion within the Heavenly Doctor's eyes only deepened.

Standing beneath the overwhelming might of the True Immortal, he made no attempt to resist.

Then, as though he had suddenly realized something, he slowly closed his eyes.

...

Outside the Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation, Li Fan looked at the formation, which was operating at full speed and on the verge of collapse, and let out a faint sigh.

The Heavenly Doctor's abilities truly were extraordinary.

Moreover, the downgraded Immortal Formation was not a genuine Immortal Formation.

Even if it had been a complete Immortal Formation, it might not have been capable of perfectly reproducing the true might of the True Immortal within the Immortal Ruins.

It was only to be expected that the Heavenly Doctor would discover its flaws.

"It does not matter. I have already uncovered enough secrets."

Chapter 1367: The Former Residence Of The Xuantian King

"Supreme Realm..."

"So this is the realm the Heavenly Doctor now claims to have attained."

Li Fan's thoughts raced. Once again, he arranged formations around the Heavenly Doctor to delay him, while glancing toward Mo Rubin in the distance.

His condition was almost identical to the Heavenly Doctor's when he had touched the High Wall inside the Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation.

No extraordinary aura emanated from his body, yet Mo Rubin seemed as though he had truly witnessed the scene beyond the High Wall. It was as if he had attained the Dao in a single instant, tears streaming uncontrollably down his face.

Fortunately, Mo Rubin was gradually emerging from his state of enlightenment. Clarity was slowly returning to his eyes.

"Let's go!"

Several golden threads shot out from Li Fan's hand, instantly traversing the distance and tightly wrapping around Mo Rubin.

The technique bore an astonishing resemblance to the divine ability the Heavenly Doctor had used within the immortal formation.

Pulling Mo Rubin to his side, Li Fan drew the phantom of the Wooden Sword.

A moment later, the two had already left the range of the Heavenly Doctor's perception.

Mo Rubin still seemed immersed in the lingering aftereffects of enlightenment, his expression dazed.

Li Fan did not disturb him for the moment. While continuing his journey toward the Xuanhuang Realm, he organized everything he had gained from trapping the Heavenly Doctor within the Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation.

As the creator of this peerless immortal formation, Li Fan had been far more than a mere observer.

The Illusory Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation blurred the boundary between illusion and reality. Built upon an Immortal-grade formation, it also incorporated a trace of Li Fan's comprehension of the [Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood]. Rather than saying everything within the formation was simply an illusion experienced by the Heavenly Doctor, it would be more accurate to say that such a possibility had genuinely existed in history, one where the Heavenly Law Realm defeated the Xuanhuang Realm.

It was merely that this possibility could exist only so long as the immortal formation endured.

Once the Heavenly Doctor broke the formation, everything would vanish into nothingness.

Every living being within the formation, apart from the Heavenly Doctor himself, contained a fragment of Li Fan's will.

Su Bai, Reverse Fusion, and the others.

Even the so called Heavenly Law Realm, the Heavenly Demons, and the High Wall all contained portions of Li Fan's consciousness.

Because of this, Li Fan was able to experience every one of the Heavenly Doctor's methods firsthand, regardless of distance.

Even the Heavenly Doctor's thoughts and emotional fluctuations could be faintly perceived by Li Fan.

This was the terrifying power of an immortal formation.

One had to remember that the Heavenly Doctor had once taught Li Fan the Heavenly Doctor Immortal Scripture and the Record of Mending Heaven. He could barely be considered half of Li Fan's teacher.

Li Fan thoroughly understood everything the Heavenly Doctor had experienced.

Whether it was the theoretical foundations or the manifestations of his divine abilities, once they had all been completely analyzed, reproducing them...

For the current Li Fan.

Was not difficult.

After integrating the transcendent [Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood], the countless golden needles wielded by Li Fan had even surpassed their original creator.

The countless golden threads wrapped around Mo Rubin gradually appeared to fade away.

In reality, they had quietly been implanted within Mo Rubin's body.

They remained concealed in a [False] state for the time being, hidden as a future contingency.

Not only was Mo Rubin completely unaware of this, but throughout the entire Darkest Star Sea, there was likely no one capable of detecting Li Fan's seemingly insignificant, yet truly transcendent method.

Whenever Li Fan required it, the Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood could instantly activate. The countless golden threads would transform from illusion into reality and erupt simultaneously from within Mo Rubin's body.

"These golden threads appear outwardly as mere threads of gold, but in truth they are manifestations of one's comprehension of the principles of heaven and earth and the Great Dao."

"Although my current strength is still somewhat inferior to the Heavenly Doctor's, in terms of my understanding in this aspect, I am certainly no weaker than he is."

Besides this golden thread divine ability, Li Fan had also learned the Heavenly Doctor's method of sealing Heavenly Demon.

The eighty one golden needles differed somewhat from the Sealing Soul, Substituting World technique the Heavenly Doctor had displayed in his previous life, yet both originated from the same source.

Li Fan had already secretly mastered nearly eighty percent of it.

After further study for a period of time, deciphering it completely would not be difficult.

Apart from these two gains, the Heavenly Doctor's actions as the Great Venerable of All Laws in his attempt to save the Heavenly Law Realm had also greatly inspired Li Fan.

Especially his final technique, gathering the eternal laws of all paths to freeze the very operation of the world.

It gave Li Fan a vague new idea regarding the World Spirit with which he would merge through Dao Integration in this life.

"The Heavenly Doctor truly is an inexhaustible treasure trove. Unfortunately, the same immortal formation will probably never be able to trap him again."

"I can simply repeat the same trick in the next life."

"Using the Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation as my eyes, I will squeeze every last bit of knowledge and foundation from the Heavenly Doctor."

...

As they neared the Xuanhuang Realm, Mo Rubin finally regained complete clarity.

He stood frozen for a moment. Once he realized where he was, he immediately attempted to return toward the High Wall.

Li Fan frowned slightly and bound him with countless golden threads.

Mo Rubin instinctively tried to break free but failed. His expression immediately changed. He had never expected Li Fan to still possess such a hidden trump card.

"Brother Mo, calm yourself."

"You have already experienced enlightenment from the High Wall twice. If you still cannot escape its temptation, then I fear you will never escape it for the rest of your life. You will remain forever lost within it."

Li Fan's icy words finally awakened Mo Rubin.

His struggles gradually ceased.

Li Fan, however, did not remove the golden thread restraints.

"Do you still feel the sensation of 'once lost, forever lost'?" Li Fan asked solemnly.

Despite his own extraordinary comprehension, Li Fan had still failed to gain any understanding from that flaw in the High Wall. His current question was entirely based upon the Heavenly Doctor's own insights into that flaw while inside the immortal formation.

Mo Rubin's expression became rather complicated.

"'Once lost, forever lost.' There truly is no phrase more fitting."

He cupped his hands in gratitude, thanking Li Fan for previously holding back their enemy, before letting out a long sigh.

"Thanks to you, I was able to completely glimpse the secret of the High Wall's flaw."

"However, everything I comprehended..."

Mo Rubin paused for a long while before slowly continuing.

"...is not something that my present self is capable of seeing."

"Hm?" Li Fan raised an eyebrow.

"I know it sounds confusing, even unbelievable. But that is precisely the truth."

"Those insights do not exist within the Darkest Star Sea. Only through the High Wall as an intermediary can we perceive and comprehend them."

"And once I leave the High Wall, even though I have already 'remembered' and 'comprehended' them, I ultimately cannot manifest something that does not exist..." Mo Rubin's expression became somewhat absent minded as he painstakingly explained his experience, speaking one word at a time.

Li Fan found himself able to understand Mo Rubin's explanation to some extent.

It was like Li Fan attempting to explain the [Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood] to Mo Rubin. Without the [Truth] ability, Mo Rubin would never be able to touch or comprehend it, no matter how much Li Fan explained.

He would only think Li Fan was a fraud speaking utter nonsense.

Because from Mo Rubin's perspective, the so called [Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood] simply did not exist.

"When touching the High Wall, I can recall those insights. But once I leave it, all of them disappear completely..."

"Is that not merely the moon reflected in water and flowers reflected in a mirror? Entirely useless. At least reflected flowers and moons can still be seen."

Li Fan deliberately spoke in a tone filled with disappointment.

Mo Rubin pondered for a moment before slowly shaking his head.

"Not exactly. Even though I cannot retain those insights, these two sessions of comprehending the Dao have allowed me to transform the form in which the High Wall exists into something I can understand."

As he spoke, Mo Rubin lightly raised his index finger and drew a circle in the air before Li Fan.

The circle enclosed Li Fan within it.

In Li Fan's vision, Mo Rubin suddenly disappeared.

Even the entire Darkest Star Sea vanished from his field of perception.

His divine sense, as well as the Golden Needle marks he had previously left behind, all became ineffective.

It was as though walls had been erected on all sides around him, completely surrounding him like a miniature High Wall that blocked both his sight and senses.

"Interesting."

"A miniature High Wall."

However, Mo Rubin's wall was clearly incomparable to the High Wall that imprisoned the Darkest Star Sea.

Li Fan did not even need to use the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger.

He merely elevated himself slightly. Then, with a casual step, he crossed over the barrier.

Mo Rubin still stood where he was. He showed no surprise that Li Fan had escaped so quickly.

"My comprehension is still insufficient."

"If I were given a little more time, I fear it would not be so easy for you to escape, Fellow Daoist," Mo Rubin said slowly.

Li Fan frowned.

"Brother Mo, compared to the invisible High Wall, your divine ability still seems to be missing a crucial element."

"It is precisely because of this missing piece that its power is greatly diminished. If that missing factor could be understood, then one might truly be able to imprison someone simply by drawing a boundary on the ground."

Hearing this, unwillingness and longing flashed through Mo Rubin's eyes.

For someone cultivating the Innumerable Calamities Undying Demon Heart Immortal Art, having his emotions stirred so easily was nearly impossible.

The fact that it happened now could only mean that the secret behind the flaw in the High Wall had thoroughly shaken the foundation of his mind.

'I possess [Truth], so I need not worry about losing these opportunities forever. Yet despite all my attempts, I have still failed to gain any insight from it. Is the difference in comprehension really this great? It seems I will have to return once more and use the countless living beings of the small worlds to help me comprehend the Dao. Although the remaining time in this life may not be much.'

Li Fan silently contemplated.

He then asked Mo Rubin about his next plans.

"You still intend to search the remaining regions of the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation for traces of the Xuantian King?"

"During the time you spent comprehending the High Wall, I searched the Xuanhuang Realm once again. Unlike the Heavenly Beast Eye and Spirit Gathering Ascension, the other sections of the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation appear to have suffered severe damage. They no longer provide conditions suitable for the Xuantian King to remain hidden," Li Fan said.

Mo Rubin gazed toward the nearby Xuanhuang Realm.

As the topic of the Xuantian King came up once more, the wavering expression on his face gradually disappeared, returning him to the inscrutable Twelfth Dharma King of the Xuantian Sect.

Perhaps Li Fan's previous act of risking his life to stop him had strengthened his trust once again.

After hesitating for a while, Mo Rubin slowly spoke.

"I still wish to visit one final place."

"But after ten thousand years, the Xuanhuang Realm has changed beyond recognition. It is difficult to determine its exact location."

"That is easy."

In an instant, a comparison map of the ancient and present Xuanhuang Realm appeared before Mo Rubin.

"Here."

After examining it carefully for some time, Mo Rubin finally selected a location.

Li Fan's expression immediately became somewhat strange.

"What is it?" Mo Rubin naturally noticed the subtle change on Li Fan's face.

Li Fan merely shook his head.

"You will understand once we arrive."

The phantom Wooden Sword flickered between light and darkness.

In the next instant, Li Fan brought Mo Rubin to their destination.

It was none other than the small mountain and Daoist temple where the Fishing Pond was located.

In this life, Li Fan had never activated the Fishing Pond.

He had merely relocated Zhong Shentong, Liuli, and the others from the temple by force.

"This place was once Brother Xuanyuan's hometown."

"It was also where he made his final ascension."

"I never imagined it would become so desolate."

Mo Rubin slowly walked into the Daoist temple, carefully observing everything as he sighed.

"This was actually the Xuanhuang Realm's final place of ascension?" Li Fan asked in slight surprise.

"Indeed. Back then, Brother Xuanyuan was extraordinarily attached to this place. Whenever no one could find him, they would eventually discover him here. Even now, I still do not know what was so special about this place, or what he experienced here."

Mo Rubin slowly walked deeper into the temple, seemingly searching for traces of the Xuantian King's aura.

He eventually reached the rear courtyard.

The moment he saw the utterly ordinary little pond, his pupils suddenly contracted.

Then he hurried forward.

"This..."

"After ten thousand years, this place has not changed in the slightest?"

Mo Rubin was deeply shaken. His keen senses immediately recognized that this place was extraordinary.

"You looked rather strange earlier. Were you referring to this place?" Mo Rubin suddenly turned around and asked.

Li Fan nodded slightly.

"I discovered something unusual here because I could not destroy this tiny pond."

"However, I have searched it countless times and never found anything strange about it."

Hearing this, Mo Rubin turned back toward the Fishing Pond.

"The surrounding mountains and rivers have all undergone tremendous changes, yet this pond has remained exactly the same. There must be some hidden secret here."

"How strange. Yet Brother Xuanyuan never once mentioned that this place held any secret."

Having finally found his only clue, Mo Rubin naturally refused to let it go.

He tried every conceivable method.

He even personally dived into the pond.

Yet in the end, he found nothing.

It was as though it truly was nothing more than an ordinary little pond.

The secret lay right before his eyes, yet he could not perceive it.

Mo Rubin's expression gradually darkened.

"So this was the Xuantian King's hometown? What kind of person was he before his ascension?" Li Fan seized the opportunity to ask.

"The first half of Brother Xuanyuan's life was truly ordinary."

"So ordinary that he once walked past me, and I did not even bother lowering my head to look at him."

"At the time, I was a direct disciple of the Nine Refinements Temple. He was merely a minor Qi Condensation cultivator."

"But no one knew that beneath Brother Xuanyuan's unremarkable appearance lay peerless talent. He rose to prominence in a single leap. Without relying on any sect resources, he alone became the first cultivator in the Xuanhuang Realm to ascend, and also its last."

Infinite nostalgia filled Mo Rubin's expression.

As Li Fan listened, he fell into deep thought.

Naturally, Li Fan knew of the Fishing Pond's existence.

But exactly when it had first appeared in the Xuanhuang Realm remained unknown.

After all, the Fishing Pond was faintly connected to the Nameless True Immortal. It completely transcended the Xuanhuang Realm.

Even the Stone Tablet that recorded the history of the Xuanhuang Realm contained no information whatsoever about the Fishing Pond.

All along, Li Fan had subconsciously assumed that after the Star Sea Catastrophe descended and countless worlds were destroyed, the Fishing Pond had suddenly appeared within the Xuanhuang Realm.

But now, it seemed...

'Could it be that Dharma King Xuanyuan Hong's astonishing rise was actually because of this supreme treasure, the Fishing Pond?'

This thought inevitably surfaced in Li Fan's mind.

Chapter 1368: The Immortal Artifact Azure Firmament Pearl

The Xuantian King's greatest trump card was actually the Fishing Pond?

It was not impossible.

After all, the Xuantian King had no backing whatsoever, yet he alone had suppressed all the geniuses of his generation and attained the Dao and ascended ahead of everyone else.

That could not simply be described with the words "exceptional talent."

But if this speculation were true...

Li Fan could not help but recall Stone Tablet that had attempted to comprehend the Dao of Fishing, only to be fished away instead, as well as Cat Treasure, who had emerged from the Fishing Pond. It looked harmless to humans and animals alike, yet it could swallow a True Immortal whole.

'Could it be that the Xuantian King met a similar fate?'

Li Fan looked at the shallow pond before him. Yet the caution in his heart had risen to an unprecedented level.

The scene soon fell into a long silence.

It was not that Mo Rubin was slow-witted. Rather, without any hint, it was genuinely difficult to associate this ordinary pond with the Dao of Fishing.

Although he had still failed to uncover the mystery of the Fishing Pond, Mo Rubin had already regarded it as his final lifeline. For the time being, he had no intention of leaving.

"Continuing to wait here is not a solution."

"Actually, I have another method. It may allow us to trace the Xuantian King's whereabouts."

After a long while, Li Fan suddenly spoke, breaking the silence.

Mo Rubin abruptly turned to look at him.

After pondering for a moment, Li Fan carefully said, "I have mastered part of the power of the True Immortal seal script character, [Reveal]. The Reveal character can materialize and reveal even the faintest connections between things."

"Previously, from the memories of Dharma King Ji's remnant soul, I learned of the existence of the Azure Firmament Pearl..."

As Li Fan spoke, he carefully observed Mo Rubin's reaction.

When the Azure Firmament Pearl was mentioned, Mo Rubin's pupils immediately contracted. His aura abruptly changed as he instinctively became guarded.

However, perhaps because of everything they had experienced together, sufficient trust had already formed between them.

Before long, Mo Rubin's vigilance subsided on its own.

Only then did Li Fan continue.

"If the memories I obtained are correct, the cultivation methods practiced by the Twelve Dharma Kings all possess an invisible connection to the Azure Firmament Pearl."

"I wonder whether, by relying on the Reveal character, we can follow that connection and trace the Xuantian King's location."

"This method requires directly confronting the power of a True Immortal seal script character, so it will certainly carry some risk. Moreover, what we would actually be tracking is the Azure Firmament Pearl, the supreme treasure of the Xuantian Sect, not the Xuantian King himself. To avoid Brother Mo misunderstanding my intentions, I did not propose it earlier."

Li Fan looked at Mo Rubin and left the decision entirely to him.

Instead of answering directly, Mo Rubin suddenly asked a seemingly unrelated question.

"Who do you think the powerful figure who laid those golden threads across the flaw in the High Wall really is?"

Li Fan did not conceal anything and answered honestly.

"When I trapped him with my formation, I also took the opportunity to investigate his identity. He should be the Venerable from the cultivation world called the Heavenly Law Realm, one of the cultivation worlds that merged with the Xuanhuang Realm."

With a wave of his finger, he transmitted part of the information regarding the Heavenly Doctor to Mo Rubin.

"The Heavenly Laws are the Eternal Dao. Acting as Heaven's enforcer?"

"How could that compare to cultivators like us becoming one with Spirit Heaven and Earth? Or even replacing Heaven itself..."

"He is nothing more than an uncivilized and insignificant fellow. His current strength is likely only the result of accumulating power over these past ten thousand years."

Mo Rubin shook his head, his tone filled with disdain.

However, he turned back toward the Fishing Pond without giving an answer.

Only after standing beside the pond for a full seven days, still unable to comprehend its mysteries, did Mo Rubin finally shake his head slightly.

Then he said in an extremely solemn tone, "It is worth trying."

"The power of a True Immortal seal script character is extraordinary. I cannot guarantee that I will be able to control it perfectly. Furthermore..."

"If it truly points toward this pond, then something capable of swallowing even a figure like the Xuantian King must contain unimaginable danger. We absolutely cannot lower our guard."

"The safety of the Xuanhuang Realm now rests upon the two of us. We cannot afford the slightest carelessness," Li Fan reminded him.

Mo Rubin accepted Li Fan's reasoning.

At the pond beside the abandoned mountain Daoist temple, they made thorough preparations.

Only then did they begin testing the Reveal character.

"When Brother Xuanyuan first passed his cultivation method to me, he mentioned that the immortal arts cultivated by the vast majority of the Twelve Dharma Kings originated from True Immortals who ascended from the Divine Shaman Realm."

"The cultivators of that world resonate with the Great Dao through their souls, manipulate the Great Dao, and even replace the Great Dao itself. Although their cultivation methods and outward manifestations are somewhat strange, they are among the easiest immortal arts for directly reaching the Great Dao. It is said that the Divine Shaman Realm is one of the oldest cultivation worlds and may even be the birthplace of the human race."

"The Divine Shamans are almost no different from ordinary humans. Their only distinction is that their innate talent is far greater overall. It is much easier for their souls to resonate with the Great Dao than it is for ours."

"Back then, it took me tremendous effort just to get started with the Innumerable Calamities Undying Demon Heart Immortal Art."

"But according to Brother Xuanyuan, members of the Divine Shaman race can cultivate it effortlessly."

As Li Fan listened to Mo Rubin's description, his eyes narrowed slightly.

Mo Rubin suddenly changed the subject.

"But even True Immortals from such a powerful race were no different from ants when the Calamity of Dao Annihilation arrived. Their corpses fell like rain. They even died while fleeing in panic..."

"There is nothing to fear from True Immortals."

"Come!"

Mo Rubin let out a low shout.

Countless Demonic Hearts surged wildly out of his body.

They revolved and roared around him like a terrifying storm.

Li Fan glanced at the immortal formation and the phantom wooden sword nearby, ensuring that he could escape immediately if anything unexpected occurred.

He then looked at the Still [Truth] panel, where the charge had already reached 400 percent.

Only then did he calmly write the True Immortal seal script character [Reveal] in midair and send it directly toward Mo Rubin.

Mo Rubin offered no resistance and allowed the power of the Reveal character to envelop his body.

Immediately, wisps of azure smoke rose from the countless Demonic Hearts.

At first they shot straight upward.

After seemingly reaching the very limits of the heavens, they began circling continuously.

As though searching for a target.

Meanwhile, Mo Rubin's face twisted violently, as if an invisible force were repeatedly grinding against it.

"Brother Mo, hold on."

Li Fan spoke in a deep voice as he shot out several golden threads that pierced into Mo Rubin's body.

Since this had already been agreed upon beforehand, Mo Rubin did not resist.

Pure spiritual energy and even soul power continuously flowed through the golden threads into his body.

Helping him maintain his condition under the pressure of the True Immortal seal script character.

Above Mo Rubin's head, the countless wisps of azure smoke gradually merged into a single stream.

Then, as if it had finally located its target, the azure smoke suddenly became alive.

Like an azure dragon soaring through the heavens, it dived violently downward.

Its destination was none other than the Fishing Pond.

'So it really is as I suspected?'

Li Fan's heart skipped a beat.

Instinctively, he retreated a little farther away from the pond.

However, what happened next completely exceeded his expectations.

The sturdy azure dragon was just about to plunge into the waters of the Fishing Pond when, for some unknown reason, it suddenly paused for a brief moment.

Then it split into two streams.

One stream shot into the Fishing Pond.

The other soared back into the sky once more, flying beyond Xuanhuang.

"What?"

The sudden turn of events left both men utterly stunned.

Mo Rubin reacted quickly. He immediately followed the first stream of azure mist and plunged into the Fishing Pond.

But the moment the mist entered the water, it disappeared without a trace.

Despite the pond's crystal clear waters, where the bottom could be seen at a glance, Mo Rubin was unable to detect even the slightest aura of the Azure Firmament Pearl.

He could not help but feel somewhat dejected.

Li Fan, meanwhile, raised his head and stared at the place where the second stream of azure mist had vanished.

"What do you think, Brother Mo? Could it be that the Azure Firmament Pearl has actually split into two?" Li Fan asked with a frown.

"Judging from what the [Reveal] character script revealed, that is possible. But what if the Reveal character does not only point toward the Azure Firmament Pearl, but also simultaneously points toward Big Brother Xuanyuan?"

"Since we cannot gain anything from the Fishing Pond for the time being, we might as well investigate where the other stream of azure mist is heading." After a moment of silence, Mo Rubin suddenly proposed.

That was exactly what Li Fan wanted as well.

Before possessing sufficient means to protect himself, Li Fan had no desire for his true body to personally deal with the Fishing Pond.

The appearance of a strange existence like Cat Treasure within the Fishing Pond had already made him wary. Now that it had essentially been confirmed that the disappearance of the Xuantian King was connected to the Fishing Pond, Li Fan naturally became even more cautious.

The phantom Wooden Sword carried the two of them as they pursued the azure mist.

Although the mist retracing its origin traveled swiftly, it was still slightly slower than Li Fan's supreme movement technique.

Before long, they caught up to it, only to find themselves forced to follow behind it.

Mo Rubin's expression remained gloomy, so Li Fan deliberately changed the subject.

"Aside from the Divine Shaman Realm, did the Xuantian King ever tell you any other stories about the Immortal Realm?"

"To be honest, even though the Immortal Path has been severed for ten thousand years, cultivators like us still cannot suppress our longing and curiosity toward the legendary Immortal Realm."

Li Fan's words drew Mo Rubin's thoughts back to the past.

"Perhaps he truly visited the Immortal Realm before, or perhaps Big Brother Xuanyuan heard these things from the Faceless Immortal. In any case, he did often speak about matters concerning the Immortal Realm. We could all tell that he remained deeply concerned about having completed half of his ascension, only to be forced back from the Immortal Realm midway."

Mo Rubin smiled faintly.

"According to him, the Immortal Realm is a wondrous sacred land with inexhaustible resources. After ascending and becoming an immortal, one no longer has to worry about cultivation resources. How many resources one can obtain depends entirely on one's own strength and luck."

"However, Big Brother never explained exactly what these so called resources were. I imagine they are far more than simply immortal spiritual qi."

"Oh, there is one more thing. Have you ever heard of the Ascension Lightning Tribulation?" Mo Rubin suddenly asked.

"The Ascension Lightning Tribulation? Of course. Back when the Immortal Path had not yet been severed, it was said that ancient cultivators could only ascend and become immortals after surviving the lightning tribulation," Li Fan replied immediately.

Mo Rubin's expression became somewhat peculiar.

"Back then, I was only one step away from ascension. But after Big Brother Xuanyuan returned from the Immortal Realm, ascension itself became nothing more than an illusion. Ever since then, I have always carried this regret in my heart. I could never let go of missing that opportunity."

"But when no one else was around, Big Brother Xuanyuan once comforted me. He said that the reason he managed to survive the tribulation and ascend was because the True Immortal presiding over the lightning tribulation on the other side of the ascension passage suddenly died after being struck by the Dao Annihilation Calamity."

"According to the original strength of the tribulation, Big Brother Xuanyuan would never have survived it. In fact, that lightning tribulation had never intended to let any cultivator survive at all."

Li Fan was stunned upon hearing this.

"So Big Brother Xuanyuan told me not to dwell on it too much. Had my cultivation progressed just a little faster, what would have awaited me would not have been ascension, but only being reduced to ashes beneath endless heavenly lightning." Mo Rubin spoke quietly.

"Of course, I do not know whether that was the truth or merely something Big Brother Xuanyuan said to comfort me. But out of trust in him, he spoke it casually, and I accepted it just as casually."

"Heh..."

Li Fan remained silent.

The idealized image he held of the Xuantian King had already begun to crack.

As silence filled the air, the azure mist produced by the Reveal character seal script finally reached its destination.

It was still beneath the High Wall.

However, this time it did not touch the High Wall.

Instead, it suddenly disappeared into an inconspicuous corner beneath it.

Li Fan's heart stirred as he immediately recognized the location where the mist had vanished.

It was one of the entry points beneath the High Wall that led into the subterranean fissure basin.

"Let's go!" Mo Rubin's expression brightened as he followed it downward.

After pondering briefly, Li Fan followed as well.

The exact same experience from before repeated itself. Their relative position rapidly descended.

Very soon, they arrived at the lowest point of the Star Sea.

The silent energy permeating the place left the newly arrived Mo Rubin momentarily speechless.

But he did not forget the purpose of this journey.

Closely following the azure mist, they swiftly advanced deeper through the winding subterranean fissure basin.

Li Fan had already known that the countless ravines stretching throughout the Star Sea formed an enormous labyrinth. Venturing in recklessly carried the risk of becoming hopelessly lost.

But now they had the azure mist leading the way. More importantly, the trail likely involved both the Xuantian King and the Azure Firmament Pearl.

Li Fan therefore followed without hesitation.

It even took them dozens of times longer than traversing the Star Sea before the azure mist finally came to a stop.

Li Fan looked at the place where the connection created by the Reveal character seal script disappeared, his expression filled with surprise.

A complete azure pearl floated quietly before them.

Only upon seeing the Azure Firmament Pearl did Li Fan truly understand the meaning of the character 'Azure' in the phrase 'As Vast as the Azure Heavens.'

Mo Rubin's body trembled as he gazed at the Azure Firmament Pearl.

At the same time, confusion filled his eyes.

He could not understand why the immortal artifact upon which Big Brother Xuanyuan had relied had been abandoned here all alone.

"Something seems wrong."

"Why does this Azure Firmament Pearl seem to have completely lost its spirituality?"

Having seen many damaged immortal artifacts before, Li Fan immediately noticed the anomaly within the Azure Firmament Pearl.

After Li Fan pointed it out, Mo Rubin also realized it.

He immediately flew forward, reaching out to touch it.

However, the moment Mo Rubin approached, the Azure Firmament Pearl dissolved into countless strands of azure light.

It shattered and dispersed without leaving a trace.

"No!"

After all their efforts, everything had ultimately come to nothing. Even with Mo Rubin's temperament, he momentarily lost his composure.

He desperately tried to grasp the already vanished strands of azure light, attempting to restore the Azure Firmament Pearl.

Li Fan, however, did not waste his efforts.

Instead, he pondered thoughtfully.

"The aura within this Azure Firmament Pearl seems somewhat..."

"Similar to the subterranean fissure basin of the Darkest Star Sea?"

"I had previously wondered why the amount of energy accumulated within these fissures far exceeded what should have been possible."

"Now it seems that perhaps it is connected to the Azure Firmament Pearl."

Chapter 1369: The Eternal Obsession Rises

Li Fan quietly surveyed his surroundings.

After the Azure Firmament Pearl shattered and dissipated, it was as if an invisible boulder had fallen into the rift basin.

The underground rivers winding endlessly through the maze-like Star Sea fissure basin rippled with gentle waves.

An indescribable aura surged within them, adding yet another trace of mysterious vitality to this place.

It seemed that the complete dissipation of the Azure Firmament Pearl had activated something.

Li Fan faintly sensed that the entire fissure basin had become somewhat different.

"It seems that over the past ten thousand years, the Azure Firmament Pearl has continuously released its energy into the outside world. It had already nearly reached its limit and was on the verge of being completely drained."

"Our arrival merely gave it the final push." Li Fan sighed softly.

Mo Rubin also realized this. The excitement that had caused him to briefly lose his composure gradually subsided.

Looking back across the entire fissure basin, he suddenly understood the true purpose of this place. It was meant to accumulate vitality, wait for the proper moment, then unleash it all at once, guiding the complete revival of the Star Sea.

"Such an exquisite undertaking could never have formed naturally within the Star Sea. Not to mention that the Azure Firmament Pearl was used as the catalyst supplying all this vitality..."

Mo Rubin's thoughts raced.

"Could this have been arranged by Brother Xuanyuan? But when could he possibly have done it?"

"The Azure Firmament Pearl was Brother Xuanyuan's most precious treasure. He never allowed it to leave his side. Yet it remained here all this time... while Brother Xuanyuan himself disappeared into that mysterious pond."

Mo Rubin's expression became uncertain.

"This matter is indeed rather strange," Li Fan nodded. "Either the Xuantian King did not disappear immediately after being ambushed all those years ago, but instead fell into a deep slumber because of his severe injuries. After awakening much later, he arranged this entire fissure basin. Perhaps the pool within the Xuanhuang Realm is connected to one of the fissures here."

"Or, before the ambush ever occurred, the Xuantian King had already entrusted the Azure Firmament Pearl to someone else. Throughout all these years, that person has continued carrying out every plan related to reviving the Star Sea in his place..."

"Impossible!"

Before Li Fan could finish speaking, Mo Rubin instinctively interrupted him.

Li Fan looked at Mo Rubin with a meaningful gaze.

"Brother Mo, could you tell me which of the Twelve Dharma Kings the Xuantian King trusted the most?"

"There is no need to claim that he treated everyone equally. Relationships naturally differ in closeness. Even saints cannot escape such principles."

Mo Rubin's face darkened. He opened his mouth as if to speak, only to stop himself.

He then simply closed his eyes, attempting to conceal the turmoil within his heart.

In the end, however, he did not avoid the question.

"I think... if Brother Xuanyuan truly trusted anyone the most, then it would certainly have been Xing Wuque."

"Xing Wuque..."

Information regarding this Dharma King immediately surfaced within Li Fan's mind.

His arms and legs had all been severed. His facial features had been destroyed. He constantly wore a bronze fanged mask and almost never communicated with anyone.

"Within the Xuantian Sect, besides Brother Xuanyuan himself, no one knew Xing Wuque's true identity. Just as you said before, relationships differ in closeness. The twelve Dharma Kings naturally divided into several small circles according to our friendships."

"Sun Xingwang and Sikong Lin were always together, discussing things no one else could understand. Gongye Tianzong and Tian Xingke would always converse merrily while drinking together. Luo Yichen, Auntie Nie, Ji Yuzhen—The Three Ladies always had an endless stream of private secrets to share..."

"But Xing Wuque alone always kept his distance from every other Dharma King. He never took the initiative to speak with anyone in the sect. Whenever he appeared, he was always alone. Yet every task assigned to him was completed flawlessly and with astonishing efficiency."

Mo Rubin's face was filled with nostalgia.

"It was as though he had abandoned all seven emotions and six desires, becoming nothing more than a machine. He no longer lived for himself."

"Perhaps that is why Brother Xuanyuan trusted him the most."

"And when the incident occurred that day, Xing Wuque indeed seemed to have been away from the sect."

Li Fan nodded slightly.

"If Xing Wuque truly took the Azure Firmament Pearl back then, then throughout all these years he should have been tirelessly carrying out the Xuantian King's mission. Brother Mo, do you have any means of contacting Dharma King Xing?"

Mo Rubin shook his head.

"Xing Wuque only maintained direct contact with Brother Xuanyuan. However..."

As if suddenly recalling something, Mo Rubin looked once more toward the place where the Azure Firmament Pearl had dissipated.

"I wonder whether the 'Reavel' True Immortal seal script can still be used on the Azure Firmament Pearl. Perhaps we can continue following the trail."

"The Azure Firmament Pearl is an immortal artifact. Even a True Immortal seal script may not affect it. Besides, it has already dissipated." Li Fan pointed toward the ripples that still continued spreading through the surrounding waters.

"Dissipation does not mean disappearance. Among all the treasures Brother Xuanyuan obtained from the Immortal Realm, the Azure Firmament Pearl ranked among the most precious. How could it possibly vanish so easily?"

"It has not disappeared. Rather, it has transformed into another unique form, becoming vitality itself and existing throughout these underground rivers."

Mo Rubin spoke with complete certainty, once again displaying the bearing of one of the Twelve Dharma Kings of the Xuantian Sect.

"You only need to cast the [Reveal] True Immortal seal script upon these endless rivers of vitality."

Li Fan once again immersed his senses into the boundless underground rivers flowing through the rift.

He vaguely understood.

Gathering his focus, he solemnly wrote the [Reveal] True Immortal seal script once again in midair.

The instant the profound character took shape, it dissolved like ink into the underground river.

The rhythm of the rippling waves was quickly disrupted.

It was as though another completely unrelated and independent fluctuation had suddenly appeared.

Li Fan and Mo Rubin immediately followed the direction in which that fluctuation spread.

This time they ventured even deeper into the rift.

After countless twists and turns and more than thirty days of travel, they finally reached the end.

"Be careful. There seems to be the aura of a living person ahead."

Mo Rubin suddenly transmitted a warning.

Li Fan had already summoned the phantom Wooden Sword to guard his side as he slowly approached.

At the end of the underground river sat a solitary figure.

Its aura fluctuated unpredictably.

Upon its face rested a fanged mask.

"Xing Wuque?"

Seeing the familiar appearance, Mo Rubin could not help but call out loudly.

However, after a brief moment of surprise, Li Fan felt an inexplicable sense of unease.

Xing Wuque had long ago lost both his arms and legs.

Yet this figure clearly possessed all four limbs intact.

More importantly...

The clothing he wore was extremely familiar to Li Fan.

It was exactly the same as that of Xu Ke, who had previously disappeared into the depths of the underground river.

"Is it Xu Ke?"

"Or is it Xing Wuque?"

"No wonder his aura felt so unstable earlier..."

Li Fan pondered silently, refraining from making any rash move.

After recovering from his initial shock, Mo Rubin also noticed the differences between the figure before him and his old companion.

After observing carefully for a while, he reached a conclusion.

"It resembles him, yet it is not truly him. It seems to exist in some extraordinary state of fusion. Could it be that after all these years, Xing Wuque also reached the end of his lifespan and was forced to use some special method to continue existing?"

Li Fan could tell that in this fusion, Xu Ke was clearly the dominant personality. Rather than Xing Wuque continuing to exist, it was more accurate to call it an inheritance.

'As expected of a child of fortune. After being struck into this place of death by the echoing star power, he still managed to encounter such a great opportunity.'

'If Mo Rubin's previous speculation was correct, and Xing Wuque has been carrying out the Xuantian King's mission for the past ten thousand years...'

'Then Xu Ke also took upon himself the responsibility of suppressing the Xuanhuang world's evil thoughts alone for all eternity because of Mr. Bai's dying request.'

'These two are remarkably alike in this regard. Perhaps that is precisely why Xu Ke was able to inherit Xing Wuque's legacy.' Li Fan silently pondered.

Mo Rubin, however, merely shook his head slightly.

"This new body is far too weak. It simply cannot withstand Xing Wuque's full strength. But we can give him a hand."

As he spoke, Mo Rubin released a single Demonic Heart.

As it flew toward its target, the originally ferocious expression upon the Demonic Heart gradually melted away.

It became a featureless face before completely dissolving into a thick grey liquid.

In an instant, it seeped into Xu Ke's body.

Moments later, Xu Ke's unstable aura gradually became much steadier.

"The countless Demonic Hearts can not only injure others and seize their bodies, but can also suppress calamities and save lives. Truly worthy of being an immortal art of the Divine Shaman Clan." Li Fan could not help but sigh in admiration. Not wanting to fall behind, he shot out dozens of golden needles.

Just as he had previously helped Mo Rubin, golden threads infused pure spiritual energy and soul power into Xu Ke.

With the combined assistance of these two great experts, Xu Ke's fusion with the bronze mask accelerated by more than a thousandfold.

Originally, it would have taken at least several decades to completely absorb the inheritance.

But now, before long, Xu Ke's aura had already gradually stabilized.

Li Fan and Mo Rubin waited quietly.

Finally, two rays of light lit up within the eye sockets of the mask.

When Xu Ke saw the two people before him, his body trembled slightly.

"Holy Teacher?!" he blurted out instinctively, his voice filled with astonishment.

His tone and voice had become completely different from the Xu Ke of the past. Yet the words he spoke unmistakably revealed the true identity of the figure before them.

"Hm?" Hearing a familiar voice speak unfamiliar words, Mo Rubin was momentarily stunned. Then he finally reacted and turned to look at Li Fan.

Li Fan also wore an expression of complete shock.

"Xu Ke? How could it be you?!" he asked in disbelief.

It was as if he had not noticed anything beforehand.

Mo Rubin, meanwhile, asked coldly, "You're not Xing Wuque? What have you done to him?"

A dangerous glint flashed in his eyes. It was only because Xu Ke knew Li Fan that he had not attacked immediately.

"Senior Xing... had already reached his limit and passed away."

"By pure chance, I found this mask and passed his trial. I merely inherited his legacy." Xu Ke spoke in a somewhat sorrowful tone.

Xu Ke then recounted the entire story in detail.

It matched Li Fan's earlier speculation exactly. Perhaps Xing Wuque had indeed intended to possess Xu Ke's body and be reborn. But after sensing how astonishingly similar Xu Ke's life had been to his own, Xing Wuque ultimately chose to give up.

The attempted possession thus became an inheritance.

"Senior's inheritance was simply too vast. Even though he completely opened it for me to absorb, I could not assimilate it all at once. Instead, my consciousness became unstable..."

"Fortunately, the two seniors came to my aid." Xu Ke bowed respectfully.

Hearing the voice of a former companion address him in such a manner left Mo Rubin feeling rather uncomfortable.

Li Fan directly asked about Xing Wuque's connection to the darkness beneath the Star Sea fissure.

"It seems Senior Xing deliberately erased those memories from the inheritance."

"But from some fragmented memories, I can still infer the general truth."

"The underground dark river stretching throughout the entire Star Sea was personally excavated by Senior Xing over countless years through the power of the immortal treasure Azure Firmament Pearl."

Xu Ke's words instantly left both Li Fan and Mo Rubin stunned.

"The underground dark river winds throughout the entire Star Sea. It is difficult to imagine that such a monumental undertaking could have been accomplished by a single person. Yet even after Senior deliberately erased those memories, countless fragments of him excavating the river still remain. That alone is enough to prove his achievement."

Xu Ke's voice was filled with sorrow.

"Ever since Senior Xing received the Xuantian King's orders all those years ago, he carried the Azure Firmament Pearl and devoted himself entirely to this task."

"For ten thousand years, he never stopped for even a single moment."

"Even with Senior's extraordinary cultivation, wielding the immortal treasure Azure Firmament Pearl placed an enormous burden upon him. After ten thousand years without rest, the endless accumulation of that strain finally pushed him beyond his limits."

"Filled with regret, he ultimately fell at the very end of this underground dark river."

Xu Ke slowly narrated everything.

Li Fan remained silent.

It all sounded utterly inconceivable.

But if Xing Wuque truly possessed the personality Mo Rubin had previously described...

Then perhaps it was entirely possible.

Mo Rubin was shaken even more deeply. Several times he opened his mouth to speak, only to stop himself.

Looking toward the end of the underground dark river, he finally asked, "Xing Wuque... even at the moment of his death, still failed to complete the task Brother Xuanyuan entrusted to him?"

Xu Ke nodded.

"And that is the mission I will continue for the rest of my life. Since I have inherited Senior Xing's legacy, it is only natural that I complete what he left unfinished."

His tone was calm, yet absolutely resolute.

Hearing this, Mo Rubin's expression changed slightly. He looked at Xu Ke with undisguised surprise.

"Ridiculous."

"Leaving aside whether any of this even has meaning, the immortal treasure Azure Firmament Pearl has already shattered. With your current cultivation, how could you possibly continue excavating new underground rivers?"

Xu Ke remained completely unmoved.

"Simply carrying out Senior Xing's final wish is meaning enough."

"As for the shattered immortal treasure..."

A brilliant azure radiance suddenly burst forth from the mask upon Xu Ke's face.

It was exactly the same azure glow Li Fan had previously seen emanating from the true Azure Firmament Pearl.

"During Senior's ten thousand years of excavation, the act of opening these underground rivers had already become an instinct engraved into his very being. Now that he has passed that inheritance to me, I can accomplish the same thing even without the immortal treasure."

"It is merely another repetition, ten thousand years later."

Specks of azure light shot forth from the mask.

They illuminated the darkness ahead, at the end of the underground river.

Under the joint witness of Mo Rubin and Li Fan, Xu Ke truly opened yet another new section of underground rift.

However, after advancing less than three zhang, the azure light suddenly broke apart.

Xu Ke collapsed to the ground in exhaustion.

"At your current pace, when exactly do you expect to finish?" Li Fan could not help but snort coldly.

"So long as I make progress every single time, one day it will be completed." Xu Ke smiled with difficulty.

"Just as Senior Xing said, the Xuantian King's orders must have carried their own purpose."
