Chapter 1370: The Star Sea Ascension Into The Immortal Domain

Xu Ke rested for a short while. Surprisingly, his vigor quickly recovered once more.

Green light flared from the mask again, and he resumed carving out fissure valleys.

"I inherited Senior Xing's legacy, and my lifespan has increased by a great deal. That is a grace equal to being given a new life. With this worn out body, completing the excavation of the Dark River should be more than enough."

"After all, before Senior Xing died, he had already extended the Dark River across most of the Star Sea. What remains for me is merely to add the finishing touches..."

Xu Ke muttered continuously, as if explaining things to Li Fan and Mo Rubin, or perhaps trying to convince himself.

His hands never stopped moving. The green light continued opening a path ahead.

Completely focused, seemingly incapable of fatigue.

Li Fan did not care whether Xu Ke's determination to continue excavating the Dark River came from his own will or from the influence of Xing Wuque's inheritance. To him, there was no real difference between the two.

What interested Li Fan far more was the method Xu Ke used to carve fissure valleys out of the void with that green light.

The fissure valleys still existed within the Star Sea, but they occupied the lowest points of momentum.

With the Ascension Formation in his possession, Li Fan could continuously elevate his own momentum. However, he had no particularly effective method of causing momentum to descend.

Li Fan vaguely sensed that the concepts of high and low momentum were actually two sides of the same coin. To comprehend only one aspect would inevitably be incomplete.

If he could unravel the method of creating fissure valleys, his understanding of Momentum would advance another step.

Xu Ke appeared to be excavating forward, but in reality, he was digging into the Star Sea itself, striking and creating points of lowest momentum that had never previously existed.

In essence, they were the same kind of existence as the natural high platforms within the Remnant World Great Wall. The only difference lay in whether their momentum was high or low.

"The key still lies in that green light emerging from the mask."

"This mask..."

After observing it for a while, Li Fan already understood.

When he deployed the Ascension Formation, he required True Immortal flesh and blood as an auxiliary material.

Xing Wuque's mask served a similar purpose.

"It is not merely an immortal artifact. There is also another extremely special power within it."

Li Fan stared at the green ghostly light covering Xu Ke's face. For some unknown reason, it gave him a strangely familiar feeling.

The feeling flashed by in an instant. When he attempted to trace and identify it, he found himself completely without direction, as though the sensation had been nothing more than his own illusion from beginning to end.

But Li Fan was not someone who would so easily abandon such a flash of inspiration.

Everything he had witnessed throughout his past experiences rapidly replayed before his eyes, constantly surfacing and being compared.

The more reincarnations he had undergone, the richer and more complicated his experiences had become. The pressure involved in searching through those memories likewise grew ever greater.

As time passed, that sense of familiarity rapidly faded away. In order to find its source before it disappeared, Li Fan pushed the Dao Deviation Stone to its absolute limit.

Sweat gradually formed on his forehead. Tiny cracks even appeared across the surface of the Dao Deviation Stone. Boundless divine soul power surged into it under Li Fan's conscious control, repairing the cracks while simultaneously serving as fuel.

Perhaps fortune favored Li Fan.

Or perhaps forcing the Dao Deviation Stone to its utmost efficiency produced the desired effect.

Just before that sudden feeling of familiarity completely vanished.

Li Fan finally found its origin among his countless past experiences.

"With the remains left behind by the First Great Celestial Venerable protecting us, and by detonating those immortal artifacts as our driving force, the two of us have an excellent chance of crossing the High Wall!"

"We have prepared for so long. How can you suddenly change your mind now?!"

Even after so much time had passed, Li Fan could still sense the boundless resentment carried within the speaker's voice.

It was precisely...

The scene that appeared within the illusionary trial of the Fallen Immortal Realm after making the same choice Su Bai had once made while becoming the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.

The Fallen Immortal Realm was illusion, yet truth.

Everything that occurred within it was both false and real.

When the fragmented consciousness of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao roared its questioning.

Within the illusion, as "Su Bai," Li Fan had also experienced an inexplicable sensation in that instant.

The so called remains left behind by the First Great Celestial Venerable...

Truly existed.

Moreover, at the point in time recorded by the illusion, those remains were actually being carried by Su Bai.

Therefore, after experiencing that scene once more within the illusion, Li Fan had been able to sense their unique aura through Su Bai's body.

When he first sensed it, Li Fan had been unable to properly comprehend it. Thus, throughout all this time, he had never realized its existence. Only the Dao Deviation Stone had silently recorded everything.

Now, returning to the present, after carefully examining the mask left behind by Xing Wuque.

That strangely familiar aura finally awakened Li Fan's perception.

"A relic of the First Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable?"

This thought immediately surfaced in Li Fan's mind.

But he quickly realized something was wrong.

"The similarity in aura does not come from belonging to the same individual."

"It comes from sharing the same fundamental nature."

Li Fan felt a trace of disappointment, but soon began contemplating exactly what that shared nature truly was.

Naturally, Li Fan's unusual behavior caught Mo Rubin's attention.

"Have you also encountered Xing Wuque before, Fellow Daoist?"

"I have never met him. I am merely astonished that someone like this could actually exist in the world..."

Li Fan paused briefly before finally choosing a single word to describe him.

"Stubborn."

Mo Rubin smiled bitterly.

"Stubborn? He was far beyond that. He was simply foolish, utterly foolish. Forget you. Even I, who was also one of the Xuantian Sect Dharma Kings, never imagined he could carry things this far."

Mo Rubin's tone suddenly became somewhat despondent.

"Perhaps this was precisely why Brother Xuanyuan entrusted this task to him back then. Had it been me, or any of the other Twelve Dharma Kings, none of us could have done what Xing Wuque did."

"It is not that our loyalty to Brother Xuanyuan was any less. But after Brother Xuanyuan disappeared, instead of searching for him, to remain here by the Dark River of the fissure valleys and carry out his mission day after day, for ten thousand years without wavering..."

Mo Rubin repeatedly shook his head.

"Xu Ke's temperament is rather similar to Xing Wuque's. Now that he has inherited the mission and chosen to continue excavating the unfinished Dark River, I cannot persuade him otherwise. However, Fellow Daoist Mo, do you know whether this fissure valley Dark River holds any deeper significance?"

While still contemplating the shared nature of that mysterious aura, Li Fan fixed Mo Rubin with a burning gaze as he continued questioning him.

"If it were merely meant to accumulate vitality for the revival of the Star Sea, then there would be no need for it to spread across the entire Star Sea. Even if it covered only a small portion, that objective could still be achieved."

"A small portion and the entirety represent completely different scales of work. Who was the Xuantian King? He would never make such a mistake. Just as Xing Wuque said, every instruction given by the Xuantian King must have carried its own meaning. So what exactly was that meaning?"

Mo Rubin narrowed his eyes as his gaze swept across the Dark River within the fissure valleys.

Li Fan's question left him speechless for a long while.

Li Fan chuckled softly.

"Surely you are not suggesting that the Xuantian King simply made a mistake when assigning this task to Xing Wuque?"

"That is naturally impossible."

Mo Rubin immediately shook his head in firm denial.

His brows remained tightly furrowed, yet no answer came to mind.

Xu Ke could only answer that Xuantian King had always instructed Xing Wuque to carry out his orders faithfully. He had never questioned why.

Mo Rubin was momentarily speechless.

"It should be like how a formation only takes shape after it has been completely laid out. Even if ninety percent of it has been completed, as long as the formation has not been fully connected, it is still useless."

"Yes, that must be it. It has to be like that." After a long while, Mo Rubin finally offered what seemed to be a very reasonable explanation.

Li Fan neither agreed nor disagreed.

"A layout that stretches across the entire Darkest Star Sea. What an unimaginably grand undertaking. If something on that scale were to erupt, let alone reviving the Star Sea, it might even be capable of overturning the High Wall itself."

Although he said so outwardly, Li Fan did not actually accept Mo Rubin's explanation.

Li Fan believed that, with his current attainments in formations, he was no longer much inferior to the Xuantian King.

There was not the slightest trace of any formation within this underground river beneath the earth fissure. How could he possibly fail to notice something so obvious?

"However, even if it is not a formation, perhaps the underlying principle is the same."

"Only when it reaches completeness can the conditions be fulfilled and activated."

Li Fan's thoughts paused slightly.

This feeling of failing at the very last step despite having done nearly everything reminded him greatly of when he used the Ascension Formation and climbed toward the highest point of momentum.

Unless one reached the absolute limit of ascending into immortality, no matter how high one had climbed beforehand, it was all meaningless.

Only after completing the final process of ascension would all the previous efforts finally become meaningful.

"Ascension."

"Immortal Ascension."

Although Li Fan stood at the lowest point of the Star Sea, it felt as though his vision had instantly broken free from its restraints.

The entire Darkest Star Sea, enclosed by the High Wall, appeared before him in miniature.

"Could it be that what the Xuantian King ultimately sought is the same plan that I am pursuing in this life?"

"The difference is that I intend to elevate the Xuanhuang Realm and evolve it into an Immortal Realm."

"But the Xuantian King..."

"Intended to elevate the entire Star Sea itself?"

Even Li Fan found the thought that had suddenly emerged utterly absurd.

Only those who had personally experienced it could truly understand the enormous gulf separating mortals from immortals.

Thinking back carefully, just how many preparations had Li Fan made in this life to bring forth the Immortal Realm Xuanhuang?

The abundant vitality contained within hundreds of remnant worlds, the echoing star force accumulated within the basin.

The legacy of the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable and immortal spiritual qi.

The return of countless small worlds, bringing all things into one.

There was even a complete fragment of an Immortal Realm left behind by some unknown True Immortal.

Even after combining all of these together, Li Fan still could not guarantee that creating the Immortal Realm Xuanhuang would succeed.

Compared to the Xuanhuang Realm, the Star Sea existed on an entirely different scale.

If one truly wished to elevate the entire Star Sea into an Immortal Realm...

The amount of energy required was simply beyond imagination.

Even with a supreme treasure like [Truth], allowing him to gather every resource within the Star Sea over and over again...

Before his mental lifespan was completely exhausted, Li Fan still could not see even the slightest hope of success.

"In the end, it is merely my own wild fantasy."

"Unless..."

"The Xuantian King saw something that I still cannot see."

For some reason, this thought suddenly arose within Li Fan's mind.

"Brother Mo, are you planning to stay here with Xu Ke?"

Silence once again filled the basin beneath the earth fissure for a long time. In the end, Li Fan was the one who broke it.

Mo Rubin withdrew his gaze from Xu Ke's resolute back and remained silent for quite some time.

"We have already tried every possible method."

"Although I do not wish to admit it, judging from everything we know now, the Xuantian King most likely disappeared within that strange pool of water."

"He no longer exists within the present Darkest Star Sea."

"Although the Xuantian King has vanished, I will never simply wait for death. It is just that from now on, saving the Xuanhuang Realm will depend entirely on us." Li Fan sighed softly.

Mo Rubin remained optimistic.

"Since Brother Xuanyuan prepared such elaborate contingencies, I do not believe something could have happened to him so easily. I think the key still lies within that strange pool."

"I will return to the Xuanhuang Realm and continue researching it."

Li Fan nodded slightly before looking once again toward Xu Ke.

"You need not worry about Xu Ke. I will regularly send people here to care for him and ensure he remains in the best possible condition to continue this endless excavation," Li Fan said solemnly.

"You also heard earlier that Xu Ke addressed me as 'Holy Teacher.'"

"I merely happened to save a few children during the effort to rescue the Xuanhuang Realm, then casually taught them afterward. In truth, I do not deserve the title of 'Holy Teacher.' Brother Mo must find it rather amusing," Li Fan said casually.

Mo Rubin nodded, paying little attention to the matter.

Under his urging, Li Fan first brought him back to the Xuanhuang Realm.

Standing beside the Fishing Pond, Mo Rubin once again began studying it carefully.

Although Xing Wuque had already died, the traces he left behind had given Mo Rubin tremendous encouragement.

"The Xuantian King truly possessed extraordinary charisma."

"Some people labored for him over ten thousand years without ever stopping, even willing to die for him."

"Others maintained absolute faith in him forever, believing in him without the slightest doubt."

Li Fan snorted inwardly.

He openly set up an immortal formation around the Fishing Pond.

Officially, it was to prevent outsiders from disturbing Mo Rubin's research into the mysteries of the pool.

In reality, the formation's true purpose was to suppress Mo Rubin at a critical moment.

During this life's elevation of the Xuanhuang Realm, absolutely nothing could be allowed to emerge from the Fishing Pond.

Mo Rubin would likely not discover the Fishing Pond's secret anytime soon.

Meanwhile, Li Fan continued contemplating the similarity in their shared nature.

Some vague intuition told him that the resemblance between Xing Wuque's bronze mask and the First Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable concealed an enormous secret.

Li Fan returned to the Great Xuan small world.

Looking upon the countless living beings throughout the world, he fell into deep contemplation.

He even temporarily set aside the work of integrating the Immortal Realm fragment.

The sun rose and the moon set. Three months passed in the blink of an eye.

Li Fan still found nothing.

Just as he shook his head and prepared to give up, his gaze suddenly settled upon the clouds and mist drifting through the small world.

"Clouds, mist, rain, and ice. They are merely different forms of water."

"So this is what is meant by similarity through shared nature."

"And..."

The tightly furrowed brows that Li Fan had maintained for so long suddenly relaxed.

"I should not be searching for what the bronze mask has in common with the First Great Celestial Venerable."

"I should instead search for what the First Great Celestial Venerable has in common with the bronze mask."

"The bronze mask's function is to open the underground river beneath the earth fissure at the lowest point of momentum."

"It is the opposite of Ascension."

"It is the descent of Momentum."

At that instant, Li Fan's thoughts became completely clear.

"The First Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable was the same."

"The descent of momentum..."

"Descending from immortal... into mortal!"

Chapter 1371: The Immortal Go Pieces Merge

"The first Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable was not an Immortal who descended into the lower realm..."

"He was an Immortal who transformed into a mortal?"

In an instant, Li Fan's mind trembled violently.

An Immortal descending into the lower realm and an Immortal transforming into a mortal seemed similar at first glance, yet they were fundamentally different.

An Immortal who descended into the lower realm was still a True Immortal. Their power was merely constrained by the maximum limit the lower realm could withstand.

But once they transformed into a mortal, then...

The Immortal was no longer an Immortal.

Becoming a True Immortal was the lifelong dream of every mortal cultivator. Yet in the ancient Xuanhuang Realm, there had actually been a True Immortal who willingly abandoned that status and descended into the mortal world.

'The Dao Annihilation Calamity!'

The name flashed through Li Fan's mind.

Other than avoiding the terrifying catastrophe that would later destroy the Immortal Realm, Li Fan could think of no other reason for making such a choice.

'When the first Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable transformed into a mortal, there should still have been quite a long time before the great catastrophe of the Immortal Realm.'

'Such foresight. Such determination.'

'This was a True Immortal descending into the mortal world.'

Li Fan could not help but inwardly marvel.

However, another thought suddenly crossed his mind.

'But I cannot rule out the possibility that he was forced into it. From the memories of the True Immortals I witnessed before, it is clear that the Immortal Realm also possessed an extremely strict hierarchy.'

'If his only goal had been to avoid the Dao Annihilation Calamity himself, then in theory he would never have accepted the position of Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.'

'It is obvious that the first Great Celestial Venerable descended in order to cooperate with some plan of the Immortal Realm.'

'And the Xuanhuang Realm was one of its testing grounds.'

Recalling the unstable rings and the Nine Star Red Beads within the Immortal Formation he had previously seen, as well as the countless frozen corpses controlled by the Watchers, Li Fan gradually connected all the clues.

'Perhaps the Immortal Realm established the Xuanhuang testing ground for more than simply seeking refuge.'

'They may also have hoped to discover a way to overcome the Dao Annihilation Calamity.'

'But judging from the final outcome, they failed.'

'The Dao Annihilation Calamity spread through the Immortal Realm even faster than anyone had imagined. Countless True Immortals perished.'

'Meanwhile, the lower realm Xuanhuang remained completely unharmed. That inevitably caused some Immortals to lose their resolve to resist the calamity.'

'And thus the Immortal Domain Fragment Plan came into existence...'

Li Fan narrowed his eyes as he contemplated.

An even greater question arose in his heart.

'Did that first Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable truly die?'

The True Immortal's remains had been passed down through the generations and remained under the control of each successive Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.

But what about the first Great Celestial Venerable himself?

Since he had already transformed into a mortal and even left behind descendants, he should have become a completely mortal being.

Could such an extraordinary figure really have disappeared into the river of history like any ordinary mortal after exhausting his lifespan?

Or had he assumed another identity, concealed his name, and silently observed everything from the shadows?

'Now it seems that the close connection between the Xuanhuang Realm and the Immortal Realm absolutely cannot be separated from this first Great Celestial Venerable. As a fallen Immortal who had descended into mortality, he served as the bridge between the immortal and mortal worlds while secretly monitoring everything happening within the Xuanhuang Realm.'

'At the same time, he himself remained under the control of the Immortal Realm. Perhaps he became dissatisfied and faked his death to escape.'

'The second Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable was no longer an Immortal transformed into a mortal, but was instead selected from among the native beings of the Xuanhuang Realm...'

'Either the price of transforming into a mortal was too great to sustain repeatedly, or the Xuanhuang Realm project was an absolute secret even within the Immortal Realm, leaving too few True Immortals qualified to participate. There simply was no suitable candidate left to undergo the transformation.'

'Or perhaps both reasons were true.'

Recalling the mysterious character he had previously seen within the You Clan bloodline, Li Fan fell into deep thought.

'For an Immortal to transform into a mortal requires far more than merely lowering one's cultivation.'

'It also involves the Transformation Between Immortal and Mortal.'

'That is a power even greater than Creation...'

His thoughts surged.

Within moments, Li Fan had roughly reconstructed what might have truly happened between the Immortal Realm and the Xuanhuang Realm.

Most of these conclusions came from the similarities he had instantly noticed between the first Great Celestial Venerable and Xing Wuque after their descent in cultivation. Yet the fact that these deductions perfectly matched the clues he had previously uncovered already spoke volumes.

'A fallen Immortal who has remained hidden all this time...'

'Yet in my previous life, even after the High Wall collapsed and the Star Sea fell into chaos, he still never appeared.'

'It seems that by this point in time, even that fallen Immortal no longer exists within the Darkest Star Sea.'

'Of course, that does not necessarily mean he has died. More likely, he has already stepped beyond the High Wall!'

Since the Darkest Star Sea remained Li Fan's primary sphere of activity and appeared relatively safe on the surface, he felt somewhat reassured.

'Since the You Clan are descendants of the first Great Celestial Venerable...'

'I wonder whether I could use the Reveal character seal script to awaken the connection within their bloodline and thereby trace that fallen Immortal?'

A dangerous idea suddenly appeared in Li Fan's mind.

But he quickly suppressed it.

'For now, there is no need to take such an unnecessary risk. Perhaps in the future, after I possess the strength to explore beyond the High Wall, I can consider it again.'

Piecing together countless fragments of evidence had allowed Li Fan to glimpse only the tip of the iceberg of the former Immortal Realm.

It made him even more curious about the Immortal Realm itself, while also causing him to become extremely wary of the already collected, yet still unassembled, Immortal Domain Fragments.

'If there truly were True Immortals who once regarded the lower realm as a refuge from disaster, then the dismantled and sealed Immortal Domain could very well be where they are hiding...'

Li Fan silently pondered, hesitating over whether he should activate the Immortal Domain Fragments left behind by Sun Piaomiao.

After thinking for a long while, he finally made up his mind and cast aside his hesitation.

'This mystery box must be opened sooner or later.'

'If it has to be opened eventually, then sooner is better than later.'

'Now that I have mastered the method of downgrading Immortal Formations and possess numerous Immortal Formations at my disposal, even if something unexpected occurs, I can still calmly activate [Truth].'

'Besides, there is also a place within the Star Sea that specifically suppresses Immortals...'

A sharp light flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

He summoned Liu Ruchen and the descendants of Sun Piaomiao from the Medicine King Sect, instructing them to bring every Immortal Domain Fragment.

Under the cover of the Wooden Sword phantom, he carried them all toward the center of the Star Sea.

The phantom solidified, manifesting a bright blue sky and the scenery of an ordinary world.

The disciples of the Medicine King Sect noticed nothing unusual about their surroundings.

Only Li Fan alone could see the endless sea of black mist not far away that inspired instinctive terror.

'It is spreading faster than I expected.'

'And around the outer edge of this sea of black mist...'

After observing for a while and comparing it with what he had previously witnessed, Li Fan frowned slightly.

He had seen signs of the approaching Dao Annihilation Calamity here more than once before. Back then, they had been separated by an immense distance. Only while directly looking at the black mist would he feel a sense of danger.

But now, even after turning his gaze away and refusing to look directly at the endless black mist, waves of inexplicable dread continued to rise within his heart.

The feeling of danger refused to dissipate. Even the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra could not eliminate it.

Instead, the longer he remained, the stronger the sensation became.

Suppressing every instinct urging him to flee, Li Fan carefully examined the exact nature of this feeling.

'It is as though a crumbling wall is about to collapse, a towering building is on the verge of falling, and I am standing directly beneath them...'

Faced with such overwhelming danger, Li Fan advanced instead of retreating.

The Wooden Sword phantom almost reached the edge of the endlessly churning sea of black mist.

"Begin."

Li Fan calmly instructed Liu Ruchen and the others within the Wooden Sword phantom.

Completely unaware of their true surroundings, the disciples of the Medicine King Sect merely stared blankly at the floating spheres of light before them.

Entwined by golden chains floated one seven-colored Go piece, one white Go piece, and six gray Go pieces.

"These are the Immortal Domain Fragments left behind by our Ancestor!"

As the ancient Immortal Realm secret left behind by Sun Piaomiao was finally about to be unveiled, everyone from the Medicine King Sect was filled with excitement. Under Li Fan's instructions, they began merging the Immortal Realm fragments.

With Liu Ruchen's World-Saving Longevity Scripture serving as the core through its Evergreen Longevity Power, they first fused together the six gray Go pieces that each of them had been sealing.

The process went astonishingly smoothly.

Just as when Li Fan had previously controlled the fusion himself, the six gray pieces merged into a single seven-colored Go piece that was one size larger.

Now, only two fused seven-colored Go pieces remained, along with the most crucial white Go piece, the one transformed from the Medicine King Cauldron.

The white Go piece seemed to be stimulated by the other two fused pieces. Seven-colored light continuously rippled around its edges.

Although it was slightly smaller than the seven-colored pieces, it instead appeared to be the true core.

The golden chains binding it trembled violently, as though they could break free at any moment.

Li Fan rapidly retreated while simultaneously releasing the seal.

The eyes of the Medicine King Sect cultivators burned with fanaticism as they controlled the two seven-colored Go pieces, escorting them toward the white Go piece.

In a single instant, the halo surrounding the white Go piece suddenly expanded outward.

It swallowed both seven-colored Go pieces whole.

Only a single Go piece remained in the field.

A faint, deep humming sound slowly emerged from within it.

Looking through layer upon layer of immortal formations, Li Fan carefully observed the newly born Go piece.

Strangely enough, although all the Go pieces had completed their fusion, the Immortal Realm that he had expected did not immediately manifest.

However, Li Fan was certain the fusion had succeeded.

Because he could clearly sense that the "weight" of the nearby Immortal Realm was continuously increasing.

The Wooden Sword phantom and the surrounding immortal formations had already reached the brink of collapse.

Under the pressure of the Immortal Realm, they could shatter at any moment.

Just as Li Fan was about to pour in more power, intending at the very least to maintain everything until the true Immortal Realm appeared.

A peculiar protective force radiated outward from the final white Go piece.

It directly enveloped both the Wooden Sword phantom and the immortal formations.

It was as though they had entered another layer of space, and the pressure exerted by the Immortal Realm naturally disappeared.

Li Fan himself, however, still remained outside the Immortal Realm.

Using the Wooden Sword phantom as his eyes, he continued observing the scene within the Immortal Realm.

Strictly speaking, the Wooden Sword phantom had not truly entered the Immortal Realm.

Rather, the Immortal Realm had simply erected a protective support for it.

The astonished members of the Medicine King Sect received the same treatment.

Like a crumpled sheet of paper gradually unfolding.

The light released by the Go piece representing the Immortal Realm became increasingly brilliant.

At one point, it even forced back the endless black mist that had nearly spread over.

Li Fan immediately retreated again, ensuring that none of the light shone upon him.

The radiance from the Immortal Realm did not continue endlessly through the Darkest Star Sea like ordinary light.

Instead, after expanding to cover a certain area, it simply stopped. From afar, it resembled an enormous sphere of light.

Floating at the edge of the sea of black mist.

The white light was so dazzling that it even blocked the perception of the Wooden Sword phantom Li Fan had placed within it.

Through the brilliance, Li Fan vaguely perceived countless blurry, shifting images.

They seemed like people, yet not people.

They seemed like scenery, yet not scenery.

Just as Li Fan waited for the Immortal Realm to fully reveal itself.

The sea of black mist, which had previously been driven back by the Immortal Realm's radiance, suddenly began to churn violently.

The black tide surged, and its expansion accelerated dramatically.

The rolling black mist arrived in an instant, reaching the edge of the sphere of Immortal Realm light.

The Immortal Realm, which was on the verge of manifesting, seemed to sense something incomparably terrifying.

Its radiance abruptly contracted.

From the enormous sphere of light, it shrank back into the white Go piece edged with seven-colored light.

Then, before the stunned eyes of the Medicine King Sect cultivators, it transformed into a streak of white light, pierced through the heavens, and fled at incredible speed.

The heavens they saw were naturally the Wooden Sword phantom and immortal formation barrier established by Li Fan.

A method capable of temporarily trapping even the Heavenly Doctor could not stop this streak of white light for even a moment.

Just as the Immortal Realm Go piece was about to disappear into the Star Sea, an enormous finger suddenly descended from above, tearing through space and firmly pressing down upon it.

It was Li Fan's Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger.

Perhaps it sensed the imposing aura carried by the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger.

Or perhaps the threat posed by the black mist had already disappeared.

In any case, after struggling only briefly, the white light stopped resisting.

It also withdrew every trace of its aura.

Quietly floating in midair.

"This reaction is far more intense than I expected."

"It was most likely the appearance of the black mist that triggered some kind of restriction."

"The expansion of the Immortal Realm has failed."

After observing for a moment, Li Fan immediately understood.

This temporary failure did not mean that the Immortal Realm Go piece had lost its usefulness.

It had merely entered a dormant state for the time being.

However, during the brief instant before the expansion failed, Li Fan had already glimpsed part of the Immortal Realm.

"I can now basically confirm that there are no living beings inside this Immortal Realm."

"The situation I feared, with a dormant True Immortal lurking within, will not occur."

"However, aside from the most fundamental Immortal Realm laws, the most obvious thing inside..."

Li Fan frowned deeply and raised his hand, unconsciously making a small gesture.

"Those drifting lights and shadows..."

"Could they be True Immortal seal script?"

Even Li Fan was not completely certain.

During the fleeting glimpse of the Immortal Realm, he had seen numerous black lines drifting about.

Having studied True Immortal seal script for so long, Li Fan recognized them immediately. Those lines were structural components that appeared within various True Immortal seal script characters.

"True Immortal seal script is essentially the manifestation of laws."

"And when manifested True Immortal seal script breaks apart and returns to becoming laws once again..."

"Is that the very process by which the Go piece unfolds into an Immortal Realm?"

Li Fan seemed to gain a new realization.

The Immortal Realm Go piece could essentially be regarded as the superimposition of countless True Immortal seal script characters.

At the same time, Li Fan's heart suddenly stirred.

A Go piece capable of constructing an entire Immortal Realm must contain an unimaginably vast number of True Immortal seal script characters.

"The True Immortal who created this Go piece back then was certainly no ordinary figure."

Chapter 1372: The Secret Of The Medicine King Stone Pill

"It is even highly likely that it was the Inscription Dao Immortal who personally took action!"

"After all, every True Immortal seal script character corresponds to a law of the Immortal Realm. To so effortlessly stack and fuse countless characters together..."

Li Fan's expression turned solemn as he summoned the Immortal Domain Go piece into his hand.

All of its sacred aura had vanished along with the interruption of its unfolding. The Go piece now seemed no different from an ordinary object as it lay quietly in Li Fan's palm.

He tried to activate it once more, but the Immortal Domain Go piece showed no response whatsoever to any external stimulus.

"As expected, it still requires the Medicine King Sect's Longevity Green Power."

"Furthermore, the unfolding of the Immortal Domain Go piece itself consumes a certain form of energy. Since the previous attempt failed midway, it will need time to accumulate power again."

Li Fan casually turned the smooth, icy Go piece over in his hand as he silently contemplated.

Far away, at the center of the Star Sea, the sea of black mist that had been stirred by the aura leaking from the Immortal Domain did not calm down after the unfolding was interrupted.

Instead, it was as though someone had pressed an acceleration switch. The endless black mist continued spreading outward irreversibly.

It looked as if it intended to swallow the entire Star Sea in one sweep.

Li Fan frowned tightly. After pondering for a moment, he used the Taijia Divine Art at that location.

Because it had been used so frequently on the Xuan Immortal Ark's side, the Star Sea's consciousness had already lost interest in responding to Li Fan's attempts at communication.

However, from the limited feedback he received...

The true intent of the Star Sea's origin had not noticed the overwhelming tide of black mist flooding the center of the Star Sea at all.

This blind indifference made Li Fan shudder inwardly.

It was as if countless black insects were devouring a person's body while the body's owner remained completely unaware.

Such a bizarre situation could only mean that the essence of the black mist far surpassed even the true intent of the Star Sea's origin.

The so called black mist Li Fan witnessed was absolutely not its true form. It was merely its outward appearance.

"'The precursor of the Dao Annihilation Calamity...'"

"'The time left for me is probably running short.'"

A trace of apprehension flashed through Li Fan's eyes. He brought the members of the Medicine King Sect, who were protected beneath the phantom projection of the Wooden Sword at the edge of the sea of black mist, and returned together to the Xuanhuang Realm.

"Senior, just now..." Medicine King Sect Master Liu Ruchen hesitated.

Throughout the entire process, the members of the Medicine King Sect had been enveloped within the illusion created by the Wooden Sword's phantom. They had no idea that, within such a short span of time, they had already traveled to the center of the Star Sea.

From their perspective, only an accident had occurred during the fusion of the Immortal Go pieces, after which the completed Go piece tore open the heavens and flew away.

Li Fan calmly replied, "There is no need to worry. I intercepted the Immortal Domain Go piece and recovered it."

Liu Ruchen immediately let out a sigh of relief.

Li Fan sighed softly.

"We were still too optimistic. The Immortal Domain Go piece left behind by Sun Piaomiao is not so easily brought back into the world. The backlash from the failed attempt nearly claimed all our lives. Fortunately, I barely managed to stop it."

Although Liu Ruchen and the others could not see the vast sea of black mist, they all instinctively sensed the overwhelming feeling of impending catastrophe.

They all nodded in agreement.

"Thank you, Senior, for saving us."

Li Fan waved his hand dismissively.

"It was merely a trivial effort. The important matter is how to successfully unfold the Immortal Domain Go piece. Back then, Sun Piaomiao must have secretly left behind some clues."

"It is only unfortunate that later generations failed to value them, causing the crucial information to be lost."

The members of the Medicine King Sect all lowered their heads in shame.

Ever since learning of their ancestor's astonishing achievements, they had continuously searched through everything related to Sun Piaomiao that had previously been overlooked.

They hoped to uncover some additional valuable clues.

However, too much time had passed. Aside from that travel journal, their founding ancestor survived only in oral teachings passed down through the generations. They had found nothing of real value.

"Senior, I believe that if there truly are hidden clues we have overlooked, then they should still remain within the Medicine King Sect itself," Liu Ruchen suddenly said.

"When we left back then, everything happened in great haste. To avoid attracting the attention of the Ten Great Sects, I only took away the important items from the sect. Everything else was left behind where it originally stood."

Liu Ruchen's suggestion immediately received the agreement of the other Medicine King Sect cultivators.

"The old site of the Medicine King Sect..." Li Fan pondered briefly before instantly transporting the Dao Integration cultivators of the Medicine King Sect to their destination.

On the desolate land lay piles of scattered stones, overgrown with wild grass. There was nothing to indicate that this had once been the site of the illustrious Medicine King Sect ten thousand years ago.

However, Li Fan had previously obtained the Medicine King Sect's exact location from Jiao Xiuyuan.

"This was the main hall... the Alchemy Workshop... Forging Mountain..."

After carefully identifying the remaining ruins, the members of the Medicine King Sect finally found traces of their former sect among the surviving structures. Their voices were filled with nostalgia and melancholy.

"Although there are no ancestor statues anywhere within the entire Medicine King Sect, I vaguely remember my master once mentioning a place within the sect that was connected to our founding ancestor..." Liu Ruchen frowned as he tried to recall his childhood memories.

Having once searched Liu Ruchen's soul, Li Fan immediately understood what he meant after a brief moment of thought.

"You mean the place where Sun Piaomiao used to refine medicine?"

"Yes, exactly!" Liu Ruchen suddenly remembered and nodded repeatedly.

"When I first refined medicine back then, I succeeded on my very first attempt and even produced a supreme-grade pill. I became extremely proud of myself. But my master scolded me, saying that when Ancestor Piaomiao successfully refined medicine in the past, heavenly phenomena descended, and the fragrance of the pills drifted for ten thousand li. Simply inhaling the fragrance for a single breath produced a faint medicinal effect comparable to consuming the pill itself. There were even legends that some pills developed spirits and awakened their own intelligence. Compared to the ancestor, the gap between us cannot be measured by distance. The moment I heard those words, all my arrogance instantly disappeared."

"The ancestor refined countless pills throughout his lifetime, yet not a single one was kept for himself. Every pill was distributed to those who needed it in the world. That was the true meaning of healing the world and bringing blessings to all living beings."

"However, the place where the ancestor spent years refining medicine was never occupied or reused by later generations after his disappearance, out of respect for him. This gradually became an unwritten rule. As time passed, the disciples no longer remembered why the rule existed. They only knew that it was a forbidden area of the sect."

As Liu Ruchen explained to everyone, he continued searching for the location.

"Ah, I found it. It's here."

His aura surged forth as he unearthed the ruins of a building that had long been buried beneath the earth.

Even after more than ten thousand years had passed, Li Fan could still vaguely make out what this structure had looked like in the past.

It was, astonishingly, nothing more than an enormous square stone.

"Our Ancestor was said to refine pills without the need for a pill furnace. Spiritual power served as the fire, and heaven and earth served as the furnace. However, whenever he refined pills, he liked to sit cross-legged atop this very stone."

"Over time, the stone became permanently infused with an enduring pill fragrance. Later, our Medicine King Sect built a structure around it to protect it."

"However, every generation of our ancestors examined it, and it truly was nothing more than an ordinary rock."

Liu Ruchen took a deep breath through his nose, his face lighting up with delight.

"Take a smell. Even after more than ten thousand years, you can still detect that faint fragrance."

Li Fan's divine sense enveloped the giant square stone as he inspected it with meticulous care.

He also caught the faint, almost imperceptible fragrance.

Yet unlike Sun Piaomiao's other relics, this stone was not some extraordinary object concealed by unfathomable means.

It was simply an utterly ordinary rock.

Of course, verifying this was very simple.

A strand of sword light appeared at his fingertip and struck the square boulder.

In an instant, the stone exploded into countless particles of dust.

Liu Ruchen, who had been speaking enthusiastically without pause, suddenly fell silent.

However, faced with Li Fan's expressionless face, he did not dare utter another word.

Li Fan watched as the powdered stone drifted through the air before settling onto the ground.

As always, he remained extremely cautious and carefully examined it once more. It truly was nothing but ordinary stone dust.

That faint fragrance also originated from the fragments themselves.

There was indeed no unusual reaction whatsoever.

"You guessed wrong. There is nothing special about this stone. Think of something else." Li Fan finally said calmly.

Liu Ruchen nodded awkwardly.

The other elders also revealed embarrassed expressions before once again searching through the ruins of the Medicine King Sect for other possible clues.

Except for one person.

Not only did this man's attention remain fixed on the countless drifting particles of stone dust despite Li Fan's conclusion, but the curiosity in his eyes only grew stronger.

"Senior..." he said.

Li Fan looked at him with interest, and the relevant information immediately surfaced in his mind.

Ruan Tianxiao, one of the Dao Integration cultivators of the Medicine King Sect.

Unlike the other elders, who specialized in refining medicinal pills from spiritual herbs, Ruan Tianxiao preferred using the body parts of animals, demon beasts, and even humans as pill ingredients.

Although the results were indeed extraordinary, the methods were steeped in bloodshed and slaughter, making them shocking and unacceptable to most people.

As a result, Ruan Tianxiao's "Flesh Pills" had never gained widespread acceptance.

"Speak freely," Li Fan encouraged.

"After our Ancestor's square stone shattered, it instead resembled a pill."

"While it remained in the form of a stone, it was still in the process of being refined. Only after the stone was crushed did the pill truly complete its refinement at that very instant..." Ruan Tianxiao said after carefully considering his words.

"Elder Ruan, how can you speak such nonsense before Senior?"

"Exactly. If your theory were true, why did the pill fragrance become weaker after the giant stone shattered?"

"Where is the pill?"

After observing for a while, the Dao Integration elders of the Medicine King Sect all voiced their objections.

Ruan Tianxiao did not argue. Instead, he smiled faintly.

"If we wish to verify whether these stone fragments are truly a pill..."

"We need only swallow them."

"Senior, I am willing to test the medicine with my own body."

The Medicine King Sect cultivators instantly fell silent.

Li Fan narrowed his eyes as he studied Ruan Tianxiao.

He raised his right hand, and an invisible whirlwind swept through the area.

All the stone powder gathered together.

It condensed into a single stone sphere.

Li Fan casually tossed it in his hand before performing one final inspection.

"It is still just stone."

"Are you certain this is a pill?"

Ruan Tianxiao stared fixedly at the stone pill in Li Fan's hand and nodded.

"I have tested medicines on my own body for many years. Over time, my body has developed an instinctive sensitivity toward beneficial pills."

"In my eyes, the fragrance of this stone pill surpasses every pill I have ever encountered by hundreds or even thousands of times."

Ruan Tianxiao spoke with absolute certainty.

Li Fan, however, fell into thought.

He suddenly recalled Mo Rubin, who was still standing before the Fishing Pond, trying every possible method yet never discovering its secret.

Without viewing it from the perspective of a fisherman, one could never perceive the Fishing Pond.

Likewise, without viewing it from the perspective of an alchemist, one could never discover the secret of this stone pill.

"Interesting."

Chapter 1373: The Dao Refining Medicine King Scripture

'To think it possesses concealment methods similar to the Fishing Pond. Sun Piaomiao's strength and foundation may be even greater than I imagined.'

As Li Fan silently pondered this, the stone pill in his hand suddenly underwent a transformation.

Formations and alchemy shared the same origin.

Li Fan's attainment in the Dao of formations had already reached the absolute peak, even touching the realm of the Immortal. Through drawing inferences from one field to another, although he had never formally studied the Dao of alchemy, he still far surpassed ordinary alchemists of the world.

Moreover, medicine and alchemy were inseparable. Li Fan had also inherited the true teachings of the Heavenly Doctor.

With Ruan Tianxiao's reminder, Li Fan seemed to transform into an alchemist.

Heaven and earth became the pill furnace. The round stone in his hand truly transformed into a crystal clear medicinal pill.

In an instant, the faint medicinal fragrance multiplied thousands of times over.

His mouth involuntarily filled with saliva. Li Fan swallowed instinctively as the thought of immediately consuming the pill arose in his mind.

'It seems this stone pill truly is a gift Sun Piaomiao left for future generations...'

The thought flashed through Li Fan's mind.

Yet instead of consuming it, he tossed the pill to Ruan Tianxiao.

"Then you should try this medicine."

His tone was calm, as though he had not been tempted by the stone pill at all.

Ruan Tianxiao trembled uncontrollably with excitement. Afraid Li Fan might change his mind, he immediately swallowed the stone pill.

The members of the Medicine King Sect had gradually recovered their senses. Regret immediately filled their eyes.

After swallowing the stone pill, however, Ruan Tianxiao's bearing and temperament changed instantly, as though he had become a completely different person.

Standing with his hands behind his back, his indifferent gaze swept across everyone present. His face was filled with remembrance and nostalgia.

Though he clearly stood before them, it felt as if he existed in a different time and space altogether.

Detached from the mortal world, he resembled an immortal banished from the heavens.

Such an obvious transformation naturally did not escape Li Fan and the others.

However, the guess forming in their hearts was simply too unbelievable. None of them dared voice it aloud.

"Sun. Piaomiao."

It was Li Fan who slowly uttered those three words.

At the same time, the phantom of the Wooden Sword had already been prepared in secret, ready to flee at a moment's notice.

Ruan Tianxiao, whose very essence had been transformed by the stone pill, as though possessed by the Medicine King Sect's founding ancestor Sun Piaomiao, remained silent in remembrance for a brief moment before sitting cross-legged in midair.

Then he began to preach.

"Alchemy is the transformation of the Great Dao of heaven and earth. Medicine is that which heals the afflictions of all living beings. The Great Dao is formless. It stands alone and never changes. It circulates endlessly without exhaustion. Through alchemy it is united. Through medicine it is manifested. Heaven and earth themselves are but a single pill formula."

Just the opening sentence completely captivated everyone present.

Including Li Fan.

His vigilance did not lessen in the slightest. Frowning, Li Fan engraved every word Sun Piaomiao spoke firmly into his memory.

"The Dao also has birth. The Dao also has death. The Dao is born, the Dao dies. The Dao manifests, the Dao fades. Just as a pill is born. Just as a pill is completed."

"The instant a pill is completed, it appears to be born, yet in truth it has died. It becomes the shadow of the Great Dao. It becomes the corpse of the Great Dao."

...

Ruan Tianxiao spoke at an unhurried pace.

Before him, the phantom of a pill furnace appeared.

Within the furnace, suns rose and moons set. Seas of stars drifted and sank.

All living things experienced life and death.

Heaven and earth themselves came into being and perished.

As the radiance continuously dimmed and reignited, the cycles accelerated faster and faster.

Until everything finally converged into a single point.

It seemed to be utter darkness born of extinction.

Yet it also seemed incomparably brilliant.

Or perhaps it possessed both qualities simultaneously.

"Life and death are one."

"United with the Dao, one attains truth."

"Beyond all worldly things."

"My pill is complete."

As those final words fell, the phantom pill furnace shattered apart.

A scorching storm swept outward.

Though it was merely light and shadow, it blew Li Fan's hair and robes into the air.

Everyone present witnessed within it the birth and destruction of the sea of stars and the Great Dao itself.

Like magnificent fireworks, they vanished in an instant.

The ethereal and transcendent aura surrounding Ruan Tianxiao also faded away together with the disappearing light.

"Ugh..."

Ruan Tianxiao awoke as if from a dream and let out a painful groan.

Clutching his forehead, he seemed to be enduring unbearable agony.

Blood poured from all seven of his facial orifices.

Li Fan also observed that Ruan Tianxiao's soul appeared to have been violently stuffed and ravaged by something.

It was covered in countless cracks.

Fortunately, the mysterious energy absorbed from the stone pill was nourishing and repairing it.

Otherwise, with only Dao Integration cultivation, Ruan Tianxiao's soul would have long since been completely destroyed.

Seeing this, the members of the Medicine King Sect immediately stepped forward to treat him.

Li Fan's thoughts, however, remained fixed upon the profound scripture that Sun Piaomiao had just expounded through Ruan Tianxiao's body.

"Life and death are one. United with the Dao, one attains truth. Beyond all worldly things. My pill is complete."

Li Fan continuously repeated the final sentence.

An emotion that rarely appeared within him surged forth.

Excitement.

"Marvelous. Truly beyond words."

"This scripture of Sun Piaomiao far surpasses even the Heavenly Doctor's teachings."

"This..."

Li Fan frowned.

Just as he was about to give this scripture a name, a phrase naturally emerged within his mind.

It was as though every living being who heard these words would instinctively arrive at the same answer.

The Dao Refining Medicine King Scripture.

Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

As he carefully savored those five words, his expression became incomparably solemn.

"This Dao Refining Medicine King Scripture is clearly Sun Piaomiao's true fundamental inheritance."

"Compared to it, that so-called World-Saving Longevity Scripture is little more than a child's primer. Crude beyond compare."

"It is not merely a cultivation technique, but a philosophy that points directly toward the source of the Great Dao."

"Just like the Mending Heaven Record, although it contains no specific cultivation methods whatsoever, anyone with sufficient comprehension can derive techniques and divine abilities perfectly suited to themselves."

Given Li Fan's current experience and accumulated knowledge, inspiration continued pouring into his mind endlessly as he contemplated the Dao Refining Medicine King Scripture.

The profundity and brilliance of this scripture were evident.

It was as though a storm of thought had erupted within his mind.

Only after three days and three nights did the storm gradually subside.

Even then, sparks of inspiration still flashed from time to time.

Li Fan carefully recorded every idea that had arisen.

Only then did he have the leisure to review everything that had just occurred.

Countless questions inevitably emerged in his mind.

'Is Sun Piaomiao still alive?'

Ruan Tianxiao's possession had seemed to originate from the inheritance Sun Piaomiao left behind within the stone pill countless ages ago.

Yet for some reason, Li Fan could not shake the feeling that, in that brief instant, Sun Piaomiao had truly descended from some unknowable distant place by borrowing Ruan Tianxiao's body.

'Throughout the Dao Refining Medicine King Scripture, there is not a single mention of Immortal Ascension.'

'Yet it still describes a level of power beyond the mortal world.'

'I would rather believe this is a newly created scripture, composed by the present-day Sun Piaomiao after ten thousand years of accumulation, than believe he had already comprehended it back then...'

While Li Fan remained lost in thought, the members of the Medicine King Sect, who were helping Ruan Tianxiao recover, enthusiastically discussed the Dao Refining Medicine King Scripture among themselves.

"Refining the Dao. Refining heaven and earth just as one refines a pill. My previous understanding of the Dao of alchemy was simply too shallow."

"Who could have imagined that the true inheritance of our Medicine King Sect was so extraordinary? Yet we allowed it to remain buried for ten thousand years. What a sin. Truly a great sin."

...

The discussion grew increasingly lively.

Liu Ruchen quietly approached Li Fan.

"Senior, I think I understand why deploying the Immortal Domain Go piece failed before."

"If that process is compared to alchemy, then it was like controlling the pill flame too fiercely. Too hurried. Too impatient. It should instead be nurtured over a gentle flame and refined gradually."

Having gained new insight, Liu Ruchen spoke with complete confidence.

Li Fan did not expose him and merely nodded slightly.

"There is no need to rush."

"The Dao Refining Medicine King Scripture that Sun Piaomiao left behind is vast and profound. Even I have benefited greatly from it."

"You should all take this opportunity to comprehend and digest it properly."

Liu Ruchen cupped his fists in salute before returning to discuss the Medicine King Scripture with the other elders.

Before leaving, Liu Ruchen hesitated, then quietly asked, "Senior, is Ancestor Piaomiao... still alive?"

It seemed that Li Fan had not been the only one who had sensed something strange earlier.

Li Fan did not answer directly. Instead, he merely gave Liu Ruchen a meaningful smile.

Afterward, the members of the Medicine King Sect exchanged their insights while digging through every inch of the sect's former grounds.

They hoped to find other relics left behind by Sun Piaomiao.

Unfortunately, that stone pill appeared to be Sun Piaomiao's only legacy.

After ultimately finding nothing else, Li Fan led the Dao Integration elders of the Medicine King Sect back to the Great Qi Small World.

Some entered secluded cultivation, while others immediately began refining pills.

All of them were eager to transform their newfound insights into tangible gains.

"Alchemy Dao..."

Those few Dao Integration elders had all gained so much. There was no need to mention Li Fan.

He gazed toward the Xuanhuang Realm. The inspiration he had previously suppressed and carefully recorded now erupted all at once.

"The process I originally planned in this life, elevating the Xuanhuang Realm into a immortal realm, can, in a certain sense, also be regarded as pill refinement."

"It likewise requires adding materials, tempering them with external forces, and finally completing the pill."

A brilliant light flashed through Li Fan's eyes as an unprecedented understanding surged through his mind like a rising tide.

"It is just that my original choice was to achieve Dao Integration with the Spirit of Heaven and Earth of the Xuanhuang Immortal Domain after it was complete. That would be like buying the jewel case while throwing away the pearl."

"Discarding the most precious immortal pill after it has been successfully refined instead of consuming it."

"And merely licking the pill patterns on its surface while swallowing only the scraps..."

Li Fan fell silent.

As this thought arose, an overwhelming ambition emerged within him.

He wanted to swallow the future Xuanhuang Immortal Domain whole as though it were a single immortal pill.

Once that desire appeared, it became impossible to suppress.

His heart filled with excitement, urging him to act immediately.

Li Fan instantly became alert.

Closing his eyes, he forcefully suppressed the restless impulse within.

"The line of thought itself is correct."

"The unfortunate part is..."

"Not just anyone possesses the ability to consume the Xuanhuang Immortal Pill."

"Even if I used every trump card I possess now, I still could not accomplish it."

Li Fan was not blinded by the enormous temptation.

He still had a clear understanding of his own strength.

"Even if I swallowed the immortal pill, I would only fail to digest it and ultimately explode to my death."

"Hmph. How could I possibly be so foolish?"

The contents of the Dao Refining Medicine King Scripture once again flowed through Li Fan's mind.

"Sun Piaomiao deserves to be counted among the greatest alchemists in the world."

"But even his limit was merely refining pills within a single lifetime."

"As for me..."

The words of the Medicine King Scripture instantly transformed into countless stars that swirled around Li Fan before being absorbed into him.

"With the aid of [Truth], I can refine the same pill across a second life, a third life, and beyond."

"From that perspective, I possess an advantage that no one else in the world can possibly match."

"I was born to stand at the very pinnacle of alchemy."

His gaze once again settled upon the Xuanhuang Realm as countless thoughts raced through his mind.

"Even if I am destined to be unable to directly consume the Xuanhuang Immortal Pill in this life..."

"I can still use the methods of alchemy to make the process of elevating the Xuanhuang Realm far smoother and more harmonious. The methods I originally planned would certainly work, but now they seem far too crude."

"And..."

"The experience accumulated in this life can be applied to the next life, and even the lives after that."

"Alchemists throughout the world exhaust themselves to refine a single furnace of perfect pills. Once refinement begins, there is no turning back. There are only two possible outcomes. Success or failure."

"But I..."

"I can continue refining the same furnace of pills over and over until it reaches the theoretical limit of perfection."

Within Li Fan's vision, an enormous purple-gold pill furnace suddenly appeared, vast enough to envelop heaven and earth.

The immense Xuanhuang world, along with every living being within it, all resided inside that purple-gold furnace, slowly refining into a single pill.

"Now all that remains is to decide when to light the fire."

Sensing that the number of living beings covered by the Equal Heaven Ritual within the Small World had already reached the requirement of the Xuan Immortal Ark, Li Fan shot toward the edge of the star sea like a bolt of lightning.

Not long afterward, he returned to the vicinity of the Xuan Immortal Ark, deliberately releasing his own aura.

"Hm? The aura around you..."

"It seems you've gained new insights again?"

Perhaps because they had all participated together in the Equal Heaven Ritual, Zhong Daogong and the other elders of the Immortal Ark immediately noticed the subtle changes in Li Fan.

Unlike before, Li Fan no longer revealed everything without reservation.

He merely smiled.

"The required number of living beings for the Equal Heaven Ritual has already been reached. It can be activated at any time."

"When shall we draw upon the power of the Star Sea?"

"I've waited long enough. I'm already becoming impatient."

Without requesting permission to board the Immortal Ark, Li Fan spoke directly.

After a brief silence, the elders gave their answer.

"We... still need to make a few preparations."

"Seven days from now. Right here outside the Immortal Ark."

"Fellow Daoist, why not come inside and rest for the time being?"

Li Fan shook his head and politely declined.

"No need. I'll wait here."

"Recently, while communicating with the Star Sea, I've gained some new insights. Remaining inside the Immortal Ark would instead be inconvenient."

The elders did not insist.

For a time, an unusual silence settled over the surroundings.

Meanwhile, Li Fan stood motionless within the starry sky with his eyes closed.

As though he were genuinely contemplating something profound.

Seven days later, the elders emerged one after another.

After nodding toward Li Fan, they began arranging the ritual within the void outside the Immortal Ark.

One white paper banner after another was planted according to an extraordinarily intricate sequence.

Li Fan saw clearly that each banner was inscribed with an overlay of more than ten different True Immortal seal script characters.

Every one of those True Immortal seal script characters was familiar to him.

Yet when they were combined and layered together in this manner, they seemed to acquire an entirely different meaning.

"Hm?"

Li Fan's heart stirred as he suddenly recalled the Immortal Domain Go piece that remained sealed within the Great Xuan.

It likewise consisted of overlapping True Immortal seal script characters.

However, the arrangement upon the Immortal Ark's banners was vastly more primitive.

"But it should still be sufficient to support the ritual."

In Li Fan's eyes, those banners resembled sharp needles.

Standing proudly within the void, they pierced deeply into the Star Sea.

"Alas!"

Once the ritual had been fully arranged, all the elders returned to their designated positions.

Zhong Daogong, standing at the forefront, flew into the center of the ritual.

He raised his head toward the heavens and let out a loud shout.
