Chapter 1374: The Equal Heaven Star Spirit

"As the body transforms into the universe, the mind roams the Star Sea. Taijia without Limit, the spirit wanders. Taijia without Change, the spirit transforms. Taijia without Emptiness, the spirit becomes spirit..."

The opening chant led by Zhong Daogong was none other than the Taijia Divine Art that Yin Shangren had obtained from the black and white twin orbs and that Li Fan had later passed on to the Immortal Ark.

However, what had once been only an incomplete fragment had now, after extensive research by the Immortal Ark's Council of Elders, finally been restored into a complete technique.

Combined with the power of the True Immortal seal script and amplified through ritual, its might had increased by far more than hundreds or even thousands of times.

Zhong Daogong led the chant, while the Immortal Ark elders gradually joined in harmony.

It was like a majestic symphony echoing throughout the Star Sea.

One after another, banners engraved with fused True Immortal seal script characters fluttered through the air. Viewed from above, one could clearly see that as the rhythm of the chant changed, certain characters upon the banners lit up in response, flashing brightly.

It was as though a colossal being composed of countless characters was breathing.

Watching this scene from outside the ritual, Li Fan suddenly understood the strange feeling he had sensed earlier.

A single [Equal] character lay hidden among the overlapping fused True Immortal seal script characters present at the ritual, concealed without revealing itself.

It merely waited...

For the Star Sea consciousness to be forcibly connected and descend.

Then it would erupt in an instant.

The Equal Heaven Ritual that the Xuan Immortal Ark had prepared for so long was, when stripped to its essence, surprisingly simple and crude.

Yet accomplishing it was far more difficult than it appeared.

The very first step alone, forcibly establishing communication with the Star Sea consciousness, had already exceeded the capabilities of the Taijia Divine Art itself. Li Fan had previously used this divine art before. Relying upon the goodwill accumulated over ten thousand years by the already destroyed Taijia World, he had obtained a single promise from the Star Sea consciousness to assist in the ascension and revival of the Xuanhuang Realm.

After that, the Star Sea had never responded again.

But now, after being improved by the Immortal Ark elders, the Taijia Divine Art had directly opened a bridge between cultivators and the Star Sea, forcibly drawing the true intent of the Star Sea's origin to cast its gaze upon this place.

The chanting grew increasingly magnificent.

Li Fan vaguely sensed an enormous vortex gradually forming above the ritual.

Unlike the utterly lifeless Darkest Star Sea, this vortex shimmered with countless lights and boundless vitality. Within it echoed indistinct rumbling and incomprehensible murmurs.

The surrounding Star Sea space itself seemed to creak under unbearable strain.

Corresponding changes also erupted within Li Fan's own body.

It was exactly the same reaction as when he had previously witnessed the True Immortal figure through that Immortal Realm bronze coin. His spiritual power, physical body, and divine soul all began boiling violently, as though they would evaporate at any moment.

'The difference is that when I faced the True Immortal's phantom before, I had virtually no ability to resist. But now...'

Li Fan took a deep breath and forcibly suppressed the abnormalities within himself.

'The Star Sea's pressure is powerful, but it ultimately cannot compare to a True Immortal.'

'No matter how vast and magnificent it is, it still falls short of the qualitative leap brought by elevated ascension.'

As countless thoughts flashed through his mind, Zhong Daogong's voice suddenly rang beside his ear.

"Fellow Daoist, why have you not entered the ritual yet?"

"You have contributed immensely to the success of the Equal Heaven Ritual. Now is precisely the time to harvest its fruits."

It was not only Zhong Daogong's voice.

Jian Daosheng, Nangong Lie, and every elder of the Immortal Ark all spoke simultaneously.

Their voices sounded both like an invitation and a coercion.

'Have all the elders left the Ark, leaving it internally vulnerable? They cannot afford to leave an unpredictable variable like me outside the ritual.'

Li Fan let out a silent cold snort.

"Then I shall gladly accept."

Completely fearless, he flew directly into the ritual.

He did not need to search for a suitable position.

The instant he entered, countless surrounding banners began rotating and shifting positions, naturally drawing him into the formation.

The chanting echoing from every direction even compelled him to unconsciously join in harmony.

Now that everyone had taken their positions, this long prepared Taijia Ritual finally reached its climax.

Within the vortex filled with scattered violet-gold radiance, the previously roaring winds and thunder suddenly fell completely silent.

Even the vortex itself became absolutely motionless.

The scenery before everyone participating in the ritual abruptly changed.

It was as if they had suddenly leaped beyond the Star Sea itself, allowing them to behold the Star Sea in its entirety.

If the previous Taijia Divine Art had merely communicated indirectly with the Star Sea like sending a message, then now they had forcibly pried open the gate separating humanity and the Star Sea itself.

Their gazes met directly.

Li Fan once again experienced the long forgotten sensation of being completely seen through.

Although he possessed absolute confidence that the [Truth] supreme treasure within him could never be detected by the consciousness of a mere Star Sea, Li Fan remained on the highest alert.

He had already summoned the [Truth] interface, ready to activate it at any moment.

Just as he had expected, the Star Sea consciousness was completely blind even to the black mist that represented the precursor of the Dao Annihilation Calamity.

Naturally, it was even less capable of discovering [Truth].

The Star Sea consciousness did not linger upon Li Fan in particular.

Instead, it evenly distributed its anger among every Immortal Ark elder participating in the ritual.

After all, being forcibly contacted by creatures no different from ants was nothing less than an outright humiliation to the Star Sea consciousness.

Now it merely waited to see what these ants wished to accomplish.

Only afterward would it unleash its thunderous wrath.

However...

The ants had never truly intended to communicate.

Countless banners fluttered without wind amidst the resounding chorus.

As each banner continuously unfurled, the portions revealed through their folds instantly combined into one complete whole.

The [Equal] character that had remained hidden beneath countless True Immortal seal script characters finally revealed its true form.

It was as though an invisible chain had suddenly linked the vast Star Sea consciousness above the vortex to the tiny ants gathered within the ritual below.

At this moment, the ants stood upon the shoulders of the Star Sea itself and gazed down upon all living beings.

Li Fan had once become one with the Canghai Pearl, had once become the Heavenly Dao of a small world, and had even connected his consciousness with the Xuanhuang Realm itself.

Yet none of those experiences could compare to the indescribable wonder of this moment.

The boundless Star Sea no longer seemed infinite.

Instead, it felt like an extension of his own body, entirely within sight.

The Star Sea was no longer dark and lifeless.

With every breath, he could sense the limitless vitality quietly accumulating beneath its tranquil surface.

Even the countless laws that composed the Star Sea no longer seemed incomprehensible.

They were like the hairs and pores upon one's own body.

One needed only lower one's gaze to observe them completely.

Wherever his thoughts reached, he could use the Star Sea's own eyes to observe every corner of the Star Sea.

At this moment, through the power of the [Equal] character, everyone participating in the ritual had truly become equal to the Star Sea itself.

They saw what the Star Sea saw.

They felt what the Star Sea felt.

Like every other Immortal Ark elder, Li Fan became deeply immersed in this extraordinary state. He deliberately looked toward the center of the Star Sea.

Sure enough, from the Star Sea's own perspective, there was no trace whatsoever of the black mist within the Central Star Region.

Instead, limitless vitality slumbered there, awaiting revival.

Everything appeared perfectly prosperous.

Naturally, Li Fan had no intention of reminding anyone.

While seizing this once in ten thousand years opportunity to comprehend the Dao of the Star Sea as deeply as possible, he also found himself somewhat curious about the Star Sea's attitude.

Logically speaking, after being ambushed by mere ants through the power of the [Equal] character, the true origin consciousness of the Star Sea should have been utterly enraged.

Even if it could not break free from the influence of the [Equal] character immediately, it should at least have struggled symbolically.

Yet now, the Star Sea was calm in a way that was almost frightening.

This was not the calm before a storm, gathering strength. It was genuine calm, with not the slightest trace of anger arising.

Why was that?

A sudden doubt surfaced in Li Fan's mind.

Under the influence of the True Immortal seal script, the consciousness of the Star Sea was now connected with everyone participating in the Equal Heaven Ritual.

Thus, without much effort, Li Fan followed the Star Sea's thoughts and caught a glimpse of what it was thinking.

'This is...'

'While we are observing the Star Sea, the Star Sea is also observing us?!'

Li Fan was instantly horrified.

In Li Fan's previous understanding, transcendent existences such as the Star Sea Origin and True Immortals would never pay attention to insignificant mortals.

Yet the behavior of the Darkest Star Sea had completely overturned his understanding.

Not only did the Star Sea show no resistance toward the ants attempting the Equal Heaven Ritual.

It even accepted them willingly.

Just as Li Fan and the others were immersed in the Star Sea's perspective.

The consciousness of the Star Sea also seemed to be extremely interested in the lives of these tiny beings.

Both sides remained in a subtle balance, each experiencing the other's existence.

However, because of the vast disparity between them, this balance was destined not to last long.

The Star Sea itself remained unharmed.

But drastic changes suddenly erupted among the cultivators participating in the ritual.

Li Fan had once transformed himself into the Canghai Pearl and observed the changes of the Congyun Sea. Compared to mountains and seas, a cultivator's lifetime was like the brief blooming of an epiphyllum. Compared to this endless starry sky, even the birth and destruction of worlds lasted only an instant.

Viewing all things from the perspective of the Star Sea naturally meant enduring the passage of time on the scale of the starry sky.

Even sacrificing billions of living beings from the Xuanhuang small world merely delayed it for a few brief moments.

Very soon, old age once again descended upon everyone aboard the Immortal Ark.

"Hold on. The power gained from equalizing with the Star Sea is already pouring into our bodies. As long as we absorb this power, we will no longer fear this level of aging!" Zhong Daogong transmitted his voice to remind everyone.

However, just like Li Fan, they had never expected that the Star Sea itself would become interested in this group of rebels.

It was no longer just them actively reaching the consciousness of the Star Sea Origin.

The Star Sea itself was also actively reaching toward them. Originally, the plan had been for the Star Sea to resist while they advanced deeper.

But now, both sides had each taken a step forward.

As a result, the erosion they suffered from the Star Sea became almost twice as severe as originally estimated.

"This is bad!"

The members of the Immortal Ark quickly realized the unexpected change. Looking at the ritual participants whose hair and bodies were rapidly turning white, expressions of fear appeared on their faces.

However, the elders were all resolute and decisive individuals. Once they understood the situation, after only a brief exchange, they reached a unanimous decision.

"At this point, the Equal Heaven Ritual absolutely cannot stop. Abandoning it halfway would result in even greater losses."

"We must sacrifice a portion of our people to buy more time until the Star Sea's power enters our bodies."

After a brief silence, someone suddenly let out a low laugh.

"This old man has already lived long enough. Living another ten or twenty years would only be a waste. If my death can help the Immortal Ark obtain the Star Sea's fortune, then I, Gan Jingda, shall die without regrets!"

Before anyone else could respond, Gan Jingda's life aura had already completely vanished.

The remaining participants in the ritual immediately felt a surge of life force appear within their bodies out of nowhere.

"My old friend has passed on. Remaining in this world would only bring me more sorrow. Better to leave. Better to leave. The future of the Immortal Ark is yours now!"

"My abilities are lacking. I should be the one to die first!"

"Everyone, you must succeed. I am going ahead!"

"I originally did not want to die. But after calculating it over and over, everyone left is more valuable than I am. There is no helping it. My luck has never been very good throughout my life."

...

One after another, figures within the ritual voluntarily abandoned their life force.

Accelerated by the power of time, they crumbled into dust and scattered with the wind.

The final words of the Immortal Ark elders echoed continuously through everyone's ears.

Feeling the life force from their companions surging within them like fresh bamboo shoots after spring rain, every survivor was overcome with grief and sorrow.

Yet thanks to their sacrifices, just before the side effects of becoming equal to the Star Sea completely consumed them, the tremendous power obtained from the Equal Star Sea finally descended.

Within the violet-gold vortex of starlight, dozens of torrents suddenly branched off.

Each poured into the body of a cultivator still persevering in the ritual.

This was the true Origin Power of the Star Sea.

In terms of quality, it might not surpass a True Immortal.

But in terms of quantity alone, it was even greater than that of a True Immortal.

The feeling was completely different from facing a True Immortal.

The boundless Origin of the Star Sea poured down like a vast flood.

As this supreme power washed over them, the bodies of the surviving Immortal Ark elders gradually dissolved.

Yet their vitality did not disappear because of it.

Instead, it became even more vigorous.

They no longer aged.

Their appearances remained frozen at the final instant before the infusion began.

Only the violet-gold radiance surrounding them obscured their features.

The Star Sea's power continued flowing into them without end.

Their bodies of light also grew larger without stop.

Gradually, they became giants standing across the Star Sea itself.

The sorrow from their companions' sacrifices, the excitement of obtaining this power, and every other emotion they once possessed gradually faded away.

...

Li Fan witnessed the birth of this extraordinary race from beginning to end.

As cautious as ever, Li Fan naturally did not directly absorb the Star Sea Origin Power descending from above like the Immortal Ark elders had done.

Instead, he isolated and preserved it with an immortal formation.

Then he concealed and sealed it with the Transformation of Truth and Falsehood, making it disappear within the Star Sea itself. Even the consciousness of the Star Sea could no longer detect it.

Another ingredient had been added for refining the Xuanhuang Pill.

Yet Li Fan felt little joy.

Instead, he watched the starlight figures appearing before him one after another with an extremely solemn expression.

Once they had completely transformed into bodies of starlight, they automatically disconnected from the link created by the Equal Character Art.

At this moment, Li Fan was the only participant remaining in the entire ritual.

'There is no way to communicate with them.'

'Even their subjective consciousness from before seems to have disappeared? No. It is still there. It is simply that the emotional fluctuations belonging to humans have been suppressed to the extreme. They have become more like the Star Sea itself.'

'They are remarkably similar to the Spirit of Heaven and Earth of the Xuanhuang Realm...'

Li Fan then looked toward the violet-gold vortex that was gradually closing.

He vaguely sensed that the Star Sea's own power had not diminished at all despite being equally shared through the ritual.

'It is not that the Equal character art has failed.'

'Rather...'

'No matter how you divide infinity equally, it is still infinity!'

Chapter 1375: A First Glimpse Beyond The High Wall

"So that is why the Star Sea's consciousness showed so little reaction to the Xuan Immortal Ark's rebellious actions, and even willingly accepted them..."

"Besides the fact that the perspective of mortals is something fresh that the Star Sea is interested in observing, the more important reason is that the Equal Heaven Ritual simply cannot have any effect on the Star Sea itself."

"True infinity!"

As long as something was not infinite, no matter how vast its quantity, even if it were divided among only a single person, the result would still be greatly reduced compared to the original amount. It could never remain completely unaffected by its own loss the way the Star Sea's consciousness had just done.

'How can this be?'

Li Fan was filled with astonishment and disbelief.

The very concept of infinity had completely surpassed the limits of his understanding.

Although the Darkest Star Sea was vast beyond measure, Li Fan could now cross it with ease. That concerned its scale.

The Star Sea had been ravaged by the power of the True Immortal seal script, its order destroyed and its vitality concealed. That concerned its nature.

Whether judged by scale or by nature, nothing about this Star Sea seemed remotely connected to the concept of infinity.

Yet as the ritual ended and the violet-gold vortex closed, the eighteen surviving Elders of the Xuan Immortal Ark transformed into eighteen radiant giants stretching across the starry sky. Feeling the boundless, majestic power emanating from them, a power that was almost identical to the Star Sea itself, Li Fan could not help but believe in the Star Sea's infinite power.

In that instant, he recalled the secret of the Immortal Realm that Mo Rubin had once heard from the Xuantian King.

"It is said that the Immortal Realm is a wondrous sacred land with inexhaustible resources."

Like a clap of thunder, those words echoed continuously through Li Fan's mind.

Previously, Li Fan had believed that the Xuantian King had exaggerated and embellished the truth.

But now, it seemed very likely that everything the Xuantian King had said was true.

If even the Star Sea could be infinite, then how much more so the Immortal Realm standing above it?

Once this fact was accepted, the next question became why.

Setting aside the Immortal Realm for now.

How exactly was this Darkest Star Sea connected to infinity?

The violet-gold vortex closed completely.

Facing the eighteen starlight giants, Li Fan's thoughts raced.

"The High Wall merely seals the living beings within the Star Sea. It does not completely separate the Star Sea itself."

"The Darkest Star Sea inside the High Wall and the Star Sea outside the High Wall are still one unified whole. It is only that the sealed region has now developed a relatively independent consciousness."

"That is one possibility."

"But... if that is truly the case..."

Li Fan gazed at the starlight giants before him, assessing their strength.

Perhaps because they had only just been born, they stood silently in the void, seemingly contemplating what they should do next.

The aura surrounding them gradually became more restrained.

Their indistinct silhouettes steadily grew clearer.

Faces that Li Fan knew all too well quietly emerged.

Their brilliant starlight bodies gradually dimmed.

Eventually, they became translucent and pale blue.

Within their transparent forms, one could vaguely see skeletal structures and meridians woven from countless stars and worlds.

"These starlight giants are to the Star Sea what the Spirits of Heaven and Earth are to the Xuanhuang Realm."

"They have lost the characteristics of cultivators, retaining only a trace of subjective consciousness while becoming completely assimilated by the Star Sea."

"Perhaps they should be called Star Spirits."

Li Fan quietly deployed an immortal formation around himself, concealing his presence as he secretly observed these unusual lifeforms.

"Within the Xuanhuang Realm, the Spirits of Heaven and Earth vary in strength according to their heavenly duties. Most range somewhere between Soul Transformation and Longevity Immortal."

"But these Star Spirits..."

"Simply by wielding the infinite power of the Star Sea, they are sufficient to overwhelm every cultivator beneath the True Immortal Realm. The limit of the Star Sea is the Star Sea itself. They may be called Supreme!" Li Fan recalled the Heavenly Doctor's memories that he had glimpsed within the illusion formation.

Although he regarded these Star Spirits as belonging to the same Supreme Realm as the Heavenly Doctor, Li Fan did not believe they could fight the Heavenly Doctor on equal footing.

"If they truly fought, forget the Heavenly Doctor. Even I have countless methods to deal with them."

"But victory and defeat are completely meaningless."

"The Star Sea is infinite. That means these Star Spirits cannot be killed by ordinary means."

"Even the True Immortal seal script that brought calamity upon this Star Sea merely caused its vitality to wither temporarily. On the Star Sea's own timescale, tens of thousands of years amount to only a fleeting moment. Its vitality will eventually be fully restored."

"Perhaps only the Dao Annihilation Calamity that destroyed the Immortal Realm..."

Li Fan once again thought of the countless strange phenomena that had frequently appeared throughout the Star Sea during ancient times.

"One is all. If the Star Sea's power truly is infinite, then every Star Spirit and every Star Sea phenomenon unleashed at full strength can be regarded as the Star Sea itself."

"Countless Supreme Realm existences. No wonder cultivators throughout history have speculated that even True Immortals would avoid those terrifying phenomena."

True Immortals were extraordinary beings beyond the mundane.

But if infinitely many Heavenly Doctors surrounded and attacked a True Immortal, they might well succeed in severely injuring or even capturing one.

In a single instant, countless thoughts flashed through Li Fan's mind.

While he was thinking, the eighteen Star Spirits finally began to move.

Some turned toward the nearby concealed Xuan Immortal Ark.

Others looked toward the High Wall at the edge of the Star Sea.

The rest slowly swept their gazes across the entire Star Sea.

"If the Star Sea's consciousness previously required cultivators to restore itself, then now it can repair itself through these Star Spirits."

"Although the Star Spirits still retain the obsessions they possessed in life, they must now act according to the will of the Star Sea."

...

Li Fan had not forgotten why he had infiltrated the Xuan Immortal Ark in this life.

Besides coveting the many treasures hidden within the Ark's secret vaults, his more important goal was to use the Ark as a vanguard to explore as far beyond the High Wall as possible.

Now that all of the Ark's Elders had become Star Spirits and possessed power comparable to the Star Sea itself, they were fully capable of carrying out the original plan of imitating the Shang Immortal Ark and crashing into the High Wall.

Seeing that the Star Spirits were about to be dispatched throughout the Star Sea under the Star Sea's will, Li Fan naturally would not waste such a perfect opportunity.

The Taijia Divine Art.

The perfected version deduced by the Xuan Immortal Ark.

Manifest!

Within a short time, this divine ability for communicating with the Star Sea appeared once more.

This time, however, Li Fan's target was not the Star Sea's original true consciousness.

It was the eighteen Star Spirits before him.

Compared to communicating directly with the Star Sea itself, communicating with Star Spirits transformed from cultivators was incomparably easier.

The moment the radiance of the Taijia Divine Art appeared, it immediately attracted the Star Spirits' attention.

Li Fan's consciousness instantly connected with theirs.

Had these Star Spirits remained human, then upon seeing Li Fan, who had participated in the ritual with them yet neither died nor transformed into a Star Spirit, but instead remained alive and well, they would certainly have been filled with fury, suspicion, and countless other emotions.

Forget communication. Drawing their swords immediately would have been perfectly natural.

Yet now, Li Fan sensed no emotional fluctuations whatsoever from any of the eighteen Star Spirits.

"The Immortal Ark. Beyond the High Wall."

"Our close friends. Their sacrifice."

"Do not forget."

Li Fan had already gained a preliminary grasp of the methods of communicating with the Star Sea, and he spoke concisely.

His words seemed to awaken the memories the Star Spirits retained from when they were alive. The human faces upon their bodies instantly became much clearer.

Their movements came to a halt. They all turned to look at Li Fan, their expressions filled with hesitation.

"Giving up halfway will only result in a meaningless sacrifice."

"With the power of the Star Sea assisting us, allowing the Immortal Ark to leap across the High Wall is no more difficult than raising a hand."

Under Li Fan's persuasion, the obsessions and thoughts the Star Spirits had carried in life gradually began to awaken once more.

Sensing the changes in their thoughts, Li Fan continued to encourage them.

"Even if the Star Sea can eventually recover, that will only happen after hundreds of thousands or even millions of years. By then, all of you Elders will have completely become Star Spirits and will no longer be able to protect the Immortal Ark at all times. What path will the Immortal Ark have left then? Are you truly willing to watch it perish like this?"

The Star Spirit transformed from Zhong Daogong was finally persuaded.

Broken fragments of thought slowly reached Li Fan.

Communicating with a Star Spirit felt completely different from communicating with a cultivator.

Star Spirit Zhong Daogong merely stated facts in an utterly emotionless manner.

As time passed, the consciousness they had possessed in life would inevitably grow weaker and weaker, until they completely became Star Spirits belonging solely to the Star Sea. Although they still retained a measure of self awareness for now, they could no longer defy the will of the Star Sea and were no longer masters of their own actions.

However, borrowing the power of the Star Sea to help the Immortal Ark cross the High Wall might not be something the Star Sea's will opposed.

The True Immortal seal script was hated by the will of the Star Sea. The Star Spirits could no longer use it.

If they wished to successfully cross the High Wall according to the original plan, Li Fan would have to preside over the process.

...

More and more Star Spirits temporarily recovered their own consciousness.

They reached an agreement with Li Fan.

During the brief final remnants of his consciousness, Star Spirit Zhong Daogong entrusted Li Fan with the Immortal Ark's highest secret, the complete plan for crossing the High Wall.

Guarded by the eighteen Star Spirits, the Immortal Ark was dragged to the vicinity of the traces left behind when the Shang Immortal Ark had crossed the High Wall long ago.

"There is very little time remaining. Begin as soon as possible."

Li Fan nodded slightly before looking toward dozens of sheets of white paper that slowly floated out from within the Immortal Ark.

They appeared completely blank, yet faint marks could still be seen upon them, as though they had already been written upon millions of times.

These were the painstaking life's work of the Immortal Ark Elders throughout countless years.

They had copied, studied, and discussed the True Immortal seal script characters endlessly, restoring every known character as close to its original form as possible.

"These old foxes truly cannot be underestimated."

"After receiving only a few pointers from me, they silently pushed their research on the True Immortal seal script this far in such a short time."

"The Immortal Ark of this life is far stronger than the one that was panic stricken and died beneath the immortal formation in my previous life."

"Not only is its foundation unimaginably deep, but its ability to study and improve is equally terrifying."

Looking at those familiar yet unfamiliar characters, Li Fan was inwardly astonished.

The imprints upon the white paper were like molds painstakingly forged by the Immortal Ark Elders through countless refinements. Li Fan no longer needed to familiarize himself with or rewrite them. He only needed to pour energy into the engraved traces, and the True Immortal seal script characters would naturally manifest one after another.

"This is probably the safeguard left behind by the Immortal Ark Elders. As long as these imprints of the True Immortal seal script remain, even if the entire Council of Elders is wiped out, the Immortal Ark's inheritance will never be completely severed. Given enough time, it may one day return to its former peak..."

With that thought, vast spiritual energy surged from Li Fan's body like countless roaming dragons, flowing separately into every engraved template.

Only someone with Li Fan's immense foundation could possibly sustain such a feat.

His Five Elements Great Cave Heaven and Xuanhuang World Destruction Transformation allowed Li Fan alone to rival an entire cultivation world.

If it had been any ordinary cultivator, the instant their spiritual energy entered the engravings, they would have been completely drained by the True Immortal seal script imprints ahead of them. Even a Star Sea Supreme Elder like the Heavenly Doctor might not have been able to sustain such terrifying consumption.

The immense power within Li Fan's body became the source force that gave form to the True Immortal seal script.

At the same time, the eighteen Star Spirits also began their next actions.

One long cry after another echoed continuously. Each voice rose after the previous one ended, steadily elevating the momentum of the Immortal Ark, one level after another, as though climbing an endless staircase.

These were not true cries, but rather strange waves of fluctuation, resembling boundless tides carrying the power of Infinity.

When Li Fan ascended, he required True Immortal flesh and blood as a medium.

Yet the eighteen Star Spirits relied solely upon the inexhaustible source power of the Star Sea to continuously elevate the Immortal Ark's momentum.

Throughout the entire process, the aura surrounding them never fluctuated in the slightest, as though the cost of ascension meant absolutely nothing to them.

Retaining their memories from life of where the Shang Immortal Ark had struck the High Wall, the Star Spirits stopped ascending after raising the Xuan Immortal Ark to a certain height.

They simply continued their endless cries, maintaining the Immortal Ark's momentum.

Each cry was also like a heavy hammer striking Li Fan's heart, urging him to begin the next step.

For the first time, Li Fan truly experienced the majesty of the Star Sea face to face.

Even he felt a trace of shock as he forcibly suppressed the boiling blood within his body.

"What a pity. Once it crashes into the High Wall, its fate will be completely unknown. All the countless treasures aboard the Immortal Ark will most likely be reduced to ashes along with it."

Even as this thought crossed his mind, his hands never paused.

Looking at the sheets of paper before him that had already been fully infused with power yet remained sealed, Li Fan suddenly clenched his hand.

He compressed every one of them together into a single paper ball.

Then he hurled it fiercely toward the Xuan Immortal Ark surrounded by the eighteen Star Spirits.

Chaotic and terrifying power belonging to the level of True Immortals was wrapped within it as it flew toward the Xuan Immortal Ark.

"Explode!"

Li Fan roared inwardly as his body retreated at maximum speed.

A storm of True Immortal seal script erupted violently beneath the Immortal Ark.

The power, enough to temporarily sweep away all vitality from the Star Sea, caused the blue bodies of the eighteen Star Spirits to flicker unsteadily.

Yet not a single one of their movements slowed.

The infinite power of the Star Sea replenished them endlessly. Even while standing directly within the True Immortal seal script storm, the Star Spirits remained completely indestructible.

Under their control and guidance, the erupting True Immortal power did not destroy the Xuan Immortal Ark.

Instead, it became the final force pushing the Immortal Ark's ascension.

Making possible, for a single instant, what no living being of the Star Sea could ever have achieved.

"A power that truly surpasses mortality, enough to rival a True Immortal. The supreme power capable of crossing the High Wall."

As one of the architects behind the plan, Li Fan watched from afar as the storm exploded violently against the High Wall, while above the storm the Xuan Immortal Ark soared upward.

An excitement he could not suppress welled up within him.

After countless reincarnations.

At last.

The possibility of glimpsing what lay beyond the High Wall had finally arrived.

Long before helping reconstruct the Xuan Immortal Ark's defensive systems, Li Fan had secretly left behind his own arrangements.

Whatever the Immortal Ark saw would also be seen by Li Fan.

Everything had been prepared.

The Immortal Ark was about to collide with the High Wall head on.

Yet at that very moment...

The eighteen Star Spirits transformed from the Immortal Ark Elders suddenly seemed to sense an existence of unimaginable terror.

The very beings least likely to flee at such a crucial moment disappeared without a trace in a single instant.

The Xuan Immortal Ark, however, continued charging toward the invisible High Wall.

Then it too vanished from the Darkest Star Sea.

Leaving only Li Fan behind, staring in complete astonishment.

Although he had witnessed the entire process of the Immortal Ark crashing into the High Wall with his own eyes, he had not sensed even the slightest trace of danger.

And moreover...

The preparations he had secretly left within the Xuan Immortal Ark had never activated at all.

Chapter 1376: Ink Death The Celestial Spirit

Li Fan remained at the edge of the High Wall for a long time, unable to recover from the tremendous upheaval that had just occurred.

The eighteen Star Spirits had suddenly broken away at the very moment the Immortal Ark was about to cross the High Wall, its most critical moment.

There was no doubt that this was not the Star Spirits' own will.

The Elders of the Immortal Ark cared deeply for the Ark. There was no question about that. They had even been willing to sacrifice their own lives without hesitation to ensure its continuation.

"It was the Star Sea's original consciousness. At that instant, it sensed something."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes. Filled with caution, he retreated another stretch into the distance.

"The Star Sea's consciousness acts purely on instinct. It does not bluff like humans do. That means an indescribable great terror truly descended just now."

"And yet I watched the entire process without noticing anything."

That was what concerned him the most.

Li Fan could not help but recall a scene from before his transmigration.

He had once walked along a glass boardwalk through a wetland park.

Walking there, he could see everything beneath the water with perfect clarity through the transparent glass.

The underwater scenery was completely different from what lay above the surface, giving it a unique charm.

The fish beneath the water would often gather near the glass walls.

The younger fish continued swimming and playing without the slightest awareness, even when visitors pressed against the glass to watch them.

But the larger fish, those that seemed to have lived for many years, sensed danger with astonishing sensitivity before anyone even approached. With a flick of their tails, they fled into the deep water and vanished.

...

How similar that scene was to what had just happened.

As the memories resurfaced, Li Fan belatedly felt a chill run through his body.

"My current strength still places me among those young fish, incapable of sensing that danger."

"Perhaps only existences at the level of the Star Sea itself, or rather those at the Star Sea's limit, the Supreme realm, qualify as the adult fish."

"But regardless of which they are, compared to those silent eyes watching from beyond the High Wall..."

Thinking of this, Li Fan's expression darkened as his vigilance toward the outside of the High Wall grew even stronger.

"Beyond the High Wall... I wonder whether the Xuan Immortal Ark, after staking everything on that desperate attempt, actually managed to break through."

Li Fan carefully recalled the final instant before the Immortal Ark disappeared, focusing on the trace of perception he had left within it.

After a long while, his expression changed slightly.

To verify his speculation, he returned once more to the vicinity of the High Wall.

Separating a strand of divine sense, he directed it toward the invisible High Wall.

The attempt was no different from throwing an egg against a stone.

The instant the fragile strand of divine sense collided with the High Wall, it was shattered by the wall's rebounding force and vanished completely.

Li Fan did not stop.

He continued projecting strand after strand of divine sense.

Only after more than ten thousand attempts did he finally notice a subtle difference.

"The disappearance caused by colliding with the High Wall is different from the disappearance inside the Immortal Ark just now."

"When it strikes the High Wall and is destroyed, I can still vaguely perceive the process of destruction. Even though it lasts only an instant, and I had to repeat the experiment tens of thousands of times before noticing it. But it is fundamentally different from that instantaneous disappearance after crossing beyond the High Wall."

"The Xuan Immortal Ark succeeded. It truly broke through the High Wall's blockade."

Li Fan's heart shook violently.

"The combined power of the eighteen Star Spirits, limitless Star Sea energy, together with the explosive fusion of the True Immortal seal script characters, truly granted transcendence for a single instant."

The success of the Xuan Immortal Ark finally allowed Li Fan to see hope of crossing the High Wall.

The methods used in this life could be completely replicated.

For a moment, his emotions could not help but surge with excitement.

Yet almost immediately, when he recalled what had happened to the Xuan Immortal Ark after crossing the High Wall, that faint joy disappeared completely.

"The moment it crossed, all perception vanished. Even if that counts as success, to me it is no different from failure."

"There are clearly countless dangers beyond the High Wall. There are even unknown forces hunting True Immortals. I absolutely cannot recklessly venture beyond the wall while knowing nothing."

Placing his own safety above everything else was Li Fan's most fundamental principle. He would never abandon it for temporary gains.

Of course, accidents occurring during the execution of that principle were another matter.

"I must find a way to maintain perception even while separated by the High Wall."

"Perhaps that will only be possible after understanding the true nature of the High Wall itself."

Li Fan turned toward the only known flaw in the High Wall.

Suddenly, something occurred to him, and he moved a little closer.

Carefully, he observed the direction in which the Xuan Immortal Ark had disappeared.

Threads of golden light spread outward like flowing mercury.

This was the technique he had learned from the Heavenly Doctor within the illusion formation, a method specifically for probing the High Wall.

After a long while, Li Fan withdrew the golden threads. His expression became rather strange.

"Even though the Xuan Immortal Ark has already broken through the High Wall, I still cannot detect any flaw in the wall itself."

"And yet, back then, a single transmission of the Xuantian King's divine will was able to leave an eternal mark upon the High Wall."

"As expected, the High Wall's blockade is far weaker against nonphysical forms. If I want to establish communication across the High Wall, perhaps this is the direction I should pursue."

Li Fan's greatest combat strength currently lay in the Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood, along with several Immortal formations.

Mental and soul cultivation were not his strengths.

"Carefree. The Dream Paradise."

Li Fan suddenly thought of the Longevity Immortal Heavenly Sovereign within the Xuanhuang Realm.

"I wonder how far the Dream Paradise has spread throughout the Star Sea by now. Has it reached the boundary of the High Wall?"

The disciples of the Medicine King Sect, along with countless beings from various small worlds, continued exploring the dream realm.

However, the Carefree Paradise and the world of dreams were simply too vast.

Every newcomer could only explore step by step.

Even the earliest pioneers, Sun Erlang and his two companions, had only just reached Dream World Level 6.

It was still far too early to uncover the true secrets hidden within the dream realm.

Nevertheless, Li Fan believed that even if this life yielded no major discoveries, with accumulated experience and the endless stream of living beings continuing their exploration, the day when the mysteries of the dream realm were fully uncovered would not be too far away.

"In the end, my own strength is still too weak. Otherwise, why would I need to place my hopes on Carefree?"

Li Fan sighed inwardly.

"Perhaps after I use the Xuanhuang Celestial Spirit to achieve Dao Integration in this life, the situation will improve somewhat."

"However..."

Li Fan once again turned his gaze toward the direction of the High Wall.

"It is highly likely that when the Xuanhuang Realm ascends into an Immortal Domain, whatever exists beyond the High Wall will once again cast its gaze upon it. I must also prepare in advance and delay them for as long as possible."

Fortunately, the incident from his previous life, when Cat Treasure captured an immortal, causing the High Wall to collapse and the Star Sea to fall into turmoil, had given Li Fan a valuable reference.

"This time, an entire world is ascending into an Immortal Domain. The disturbance it causes may be even greater. To be safe, I must complete the devouring of the Celestial Spirit before half the time it took for the previous life's anomaly to occur."

"The Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth may have changed its name, but its essence remains the same. It is still born bearing a heavenly duty."

"If I want to complete the devouring as quickly as possible, then the Spirit of Heaven and Earth itself must be born as swiftly as possible."

Having managed the Xuanhuang Realm for so many years, and even possessing the ability to reverse the principles of heaven and earth to summon a Spirit of Heaven and Earth out of thin air, Li Fan naturally understood every type of Spirit of Heaven and Earth like the back of his hand.

"The time required for a Spirit of Heaven and Earth to manifest after being awakened by the will of heaven and earth varies greatly. Across a hundred reincarnations, the one that descended the fastest was..."

"Only Ink Death!"

A brilliant light flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

In the lifetime when Zhang Haobo used the Twenty-Eight Congyun Swords to slay Crimson Flame and became the youngest Dao Integration Immortal Sage in Xuanhuang history, he was killed by Ink Death the instant he broke through.

Almost the very moment Crimson Flame was slain, Ink Death had already been activated by the will of heaven and earth.

"Unlike the other Spirit of Heaven and Earth, Ink Death is part of the operating mechanism of heaven and earth itself. It likely remains permanently active and can be instantly awakened at any moment. This is perhaps a spontaneous change that the Xuanhuang Realm developed after being stitched together with fragments from the outside world."

After only a brief moment of thought, Li Fan understood.

"Ink Death will most likely undergo its transformation from a Spirit of Heaven and Earth into a Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth alongside the ascension of the Xuanhuang Realm. Furthermore, among all Spirits of Heaven and Earth, its actual combat strength ranks among the very strongest."

"It truly could not be more suitable."

Li Fan nodded slightly. With a turn of thought, he had already locked onto his target.

"The matters of the Immortal Ark have been settled. It is time to return and carefully prepare for the Xuanhuang Realm's final ascension."

Feeling the single strand of Star Spirit Power obtained from the Star Sea, currently sealed within the immortal formation inside his body, Li Fan became even more confident in completing his plan.

Just as he was about to leave upon the wooden sword, another disturbance suddenly occurred near the High Wall.

This time, however, it did not originate from the High Wall itself.

Instead, it came from the entrance leading into the underground fissure basin.

An enormous amount of life force suddenly erupted outward.

Like a fountain, it shot high into the Star Sea.

A figure borrowed this tremendous force and escaped from within.

Li Fan looked closely.

It was none other than the long missing Qiao Gong.

After being swept away by the echoing star force storm, Qiao Gong had become trapped within the maze-like underground earth fissure, disappearing without a trace.

Li Fan had been unable to contact him ever since, although he could vaguely sense that his aura remained steady and that his life was never truly in danger.

Unexpectedly, he had finally escaped from the labyrinth.

Qiao Gong seemed extraordinarily excited by his successful escape, dancing about wildly while shouting in celebration.

Li Fan extended his hand and directly pulled him over.

The surrounding scenery changed abruptly.

Thinking that he had only escaped one danger to fall into another, Qiao Gong's face immediately turned deathly pale.

Only after recognizing Li Fan did he finally let out a long sigh of relief.

Clearing his throat, he respectfully bowed.

"Greetings, Holy Teacher."

Li Fan replied calmly.

"It has indeed been quite some time since I last saw you. I even entered those underground fissures searching for you before. However, the underground earth fissure twists endlessly beneath the entire Star Sea. It was impossible to search completely, so I eventually gave up."

"Judging by your current appearance, it seems misfortune has turned into good fortune."

Compared to before his disappearance, Qiao Gong's spirit, vitality, and bearing had all undergone a qualitative transformation.

It was obvious that he had encountered an extraordinary opportunity within those endless underground fissures.

At the mention of this, a trace of pride appeared on Qiao Gong's face.

"As expected of the Holy Teacher. Your insight truly sees through everything. I indeed obtained a small opportunity."

"When I first discovered that I had become lost within those endless underground rivers, I panicked a little."

"But I quickly realized that the place was overflowing with vitality. Even if I remained trapped there for my entire life, there would be no danger to my life."

"So I gradually relaxed."

"You know me well, Holy Teacher. I have always been accustomed to locking myself away in my workshop conducting research without ever leaving. Staying inside those underground rivers was merely changing the environment. Besides, I still had Shangguan's puppet to vent my frustrations on, so there was no chance of becoming bored..."

Qiao Gong continued speaking endlessly.

Li Fan interrupted in a deep voice.

"Get to the point."

Qiao Gong paused awkwardly before continuing.

"After adapting for a while, I had nothing to do, so out of curiosity I began researching those endless underground rivers."

"Who would have thought I would accidentally discover their secret."

His tone gradually became excited.

"Those underground rivers are unbelievably complicated."

"At first I tried memorizing every single route they took, but there were simply too many branches, so I never succeeded."

"I did not give up. During that period, my mind was completely filled with the shapes traced by those underground rivers."

"Then one day, after I accidentally broke Shangguan again, I prepared to repair her."

"But while repairing her, as if possessed, I instinctively engraved the flow patterns of those underground rivers that had remained in my memory onto Shangguan's puppet."

"What happened afterward was something I had never heard of in my entire life."

At this point, Qiao Gong unconsciously licked his lips, a strange expression flashing through his eyes.

Li Fan naturally knew that the so-called Shangguan puppet was actually the puppet that contained the memory backup of Shangguan Tuo, Qiao Gong's master and an elder of the Heavenly Mechanism Realm.

According to the laws of the Heavenly Mechanism Realm, however, memory backups possessed no status equal to the original owner.

They could only obey the commands of Heavenly Mechanism Realm cultivators absolutely.

Li Fan had always known about Qiao Gong's somewhat twisted hobby.

Since he merely entertained himself, Li Fan had never bothered to interfere.

But seeing Qiao Gong's current expression, even Li Fan became interested.

Qiao Gong seemed to savor the memory for a moment before speaking slowly.

"I never imagined that after the repairs were completed, the Shangguan puppet, which should have obeyed every order without resistance, not only refused my commands..."

"It even cursed me viciously."

"The insults were so unbearable that they reminded me of some very unpleasant memories from long ago."

"I became furious and accidentally hit it a little too hard."

"So I broke it again."

"Only much later did I suddenly come to my senses."

"Something extraordinary had happened."

Li Fan pondered.

"You mean that the patterns of those underground rivers actually awakened Shangguan's self-awareness?"

Qiao Gong shook his head vigorously.

"No."

"It already possessed complete self-awareness as a memory backup."

"It was merely restricted by the prohibitions left behind by the Heavenly Mechanism Realm and therefore could only obey my commands."

"But after those patterns were engraved..."

"Everything became different."

He licked his lips once again.

"The newly born Shangguan was no longer treated as a memory backup."

"According to the Heavenly Mechanism Realm's prohibitions..."

"It became Shangguan Tuo herself."

"Of course, Shangguan Tuo has been dead for who knows how many years. That is obviously impossible."

"But because of the influence of those unknown patterns..."

"She was revived, in a certain sense."

"And what I engraved was only an utterly insignificant fragment of the shapes formed by those underground rivers."

"This is simply..."

"Unimaginable!"

Qiao Gong exclaimed in amazement.

After hearing his explanation, Li Fan suddenly understood the true purpose of those underground dark rivers that stretched throughout the entire Darkest Star Sea.

They were not merely reservoirs storing vitality.

They were also an unimaginably powerful divine ability.

A divine ability capable of granting independent self-awareness to the Darkest Star Sea sealed behind the High Wall.

Chapter 1377: The Living Being Ascends To Immortal Shape

Li Fan had previously been puzzled as to why the Darkest Star Sea sealed behind the High Wall had developed an independent consciousness.

He had not expected the mystery to be solved so quickly.

"The earthly fissure was constructed by Xing Wuque under the orders of the Xuantian King. He labored tirelessly for tens of thousands of years without interruption. Even now, it has still not been completed. Xu Ke must continue the work."

"Setting aside whether Xu Ke's persistence comes from his own will or from the influence of Xing Wuque's inheritance, in the Xuantian King's plan, the fissure absolutely had to satisfy the condition of completeness."

"I previously speculated that the Xuantian King intended to elevate the entire Darkest Star Sea into the Immortal Realm. But now it seems..."

"There may have been another objective besides that."

Qiao Gong continued his endless explanation of how the fissure pattern transformed the ordinary into the miraculous. Using his finger as a brush, he drew before Li Fan the pattern he had memorized.

At first glance, there was nothing extraordinary about it. It looked no different from the meaningless scribbles of a child.

Li Fan also recalled the route map of the fissure that he had memorized.

Following the guidance of the [Reveal] character, he had traveled all the way to the end of the fissure basin. As a result, the pattern he had recorded was far more detailed and complete than Qiao Gong's.

Even so, after studying it carefully, Li Fan still failed to uncover the mystery hidden within those patterns.

"It seems this belongs to a completely different system from anything I have encountered so far."

"Only by engraving it can its effects manifest?"

"Just one incomplete portion is enough to give birth to an independent consciousness. But when the entire pattern is completed, what exactly will it accomplish?"

Li Fan frowned inwardly.

With a thought, a long sword resembling flowing sapphire liquid quietly appeared in his hand.

It was one of the five treasures Li Fan had obtained from the Immortal Ark under the pretense of earning Great Qi's trust and ensuring the smooth progress of the Equal Heaven Ritual.

From the second level of the Immortal Ark treasury, he had taken two treasures, the Yin-Yang Jade and the Three-Pronged Tree.

From the first level, he had taken three treasures, the Blackstar Stone, the strange bronze mirror, and the liquid sword.

The Three-Pronged Tree had unexpectedly triggered a response within [Truth], helping Li Fan deepen his understanding of the Transformations Between Truth and Falsehood.

The Yin-Yang Jade was reserved for a future plan, where it would transform into Yin and Yang Qi to promote the evolution of the Xuanhuang Realm.

The Blackstar Stone had already been fused into Tianyang's Immortal Puppet body.

Only the strange bronze mirror and the liquid sword remained unused.

With Li Fan's current strength, allowing him to roam freely across the Star Sea, treasures casually selected from the Immortal Ark treasury had each provided him with such tremendous benefits. This alone demonstrated how astonishingly rich the Immortal Ark treasury truly was.

And this was only the first and second layer of the Immortal Compendium of Hundred Tales.

It was difficult to imagine what priceless treasures were stored within the third level.

"What a pity. In this life, the entire treasury has already departed beyond the High Wall."

"I can only wait until a future opportunity to explore it thoroughly."

"However, if I can successfully achieve Dao Integration with the Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth, then when I face the Immortal Ark again, there will be no need for all the complicated schemes of this lifetime."

As these thoughts flowed through his mind, Li Fan quietly engraved the known earth fissure pattern onto the liquid sword before him.

Not the slightest fluctuation of energy appeared.

Yet for some unknown reason, the liquid sword suddenly began to boil violently.

Li Fan narrowed his eyes and separated a strand of divine sense to carefully observe the sword's transformation.

"Kill. Kill. Kill. Kill. Kill. Kill. Kill."

The sapphire blade gradually turned completely black.

Within it, a newly born, immature consciousness emerged, obsessively repeating those words.

The earthly fissure pattern slowly disappeared into the interior of the sword.

The flowing liquid blade then solidified into a sharp sword radiating icy brilliance.

With a sharp whistle, it suddenly flew toward the nearest living target.

Like a brush drawing a straight black stroke across white paper, black ink spread outward along its path.

"Kill!"

Space split apart.

A boundless murderous aura surged directly toward Li Fan's face.

At that moment, the entire Star Sea seemed to vanish from Li Fan's perception.

Everything he saw, everything he sensed, everything he felt, became nothing but this single sword descending through the void.

"Not bad."

Li Fan praised softly.

Two enormous fingers descended from the heavens, piercing through the starry sky.

They stopped before Li Fan and gently caught the black sword between them.

"Kill..."

The black sword still struggled desperately.

But how could it possibly break free?

It could only rage helplessly, letting out continuous low growls.

Qiao Gong was completely stunned by the sudden change, his explanation stopping abruptly. The overwhelming pressure radiating from the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger filled him with terror, leaving him unable to even look directly at Li Fan.

"It truly developed self-awareness. That liquid sword was previously nothing more than an ordinary object, completely devoid of even the slightest consciousness."

"Unfortunately, whether because the pattern is incomplete or because this consciousness was born from nothing, what emerged within the sword cannot yet be considered true intelligence."

Li Fan had already gained a preliminary understanding of the earthly fissure pattern's effects.

The Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger then exerted slightly more force.

With a single squeeze, every engraved pattern within the sword was instantly erased.

The black color faded away.

The sword returned to its original liquid form.

Its overwhelming murderous aura disappeared as well.

"Wait here for a moment."

After putting away the liquid sword, Li Fan instructed Qiao Gong before vanishing from the spot.

Having witnessed Li Fan's overwhelming power, Qiao Gong naturally dared not disobey.

He obediently remained where he was.

At the same time, his eyes darted about as he tried to recall the pattern that had briefly flashed across the sword.

"The Holy Teacher actually possesses a far more complete version of the pattern than I do. Unfortunately, the details were far too complicated. In that brief instant, I only managed to memorize a little more than half."

"But that should be enough. Hehehe. I wonder what I'll be able to turn Shangguan into this time."

Qiao Gong's thoughts wandered excitedly.

The next moment, Li Fan's voice suddenly rang beside his ear.

"So, you also want to know the complete pattern?"

"Of course."

Qiao Gong answered instinctively.

But he quickly realized what he had just admitted.

His face instantly turned deathly pale.

He frantically shook his head.

"Hehehe. Holy Teacher, you've misunderstood. How would I dare pry such a profound secret? The portion I already possess is more than enough..."

Li Fan waved his hand, cutting off Qiao Gong's rambling.

At the same time, he sent a pattern directly into Qiao Gong's sea of consciousness.

"Since you're interested, I don't mind teaching you this [Shape of Living Beings]."

Li Fan spoke indifferently.

Qiao Gong said nothing.

His eyes became vacant as he completely immersed himself in the intricate and wondrous pattern.

The Shape of Living Beings was not the earth fissure pattern's original name.

It was merely a name Li Fan had casually given it.

Earlier, Li Fan had returned to the depths of the fissure in an attempt to obtain the complete pattern from Xu Ke.

As the true builder of the fissure, Xing Wuque's inheritance should have contained the relevant memories.

Unfortunately, Li Fan was somewhat disappointed.

Xing Wuque's inheritance was simply too vast.

If every detail had been passed down without omission, Xu Ke's soul would never have been able to withstand it.

Therefore, from Xing Wuque's perspective, many insignificant matters had been discarded and excluded from the inheritance.

Among them were the construction memories of the already completed outer sections of the fissures.

Fortunately, the unfinished portion of the Shape of Living Beings remained within Xing Wuque's inheritance.

After obtaining it from Xu Ke, Li Fan once again laid down countless golden threads throughout the underground river of the fissure.

Using the vitality of the Underground River, it continuously proliferated and evolved. Like liquid mercury flowing across the ground, it began a comprehensive exploration of the earth fissure.

Although the earth fissure had countless branches and spread throughout the entire Star Sea, for Li Fan, it was merely somewhat troublesome, not something impossible to fully understand.

It was just that, until now, Li Fan had never had sufficient motivation to do so.

But after learning that its complete pattern was very likely an entirely new and unknown powerful divine ability, Li Fan resolved to fully explore every part of it.

"Judging by the current progress of the golden threads searching through the earth fissure, the exploration should be completed before the end of this lifetime."

"I hope it brings me a pleasant surprise."

Sensing the Shape of Living Beings continuously spreading outward through his mind, Li Fan thought to himself.

Having just returned from the earth fissure, Li Fan also learned why Qiao Gong had managed to escape.

It was most likely another chain reaction caused by the Xuan Immortal Ark crossing the High Wall.

The instant the Immortal Ark crossed the High Wall, it attracted the attention of an unknown existence beyond it. As a result, the Star Sea's consciousness sensed an incomparably intense crisis.

Like some kind of catalyst, it stimulated the enormous vitality stored within the earth fissure.

"The revival of the Star Sea has once again been brought forward."

"The Shape of Living Beings, the Star Sea consciousness, the High Wall, the Immortal Realm..."

Grabbing the still-enlightening Qiao Gong, Li Fan returned to the Xuanhuang Realm while silently contemplating these matters.

"Wonderful!"

Only then did Qiao Gong awaken as if from a dream and cry out in delight.

"Although I still cannot see its complete form, I already have a premonition. Using this Shape of Living Beings, I can reshape Shangguan's mind according to my own design. I can create a Shangguan Tuo who belongs to me alone, the Shangguan Tuo of my dreams!"

"Shangguan, wait for me. Just wait for me..."

Qiao Gong's eyes had already become somewhat frenzied from overwhelming joy. At this moment, the only thought in his mind was to immediately find a quiet and secluded place to create a Shangguan Tuo puppet made specifically to his own specifications.

"I heard you still possess several combat memory records belonging to the Immortal Puppet Ancestor?" Li Fan suddenly blocked his path.

"Yes, yes, yes. Does the Holy Teacher need them? Please, take them all!"

Already gradually becoming dominated by his own desires, Qiao Gong did not even bother questioning how Li Fan had learned such a closely guarded secret. He directly tossed over a seven-colored sphere of light.

Li Fan inspected it briefly, smiled faintly, and stepped aside.

Qiao Gong immediately vanished in a flash, disappearing to who knew where.

Li Fan, meanwhile, held the sphere of light in one hand and arrived at Tianyang's secluded cultivation chamber.

Ever since the battle aboard the Immortal Ark against the Thousand-Eyed Desolate God, Tianyang had remained in a state of secluded enlightenment.

The aura surrounding him surged like an endless sea of clouds. At times it expanded wildly in every direction, while at other times it rapidly contracted until it was completely hidden.

Li Fan could even faintly sense from Tianyang the same terror he had experienced when facing the Thousand-Eyed Desolate God.

"The power of the Star Spirit, a complete Immortal Realm fragment, the foundation of a ruined world, the remaining power of a True Immortal..."

"With every lifetime, I prepare more and more contingencies. Yet for some reason, the unease within my heart only grows stronger day by day."

Standing before the Immortal Puppet Tianyang, Li Fan's expression was unreadable.

"My intuition has always been accurate. Countless reincarnations have already proven that."

"It seems that promoting the Xuanhuang Realm's ascension will inevitably bring unforeseen dangers."

"I need allies, even if they can only buy me a single instant."

Li Fan slowly implanted the entire seven-colored sphere into Tianyang's Immortal Puppet body.

The instant the sphere approached, the True Immortal flesh covering Tianyang's body seemed to sense danger.

It rose like a living creature, baring its fangs and claws.

But upon truly coming into contact with the Ancestor's combat memories, the flesh suddenly quieted.

A moment later, however, it reacted even more violently, almost rioting as it eagerly dragged the sphere deep into Tianyang's body.

A trace of ferocity suddenly flashed across Tianyang's previously tranquil face.

Two completely different auras appeared simultaneously upon his body.

One was ancient, desolate, and sinister.

The other was magnificent and righteous, unmoving in all directions.

The first originated from the Thousand-Eyed Desolate God.

The second came from the Immortal Puppet Ancestor.

Neither of these beings had reached the level of a True Immortal.

Yet they had long transcended the mortal realm and were far beyond what ordinary cultivators could endure.

Under normal circumstances, even a Supreme realm cultivator of the Star Sea would have their mind shaken and worn away beneath the clash of these utterly opposing auras.

But the core of an Immortal Puppet was an Eternal Remnant Will.

Even Li Fan was forced to retreat slightly from the collision of the two auras.

Yet Tianyang, standing at the center of the storm, remained completely unmoved, allowing the raging forces to batter him freely.

Not only did the violent clash fail to diminish him in the slightest, it instead refined him like gold within blazing flames, causing him to shine even more brilliantly.

"So this is an Eternal Remnant Will?"

It was also Li Fan's first time truly witnessing what eternity meant.

Something left behind by an ordinary mortal could actually stand firm before Immortal-level power without collapsing.

The overwhelming contrast caused even Li Fan's heart to tremble.

He suddenly remembered that within the Xuanhuang Realm there remained another Eternal Remnant Will that had yet to be absorbed through [Truth].

The skull of Mr. Bai within the Divine Treasury Museum.

"It has already been far too long."

“It has been too long. After achieving the Celestial Spirit, it is finally time to go and collect it.”

Although enemies within the Star Sea had become exceedingly rare for him, there were still many occasions when he found himself constrained.

"Only by using my Celestial Spirit to achieve Dao Integration and step into the Immortal Realm, even if only as a Half-Immortal, can I truly roam without restraint."

At this moment, Li Fan's determination had never been firmer.

"The Tianyang Immortal Soul is one safeguard."

"Perhaps this sword can become another."

Li Fan flashed to the center of the Great Xuan Dao Lecture Platform.

He took out the liquid longsword and quietly placed it before himself.

The spiritual energy within his body surged as he engraved every portion of the Shape of Living Beings that had currently been explored onto the blade.

Compared to his first attempt, the Shape of Living Beings pattern had nearly doubled in size.

The blade no longer transformed toward an ink-black color.

Instead, it remained a deep azure.

Li Fan deliberately left a large blank section where the unexplored areas remained, allowing future additions whenever more of the pattern was discovered.

Once the Shape of Living Beings had been completely engraved, an incomprehensible fluctuation descended and enveloped the liquid sword.

A dazzling light erupted before gradually fading.

Then a naked little Daoist child with delicate features slowly appeared before Li Fan.

Only during the instant of his birth did confusion briefly appear in the child's eyes.

Moments later, he somehow understood the origin of his own existence.

"Thank you, Great Master, for granting me life."

The little Daoist child spoke in a clear voice before respectfully kneeling before Li Fan.
