Chapter 1378: Qiushui Enter The Star Sea

The effects of the Shape of Living Beings were even more miraculous than Li Fan had anticipated.

Looking at the young Daoist child kneeling before him, Li Fan attempted to perceive the exact nature of its life.

"'Granting Life...'"

He silently savored those two words.

By engraving the Shape of Living Beings onto the liquid longsword, Li Fan had created an existence similar to an artifact spirit. Moreover, an innate and extremely strong connection had naturally formed between him and his creation.

The "Great Master" the Daoist child spoke of was, in truth, its master and creator.

Li Fan vaguely sensed that with a single thought, he could erase the Daoist child's consciousness at will and restore the liquid longsword to its original state.

No matter how powerful the Daoist child became, so long as it could not break free from the constraints of the Shape of Living Beings, it would never escape the destiny of being a creation.

"The Shape of Living Beings truly contains endless mysteries. The only pity is that what it creates is a genuinely independent living being with its own consciousness. I cannot completely perceive every one of its thoughts."

"However, controlling it like a puppet is still entirely possible."

Having instantly understood the entire situation, Li Fan said calmly, "Rise."

With a casual point of his finger, he manipulated the Dao to create a set of robes to cover the Daoist child's body.

"Many thanks, Great Master, for bestowing these clothes!"

The Daoist child respectfully kowtowed once more before standing up as instructed.

"Attack me with your full strength."

"This..."

The young Daoist child hesitated briefly, but ultimately obeyed.

Its figure vanished in an instant.

In its place, torrential rain poured from the heavens.

A closer look revealed that every single raindrop was an icy sword radiating chilling sword intent.

The storm of sword rain surrounded Li Fan, intending to cut him into countless pieces.

The newly born Daoist child was a blank slate that knew only how to faithfully execute Li Fan's commands.

Now that it had begun attacking, it showed absolutely no restraint.

"Even with such immature intelligence, it can unleash so many pure and distinct sword intents. An ordinary cultivator would likely require hundreds or even thousands of years of tempering to reach such a level. Is this the innate advantage possessed by artifacts that have assumed human form..."

"Unfortunately, this liquid longsword is still only a world artifact. Its upper limit is no more than this."

Li Fan neither dodged nor defended.

He simply allowed the endless rain of swords to fall upon him.

Every sword qi appeared overwhelmingly powerful.

Yet each time it was about to touch Li Fan, it seemed to collide with some invisible barrier, erupting into dazzling golden light before silently dissipating.

Although the rain poured endlessly, not even the corner of Li Fan's robes became wet.

"Return!"

Li Fan's counterattack consisted of nothing more than a casual sweep of his sleeve.

The countless raindrops instantly gathered together.

He lightly flicked them with his finger, producing a crisp ringing sound.

The young Daoist child immediately reverted to its original form and tumbled awkwardly onto the ground.

"Many thanks, Great Master, for showing mercy."

"Great Master's divine might is unmatched beneath the heavens and invincible throughout the universe."

The Daoist child hurriedly climbed to its feet and instinctively knelt to flatter him.

"It has assumed human form."

"But its strength is still far from sufficient to block a blade for me."

"It still requires further strengthening."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes and had the Daoist child return to its original form once more.

After receiving the imprint of the Shape of Living Beings, the surface of the liquid longsword resembled flowing water, becoming noticeably more lively and spirited.

As for how to strengthen the sword, Li Fan had already formulated a plan.

His greatest strength lay in Immortal formations.

Naturally, the best method was Formation Refinement.

Golden source power essence surged forth.

Countless golden patterns transformed into individual formation units, all of which merged into the liquid longsword.

The moment the Immortal formation entered its body, the liquid longsword immediately seemed to boil violently.

Its entire surface rippled uncontrollably.

Ordinarily, a world-level artifact should never have been capable of enduring the vast and transcendent power of an Immortal formation.

However, what Li Fan engraved this time was the Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation, a fusion of every Immortal formation he had mastered thus far.

As the formation continuously evolved, the powers of creation and destruction naturally circulated within it.

This was sufficient to preserve the liquid longsword from collapsing.

Furthermore, during the process of Formation Refinement, Li Fan also faintly sensed the influence of the Shape of Living Beings.

"The birth of intelligence has caused the liquid longsword itself to undergo a qualitative transformation. Otherwise, it might not even have survived the very first impact before the Immortal formation was fully engraved."

Golden light continued flashing.

Seven days later, Li Fan finally completed the engraving of the entire Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation.

At this moment, what remained within the liquid longsword was merely something similar to the template of a True Immortal seal script character.

It was only the foundational framework of an immensely intricate formation.

To truly activate the formation and allow it to evolve, energy still had to be supplied.

If the liquid longsword relied solely upon its own power, it probably could not sustain the formation for even a short while before being completely drained dry by the Immortal formation.

As for source power essence, Li Fan had no intention of allowing the liquid longsword to use it.

After all, the elevation of Xuanhuang was imminent.

Every additional reserve of source power essence increased his chances of success. If this creation, which existed to block blades on his behalf, also had to compete with him for resources...

Would that not defeat its very purpose?

Of course, Li Fan had no intention of allowing the liquid longsword to become nothing more than an ornamental piece capable of activating the Immortal formation only briefly.

In truth, he already had an excellent idea.

"Energy."

"Infinite."

Li Fan raised his head toward the Star Sea and narrowed his eyes.

After making thorough preparations, twenty days later.

Within the empty star sea, the blue-robed young Daoist child continuously chanted an incantation.

What it recited was none other than the enhanced Taijia Divine Art from the Immortal Ark.

Meanwhile, Li Fan concealed himself in the distance and quietly observed.

That was right.

He intended to recreate the Immortal Ark's balancing of the Star Sea.

Only this time, it would not be Li Fan balancing the power of the Star Sea.

It would be the liquid longsword.

Admittedly, from previous experience, once one balanced the infinite power of the Star Sea, one would instead be assimilated by it.

One would become an existence similar to a Star Spirit.

However...

The liquid longsword contained the Shape of Living Beings.

The Shape of Living Beings had even given rise to the independent consciousness of this Darkest Star Sea itself.

Its level of existence undoubtedly surpassed that of the Star Sea.

As long as the Shape of Living Beings remained intact, then even if it transformed into a Star Spirit, its life and death would still remain under Li Fan's control with a single thought.

"A Star Spirit cannot defy the will of the Star Sea."

"A creation born from the Shape of Living Beings cannot defy the will of its creator."

"When these two laws come into conflict..."

"Let me see which one prevails."

The young Daoist child's chanting continued without pause.

It was as though it had practiced the technique millions of times, without the slightest trace of unfamiliarity.

Its performance was even more perfect than that of the vast majority of the Immortal Ark Elders.

The learning ability of an artifact spirit that had assumed human form truly far surpassed ordinary people.

Perhaps because it had already been forced to communicate with the Star Sea once through the Taijia Divine Art, the consciousness of the Star Sea seemed to have developed a slight resistance.

This time, it took nearly twice as long as before before the Star Sea consciousness finally descended.

A violet-gold vortex resembling an immeasurably deep eye once again appeared within the star sea.

The young Daoist child hesitated not at all.

Its brush danced like a dragon and serpent as the Character of [Equal] erupted forth.

The Star Sea's response remained exactly the same.

It accepted everything without rejection.

However, compared to the Immortal Ark Elders who had weathered thousands of years, this young Daoist child, which had existed for less than a month and whose experience was almost completely blank, clearly did not attract much of the Star Sea's interest.

Nevertheless, once the Character of Equal had been completed.

An endless torrent of Star Sea energy poured down from the void.

Bathed in starlight, the young Daoist child gradually transformed into a Star Spirit.

Its entire body shone with brilliant blue starlight, while constellations linked together throughout its body like a skeleton.

Suddenly, as if struck by the boundless power of the Star Sea, the hidden Shape of Living Beings pattern within the little Daoist child's body began to shine. It surfaced upon his body of its own accord.

Stimulated by an external force that was just barely worthy of being its opponent, the Shape of Living Beings finally revealed its true radiance.

It was a black that represented nothingness, yet within that darkness shimmered every brilliant color in existence.

Around the outermost edge of the pattern was a faint white glow that likewise represented nothingness.

A seven-colored black surrounded by a luminous white outline.

The moment this unforgettable and dazzling color appeared, it completely overwhelmed the blue radiance of the Star Sea.

Within the violet-gold vortex, a deafening roar erupted, countless times louder than the sound of wind and thunder.

Even Li Fan, watching from afar, could sense the Star Sea's fury from the violently surging vortex.

Furious though it was, the consciousness of the Star Sea did not act recklessly.

Its display was all thunder and little rain. The violet-gold vortex disappeared even faster than it had appeared.

As the Star Sea's threat vanished, the Shape of Living Beings concealed itself once more within the little Daoist child's body. Only the Star Spirit Dao Child remained standing blankly within the Star Sea.

'It succeeded?'

The process had gone even more smoothly than Li Fan had anticipated. He calmed his mind and sensed the connection between himself and the little Daoist child.

The authority of the Shape of Living Being's dominion still remained.

It had not disappeared under the influence of the true intent of the Star Sea's origin.

With a thought from Li Fan, the little Daoist child floated gracefully over, moving several times faster than before, and arrived before him.

"Many thanks, Great Master, for bestowing this fortune upon me!"

Li Fan quietly observed the Daoist child's brand new Star Spirit body.

Using the Shape of Living Being's power of dominion, Li Fan was able to peer through the dazzling starlight and clearly observe its internal structure.

Every point of light resembled a passage.

Each one led to an unknowable and mysterious place. That was the true source of the infinite star power.

Perhaps because it was simply too vast, exceeding Li Fan's ability to perceive, he could detect no unusual presence within it at all.

The restrictions imposed by the Star Sea's consciousness had not disappeared. They had merely been suppressed by the Shape of Living Beings, preventing them from affecting the little Daoist child for the time being.

Li Fan also vaguely sensed that, as endless star power continuously poured out through those passages, countless Star Sea laws were gradually integrating into and transforming the Daoist Child's sword body through the tempering of star power.

"It has not reached the level of an immortal artifact, but it is already a Supreme Sword."

"With infinite star power as its source, it can continuously drive an immortal formation at its maximum capacity without end."

Li Fan reached out and grasped the longsword, which instantly returned to its original form.

It was no longer liquid.

Instead, it surged with brilliant starlight, as though it were the boundless Star Sea itself.

Within the shifting radiance, countless worlds seemed to be born and perish.

Having personally forged such a divine weapon, even Li Fan could not suppress the excitement rising within his heart.

"I wonder if I can use this sword to draw upon the infinite power of the Star Sea?"

With a thought, an immense amount of star power surged from the blade.

However, this pure and primordial Star Sea power was fundamentally different from the spiritual energy cultivated by cultivators.

After entering Li Fan's body, not only could it not be absorbed or controlled, it instead rampaged like a flood, wreaking havoc throughout his body.

Li Fan frowned slightly and was forced to expel it.

"What a pity. However, there must exist cultivation techniques capable of converting Star Sea power for one's own use."

He could not help but think of the cultivators of the Taijia Realm, who had once dominated through the power of the Star Sea.

A moment later, Li Fan silently shook his head.

"I was thinking too narrowly. Even the infinite Star Sea must ultimately remain bound by the Shape of Living Beings."

"Pursuing nothing more than an increase in quantity..."

"Is ultimately the wrong path."

"Still, being able to create a Supreme realm existence so easily is undoubtedly a tremendous blessing for my current self."

If he possessed more than ten Supreme realm protectors, even if they were only Supreme realm artifact spirits, it would be enough for Li Fan to sweep across the Star Sea.

Thinking this, Li Fan prepared to repeat the process.

However, something unexpected happened.

The Shape of Living Beings...

Could no longer be imprinted onto any other object.

Although the pattern still remained perfectly clear within his mind, when the moment came, he found himself unable to engrave it.

"So there is such a restriction."

After several more attempts confirmed this limitation, Li Fan could only sigh in disappointment.

"I originally intended to use the Shape of Living Beings to create an army of artifact spirits, unify the Star Sea, and explore beyond the High Wall."

"After all, creations under complete control are far easier to use than cultivators."

"What a pity."

Li Fan shook his head and tossed the starlight sword into the air.

The little Daoist child transformed back into human form once more, lowered his head respectfully, and stood before Li Fan.

After pondering for a while, Li Fan said, "All things possess infinite measure, endless time, and ever-changing division. Now that you have obtained the infinite divine power of the Star Sea, you are forever free from mortal restraints and have transcended the mundane world."

"From this day onward, your name shall be..."

"Qiushui." [1]

The little Daoist child was stunned at first, unable to understand what Li Fan's words about infinity, eternity, and constant change had to do with the name Qiushui.

But the Great Master's words were absolute.

He immediately stopped thinking about it, happily knelt down, and kowtowed.

"Many thanks, Great Master, for bestowing this name!"

The moment he accepted the name Qiushui, the aura surrounding the little Dao child seemed to undergo an indescribable transformation.

He appeared even more like a naturally born living being.

As his creator, Li Fan instantly gained a trace of enlightenment.

If one day Qiushui could completely evolve into a true living being and escape the destiny of being merely a creation, then Li Fan would once again be able to imprint a new Shape of Living Beings.

Li Fan contemplated this realization for a long time, his expression becoming unreadable.

"Hmph."

"A pure creation is still preferable."

When he returned to the Xuanhuang Realm, Li Fan discovered that Tianyang had also awakened from his enlightenment.

Although he was merely a puppet assembled from various materials, he now possessed a faint aura of transcendence, ethereal and detached from the mortal world.

Compared to the True Immortals Li Fan had once seen, he was only half a step inferior.

Li Fan suspected that if Tianyang were to appear in the Xuanhuang Realm at this moment, countless cultivators would immediately kneel before him.

Afterward, Li Fan had Qiushui spar with Tianyang.

Qiushui possessed infinite star power to drive the Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation. In theory, he should have been able to suppress Tianyang with ease.

However, Li Fan discovered that the immortal-grade illusion formation, which had trapped the Heavenly Doctor for such a long time, had very little effect on Tianyang.

Whenever Tianyang entered combat, he could ignore everything generated within the illusion.

Even the memories of transforming himself into the Dao in ages past failed to trouble him for long.

Instead, every illusion further tempered Tianyang's heart, making it even more perfect.

Bursting out from the storm of the All Things Return to Void Formation that Qiushui had hastily transformed into, Tianyang delivered a powerful punch directly into Qiushui's body.

...

[1]:- 秋水 (Qiū Shuǐ) translates literally to "Autumn Water."

Chapter 1379: Condensing The Eternal Remnant Will

The little Daoist child Qiushui let out a strange cry, and his body instantly exploded into countless fragments.

Yet he was far from defeated. Those countless fragments transformed into a torrential rain that continued pouring down upon Tianyang.

Qiushui had used this move before in front of Li Fan, but after its sublimation, this divine ability had become vastly more powerful.

Connected to the infinite power of the Star Sea, the sword rain fell endlessly without cease.

Every single raindrop contained the greatest destructive force that the Qiushui Sword could unleash.

Boom, boom, boom, boom!

Even with the Immortal Puppet Ancestor's combat instincts supporting him, allowing him to evade the overwhelming majority of the sword rain through constant shifts in movement, the sheer number of sword lights erupting in that instant was simply too great.

Countless points of light still exploded violently across Tianyang's Immortal body.

The protective field surrounding him trembled violently. Even the barrier capable of isolating the power of True Immortal seal script characters became increasingly unstable under the endless assault of Supreme Sword Qi.

Yet Tianyang's expression remained calm and indifferent.

Not the slightest trace of emotion appeared despite gradually falling into a disadvantage.

Then, a vertical eye suddenly opened upon the center of his forehead.

The third eye radiated a faint golden glow. It did not resemble anything of the mortal world, but instead seemed like the eye of an ancient desolate god.

Where its gaze fell, the endless rain froze in midair.

Tianyang released an unconscious roar as both hands formed a grasping motion before his chest.

The countless sword raindrops that Qiushui had transformed into were forcibly fused together by Tianyang in an instant, becoming a single sphere.

An invisible flame emerged from Tianyang's palms.

It seemed intent on burning the entire sphere of water into nothingness.

The little Daoist child Qiushui appeared in a panic from within the water sphere and hurriedly shouted toward Li Fan.

"Master, save me!"

Li Fan had merely wished to test Qiushui's true combat strength. He had no intention of destroying such a rare Supreme assistant.

With a thought, Tianyang, who was just about to deliver the finishing blow, paused slightly before finally stopping.

At the same time, Li Fan noticed that an extremely profound and indescribable aura disappeared from Tianyang's body.

Tianyang silently returned to Li Fan's side, while the little Daoist child Qiushui knelt on the ground and repeatedly kowtowed in gratitude, continuously praising, "Master is merciful."

Although Qiushui had been defeated by Tianyang, Li Fan was still highly satisfied with the strength he had displayed throughout the battle.

At the very least, Li Fan himself could not withstand that endless sword rain attack. His only option would have been to evade it.

As for why Tianyang had won so effortlessly, aside from the insights inherited from the Immortal Puppet Ancestor and the Thousand-Eyed Desolate God, the decisive factor had actually been the wisp of invisible flame Tianyang displayed at the end.

Judging from the little Daoist child Qiushui's extreme fear, this invisible flame truly possessed the ability to threaten his existence.

This immediately aroused Li Fan's curiosity.

After all, once connected to the infinite power of the Star Sea, even Li Fan himself could only destroy the Qiushui Sword by assuming the Shape of Living Beings. No other divine ability or spell could inflict any real damage upon it.

Yet this invisible flame had accomplished what even Li Fan could not.

Li Fan immediately questioned Tianyang about it.

Unexpectedly, Tianyang's answer consisted of only two words.

"I don't know."

Li Fan frowned slightly. After further questioning, he finally understood.

The invisible flame appeared naturally whenever Tianyang entered a state of pure combat consciousness. As for its underlying principles or how it was activated, Tianyang himself had absolutely no idea.

That pure combat consciousness originated from the inheritance of the Immortal Puppet Ancestor.

Once activated, all distracting thoughts vanished. His mind faintly resonated with the Great Dao of Heaven and Earth, relying entirely on instinct to launch relentless attacks until the target was dead.

"Instinct..."

Li Fan gradually formed a suspicion.

"It must be inseparable from the Eternal Remnant Will."

"I never expected the Eternal Remnant Will could also be used as a divine ability to injure others. As expected of an existence capable of resonating with the Great Dao."

Li Fan pondered it carefully for a while, feeling somewhat regretful.

Although he had long known that the Eternal Remnant Will possessed an extraordinarily high level, aside from having [Truth] actively absorb it, he had still found no way to comprehend or utilize it himself.

"Come to think of it, the seeds I planted in this life should finally be ready to blossom and bear fruit."

After instructing Qiushui to continue learning from "Second Master" Tianyang, Li Fan flashed away and arrived inside the Dao Lecture Platform.

With a gentle wave of his hand, the enormous eye formed from the simulated Heavenly Mandate immediately projected the figures of Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi.

In this life, after discovering that these two "Sincere Seekers of the Dao" might possess beliefs that represented the budding sprouts of the Eternal Remnant Will, Li Fan had secretly made numerous arrangements.

His goal was to nurture those sprouts, perhaps even giving birth to genuine Eternal Remnant Will.

Thus, the two brothers, whose cultivation paths had already been filled with hardship and who in previous reincarnations had once fought to the death over nothing more than a Nascent Soul cultivation technique, suffered even more tragic experiences in this life.

Over the years, they had wandered everywhere searching for cultivation methods beyond Foundation Establishment.

It could not be said they had gained nothing.

However, every single time they discovered something valuable within an ancient cave dwelling, a Nascent Soul cultivator would suddenly descend from the heavens before their very eyes and forcibly snatch away their prize.

If it had happened only once or twice, Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi could barely have accepted it.

But the same thing had already happened nearly ten consecutive times.

The frustration in Kou Hong's heart had nearly reached its limit.

Every single time, he wanted to fight those Nascent Soul cultivators to the death.

Yet Dao Xuanzi, who still retained his rationality, always restrained him with all his strength.

Even clay figures possessed some measure of anger.

After the same thing happened yet again during their latest expedition, even Dao Xuanzi could no longer endure it.

The two brothers joined forces and launched a desperate attack against the suddenly appearing Nascent Soul cultivator.

The result was entirely predictable.

The two brothers were thoroughly humiliated.

However, their opponent did not kill them.

Instead, he deliberately revealed his own name before sneering disdainfully.

"You two pieces of trash. From now on, every time I see you, I'll beat you."

After saying that, he departed arrogantly.

Following that incident, Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi remained dispirited for quite some time.

Yet they truly deserved the title of Sincere Seekers of the Dao.

Before long, they recovered from the blow.

They even secretly swore that one day they would achieve success in cultivation and personally avenge themselves against that Nascent Soul cultivator.

To accomplish that goal, they even abandoned the principles they had always upheld.

They gave up their identities as independent cultivators and chose to join the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

From then onward, they no longer needed to risk their lives exploring the ruins of ancient sects.

Instead, they accepted commission after commission each day, slowly accumulating Immortal Alliance contribution points.

Living with extreme frugality, the two brothers finally gathered enough contribution points to exchange for a Golden Core cultivation technique.

The moment the contents of the technique transformed into streams of golden light and flowed into their minds, both Kou Hong and Daoist Xuan burst into tears.

Although they had barely entered the Golden Core realm, they remained far from achieving their goal of revenge.

The two brothers worked even harder, continuously accepting commissions to earn more contribution points.

However, the price of Nascent Soul cultivation techniques was on an entirely different level.

They routinely cost fifty or sixty thousand contribution points, leaving the two brothers utterly helpless.

Moreover, if they wished to avenge themselves successfully, the Nascent Soul cultivation technique they cultivated could not be mediocre.

Otherwise, even after reaching the Nascent Soul realm themselves, they might still be no match for their great enemy.

The powerful Nascent Soul techniques they desired all cost nearly one hundred thousand contribution points.

The astronomical price was enough to make anyone despair.

At first, the brothers silently continued saving.

But after some time, they carefully calculated both their income and expenses.

They discovered that it would take at least fifty-six years before they could finally exchange for a Nascent Soul cultivation technique.

And that was assuming absolutely nothing unexpected happened.

But how could a world like this ever be free of unexpected events?

To earn contribution points more quickly, they had to accept missions with a certain degree of danger. That also meant there was a high chance of being injured while completing them. Before reaching the Nascent Soul realm, without the constant regeneration provided by the power of a Cave Heaven, healing injuries was an extremely costly matter.

Unfortunately, the two of them had never been particularly lucky.

While carrying out missions, about three out of every ten would end with some unexpected accident. Although their lives were never truly in danger, they were almost always seriously injured. After deducting the cost of treatment, there was barely any profit left. If those accidents had not all been caused by natural disasters, calamities, or rampaging spirit beasts, with no trace of cultivator interference, the two of them would have suspected they had offended some great almighty who was deliberately toying with them.

Earning little was one thing. As long as they could save a little every day, they could still see hope.

But for some unknown reason, news of their astonishing bad luck somehow spread. The rumors became more and more outrageous. Some even claimed they had been afflicted by a mysterious curse, and that anyone associated with them would also suffer misfortune.

Gradually, no cultivators were willing to accompany them on missions anymore. Worse still, many mission publishers, fearing they would be implicated by the so called mysterious curse, specifically stated in their mission notices that Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi were forbidden from accepting the task.

Saving contribution points had become nothing more than an impossible dream.

Even after things had reached this point, the two brothers still refused to abandon their dream.

After discussing it together, they returned to their old profession of exploring ancient sect ruins.

Since the Tianxuan Mirror was responsible for purchasing recovered relics, they did not have to worry about being unable to sell anything they found.

It had to be said that after advancing to the Golden Core realm, their strength had increased tremendously. Combined with their many years of experience exploring ruins, they truly achieved impressive results after several expeditions.

Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi were overjoyed. They thought their luck had finally changed.

However, the two brothers were puzzled by one thing. The Tianxuan Mirror always offered purchase prices far below the market value. After subtracting the cost of all the supplies needed for each expedition, they ultimately failed to accumulate many contribution points.

Still, it was far better than slowly completing ordinary missions.

The two brothers remained optimistic.

Watching their contribution balance increase little by little each day filled them with a quiet sense of happiness.

Finally, after successfully exploring several small ruins in succession, without having any Nascent Soul great cultivators swoop in to steal the rewards, they found themselves only one step away from obtaining the Nascent Soul cultivation technique they had long desired.

The two decided that, while fortune still favored them, they might as well press on in one final expedition.

As long as they did not return completely empty handed, they would achieve their goal.

This final expedition was carried out with extreme caution.

It was as if the lifetime of bad luck that had plagued them had finally come to an end.

Based on their previous exchange experience, the harvest this time would be worth at least thirty thousand contribution points. The two brothers were on the verge of completely turning their lives around.

Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi forcibly suppressed the joy in their hearts, maintaining calm expressions as they hurried toward the nearest floating Heavenly City.

At the same time, they imagined the day in the near future when they would exchange for the Nascent Soul cultivation technique, find a Nascent Soul Cave Heaven, break through to the Nascent Soul realm, avenge themselves in glorious fashion, and finally hold their heads high.

The journey went smoothly. When they once again entered the Tianxuan Mirror and sold every ancient relic they had recovered from the ruins, receiving thirty thousand contribution points in return.

Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi finally let out long sighs of relief.

After crying tears of joy, they eagerly opened the cultivation technique exchange page, ready to make the purchase.

However, the Tianxuan Mirror's mechanical and emotionless voice exploded like thunder in the brothers' ears.

"What do you mean, insufficient contribution points?"

"We each clearly have over seventy thousand contribution points!" Kou Hong roared, his eyes bloodshot and nearly splitting apart. He breathed heavily, fists clenched so tightly that his fingernails dug deep into his flesh without him noticing. He only knew how to roar in fury.

"He has 73,246. I have 78,355. We earned every single one of those points through years of hard work and risking our lives. There is no way they could be gone..." Dao Xuanzi barely managed to remain calm as he stated the exact numbers, demanding that the Tianxuan Mirror verify them again.

Yet the cold sweat pouring from his forehead and his increasingly pale face completely revealed the panic within his heart.

The Tianxuan Mirror did not remain silent for long.

Its reply soon arrived.

"After verification, Kou Hong currently possesses 234 contribution points. Dao Xuanzi currently possesses 264 contribution points."

"The detailed sources of these contribution points are as follows."

"There are no other records."

"Repeating..."

That icy voice echoed endlessly in the brothers' ears like the pronouncement of a death sentence.

Even Dao Xuanzi could no longer remain composed.

He stared blankly at the records displayed by the Tianxuan Mirror.

He discovered that their contribution records had reverted to the very first day they joined the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

All the blood, sweat, and years of effort they had spent accumulating contribution points had simply vanished into nothingness.

Dao Xuanzi felt a wave of dizziness.

'Could it be... that everything was just an illusion?'

But Kou Hong's furious roar immediately jolted him awake.

Their Golden Core cultivation was undeniably real.

The thirty thousand contribution points they had just earned were also undeniably real.

If that was the case, then how could the memories of the past several years possibly be false?

"You swallowed our contribution points! You stole the rewards we earned with our blood and sweat!"

"Give them back!"

Dao Xuanzi's expression also became twisted with rage.

The Tianxuan Mirror simply continued repeating its cold response.

The two brothers finally broke down completely and actually launched an attack against the Tianxuan Mirror.

After issuing several warnings to no effect, the Tianxuan Mirror directly expelled them.

The miserable state of Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi naturally attracted the attention of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators.

But no matter how desperately they cried and pleaded, claiming that the Tianxuan Mirror, which had never once made a mistake, had swallowed all the contribution points they had painstakingly accumulated.

Coupled with the fact that they were already infamous as the unlucky duo.

Naturally, not a single person believed them.

Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi cried until tears of blood streamed down their faces, only to find nothing but cold indifference surrounding them.

Having finally accepted reality, they stopped making a scene.

Their memories of everything that had happened since joining the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance replayed one by one in their minds.

It all felt like nothing more than a dream.

"Let's go."

Kou Hong gritted his teeth as he spoke.

Chapter 1380: Secrets Hidden Within The Nether Prison

"That Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance really devours people without even spitting out the bones!"

Thinking of how the more than seventy thousand contribution points he had painstakingly accumulated had vanished into nothing, Kou Hong's eyes turned bloodshot as a piercing pain gripped his heart.

"How were we so blind back then that we chose to join the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance?"

Even Dao Xuanzi, who had always been the calmer of the two, could no longer steady his state of mind.

"We're defecting to the Five Elders Association. We must make the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance pay the price!"

Having reached an agreement, the two quietly departed from the Immortal Alliance Heavenly City and headed toward the territory of the Five Elders Association.

However, they had forgotten one fact.

Although the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance publicly claimed that it did not restrict the personal freedom of its members, and even did not forbid members from withdrawing and joining the Five Elders Association instead.

Everything they had obtained from the Immortal Alliance had to be returned.

Thus, the moment the two showed signs of defecting, a Nascent Soul cultivator from the Guardian Hall began pursuing them.

Sensing the powerful aura behind them, Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi's expressions changed slightly.

Even after increasing their speed, the vast gulf in cultivation between them could not be overcome. It was not long before the other party intercepted them.

"If you wish to join the Five Elders Association, I do not care. But the two Golden Core cultivation techniques you exchanged for must be returned."

"One is the Thousand Dragon Transformation. The other is the Mind Rebirth Sword Art."

The Nascent Soul Guardian spoke calmly.

Hearing this, Kou Hong nearly coughed up blood. His entire body trembled as he pointed at the man and cursed.

"What kind of absurd logic is this? Our contribution points disappeared for no reason, and nobody cared. Fine, we endured that. But now you're even taking back the cultivation techniques we exchanged with the contribution points we earned through hard work?"

The Nascent Soul Guardian sneered.

"All cultivation techniques of the Immortal Alliance belong to the Immortal Alliance. What you exchanged for was merely the right to use them. Since you clearly intend to defect to the Five Elders Association, should we simply allow you to strengthen the enemy? Sparing your miserable lives is already the Alliance showing mercy."

Upon hearing these words, Kou Hong let out a furious roar.

The resentment trapped within his chest could no longer be suppressed, and he spat out a mouthful of blood.

"Flame Dragon's Wrath!"

A crimson flood dragon instantly appeared across the heavens.

Wrapped in blazing flames of terrifying heat, it coiled around the Nascent Soul Guardian.

The brothers fought as one. Kou Hong struck without hesitation, and Dao Xuanzi immediately followed.

With a single thought, more than thirty transparent sword shadows suddenly appeared in the sky.

Each seemed to have come from a different era, weathered and decayed by time itself.

The sword shadows howled through the air, carrying with them an aura of age and frost that seemed capable of freezing even space itself.

The Nascent Soul Guardian raised an eyebrow, seemingly surprised that the two could unleash such power.

"What a pity," he thought to himself.

"The rules of the Immortal Alliance cannot be violated."

Facing the combined assault of Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi, the Guardian merely let out a cold laugh.

High above, the phantom of a Cave Heaven resembling a black sun suddenly emerged.

The blazing flames surrounding the crimson flood dragon were extinguished in an instant.

As for the more than thirty sword shadows, they could no longer even maintain their own balance.

Completely beyond their control, they all flew toward the black circular Cave Heaven in the sky.

The moment they entered the Cave Heaven, not the slightest ripple remained.

The gap between the Golden Core Realm and the Nascent Soul Realm was simply too great.

Although Kou Hong and Dao Xuanzi had enjoyed a measure of fortune, they were ultimately still ordinary cultivators among the countless living beings beneath heaven. They possessed no heaven-defying opportunity capable of bridging such an overwhelming disparity.

"Since you refuse to come to your senses, then don't blame me, Chu, for showing no mercy."

The black circular Cave Heaven descended from above, preparing to suppress the two brothers completely.

Under the pressure of a Nascent Soul cultivator, their entire bodies were immobilized.

Unable to move, they could only watch helplessly as death approached.

At that moment, a trace of determination flashed through Dao Xuanzi's eyes.

"Daoxuan!"

A crisp, cold shout suddenly rang out.

A rust-covered ancient longsword appeared before Dao Xuanzi, its tip aimed directly at the Nascent Soul Guardian of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

A trace of surprise flashed through the Guardian's eyes.

Countless points of light suddenly erupted from Dao Xuanzi's body.

Like stars filling the night sky, they flickered briefly before rushing together into the Daoxuan Sword.

The countless starlike lights restored the decayed sword.

At that moment, Dao Xuanzi and the Daoxuan Sword became one.

The peerless divine weapon from the ancient age finally revealed its true form.

"Run!"

Dao Xuanzi's voice echoed in Kou Hong's ears.

The next instant, Kou Hong saw a dazzling sword light that seemed capable of splitting heaven and earth apart.

Amid a deafening explosion, the black circular Cave Heaven emitted a soft white radiance before shattering inch by inch.

The Daoxuan Sword, however, continued forward without losing any momentum.

Using the final moments of its existence, it continued flying toward the direction of the Immortal Alliance Heavenly City.

"Dao Xuanzi!"

With the Nascent Soul Cave Heaven destroyed, Kou Hong regained the ability to move.

His eyes filled with tears as grief overwhelmed his heart.

He knew Dao Xuanzi had sacrificed his own life to save him.

After the death of the Nascent Soul Guardian, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance would undoubtedly dispatch even stronger pursuers.

Knowing he could not remain, Kou Hong merely wiped away his tears before racing toward the territory of the Five Elders Association.

"Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance..."

He ground his teeth in hatred.

"Just you wait."

"I will become stronger."

"I will have my revenge."

The flames of vengeance burned fiercely within Kou Hong's eyes.

Just as he was about to cross the border.

A streak of light suddenly shot across the sky, piercing straight through his body.

"..."

Kou Hong opened his mouth as if to speak.

But no words ever came out.

His head flew from his shoulders as blood gushed like a fountain.

Only then did the streak of light reveal its true form.

It was a longsword that flowed like water.

One sword strike had severed his head.

A young cultivator dressed in the black robes of the Guardian Hall slowly revealed himself.

"Couldn't even deal with two mere Golden Core cultivators. What a bunch of trash. They deserved to die."

The young cultivator spat disdainfully before no longer sparing Kou Hong's corpse another glance.

"Strange. Where did that ancient sword disappear to? And those contribution points vanishing for no reason... It really may be a scheme by the Five Elders Association."

Muttering to himself, the young cultivator disappeared.

A long time later.

Kou Hong's head, which had rolled onto the ground with its eyes still wide open in death, gradually crumbled like grains of sand and scattered into the wind.

Only a dragon-shaped branch embedded between his brows remained behind.

Li Fan's figure quietly appeared.

With a casual wave of his hand, the dragon-shaped branch flew into his grasp.

Faintly, endless unwilling roars could still be heard coming from within the branch.

Li Fan frowned slightly as he quietly observed the reaction of the [Truth].

After waiting for a while, he sighed softly.

"It does not possess such a strong appetite for devouring."

"It seems my assumptions were still too simplistic."

"However, this fragment of lingering will is not entirely useless."

With that thought, Li Fan forcibly fed it to the [Truth].

The dragon-shaped branch in his hand slowly disappeared.

At the very same moment, countless blurry images suddenly flashed rapidly through Li Fan's mind.

"This is..."

Li Fan frowned.

There was no doubt that these fleeting scenes were produced after the [Truth] devoured Kou Hong's lingering will.

Although Kou Hong's lingering will had not yet reached the level necessary to form an Eternal Remnant Will, it was barely sufficient to become food for the [Truth].

Previously, whenever the [Truth] devoured an Eternal Remnant Will, a new ability would be born.

But this time, these rapidly flashing images appeared instead.

What exactly did they represent?

The fragmented scenes vanished like sudden inspiration.

Even for Li Fan, capturing them proved extremely difficult.

Standing motionless, he carefully contemplated them for a long time before finally reaching a tentative conclusion.

His expression became rather strange.

"They appear to be... events I experienced before this lifetime?"

"What does that mean?"

Li Fan could not understand.

Yet an instinctive sense of unease quietly arose within his heart.

No matter how much he pondered, however, he could not determine the source of that unease.

In the end, he could only commit it to memory for the time being.

While his emotions gradually settled, another incomparably sharp longsword appeared in Li Fan's hand.

It was the Daoxuan Sword, formed from Dao Xuanzi's final desperate strike.

A weapon with barely enough power to kill a Nascent Soul cultivator naturally did not interest Li Fan. What truly intrigued him was the sword's origin.

From it, he sensed a faintly familiar aura.

Long ago, Li Fan had absorbed the Heavenly Treasure known as the Rusted Daoxuan Sword. However, after countless years of being eroded and transformed by the world itself, that Daoxuan Sword had become vastly different from its original form. As a result, even after encountering matters related to it later, Li Fan had never recalled its true origin.

But in this life, perhaps because it had been nurtured for so many years, combined with Dao Xuanzi's exceptionally compatible innate Sword Dao constitution, despite possessing only Golden Core cultivation, he had actually restored the Daoxuan Sword to its original perfect state.

"So it is a relic of the Heavenly Sword Sect."

Li Fan sighed softly. With a casual point of his finger, the Sword Dao Laws of the Xuanhuang Realm transformed into countless glowing threads that poured into the Daoxuan Sword, whose unstable body was on the verge of shattering at any moment.

The sword gradually stabilized. Li Fan then reinforced it using the Art of Formation Refinement.

In the end, this ancient Daoxuan Sword was reborn. Not only had its power not diminished, it had become even stronger than before.

The Heavenly Sword Sect, once one of the Ten Great Immortal Sects, had long since torn through the world boundary and departed.

Only countless broken swords remained within the Sword Tomb ruins.

"The Heavenly Sword Sect..."

Li Fan had once attempted to use those broken swords together with the Reveal character seal script to trace whether the Heavenly Sword Sect had truly escaped successfully.

Unfortunately, under the illumination of the Reveal character, although every broken sword emitted a thread of light, they all pointed toward the Wooden Sword, Heavenly Wonder, at the center of the Sword Tomb.

Now, however, this restored Daoxuan Sword gave Li Fan an entirely new idea.

Silently, the [Reveal] Character appeared.

It enveloped the reborn Daoxuan Sword.

In an instant, three streams of light flew out from the sword.

The thickest stream soared into the heavens like a dragon emerging from the sea, then scattered in every direction before dissipating into heaven and earth.

Another stream flew toward Li Fan.

The final stream, the thinnest of all, drifted toward a certain location within the Xuanhuang Realm.

"Hmm?"

Li Fan's attention was immediately captured.

"Could there still be descendants of the Heavenly Sword Sect within the Xuanhuang Realm?"

His interest was instantly piqued. Floating into the air, he quickly followed the thread of light created by the Reveal Character seal script.

The Reveal Character seal script revealed the connections between all things. Only the caster, or someone with profound understanding of the True Immortal seal script character [Reveal], could perceive these connections.

Thus, there was no concern that anyone else would notice the anomaly.

Following the thread of light, Li Fan arrived somewhere he had never expected.

The Immortal Alliance Nether Prison.

Having once infiltrated it in disguise, the Nether Prison's restrictions were practically nonexistent to Li Fan.

Watching the thread rapidly descend toward the deepest level, Li Fan followed it inside.

His expression gradually became rather subtle.

Because he saw that the thread of connection landed directly on the cultivator imprisoned at the very bottom of the Nether Prison.

"Strange..."

Li Fan had long known that such an individual was imprisoned beneath the Immortal Alliance Nether Prison.

Moreover, the first time he had seen him, he had vaguely felt a sense of familiarity.

Now, connecting that feeling with the Daoxuan Sword's reaction under the Reveal Character seal script, Li Fan finally confirmed his earlier suspicion.

"A descendant of the Heavenly Sword Sect?"

The imprisoned cultivator's eyebrows and facial features bore a striking resemblance to Situ Yao, the former Senior Brother of the Heavenly Sword Sect.

However, the prisoner had already become little more than a living skeleton, making the resemblance only faintly discernible.

Furthermore, similar-looking people were hardly uncommon, so Li Fan had never been certain.

Now, however, his judgment had been confirmed.

"It seems I should trust my intuition more."

"Situ Yao's descendant? Interesting. If I remember correctly, before the Heavenly Sword Sect departed, this Senior Brother of the Heavenly Sword Sect never had any descendants."

"Could it be..."

Li Fan's heart trembled.

He immediately prepared to rescue the man and question him thoroughly.

However, upon closer inspection, Li Fan discovered that the methods used to imprison this descendant of the Heavenly Sword Sect had actually been personally carried out by the Heavenly Doctor.

Had he not secretly learned them from the illusion formation in this life, Li Fan would not even have recognized them.

"Without the proper method to remove the seal, forcing it open will certainly attract the Heavenly Doctor's attention."

"The Xuanhuang Realm's ascension has already reached its final critical stage..."

Under normal circumstances, Li Fan would have simply waited until the next life, when his strength had increased dramatically.

But because he had previously glimpsed the Heavenly Doctor's secrets within the illusion formation, he did not give up immediately.

Instead, he attempted to unravel the seal.

It proved even easier than he had expected.

Apparently, the Heavenly Doctor had never attached much importance to this man. The seal itself was not particularly complicated.

Its primary function was merely to drain all the spiritual energy from his body and suppress him.

After expending considerable effort, Li Fan finally removed the seal.

To avoid alarming the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, he also left behind an illusion that continued to depict the prisoner as still being sealed.

Li Fan quietly brought the emaciated descendant of the Heavenly Sword Sect out of the Immortal Alliance Nether Prison.

They arrived at an empty and deserted place. Just as Li Fan was about to question him, a flash of golden light suddenly erupted from his hand.

The man instantly broke free from Li Fan's restraint.

Transforming into a streak of golden light, he fled toward the horizon.

In the blink of an eye, he had already disappeared from sight.

This greatly exceeded Li Fan's expectations. Instead of being alarmed, he was delighted.

Although the descendant of the Heavenly Sword Sect was astonishingly fast, how could he possibly outrun Li Fan?

The phantom of the Wooden Sword left its sheath.

The next moment, Li Fan had already caught up.

With a single slap, he trapped the man once more.

This time, no matter how the golden light darted and twisted, it could not escape.

Li Fan had already laid down an Immortal Formation around the area.

"Hmm?!"

Seeing that further attempts were futile, the golden light dispersed and revealed his true form.

Within this short span of time, he had already recovered somewhat from his skeletal appearance.

At least he now retained a human form, though he still appeared extremely frail.

"Many thanks, Senior, for saving my life."

The man carefully cupped his fists in salute.

"Why did you run?" Li Fan asked coldly.

"I was imprisoned for far too long. The moment I saw an opportunity to escape, I simply could not help myself." The man smiled bitterly as he explained.

Li Fan could not be bothered to question him further.

He immediately pressed his left hand onto the man's head, intending to directly use the Soul Search Technique.

The man's body shook violently as though struck by lightning. His already frail body trembled uncontrollably.

Countless memories poured into Li Fan's mind.

Yet Li Fan frowned deeply.

The Soul Search proceeded smoothly, but...

He found absolutely nothing in the man's memories related to the Heavenly Sword Sect.

Chapter 1381: Hunting Ink Death In The Present

From the soul search, Li Fan learned that the man before him was named Qin Zhuang.

He had originally been the strongest being in the Changyang Small World of the Xuanhuang Realm.

The Changyang Small World itself possessed no spiritual energy. Only a peculiar blazing sun hung high in the heavens, illuminating the world. Daylight occupied three quarters of every day, and its duration continued to grow longer, as though it intended to scorch and devour every living thing beneath heaven and earth.

Qin Zhuang began as an ordinary mortal. He continuously absorbed the energy of Changyang and developed the hidden potential of his body. After ninety-nine years of cultivation, he completely fused the blazing sun in the sky into himself.

From that day onward, Changyang lost its sun and fell into eternal night.

Just as Qin Zhuang had decided to leave the small world, a mysterious figure came to find him. Qin Zhuang believed his divine strength was capable of destroying heaven and earth, yet before this person, he could not even withstand a few exchanges. After suffering a crushing defeat, the mysterious figure revealed to him the truth about the Xuanhuang Realm, mortals, and the small worlds. He also invited Qin Zhuang to join the allied army in its campaign against the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

Qin Zhuang was deeply impressed by the other's bearing and strength and gladly accepted.

What followed was a magnificent and earthshaking war.

This counteroffensive launched by the small worlds was far from the effortless, overwhelming victory recorded in the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's history.

At the beginning, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance suffered repeated defeats and could only retreat into the Central Four Prefectures, barely surviving.

In the end, one of the Dharma-Transmitters sought help from the Immortal Ancestor. Countless golden threads descended like rain from beyond the starry sky, completely crushing the allied army.

The allied forces were defeated and scattered in every direction. As one of their commanders, Qin Zhuang was suppressed forever in the deepest level of the Nether Prison.

...

Li Fan carefully savored the memories of the man before him.

At first glance, there seemed to be no flaws. Everything originated from the deepest imprints within his soul. Yet Li Fan instinctively sensed something was wrong.

It was not that the memories were fabricated. In truth, the Changyang World in its eternal night state did indeed exist. Li Fan had even personally visited it.

'The problem lies in the mismatch between this body and those memories. It feels as though someone seized another's body and occupied the magpie's nest.'

Having done similar things many times himself, Li Fan immediately detected the anomaly.

Although it was only an instinctive feeling, he trusted his own judgment.

'Since soul searching is useless, I will have to try another method.'

Thinking this, Li Fan casually threw the exhausted "Qin Zhuang," who had nearly collapsed from the soul search, onto the ground.

Qin Zhuang appeared to be on the verge of death. Yet a moment later, he transformed into a streak of golden light and once again shot toward the outside of the Xuanhuang Realm. This time, he was several times faster than before. A faint trace of crimson could be seen within the golden light, showing that Qin Zhuang was risking his life.

The outcome, however, remained unchanged.

The phantom Wooden Sword flashed.

Li Fan caught him once again and hurled him heavily back onto the ground.

"Senior, spare my life. Senior, spare my life..."

Qin Zhuang finally revealed genuine fear as he repeatedly begged for mercy.

"What is your relationship with Situ Yao of the Heavenly Sword Sect?" Li Fan suddenly asked without any warning.

"Hmm? This junior has no idea what Senior is talking about..." Qin Zhuang answered cautiously with a bewildered expression.

Yet the fleeting change in Qin Zhuang's expression at the moment he heard the question naturally could not escape Li Fan's eyes.

Having obtained the answer he wanted, Li Fan wasted no more words. He pressed a finger against Qin Zhuang's forehead.

The Bewildering Illusion Formation enveloped Qin Zhuang.

Li Fan attempted to use the illusion world generated by the formation to glimpse Qin Zhuang's true past.

However, this method, which had worked even on the Heavenly Doctor, failed completely this time.

Within the illusion, Qin Zhuang's every action perfectly matched the logic expected of the strongest expert of the Changyang World. The illusion evolved dozens of different possibilities, yet every outcome remained exactly the same.

Even Li Fan began to question his own judgment.

As Qin Zhuang gradually regained consciousness within the illusion, the fear in his eyes toward Li Fan only deepened.

He hesitated as though he wished to speak.

Yet it was precisely this trace of fear that eliminated Li Fan's doubts.

Instead, it convinced him that Qin Zhuang was hiding an enormous secret.

Li Fan saw clearly that Qin Zhuang's fear stemmed from his worry that this secret would be exposed.

If he truly were only Qin Zhuang of the small world, after every detail of his life had already been exposed, the fear he displayed now would never be like this.

'It seems there is some restriction or secret technique from beyond the High Wall protecting the deepest secrets of his soul. Ordinary methods simply cannot reach them.'

Understanding this, Li Fan looked meaningfully at Qin Zhuang.

"No matter. Let me see just how long you can endure."

Li Fan possessed abundant experience in prying open someone's mouth.

He separated a simulated personality specifically for interrogation and torture.

Then he imprisoned Qin Zhuang within himself and gave him a very thorough welcome.

'Perhaps it is not that he refuses to speak. Perhaps he simply cannot. Either way, let him suffer for a while first.'

Li Fan narrowed his eyes. Watching Qin Zhuang screaming endlessly within that personal hell, his expression remained utterly indifferent.

"Beyond the High Wall..."

After a while, he raised his head toward the heavens beyond the Xuanhuang Realm and fell into deep thought.

From all the clues he had gathered in the past, since the day the great catastrophe descended, a group of refugees had fled the Xuanhuang Realm. Some of them had even likely crossed the High Wall and escaped into the Darkest Star Sea beyond.

"The Ten Great Immortal Sects, including the Heavenly Sword Sect, the demon race of Nanming Sacred Beast Mountain, and Shang Immortal Ark."

"Those are only the ones already known. The Star Sea is vast, and there are countless cultivation worlds. There must certainly have been other fortunate survivors."

"But among all of them, Qin Zhuang seems to be the only one who has returned."

Naturally, Li Fan had no intention of letting him go.

The reaction of the Star Sea origin consciousness when the Xuan Immortal Ark broke through the High Wall had filled Li Fan with deep unease. His vigilance toward what lay beyond the High Wall had reached an unprecedented level.

"But most fear comes from the unknown. If I can uncover even a little information..."

"That depends on how much Qin Zhuang can endure."

Setting the matter aside for the moment, Li Fan began making the final preparations before promoting the Xuanhuang Realm.

The first task was to rehearse the hunt for Ink Death.

Li Fan was now eighty percent confident that he could successfully promote the Xuanhuang Realm into an Immortal Domain.

However, how to eliminate the Spirit of Heaven and Earth, Ink Death, in the shortest possible time still required careful consideration.

Ink Death had always been among the strongest Spirit of Heaven and Earth within the Xuanhuang Realm. After the world's ascension, its strength would certainly increase accordingly.

"But regardless of how much it changes, its essence remains that of a Spirit of Heaven and Earth."

"As long as I know its attributes and weaknesses, I can deal with it accordingly."

After pondering for a while, Li Fan arrived at the Congyun Sea.

He separated a strand of divine sense and sent it toward Ten Thousand Immortals Island.

At the same moment, Hong Xi, the Island Lord of Ten Thousand Immortals Island and a Soul Transformation cultivator, suddenly sensed something and looked toward the sky.

"A Spirit of Heaven and Earth!"

Greed instantly arose within his heart.

Ordinarily, with Hong Xi's cautious personality, he would certainly have gathered several trusted companions to plan together. He might even have invited several Dao Integration Immortal Sages to oversee the operation.

But this time...

"If word leaks out and everyone comes to compete for it, then no one knows who will ultimately obtain the Spirit of Heaven and Earth."

"I have cultivated in seclusion for many years. It is merely a Spirit of Heaven and Earth."

"I alone am enough to slay it."

A trace of pride appeared in Hong Xi's eyes.

Seven days later, after believing he had made sufficient preparations, Hong Xi began hunting the Spirit of Heaven and Earth, Crimson Flame.

This Spirit of Heaven and Earth, capable of burning mountains and boiling seas, turned out to be little more than an empty shell. Under Hong Xi's relentless attacks, it retreated again and again.

The longer the battle continued, the braver Hong Xi became. Every technique he had cultivated throughout his life was unleashed to its fullest, and he fought with exhilarating freedom.

Finally, after an entire day of battle, he completely slew Crimson Flame.

A new Dao Integration Immortal Sage was born above the Congyun Sea.

Standing proudly in the sky, Hong Xi felt the unprecedented power surging through his body, his heart overflowing with excitement.

His mind was filled with fantasies of the wonderful life that awaited him.

Then suddenly, for no apparent reason, his heart skipped a beat.

Cold sweat poured down his back, as though he had just walked through the gates of death.

Hong Xi abruptly turned around and scanned his surroundings.

The world was silent. White clouds drifted lazily across the clear sky. Yet nothing had happened.

Unable to make sense of it, Hong Xi thought it was simply a normal phenomenon after reaching Dao Integration.

He no longer paid it any attention.

What he did not know was that he had truly come within a hair's breadth of death.

Had Li Fan not intervened to stop Inkslaughter, he would already have perished.

Within the Great Xuan Lecture Platform.

Li Fan looked at the ever-expanding mass of blackness that continued to multiply despite being wrapped by countless golden threads. A trace of solemnity flashed across his face.

"As expected of Ink Death."

"It can even corrupt source power essence, a force approaching the immortal level."

"And turn it into its own strength." After studying it for a while, Li Fan could not help but praise it.

After Crimson Flame had been executed, Ink Death, which had descended under orders, had not been destroyed by Li Fan.

Instead, it had been imprisoned and studied.

Li Fan could not help recalling the Heavenly Doctor's guidance regarding the Great Five Elements Annihilation Sword within the illusion formation.

'True annihilation does not exist within the world's own cycle. So called annihilation merely exists to pave the way for rebirth. If you wish to touch true destruction, you must venture into the depths of the Star Sea...'

Yet what Li Fan sensed from Ink Death completely contradicted the Heavenly Doctor's conclusion.

Li Fan had witnessed true annihilation before, and had even personally brought it about.

Naturally, he knew exactly what genuine destruction and absolute nothingness looked like.

What Ink Death produced was almost completely identical.

"It simply carries a few unique characteristics belonging to the Xuanhuang Realm itself." Li Fan pondered thoughtfully.

"Ink Death's power of annihilation is absolutely not something an ordinary cultivation world could produce."

"It is most likely a mechanism that has existed within the Xuanhuang Realm since the moment of its creation."

Li Fan extended one finger through the many layers of golden thread protection.

In an instant, the connection between his finger and the rest of his body was severed.

Moreover, the ink-like intent, writhing like countless crawling insects, attempted to exploit the broken connection and spread even further.

It sought to erode not only his body, but also his soul.

Like peeling a potato, Li Fan continuously shaved away layer after layer of both flesh and soul before finally isolating Ink Death completely.

"What terrifying aggression."

Li Fan frowned inwardly.

"And that feeling when the connection was suddenly cut..."

His expression became uncertain. After circulating the power within his body to restore what had been lost, he extended his index finger once more.

As expected, the finger was instantly swallowed by Ink Death again.

This time, however, Li Fan keenly noticed that Ink Death acted even faster than before.

"The degree of corruption has also deepened."

"Ink Death is learning and improving."

After once again completing the potato peeling style restoration, Li Fan finally withdrew his hand.

"My senses were not mistaken. The feeling of losing all connection after being swallowed by Ink Death is exactly the same as outside the High Wall."

"What exactly is going on?"

Li Fan's brows remained tightly furrowed, countless doubts filling his mind.

Unable to reach any conclusion after prolonged thought, Li Fan decided to first identify Ink Death's weakness.

"Theoretically speaking, the powers of life and death stand in opposition."

"If one wishes to counter Ink Death, then one would require boundless vitality."

With a thought, Li Fan arrived at the great fissure beneath the Star Sea.

He drew upon the vitality contained within it and poured it into the imprisoned Ink Death.

Unexpectedly, however, this vitality seemed to serve only as nourishment for Inkslaughter.

The black mass suddenly surged violently.

The countless golden threads sealing it instantly became dangerously unstable.

Fortunately, several layers of immortal formations still stood beyond the golden threads.

Li Fan calmly added another layer of golden threads, reinforcing the seal.

After charging furiously for a while without breaking free, Ink Death seemed to abandon its struggle.

It no longer expanded outward. Instead, it began shrinking inward.

The blackness grew increasingly concentrated, gradually becoming as deep and unfathomable as the Darkest Star Sea itself.

A mysterious and indescribable aura slowly emerged from within Inkslaughter.

Li Fan's pupils contracted sharply.

"This is..."

Within the golden outlined humanoid void, Li Fan actually sensed an aura remarkably similar to the black mist at the center of the Star Sea.

"The Dao Annihilation Calamity?!"

His heart shook violently. Almost instinctively, Li Fan immediately doubled the protective measures.

At the same time, countless thoughts flashed through his mind.

"I previously speculated that the Xuanhuang Realm was likely created by the Immortal Realm as an experimental ground to discover a solution to the Dao Annihilation Calamity."

"But I could never determine what that solution actually was."

"However, if Ink Death is merely a weakened version of the Dao Annihilation Calamity..."

"The Dao Annihilation Calamity merged into the Xuanhuang Realm itself, becoming part of the world's natural laws as heaven and earth continued to evolve."

"When Ink Death strikes, all things under heaven are reduced to absolute nothingness."

"But afterward..."

Several scenes suddenly flashed before Li Fan's eyes.

They were the images from long ago, after Ink Death had extinguished the world, when life unexpectedly reappeared within the absolute void.

"Ink Death's annihilation is absolute, yet life can still be reborn."

"This is the Xuanhuang Realm's own evolved power of resistance."

A sudden realization filled Li Fan's heart.

The way he looked at Ink Death changed completely.

"I was mistaken."

"Although Ink Death manifests as annihilation, its true essence is still the Spirit of Heaven and Earth of the Xuanhuang Realm."

"And since it is the Spirit of Heaven and Earth..."

Li Fan gently pointed toward the center of the humanoid mass of blackness.

"Xuanhuang World Destruction Transformation!"

In an instant, it was no longer merely a single transformation.

Instead, every possible transformation that the Xuanhuang Realm would evolve in a single instant when facing extinction descended simultaneously upon the concentrated blackness.

Countless vortices seemed to appear at once as the black mass churned violently.

Under Li Fan's guidance, countless transformations were actually born from the void itself.

Brilliant rainbow colors emerged from the depths of the black abyss.

Even Li Fan, the creator of this phenomenon, had never expected such a result.

Watching Ink Death's power continuously transform into countless other world destroying transformations, while Ink Death itself gradually weakened and died during the conversion, Li Fan's expression became deeply contemplative.

Only when the blackness was on the verge of completely disappearing did Li Fan withdraw his divine ability, absorbing all of the Xuanhuang World Destruction Transformations into his own body.

"Destruction is the ancestor of life."

"Life is the path of destruction."

"So this... is the contingency plan for overcoming the Dao Annihilation Calamity?"
