Chapter 1382: The Death Of Li Fan Once Before

Li Fan's thoughts surged, but his hands never stopped moving.

He separated the countless Xuanhuang World Destruction Transformations from Inl Death's true body.

Each of these transformations was capable of giving birth to a Soul Transformation cultivator of the Xuanhuang Realm with considerable strength.

"Though they are called world destruction, they are actually transformations of life."

"I can collect them first. Even if the Xuanhuang Realm ascends into an Immortal Realm in the future, as long as I release them all at once, I can throw the entire Xuanhuang Realm into chaos in an instant."

As Li Fan thought this, golden threads shot through the air, forming layer after layer of seals that wrapped around the many world destruction transformations and suppressed them within his body.

"As for Ink Death..."

Li Fan's expression became solemn once more.

The black shadow, which had previously been consumed until only a tiny black speck remained, had completely recovered after only a brief moment of respite.

Without pause, it continued eroding everything around it.

"One is all. As expected of a weakened, preliminary version of the Dao Annihilation Calamity. Unless it is completely destroyed, even if only a single trace remains, it will soon return."

Li Fan recalled everything he had learned about Ink Death.

Ink Death rarely appeared, but every time it did, it shook heaven and earth and annihilated an entire prefecture.

Even when the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Five Elders Association detected Ink Death's appearance, they would choose to avoid it and allow it to rampage freely.

"Those five old turtles may have already realized how extraordinary Ink Death truly is. It is far beyond an ordinary Spirit of Heaven and Earth."

"Ink Death has fused into the laws of the Xuanhuang Realm itself, giving the world a kind of resistance through compatibility. Even after annihilating everything, life will ultimately reappear."

"If that is truly the case, then does it not mean that once the Xuanhuang Realm ascends into an Immortal Realm, it will possess the power to resist the Dao Annihilation Calamity?"

Li Fan's heart suddenly stirred.

"I imagine this was exactly how the True Immortals designed it. Of course, whether it truly succeeds or not still depends on what happens in this era."

After much contemplation, and after repeatedly testing Ink Death until he gradually understood its various properties, Li Fan brought it to the center of the Star Sea, near the sea of black mist.

The surging black mist steadily devoured the surrounding Star Sea.

The Star Sea's consciousness remained oblivious, but Li Fan frowned deeply as the endless sea of black mist became increasingly terrifying.

Although Ink Death remained bound beneath countless layers of golden threads, the moment it sensed the nearby black mist, it instantly became far more active.

Previously, it had remained tightly contracted, quietly waiting for an opportunity to break free.

Now, however, it charged wildly in every direction, recklessly slamming against the golden threads in an attempt to escape.

"Just as I thought."

A flash of light appeared in Li Fan's eyes.

After confirming that Ink Death truly possessed some connection to the Dao Annihilation Calamity, he noticed that, being so close to the sea of black mist, the sealed Ink Death seemed to be drawing some form of energy from it.

Li Fan did not dare remain there any longer and immediately departed.

He returned Ink Death to the Xuanhuang Realm, within the Congyun Sea.

Since he intended to let it evolve into a Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth before using it for Dao Integration, Li Fan naturally had no intention of killing it now.

The moment Ink Death escaped its restraints, it searched throughout heaven and earth for the enemy who had imprisoned it, but found nothing.

With no target for its rage, it vented all of its fury upon Hong Xi and the Congyun Sea.

Poor Hong Xi had only just completed Dao Integration and returned to Ten Thousand Immortals Island, where countless cultivators throughout the Congyun Sea were bowing in worship.

Suddenly, however, an expanse of black spread across the sky.

Everything was engulfed and swallowed.

Although Ink Death had only briefly come into contact with the sea of black mist, subtle changes had already begun taking place within it.

Not only Li Fan, but even the Xuanhuang Realm itself seemed to notice this transformation.

Ink Death did not complete its work of world annihilation.

After the Congyun Sea had been eroded until only a final thin layer of bedrock remained, Ink Death was forcibly recalled by the world's consciousness.

"It acts far more swiftly and violently than before."

"And..."

Li Fan flashed forward, arriving at the final remaining fragment of the Congyun Sea to inspect it carefully.

Although Ink Death had disappeared, a certain corrosive force still lingered.

It prevented the vitality of the Xuanhuang Realm from flourishing once more.

"This directly conflicts with the will of the Xuanhuang Realm. It dispatches Ink Death to exterminate everything precisely so complete assimilation can occur afterward. But now..."

Li Fan extended the index finger of his right hand and pressed it against the remaining bedrock of the Congyun Sea.

"Sizzle..."

The sound resembled flesh being burned by flames, yet also being dissolved by powerful acid.

The power of absolute nothingness that destroyed all things flowed through the point of contact, beginning to devour both Li Fan's body and soul.

It was exactly the same as when he had previously touched Ink Death.

"Even after the main body has been recalled, residual power remains."

"For a Spirit of Heaven and Earth, this is virtually impossible. Yet it has truly happened."

"Without even fully coming into contact with it, there are already signs that it is slipping out of control."

Li Fan chipped off a large piece of the remaining bedrock of the Congyun Sea and brought it back for further study.

The furrow in his brow only deepened.

After realizing Ink Death's possible true nature, the unease within Li Fan, born from the spontaneous simulation performed by [Truth], not only failed to diminish, but instead became even stronger.

He temporarily set aside everything else.

Out of habit, he arrived at the place where Jieli Mountain had once stood.

He sat cross-legged in the center of the Dao Lecture Platform and quietly contemplated.

"I should trust my instincts."

"I have never experienced such intense unease, not even after so many reincarnations."

"The source of this unease..."

"It should still be that inexplicable spontaneous simulation performed by [Truth]."

"Under normal circumstances, if I do not activate [Truth] myself, it should never begin a new simulation on its own."

"The Three-Pronged Tree left behind by Sun Piaomiao must absolutely involve resonance with a certain Great Dao, or perhaps even the Great Dao itself. Only after absorbing it did [Truth] undergo such a bizarre transformation."

"In reality, [Truth] spontaneously simulating a lifetime is not the frightening part."

"The truly terrifying part is that I retained absolutely no memory of it."

A shadow passed across Li Fan's face.

"Until now, every simulation performed by [Truth] has always been centered around me."

"Every reincarnation has been my own personal experience."

"And now, [Truth] is still completely merged with me, with no signs of losing control."

"So there is only one possibility."

"During that simulation, because of some unforeseen event..."

"I died."

A cold light flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

His body suddenly stiffened for a brief moment before he continued thinking.

"I did not even have time to activate [Truth] before I died."

"It was [Truth] itself that reversed everything."

"Therefore, the experiences of that lifetime exist only within [Truth] itself, and not within my own memories."

"Only after I consumed Kou Hong's nearly Eternal Remnant Will did [Truth] finally release those memories."

After deducing this conclusion, the unease within Li Fan unexpectedly lessened somewhat.

Although it had not completely disappeared, he had finally uncovered its possible cause.

"So..."

"I have already died once."

For the first time, an icy chill unlike anything before filled Li Fan's heart.

"So those vague memory fragments I learned through [Truth] did not happen in this lifetime."

"They happened in the lifetime where I died."

"And now, I am simply continuing along the original path."

"If I do not make any changes..."

"It ends in certain death!"

As though he had witnessed the scene of his own future demise, the tension in Li Fan's heart suddenly eased.

"In simple terms, after [Truth] absorbed the Three-Pronged Tree in this lifetime, it carried out a simulation. The simulated version of me never realized that a branch had occurred. He simply continued following the original plan, advancing the Xuanhuang Realm into an Immortal Domain and using the Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth to achieve Dao Integration."

"He never noticed the hidden danger. No matter how thoroughly he prepared, he still died and failed."

Li Fan slowly let out a long breath.

"The Three-Pronged Tree truly is a divine treasure. Without this advance simulation, I would have followed the same path to failure."

"I wonder if [Truth] will still be willing to absorb it again in the next lifetime."

His thoughts quickly returned to the matter at hand.

If all of his deductions were correct, then a question directly related to his survival now stood before him.

What exactly had caused the simulated Li Fan's death?

The current Li Fan possessed Immortal formations and unparalleled escape techniques for protection.

He also had Tianyang and Qiushui, two Supreme Protectors.

Even if his Dao Integration plan failed, it should not have left him without even enough time for [Truth] to activate.

"In truth, there are not many things that can genuinely threaten me."

"Inside the High Wall are the True Immortal within the Immortal Ruins, the True Immortal corpse and survival instinct within the Dark Sea of Xuanhuang, and the black mist representing the Dao Annihilation Calamity."

"Outside the High Wall lies every unknown existence."

At this point, Li Fan paused before sudden realization flashed across his face.

"And one of the primary materials needed to elevate the Xuanhuang Realm into an Immortal Domain, the Immortal Domain fragment left behind by Sun Piaomiao."

After eliminating every other possibility, only these suspicious targets remained.

"The Dao Annihilation Calamity is a terrifying disaster that specifically targets the Immortal Realm. Although it has not yet fully descended and only the endless black mist has appeared, the moment I elevate Xuanhuang into an Immortal Domain, it may suddenly erupt."

"Even countless True Immortals of the past could not escape it. If I am caught unprepared, I will likely perish as well."

Li Fan identified this as the most probable cause of his failure.

"As for the one dead and one living True Immortal within the Dark Sea and the Immortal Ruins, the Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Formation should be able to hold them back for at least a brief moment."

"As for the forces beyond the High Wall, the High Wall itself serves as concealment. Judging from the experience of the previous lifetime, I should still have enough time to respond. But that is still not enough."

"The moment the High Wall collapses and the Star Sea falls into turmoil, I must stir up enormous waves throughout the Star Sea and obscure the sight of anything coming from outside."

Li Fan immediately thought of the endless vitality within the earth fissure and the Shape of Living Beings.

"The descent of the forces beyond the High Wall will inevitably pose an immense threat to the Star Sea itself. If I further amplify it with the Divine Technique of Taijia..."

"The infinite power of the Star Sea should be able to delay those outside forces for a brief moment."

After careful consideration, Li Fan added another series of preparations to his plans.

"Finally, there is the Immortal Domain formed from those many Go pieces."

"I previously attempted to fuse it. Even after more than halfway through the process, I never sensed the presence of any True Immortal within it. It appeared to be nothing more than a pure Immortal Domain."

"But thinking about it now, I was still somewhat careless."

Li Fan's expression became solemn.

"After all, we are dealing with a True Immortal. Concealing themselves from my perception would not be difficult."

"If I do not fully unfold the Immortal Domain, how can I confirm that it is truly safe?"

"At worst, I only waste one reincarnation and twenty or thirty years."

Having reached a decision, Li Fan no longer hesitated.

No matter what, he had to completely unfold the Immortal Domain contained within the Go pieces and verify its safety.

"The reappearance of an Immortal Domain will certainly shake the entire Star Sea."

"I must find a secure location and prepare in advance."

"If a True Immortal truly lies hidden within, then I will immediately activate [Truth]. In the next lifetime, I will search for another method to anchor the world's momentum."

"If there is nothing unusual inside, then all the better..."

Li Fan still wished to minimize the impact of unfolding the Immortal Domain.

"Using the lowest point of the basin to offset the height of the Immortal Domain."

"The earthly fissure basin, the lowest point of the Star Sea, should be the ideal location."

"Moreover, the countless intertwined rifts and the presence of the Shape of Living Beings should be enough to confuse any possible enemies to some extent."

Thus, Li Fan once again descended beneath the Star Sea.

He did not disturb Xu Ke, who was still tirelessly expanding the underground passages.

Instead, he arrived at the center of the region that had already been explored, ensuring that outside interference would be reduced as much as possible.

With a seriousness unlike ever before, Li Fan slowly laid down layer after layer of Immortal formations.

Employing every method currently at his disposal, he resolutely restarted the unfolding of the Immortal Domain.

Buzz. Buzz.

Within the Immortal formations, a violent gale seemed to arise, ruthlessly battering everything in its path.

The formations that Li Fan had once been so proud of resembled nothing more than a dilapidated thatched hut. They could not endure for long and were already on the verge of collapse.

Li Fan could only continue pouring in source power essence, patching and repairing them as much as possible in an effort to delay their destruction.

His expression remained focused as he stared intently at the countless overlapping, indistinct phantoms within the center of the Immortal formation.

They resembled people, yet were not people.

They resembled scenery, yet were not scenery.

Exactly as he had seen before.

The only difference was that the previous unfolding of the Immortal Domain had been interrupted by the black mist at the center of the Star Sea.

This time, under Li Fan's deliberate control, it was allowed to continue.

Boundless rays of light burst forth from the Immortal Domain.

Li Fan vaguely saw that those figures were in fact incomparably profound characters.

They scattered in every direction before dissolving as though melting into water, transforming into countless intersecting lines that upheld heaven and earth.

Endless characters poured forth from the infinite radiance.

More and more horizontal and vertical lines intertwined, weaving the world into something increasingly bright and vivid.

The Immortal Domain was about to be born within the darkest reaches of the Star Sea.

Li Fan could already sense the various changes occurring throughout the Star Sea.

These included, but were not limited to, the awakening of the True Immortal within the Immortal Ruins, the astonishment of the Heavenly Doctor and the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor, and the trembling of the Star Sea's own consciousness.

But he had no attention to spare for any of them.

His gaze remained fixed upon the Immortal Domain that was taking shape.

He wanted to determine whether the Immortal Domain fragment left behind by Sun Piaomiao contained anything besides the laws of the Immortal Realm.

"The reappearance of the Immortal Domain is causing an even greater disturbance than I imagined."

"Even if there is no danger within it, I cannot remain in this lifetime much longer."

"But it is hardly a meaningless ending. At the very least, I have avoided one certain path to death. In the next lifetime, all I need to do is repeat everything according to plan."

Li Fan's thoughts raced like lightning.

At this moment, as the Immortal Domain blossomed like fruit emerging from a flower, preparing to burst through the earth fissure basin of the Star Sea and return to the normal Star Sea.

Li Fan finally saw the final phantom that emerged within the Immortal Domain.

It was a wordless Stele standing between heaven and earth within the Immortal Domain.

A Stele without a single inscription.

Chapter 1383: The Dao Annihilation Calamity Descends

The Wordless Stele emerged, and Heaven and Earth were stabilized.

The Immortal Domain, which had been trembling violently moments ago, instantly became stable.

At this moment, time itself seemed to fall into stillness.

Amid the absolute silence, a majestic aura emerged. It was an immense and glorious might so overwhelming that even Li Fan, the closest observer, found his thoughts nearly freezing.

If the Wordless Stele had not merely remained there in silence without any intention of attacking, and if it had not been standing within the Immortal Domain, Li Fan feared that he would have been torn to pieces by this aura alone.

His strength was enough to dominate the Darkest Star Sea, yet before the Wordless Stele of the Immortal Domain, Li Fan was truly no more than an ant caught in a violent storm, with neither his life nor death under his own control.

Li Fan's expression changed drastically. He tried to summon the phantom of the Wooden Sword and flee.

But to his horror, he discovered that all the laws constituting the Wooden Sword had been affected by the Wordless Stele and were completely unable to function.

Even the Transformation of Truth and Falsehood was no exception.

The Wordless Stele stood there as though it were the center of all worlds.

Apart from the Immortal Domain, which was slowly stabilizing, everything else was surging toward the Wordless Stele and collapsing into it.

This was different from the Immortal Ruins absorbing and devouring everything in the star sea. Things drawn toward the Immortal Ruins were torn apart by powerful True Immortal power and reduced to fragments.

But those falling toward the Wordless Stele...

Li Fan saw it clearly. Outside the Immortal Domain, within the Darkest Star Sea, whether they were remnants of True Immortal power or fragments of worlds, all of them surged violently toward the Wordless Stele. Yet after entering its vicinity, they were all decomposed and transformed into "nothing."

"No!"

The charging progress of the [Truth]'s protective energy plummeted. Li Fan's vision gradually distorted.

Countless arcs revolved around the center. On the Wordless Stele that was absorbing and devouring everything, Li Fan could clearly see that mottled shadows had begun to appear.

"It is not nothing! All things are returning to their original state, returning to the Wordless Stele! This is the evolution of the Dao, tracing the Dao back to its origin!"

Li Fan's mind trembled violently, and his brain was almost completely blank.

The magnificent scene before his eyes, comparable to the creation of the world itself, deeply shook Li Fan.

It was as if he had been fortunate enough to glimpse the Great Dao itself.

With every passing moment, countless insights erupted within Li Fan's mind.

He had once experienced something similar when he directly confronted the true intent of the origin of the star sea. But now, Li Fan's comprehension was a thousand, ten thousand times greater than before.

Even the Transformation of Truth and Falsehood, which he could only comprehend to a limited extent through each reincarnation simulation, now seemed faintly within his grasp.

"What is true, and what is false? They are all merely evolutions of the Dao! With a single thought, the Dao gives birth to a world, and the Dao evolves into all things. With a single thought, the Dao perishes, all things wither and return to nothingness..."

Li Fan seemed possessed, completely immersed in his observation of the Wordless Stele and unable to extricate himself.

Just like the countless things in the Star Sea drawn toward the Wordless Stele, he could not escape.

Even after sensing several figures that had been drawn here by the appearance of the Wordless Stele within the Immortal Domain, Li Fan did not divert his attention in the slightest.

Those figures treated one another with mutual courtesy, each maintaining a certain distance.

Several strands of consciousness seemed to drift across Li Fan's body as well, but without exception, they soon shifted their attention toward the center of the storm.

Before the upheaval caused by the Wordless Stele, all living beings were equal.

True Immortals and Supreme Ones were all ants.

The pressure that those occupying higher positions had once exerted upon those beneath them was completely erased by the Wordless Stele.

They gazed upon the Wordless Stele, just like Li Fan, shaken into silence.

The Wordless Stele of the Immortal Domain was like a tiny hole that had suddenly appeared at the center of the Star Sea, with everything within the star sea collapsing toward it.

The collapse of all things formed a torrential waterfall flow.

Only the strongest beings standing at the summit of the Star Sea could barely maintain their positions outside the tiny hole.

From the distant edges of the Star Sea, faint rumbling sounds could be heard.

These were signs that the endless Sea of Relic Artifacts and the Great Wall of Remnant Worlds were beginning to collapse.

Countless endless ruins surged toward the Immortal Domain.

Even the invisible High Wall seemed to have been affected.

Amid violent tremors, some inexplicable transformation occurred.

Like dark clouds pressing down upon the land, countless scenes and images descended upon the edges of the star sea.

...

One terrifying phenomenon after another appeared.

Then a clear female voice suddenly rang out, carrying both surprise and fear.

It sounded so out of place.

Yet it was able to cross through the storm caused by the Wordless Stele and reach the ears of everyone present, demonstrating just how terrifying its owner's strength was.

"The Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar? How could it appear here?"

Before her voice had even faded, its owner transformed into a streak of flowing light and shot directly toward the center of the storm.

She seemed intent on entering the Immortal Domain to investigate.

But the Immortal Domain emitted a faint radiance, actually blocking that figure outside.

"This is..."

"The Tali Star Domain, the Ancient Realm of All Living Beings!"

The slightly slender figure finally revealed her true appearance.

She looked somewhat pale, as if she had just recovered from a serious illness.

Her eyes were deep, seemingly containing endless mysteries within them, causing anyone who looked upon them to become deeply entranced.

Her appearance was not particularly beautiful, and could even be described as ordinary.

Yet she possessed a unique charm that made her unforgettable at a glance.

"She is..."

The appearance of this figure caused Li Fan to regain a trace of awareness.

Thinking about her words and looking at that somewhat familiar figure, Li Fan's heart stirred.

"The True Immortal who is comprehending the Dao within the Immortal Ruins? I had previously only seen her skeletal form and incarnation phantom. I never expected that she was actually a woman."

Perhaps sensing the thoughts around her that were related to herself, the True Immortal slightly frowned and swept her gaze around.

Li Fan's heart immediately tightened.

But perhaps because of the influence of the Wordless Stele, the True Immortal could not precisely lock onto her target.

After confirming that everyone around her appeared to be ordinary mortals, the True Immortal's attention returned to the Immortal Domain.

Her figure rippled like waves as she seemed to attempt to merge into the Immortal Domain.

But the Immortal Domain seemed to possess an innate repulsion toward True Immortals.

A more violent radiance suddenly erupted, instantly forcing the True Immortal back several dozen feet.

The True Immortal's expression immediately became somewhat grim.

The aura around her suddenly changed.

Her figure also vanished from everyone's sight.

Li Fan could only vaguely see a transparent protrusion formed from distorted spacetime, seemingly moving toward the Immortal Domain.

The radiance surrounding the Immortal Domain was suddenly pushed outward, forming a huge bulge.

Several breaths later, the True Immortal successfully entered the Immortal Domain.

Her objective was obvious.

She headed directly toward the Wordless Stele at the center.

From outside, the Immortal Domain appeared to be merely a tiny region.

Yet the True Immortal from the Immortal Ruins flew for a long time and had only advanced a short distance within it.

Moreover, the closer she approached the Wordless Stele, the slower her movement became.

It was as though an infinite distance truly lay between them.

What happened within the Immortal Domain did not affect the Darkest Star Sea.

The endless Great Wall of Remnant Worlds and the Sea of Relic Artifacts still inevitably fell toward the Wordless Stele.

Before even approaching the Immortal Domain, they transformed into streaks of light.

After being absorbed by the Wordless Stele, they merely added a few more mottled marks upon its surface.

They could not even leave behind the slightest shallow imprint.

The "waterfall flow" became increasingly violent.

Li Fan gradually found it difficult to maintain his position.

Whenever a streak of light representing some object roared past him, Li Fan would feel as though the original object represented by that light had suddenly crashed into his body.

It pushed him step by step toward the Immortal Domain.

Nothing in the Star Sea could escape this fate.

The Xuanhuang Realm was no exception.

Li Fan saw Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor.

The two figures had actually broken free from the temptation of comprehending the Dao presented by the Wordless Stele.

They were desperately attempting to prevent the Xuanhuang Realm from falling into destruction.

But their efforts were nothing more than a cup of water against a burning cart, merely delaying the inevitable.

Apart from them, two figures, one large and one small, stood side by side not far away, attracting Li Fan's attention.

"The Dao, ancient beyond antiquity. Xin, is completely extinguished. Walk the path of thought cultivation, comprehend the intent, proceed toward the divine. A thousand paths shift the soul, a hundred trials turn the spirit."

"...No calamity."

There was a faint, profound and mysterious sound continuously resounding from the larger figure. As for the smaller figure, its gaze was greedy yet tinged with fear as it stared at the Wordless Stele not far away.

“Heavenly Capital Grand Mage!” Li Fan's heart tightened.

“The incantation being recited by that phantom seems to have appeared in my previous life as well, when I was facing the Obliterating Wind Calamity.”

“Could there be some deeper mystery behind it?”

This time, he was extremely close, allowing him to hear the phantom's recitation completely and clearly.

After memorizing the entire immortal art, Li Fan followed along and silently recited it in his heart.

In an instant, it was as if an invisible force enveloped his body.

It was like a great hand pressing firmly down upon him, making him even more stable amid the storm generated by the Wordless Stele.

“Could this be used to evade calamity?” Li Fan was filled with uncertainty.

The Daoist child beside the phantom glanced at Li Fan with a hint of mockery.

However, he did not say anything. He was not even interested in paying attention to Li Fan, quickly turning his gaze back toward the Wordless Stele.

Li Fan glanced at the remaining charging progress of [Truth]. Seeing that it could still hold out for a while, his thoughts stirred, and he summoned Tianyang and Qiushui.

The two figures crossed the void and arrived beside Li Fan, standing on either side to protect him.

Even the auras of the two Supreme failed to make the Daoist child phantom shift his gaze.

Li Fan had no intention of provoking the Grand Mage either. Instead, he once again looked toward the Immortal Domain.

He did not know what method the True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins had used. Unnoticed by the surrounding observers, she had suddenly moved much closer to the Wordless Stele.

The blurred scene within the Immortal Domain gradually became clearer.

Mountains, rivers, and vast stretches of land began to emerge.

Li Fan keenly noticed that the aura surrounding the Grand Mage had become somewhat chaotic. It seemed that he was unwilling to accept something and was beginning to stir restlessly.

Just at this moment...

The rolling black mist at the center of the Star Sea finally arrived like a world devouring flood.

As if possessing a will of its own, it swept past Li Fan and headed straight toward the Immortal Domain.

The phantom of the Grand Mage seemed to awaken from a dream. His expression instantly became one of extreme terror, as if he had seen a ghost.

He fled without hesitation and disappeared in an instant.

The radiance of the Immortal Domain could not obstruct the black mist in the slightest.

Instead, because of the attraction of the Wordless Stele, the vast black mist became even more condensed.

Originally, it had merely been an endless sea of black qi.

But after pouring into the Immortal Domain, it transformed into a long, concentrated stream descending from the heavens.

Within the Immortal Domain, dark clouds pressed down upon the city, as if the heavens themselves were about to collapse.

The True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins, who was approaching the Wordless Stele, suddenly raised her head.

Her expression could not be seen clearly, but her next action was somewhat beyond Li Fan's expectations.

She did not flee like the phantom of the Grand Mage.

Instead, she accelerated even further and charged toward the Wordless Stele.

The space around the True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins became somewhat distorted. She was now only a stone's throw away from the Wordless Stele.

Under the influence of the endless dark clouds, a terrifying calamity descended upon the Immortal Domain that had only just manifested.

It was as if a layer of the heavens had collapsed for no reason.

Then, beneath that collapsed sky, the mountains, rivers, and land that had only recently appeared began to disintegrate inch by inch, instantly turning into nothingness.

Moments later, boundless black mist surged forth from within.

A black avalanche swept inward from all directions, engulfing everything as it surged toward the center of the Immortal Domain.

The heavens of the Immortal Domain continued to collapse.

The boundaries of the Immortal Domain also grew smaller and smaller.

At this critical moment, the True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins finally arrived before the Wordless Stele.

She struck out with a dazzling radiance, blasting it directly into the Wordless Stele.

It seemed that several strokes of a character suddenly appeared upon the surface of the Wordless Stele.

Moments later, a pillar of light that reached the heavens erupted from the top of the Wordless Stele.

It barely held back the surging tide of black mist and the descending phenomenon of the collapsing heavens.

It was like a heavenly pillar, supporting the heavens that were on the verge of falling.

“The Dao Annihilation Calamity...”

“The Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar...”

After witnessing everything, Li Fan vaguely understood the meaning behind the words of the True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins.

But a lone tree could not support the heavens.

The power of the Wordless Stele activated by the True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins alone seemed insufficient to stop the arrival of the Dao Annihilation Calamity.

Although the tide of black mist advanced slowly, it continued pressing downward with unwavering determination.

Despair gradually appeared on the face of the True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins.

And after devouring the Immortal Domain, the black mist had also become somewhat different from before.

Vague figures seemed to flicker in and out of existence within it.

Li Fan's sense of danger suddenly intensified.

He turned his head and saw that, throughout the remaining regions of the Darkest Star Sea, boundless quantities of black mist were simultaneously emerging from every corner.

In an instant, they spread throughout the entire Star Sea.

Moreover, none of this black mist was the same as the version that had originally existed within the Star Sea.

It had seemingly undergone a sublimation after devouring the Immortal Domain.

Throughout the Star Sea, faint clusters of black mist drifted everywhere, like countless ghosts wandering through the night.

The strange figures within the black qi seemed to conceal some tremendous terror. They caused Li Fan's heart to race for no apparent reason, while a chill crawled across his scalp.

Even [Truth], which rarely issued warnings, transmitted an alarm.

It continuously urged him to flee immediately.

“It is time to return to [Truth].”

Looking at the terrifying scene of the black mist running rampant, this thought could not help but emerge within Li Fan's heart.

But just before the light screen of [Truth], enveloped him, Li Fan suddenly experienced a moment of enlightenment.

A white circle flew from his hand and instantly shot toward the Wordless Stele within the Immortal Domain.

It was none other than the White Ring, Descends into Mortal World!

It did not encounter the same obstruction as the True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins.

Instead, it flew straight inside, breaking through the encircling tide of surging black mist.

Then it collided with the Wordless Stele.

There was no earthshaking explosion.

Only dazzling radiance suddenly surged from the white circle.

Then it disappeared from view.

At the same time, a complete character suddenly appeared upon the Wordless Stele.

It was none other than a True Immortal Seal Script character representing the principles of the Great Dao of the World!

The appearance of this True Immortal Seal Script character seemed to inject an immense amount of energy into the Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar.

The pillar of light it emitted suddenly expanded.

The surrounding tide of black qi was instantly forced back.

The True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins, who had been filled with despair moments ago, also reacted at this moment.

Without holding anything back, she poured all her energy into the Wordless Stele before her.

Flesh and blood, along with her hair, vanished from the body of the True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins.

She once again returned to the skeletal appearance Li Fan had previously seen within the Immortal Ruins.

Within the Wordless Stele, a second True Immortal Seal Script character slowly emerged.

The pillar of light expanded once again, finally piercing through the tide of black mist.

A gigantic ring of light formed across the horizon.

The True Immortal of the Immortal Ruins wrapped herself around the Wordless Stele and broke through the black mist's blockade.

It seemed that she had noticed Li Fan's earlier intervention and intended to take him with her.

She flew toward Li Fan's position.

Yet, to her utter astonishment, Li Fan's figure rapidly retreated.

At the same time, Tianyang and Qiushui moved forward to intercept her.

“[Truth]!”

Li Fan silently recited the words in his heart.

Chapter 1384: The Bone Of The Nameless Immortal

'[Truth].'

As Li Fan silently uttered those words in his heart, a layer of watery mist instantly enveloped everything around him.

However, Li Fan was astonished to discover that the color of the Wordless Stele in the distance, also known as the Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar, could faintly penetrate the mist of [Truth].

It remained as brilliant as before.

Along with it, the figure of the Immortal Ruins True Immortal beside the Wordless Stele could also be vaguely seen.

The interception by Tianyang and Qiushui seemed to have been unable to stop her for long. That strand of color within the mist was drawing closer and closer to Li Fan.

Yet just as when she had approached the Wordless Stele in the Immortal Realm, the closer she got to Li Fan, the slower her advance became.

Until she came to a complete stop.

The dense fog completely obscured the Immortal Ruins True Immortal. Even the Wordless Stele became indistinct and barely visible.

'That is...'

Li Fan could not help turning his gaze toward the Wordless Stele.

He could vaguely see that besides the two True Immortal seal script characters formed earlier by the Immortal Ruins True Immortal and White Circle Descends into the Mortal World, a third character had begun to manifest on the stele.

Or rather, countless characters were appearing at the same time, densely packed across the surface of the Wordless Stele!

An indescribably terrifying impact suddenly erupted from the Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar. Although the scene within the Star Sea had already become impossible to see clearly, the sheer might of the impact could be discerned from the white mist of [Truth] that continued to ripple outward like waves.

'Pfft!'

Even with the white mist of [Truth] protecting him, the instant countless characters flooded into Li Fan's eyes, his brain felt as though it had been struck hundreds of times in succession by a heavy hammer.

His divine soul shook violently and boiled over, and his consciousness nearly tore apart.

Fortunately, at this very moment, the Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar itself could no longer withstand such terrifying pressure.

With a thunderous explosion, it shattered into countless fragments!

Perhaps it was merely a coincidence, or perhaps some other factor was at work. In any case, the largest fragment unexpectedly flew straight toward Li Fan.

It was more than a thousand times faster than the pursuing Immortal Ruins True Immortal.

In an instant, it pierced through ordinary spacetime and arrived within the white mist of [Truth]!

At the same time, the white mist of [Truth] completely swallowed the world.

The moment the fragment entered the white mist, it lost all its speed and radiance. It simply floated quietly at the edge of the mist.

Li Fan, who had been shaken senseless, finally managed to regain his bearings.

Looking at the surroundings still shrouded in mist and facing the situation in which he had yet to return to his predetermined anchor point, Li Fan fell into deep thought.

After carefully sensing the fluctuations transmitted by [Truth], Li Fan cautiously beckoned with his hand and brought the fragment over.

A familiar light screen suddenly erupted.

The interrupted [Truth] process resumed once again.

Scene after scene from his previous life surfaced in succession.

Before Li Fan's consciousness sank into darkness, he suddenly discovered that at some point, the fragment of the Wordless Stele in his hand had already disappeared.

...

Anchor Year 1, Summit of Jieli Mountain!

Li Fan, twenty years old, opened his eyes once again.

'Phew!'

The simulation had ended, and he had begun another life. Yet this time, Li Fan did not experience the feeling of having lived through another lifetime.

The series of dangerous, thrilling, and utterly bizarre events he had experienced at the end of his previous life remained vividly etched in his mind.

It was as though they had happened in this life as well.

Li Fan instinctively glanced at the [Truth] panel.

The charging progress remained at 31 percent.

One had to know that when [Truth] had begun, its charging progress had been as high as 400 percent.

This alone was enough to show just how dangerous the events at the end of his previous life had been.

Although he had successfully returned to his predetermined anchor point once again, Li Fan still felt somewhat uneasy.

He walked out of the thatched hut and came to the edge of the cliff at the mountain summit, facing the vast sea of clouds.

His gaze remained fixed on the [Truth] panel, specifically on a new item that had suddenly appeared among the objects he had retained.

[...Leg Bone]

Before the words 'Leg Bone' were a series of distorted and blurred symbols. Li Fan could not determine what they represented.

But naturally, Li Fan knew where this bone had come from.

'The Wordless Stele, the Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar?'

'This Immortal Celestial Pillar was actually forged from the leg bone of some existence?'

Li Fan's mind was deeply shaken.

The distorted and blurred symbols that he could not see clearly immediately reminded Li Fan of the legendary Nameless Immortal.

This bold speculation caused countless thoughts to burst forth in Li Fan's mind.

'But right now, the most important thing is...'

'Ensuring my own safety.'

Li Fan casually picked up a stone beside his feet and held it tightly in his hand as he silently thought.

The prompt from [Truth] immediately followed.

'Consume one available anchor point to replace the bound item... Leg Bone?'

The moment the prompt appeared, Li Fan inexplicably breathed a sigh of relief.

[Truth] had not lost control.

He still possessed the highest authority over [Truth].

The appearance of this leg bone merely meant that during his previous [Truth] process, he had brought along an additional stowaway.

'Even so, this Nameless Immortal's leg bone is truly extraordinary.'

Li Fan was secretly alarmed.

Since he could not yet determine the true origin of the leg bone, he could only provisionally refer to its owner as the Nameless Immortal.

He first selected 'No', choosing to retain the Nameless Immortal's leg bone.

Staring at the fragment within the [Truth] panel, Li Fan's expression became solemn.

He recalled everything that had happened at the end of his previous life.

'That Wordless Stele, also known as the Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar, can resist the Dao Annihilation Calamity to a certain extent.'

'Since it bears the name Southern Immortal Heaven, it means that in the ancient Immortal Realm, there must have been more than one Celestial Pillar like this.'

'Leg bone... Could it be that the other Celestial Pillars were also forged from the bones of other parts of the Nameless Immortal? Or perhaps they were forged from the remains of other Nameless Immortals?'

A faint chill crept into Li Fan's heart.

'When the Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar first faced the Dao Annihilation Calamity, it was essentially unmoved. It was only after the Hunger Immortal infused it with the [Hunger] Character seal script she had comprehended that it formed a pillar of light supporting the heavens. Only then was it able to successfully resist the Dao Annihilation Calamity.'

'The Wordless Stele seems to possess an unparalleled divine ability capable of causing all things to reappear in their original Dao laws, and then manifesting those laws upon the stele in the form of True Immortal seal script characters.'

'It was precisely because I saw this that I suddenly had an idea and unleashed White Ring Descends into Mortal World. Naturally, I was not trying to save the Hunger Immortal's life. After all, I had already been prepared to use [Truth] at that time. I simply wanted to see through the origins of White Ring Descends into Mortal World.'

'As expected, Descends into Mortal World represented some extremely powerful law of the mortal world...'

Li Fan carefully recalled the character that had manifested upon the Wordless Stele in his previous life.

'[Innate].'

'It is almost on the same level as [Creation].'

'Back then, Dao Inscription Immortal could manifest the Great Dao of Heaven and Earth through True Immortal seal script characters. But now, beyond the High Wall, could the power of laws actually be solidified and forged into physical objects?'

The shock in Li Fan's heart was even greater than when he had just learned that the Nameless Immortal's leg bone had appeared.

'However, I still cannot determine whether White Ring Descends into Mortal World is truly an existence originating beyond the High Wall...'

Li Fan pressed against his throbbing temples and took a deep breath.

His thoughts returned to their proper course.

“The Wordless Stele manifested into the world and absorbed everything, both things and phenomena, from the Star Sea outside the Immortal Realm. It seemed to be trying to reproduce the laws of the Myriad Daos of Heaven and Earth upon the stele, restoring the true form of the Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar.”

“Everything I saw, and everything that exists within the Star Sea, was transformed into countless threads that became shadows added to the Wordless Stele. This proves that point.”

“And then…”

When his thoughts reached this point, a strange light suddenly burst forth from Li Fan’s eyes.

“[Truth] was activated. The Wordless Stele sensed it, and countless characters manifested upon its surface!”

At that moment, the characters that appeared upon the stele were simply too numerous and too complex.

Even with the assistance of the Dao Deviation Stone, Li Fan was completely incapable of remembering them.

He could not even retain a basic impression.

He only vaguely remembered seeing dozens of True Immortal seal script characters that he was familiar with, but which were far more complete and pure.

However, Li Fan did not feel any regret or disappointment.

He had a premonition that if he had been too greedy and disregarded the consequences, forcibly attempting to remember all the True Immortal seal script characters on the entire stele...

His fate would only have been the same as the Wordless Stele in his previous life.

He would have been blown to pieces in an instant!

“Although it was forged from the leg bone of an Nameless True Immortal and is known as the Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar, even it cannot withstand the countless characters manifested by [Truth]…”

“It survived the destruction catastrophe of the Immortal Realm, only to be buried by its own nature.”

Li Fan secretly shook his head and warned himself to be cautious. At the same time, he gained a new understanding of [Truth].

“Since the Wordless Stele is known as an Immortal Celestial Pillar, perhaps it once had multiple True Immortal seal script characters engraved upon it, allowing it to resist the Dao Annihilation Calamity on behalf of the Immortal Realm.”

“This is also why countless insights continuously surged into my mind the instant I saw it. Although the True Immortal seal script characters on the stele disappeared for some unknown reason, some traces of their inscriptions still remain.”

“All things in the world are manifestations of the Dao. If one could grasp every way of the Dao, then with a single thought, one could manifest everything in the world. This is what is known as the Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood.”

At this moment, Li Fan had still not chosen the option to inherit [Truth]. He remained an ordinary mortal in every sense.

Yet he stood with his hands behind his back, his eyes narrowing slightly.

A powerful pressure suddenly surged from his body.

In that instant, Li Fan’s cultivation returned to the peak of the Soul Transformation Realm, founded upon the countless transformations of the Xuanhuang Annihilation of All Things.

With a flick of his finger, a streak of meteoric light shot upward from the mountain peak.

It tore through the sky of the Great Xuan small world, revealing the faint and secluded void beyond.

Only after completing all this did the profound aura surrounding Li Fan slowly disappear.

“My comprehension of the Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood has reached another level.”

“Without relying on [Truth] itself, I can now briefly reproduce the cultivation I once possessed. Moreover, in that instant, I can unleash a full-powered strike.”

“Although this transformation cannot yet be maintained for long, its significance to me is extraordinary.”

Li Fan opened the [Truth] interface and selected the option to inherit his cultivation.

In an instant, Li Fan transformed from an ordinary mortal back into an existence standing at the pinnacle of the Darkest Star Sea.

It was as though he had experienced several hundred lifetimes of vicissitudes.

“The Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood…”

Li Fan did not stop. Instead, he once again recalled the entire process of [Truth] being activated, realized, and used to carry out the reincarnation simulation.

Suddenly, another surge of Li Fan’s cultivation from his prime descended.

It was as though another version of himself had suddenly merged into his body.

At this moment, the spiritual energy within Li Fan surged and boiled.

The phantom of the Wooden Sword was unsheathed, and in an instant, he arrived in the void of the Darkest Star Sea.

His entire strength erupted.

Countless terrifying transformations descended and evolved throughout the dark starry sky.

They continued without end for a long time.

The second layer of cultivation that had appeared upon Li Fan quietly faded away.

He returned to his normal state.

“I had already touched the limit of the Star Sea, yet by relying on the Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood, I can briefly unleash twice my original strength.”

“Moreover, this outburst has absolutely no side effects. I can even borrow all the consumption required for these operations from nothingness, achieving a form of perpetual motion in a certain sense.”

Li Fan looked at his own hands, feeling utterly incredulous.

Even though he was the creator of this divine ability, he was still shocked by its actual performance, which completely surpassed common sense.

“[Truth], [Truth]…”

As he silently repeated the name in his heart, Li Fan’s gaze gradually became incomparably profound.

“What exactly is [Truth]?”

“The Wordless Stele merely sensed it from the outside, yet it absorbed and manifested countless True Immortal seal script characters, so numerous that even it could not withstand them. As for its origin…”

Even if he allowed his imagination to run wild, Li Fan could not conceive of the source of [Truth].

All Li Fan knew was that possessing [Truth] was undoubtedly the greatest fortune of his life.

“In truth, I do not need to cultivate any new method or another new method at all. As long as I continuously deepen my understanding of [Truth], I will eventually be able to achieve true Dao annihilation and Dao creation with a flip of my hand.”

“What True Immortal? What Nameless True Immortal? Life, death, nature, and fate would all be decided by a single thought of mine.”

Li Fan’s heart surged with excitement as he became lost in this vision.

But fantasies ultimately had to return to reality.

After a long while, Li Fan, who possessed ample self-awareness, still shook his head slightly.

“However, this also contains a paradox. If I do not first cultivate, increase my own strength, and deepen my understanding, then how could I truly comprehend [Truth]?”

“When my strength was weak, even if I possessed [Truth] and spent thousands or tens of thousands of lifetimes in empty reincarnation, I still could not accomplish what I can do now and briefly realize the Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood. Even if it were merely the cultivation I once possessed.”

“And as my understanding of the True Immortal seal script and the Great Dao deepens, my understanding and deconstruction of [Truth] also gradually increases.”

[Truth] was far too profound, mysterious, and complex. Even the laws of the Great Dao of Heaven and Earth could only barely serve as a tool for interpreting it.

“The height of [Truth] lies even above the highest heavens. To touch [Truth], one must first ascend to the Ninth Heaven.”

The somewhat restless thought that had arisen in Li Fan’s heart quietly subsided the moment it appeared.

“I should still cultivate step by step and keep my feet firmly on the ground.”

As Li Fan pondered, he once again recalled the reason why his previous self had decided to advance the unfolding of the Immortal Realm ahead of schedule.

“Looking back now, in the simulation where I died, the reason I suddenly died was probably due to the combined effects of Ink Death and the Wordless Stele.”

“It was very likely a weakened version of the Dao Annihilation Calamity. After Ink Death was sublimated, it returned to the realm of the Dao Annihilation Calamity. When the Immortal Domain unfolded, the Wordless Stele also manifested in an instant…”

When that scene surfaced in his mind, the skin on Li Fan’s face could not help twitching.

“I was still thinking about things far too simply.”

“If it could allow an Ancient True Immortal to entrust themselves to it and survive the Dao Annihilation Calamity, I should have known that the Immortal Domain could never be simple.”

Li Fan sighed softly inwardly.

But this did not cause Li Fan to abandon his plan to absorb Ink Death’s Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth.

On the contrary, the fact that Ink Death possessed the ability to pose an enormous threat to Immortal-grade existences made Li Fan even more determined to use it as material for Dao Integration.

After all, looking across the entire Darkest Star Sea, only Ink Death’s Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth was capable of moving Li Fan’s heart at present.

“Anchor and sublimate the Xuanhuang Realm…”

“The Wordless Stele is far too terrifying. For now, I cannot consider it.”

“But... one fragment of the Wordless Stele might perhaps be enough.”

The phantom of the Wooden Sword was already prepared, and Li Fan had made sufficient defensive preparations.

He took out the bone of the Nameless True Immortal that had accompanied him through [Truth].

Chapter 1385: The Stone Stele Derives Immortal Script

If this had been the previous life, before the completion of [Truth]'s charging, and this were merely a fragment of stone that had flown out from the Wordless Stele itself, Li Fan would absolutely never have dared to test it with his own body.

But now, the leg bone of the Nameless True Immortal had already become a bound item of [Truth].

Li Fan had personally witnessed how, after entering the white mist of [Truth], the leg bone had lost all signs of spirituality and remained completely motionless. Li Fan was confident that something bound to [Truth] could absolutely never harm him.

He carefully examined the object that had appeared before him.

Without [Truth]'s prompt, Li Fan would never have imagined that this round fragment of stone, roughly the size of a fist, was actually the leg bone of some unknown and immensely powerful existence.

"Unlike the complete Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar, merely looking at its surface does not cause various insights to surge into my mind. It seems to be nothing more than an ordinary stone..."

Li Fan did not approach it. Instead, he observed it from a distance.

"The Nameless True Immortal is an existence above the True Immortal realm. After completely mastering a particular Dao, one transcends beyond it. Such an existence is unknowable and unseeable to mortals."

"Yet there is not the slightest trace of the Great Dao on this leg bone..."

"Could it be that the Dao mastered by this Nameless True Immortal was stripped away? And that this existence was itself slaughtered, with its entire skeleton refined into the Immortal Celestial Pillars?"

Li Fan's thoughts ran wild.

But even when facing such an inconspicuous leg bone, Li Fan did not let down his guard.

Even the True Immortal remains beneath the Dark Sea could give birth to the [Will to Survive]. Who knew what kind of strange thing the remains of the Nameless True Immortal might derive?

However, the reason Li Fan was so eager to take it out and study it was naturally to verify a certain conjecture in his heart.

In his previous life, after he cast the White Ring Descends into Mortal World toward the Wordless Stele, the two characters [Innate] appeared upon the Wordless Stele.

At that time, all kinds of details regarding the character [Innate] in Li Fan's mind had been magnified countless times and presented perfectly before him.

One had to know that True Immortal seal script was actually another manifestation of the Great Dao itself. It was not something that could easily be comprehended.

Even the True Immortals of the Immortal Ruins had to sit in meditation for ten thousand years merely to comprehend a single character, [Hunger].

As for the peerless geniuses among mortals, such as the successive elders of the Immortal Ark, even reproducing the original appearance of True Immortal seal script required generation after generation to advance one after another, preserving the flame of knowledge through the wisdom accumulated by countless predecessors.

There was naturally an insurmountable chasm between True Immortal seal script and mortal existence, preventing mortals from investigating it.

Li Fan was an exceptionally fortunate person who had seen quite a few True Immortal seal script characters. However, most of them originated from the imitations written by that "Immortal He Gan", who had once caused the catastrophe that devastated the Star Sea.

Originally, Li Fan had believed that his understanding had already captured eighty or ninety percent of the true essence.

But at the end of his previous life, a single stroke upon the Wordless Stele, which was covered in True Immortal seal script, suddenly awakened him.

What he had comprehended was still far too distant from the original appearance of the Great Dao laws.

"The True Immortal seal script I currently know consists of the [Innate] and [Hunger] characters. Among them, these two are the closest to their fundamental essence. My understanding of [Innate] is even superior to my understanding of [Hunger]. Because what I saw of [Hunger] was merely something I observed from outside the Immortal Realm. But [Innate]."

"It was directly projected into my mind."

A faint glimmer flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

"The Wordless Stele seems to be a machine for analysis. It decomposes all things into their most primordial state and manifests them through True Immortal seal script. And personally throwing an object into it seems to provide an additional enhancement."

"Would this not be the perfect, natural treasure for learning True Immortal seal script?"

At this thought, Li Fan could not help becoming somewhat excited. Even though he had always prided himself on remaining calm, he found it difficult to suppress his emotions at this moment.

"Even if this is merely a fragment of the Wordless Stele, the ability of this leg bone to derive True Immortal seal script should far surpass the combined efforts of the entire Xuan Immortal Ark."

"It will be of immense help in allowing me to master as many True Immortal seal script characters as possible."

Li Fan stared at the leg bone in the distance, his eyes blazing with anticipation.

True Immortal seal script was not merely significant during one's mortal existence. Even after becoming a True Immortal, it remained just as important. If one wished to advance further, True Immortals still had to continue studying it, choosing a suitable Dao in pursuit of the [Nameless] realm.

"Of course, what the Wordless Stele manifests may not necessarily be pure True Immortal seal script representing the primordial laws of the Great Dao."

"It is more like..."

"The understanding of that Nameless True Immortal regarding all the Great Daos in the mortal world."

"Unless this Nameless True Immortal is actually the legendary [Dao Inscription Immortal]."

Li Fan's thoughts abruptly stopped.

He carefully considered what it would mean if that were truly the case.

The truth was still far too distant from him. He silently buried these thoughts deep within his heart for the time being.

"The vision of the Nameless True Immortal naturally surpasses ours by far. Even if what it inscribed was not the Great Dao itself, it is almost indistinguishable from it. It is more than enough to serve as my teacher for a very long time to come."

"My idea is good, but manifesting True Immortal seal script upon the Wordless Stele is not an easy matter. After all, it is not the Nameless True Immortal itself. It is merely a leg bone. I need to gather enough material."

Li Fan pondered as he recalled the scene he had witnessed in his previous life.

"The White Ring Descends into Mortal World is itself mysterious beyond comprehension. It is only natural that it can independently manifest a character."

"The key is that Immortal Hunger. She exhausted all her strength just to barely manifest the character [Hunger] upon the stone stele."

Li Fan could not help frowning slightly.

"With ordinary methods, even if the entire Darkest Star Sea were buried, it might not be enough to manifest many useful characters."

"But it does not matter. I took out this leg bone precisely so that I could use it against those strange and mysterious things."

A cold glint flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

Over the course of his two recent lives, Li Fan had experienced two great upheavals in the Star Sea.

One was when Cat Treasure caused forces from beyond the High Wall to descend.

The other was when the Immortal Domain descended while carrying the Immortal Celestial Pillar.

Under those world destroying crises, all the hidden existences within the Star Sea had been forced to reveal themselves. They had used every means at their disposal to ensure their own survival.

This had allowed Li Fan to see things clearly.

"Right now, there are only a few existences throughout the entire Darkest Star Sea that can threaten me."

"Before I achieve Dao Integration, if I explore and investigate them again, I will probably obtain the same result as in my previous life. But now that I have the leg bone of the Nameless True Immortal, things are different."

"No matter how powerful or mysterious they are, can they really surpass the Nameless True Immortal?"

Images of his experiences from his previous life continuously flashed before Li Fan's eyes.

"Then let us go through them one by one."

The leg bone of the Nameless True Immortal descended, yet for a long time, no abnormal change occurred.

Only then did Li Fan relax. With a thought, he returned the leg bone to the bound space of [Truth].

He then returned to the Xuanhuang Realm and arrived at the small world where the You Clan lived.

In his previous life, Li Fan had discovered that the You Clan, as descendants of the First Generation Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, seemed to have True Immortal seal script related to the power behind the [Immortal Mortal Transformation] sealed within their bloodline.

Unfortunately, with his strength at the time, he was completely incapable of observing it.

But in this life, with the Wordless Stele present, Li Fan did not need to act himself.

"As long as enough You Clan members are sacrificed, I can truly reproduce the True Immortal seal script behind the [Immortal Mortal Transformation]."

Li Fan looked down at the You Clan gathered below.

There were not many of them, and their physiques were extremely frail.

His expression remained indifferent.

"The current number is nowhere near enough. I also need to set aside a portion of them to provide me with source power essence."

"As the saying goes, if you wish to take something, you must first give..."

Li Fan gently waved his hand.

Just as he had done in his previous life, images of the heavenly revelation concerning the Immortal Mortal Transformation appeared within the minds of several You Clan members below.

Because they had touched upon a taboo, they turned into flying ash. However, the constitution of the entire You Clan gradually became stronger due to a certain degree of ancestral reversion.

'Governing a great nation is like cooking a small fish. There is no need to rush.'

Li Fan silently murmured to himself, leaving behind a strand of divine sense to watch over the matter.

His true body then returned once again to the Great Xuan Small World.

A white ring descended into the mortal world, transforming Jieli Mountain into a region of nothingness. The Dao Lecture Platform stood between heaven and earth, attracting mortals from all over Great Xuan, who came rushing toward it like moths flying into a flame.

'For this life, the overall plan will remain unchanged for now. I will still promote the ascension of the Xuanhuang Realm and merge the Ink Death Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth into the Dao.'

'Only some details need to be perfected and modified.'

'I still need to play the role of the Teacher of Heaven and Earth, allowing all living beings to help me comprehend the flaws in the High Wall and explore the Carefree Paradise.'

'Carefree...'

Li Fan's gaze turned toward the territory of the Five Elders Association, and his expression became unreadable.

In his previous life, when the Wordless Stele emerged, none of the Longevity Immortal realm cultivators of the Five Elders Association, including Carefree Heavenly Sovereign, had appeared.

It seemed that they had not noticed it at all.

Yet later, when the True White Mist concealed everything and only the radiance of the Wordless Stele remained visible, it revealed traces of something unusual.

'Apart from the Hunger Immortal, there were still other observers at that time. They had no physical bodies, and only barely perceptible strands of thought had arrived. Within the Star Sea, there are only a few who can accomplish something like this.'

'However, to remain undetected by the Hunger Immortal and all those Supremes, it is difficult to say exactly how powerful this person is for now. But their methods of preserving their life are truly bizarre.'

...

'However, with the experience gained from the exploration of all living beings in my previous life, the speed at which I explore the dream realm in this life will inevitably increase once again.'

'No matter how deep the dream realm is, it cannot withstand my repeated probing through reincarnation.'

'Hmph... Carefree!'

Strands of divine sense flew toward the various small worlds of the Xuanhuang Realm, transforming into magnificent Dao Lecture Platforms that reached the heavens and earth.

Under Li Fan's manipulation, they slowly gave birth to simulated Heavenly Mandate.

Those small worlds that originally possessed a consciousness of the Heavenly Dao were replaced by it.

Those that originally had none instead took it as their Heavenly Dao.

Within Li Fan's sea of consciousness, countless specks of light slowly began to illuminate.

Each point of light represented a small world within the Xuanhuang Realm.

Li Fan stood high above like a god.

Watching the countless living beings below.

At the same time, Li Fan had not forgotten Wuming of the Thirteen Peaks World.

Under Li Fan's guidance, Wuming also developed the desire to leave and explore a greater world.

However, after the changes he had experienced, Li Fan needed to spend more time making preparations in this life.

For now, Wuming remained within the Thirteen Peaks World, comprehending the Heavenly Dao of the small world.

But Li Fan had already secretly connected this small world to the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm.

What Wuming was comprehending would soon become the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Before [Truth] had finished charging, Li Fan also did not make any rash moves. Everything proceeded step by step, advancing almost exactly along the trajectory of his previous life.

In the blink of an eye, three years had passed since the anchoring.

During these three years, Li Fan's attention had been focused primarily on the You Clan.

Almost every few days, he would descend with a Heavenly Revelation.

The You Clan's overall understanding of the Transformation Between Immortal and Mortal had already almost caught up with Li Fan's own.

The You Clan members who further unlocked their bloodline seals and restored their original bloodline displayed a terrifying rate of reproduction.

A newborn needed only twenty to thirty days from birth to adulthood.

Moreover, almost every You Clan member was physically robust and immune to disease.

In just three short years, their figures had already filled and occupied the entire small world.

Looking at the world ecology that was struggling under the burden, Li Fan felt that it was time to harvest.

Suddenly, dark clouds densely covered the sky.

Within the surging vortex of clouds carrying a heaven-shaking aura, a stone stele crashed down.

Its immense might instantly crushed tens of thousands of You Clan members to death.

Blood flowed in streams toward the stone stele.

Their corpses also transformed into streaks of light and flew into the stone stele.

Just as Li Fan had expected, blurred phantoms began to emerge upon the stone stele.

However, the amount of material absorbed so far was still far too small. It was still a long way from revealing the complete form of the True Immortal seal script character.

The emergence of the stone stele shook the entire You Clan.

After several attempts and confirming its danger, all the You Clan members chose to flee the area covered by the stone stele.

But how could Li Fan possibly let them have their way?

In what seemed like a single breath, the formation absorbed more than half of the You Clan members into the stone stele.

They were transformed into fuel that powered the deduction of the True Immortal seal script.

The range of the formation continued expanding, almost completely swallowing the entire You Clan.

Soon, only a corner of the small world remained where the You Clan members survived.

There were approximately eight thousand of them.

The inexplicable arrival of this calamity terrified these You Clan members.

At this moment, Li Fan also sent out a dark phantom that blocked the expanding formation.

Strands of darkness erupted from the phantom.

It forced back the formation that was devouring everything in its path.

The You Clan members who had narrowly escaped death wept with joy. They spontaneously knelt on the ground and prayed.

The phantom seemed to sense their devotion and once again forced the formation backward.

It bought the You Clan enough space to survive.

Afterward, as if it had exhausted its strength, it transformed into a stone statue and fell into the You Clan settlement.

The You Clan members hurriedly surrounded it and protected the stone statue.

Above the small world, Li Fan watched this scene and nodded slightly.

'Whenever the You Clan has reproduced enough, I will let the formation harvest another batch.'

'In this way, it will both satisfy my consumption of source power essence and provide sufficient material for the Nameless Immortal's leg bone to deduce the Transformation Between Immortal and Mortal.'

Thinking of this, Li Fan could not help but look toward the stone stele standing at the center of the small world.

The Nameless Immortal's leg bone was naturally not that enormous. A layer of formation had merely been arranged around it to conceal its presence.

After absorbing ninety percent of the You Clan, the changes in the leg bone had become extremely obvious.

Continuous golden patterns had emerged upon it.

'This character seems even more complicated than [Creation] and [Innate].'

'And besides its complexity...'

Li Fan pondered over it, his expression becoming unreadable.

'There is also a trace of sacredness and a magnificent, resplendent aura within it.'

Comparing it with what he had witnessed in his previous life, Li Fan estimated that at the current pace, it would still take more than a hundred years before the complete True Immortal seal script character could emerge.

'Too slow.'

'Could it be that I need to unlock even more of the You Clan's bloodline seals?'
