Chapter 1386: Glimpsing The Immortal Realm

Within the small world, under the stimulation brought about by the stone stele and the threat of possible extinction at any moment, the You Clan people’s desire to reproduce had risen to yet another level.

Once their subjective initiative was fully awakened, it was foreseeable that their reproductive rate would increase by another twofold.

‘The only things limiting the expansion of their race are resources and time.’

‘This constitution...’

Li Fan’s eyes flickered slightly. He casually grabbed one of theYou Clan people and began studying it, comparing it with the previous life.

‘As the seal is gradually undone, the efficiency of their return to their ancestral state is not increasing linearly. Instead, the further it progresses, the greater the increase becomes.’

Li Fan controlled the level of energy he released and continuously tested them.

He discovered that the vitality of these You Clan people had now become frighteningly vigorous.

They could actually withstand the attacks of an ordinary late-stage Qi Condensation cultivator with nothing but their flesh and blood.

‘Even a physically robust adult You Clan person can take a Foundation Establishment cultivator’s attack head-on without dying. Given their physical constitution, as long as they are not killed on the spot, it will not take long for them to become vigorous and lively again.’

Li Fan shook his head slightly, and the thought that had surfaced in his mind immediately faded.

‘At their current level, they have already reached the limit.’

‘It is not that I am afraid these You Clan people could cause trouble. Even if they became much stronger, they would still have absolutely no ability to resist before the leg bone of the Nameless True Immortal. I am merely wary of the First Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable...’

‘It may not be impossible for something like resurrection from descendants and bloodlines to occur. It is better to be cautious.’

‘As for how to ensure that, in this life, I can use the leg bone of the Nameless Immortal to deduce the complete [Immortal Mortal Transformation].’

Li Fan glanced at the indistinct mark on the stone stele.

‘The True Immortal Transformation is a once lost, forever lost opportunity. If I cannot completely glimpse it the first time I encounter it, then I will never have another chance to comprehend it in this life.’

‘Once the deduction progress of the Nameless Immortal leg bone exceeds halfway, I will personally comprehend its mysteries through the bloodline of the You Clan.’

‘While comprehending it, I will directly pour everything I see and feel into the stone stele. I cannot remember it, but the Nameless True Immortal should not be subject to this restriction.’

A vague plan gradually formed in Li Fan’s heart.

Below, the stone statue worshipped by the You Clan people as their savior was continuously transmitting source power essence to Li Fan.

As the physical constitution of the You Clan people grew stronger, the quantity and quality of source power essence produced by each of their prayers far exceeded that of the past.

In this life, Li Fan no longer needed to worry about running out of source power essence.

Golden light flowed continuously. Outside the leg bone of the Nameless True Immortal, Li Fan once again laid down a layer of Immortal-grade formation protection.

At the same time, he activated the [Simulated Creation, Diverse Forms of Sentient Beings] formation, creating a Heavenly Mandate that monitored everything happening within this small world.

Only after making sufficient preparations did Li Fan nod in satisfaction and leave.

Over the next six months, Li Fan used his inexhaustible source power essence to deploy Immortal-grade formations throughout the vast majority of the small worlds within the Xuanhuang Realm.

The first purpose was to promote the small worlds’ return to the Xuanhuang Realm and prepare for the future ascension of the Xuanhuang Realm into an Immortal Domain.

The second was to better control the myriad worlds and search for suitable ‘seeds’ to temper Eternal Remnant Will.

In the previous life, Li Fan had attempted to use Kou Hong, a sincere seeker of the Dao, to catalyze an artificial Eternal Remnant Will. Although the final result had failed, it had given Li Fan some inspiration.

In fact, judging from the fact that [Truth] had been barely able to devour Kou Hong’s remnant intent, the distance from truly forming Eternal Remnant Will was not that great.

Perhaps it was only one final step away.

Li Fan pondered that perhaps the tempering period had been too short, and the process had not reached the necessary intensity.

‘The deepest emotions do not fade with the passage of time. Instead, their response becomes ever fresher with the passage of years. The more they are washed by the river of time, the more crystalline and brilliant they become.’

A thoughtful expression appeared in Li Fan’s eyes.

‘I have yet to control the power to distort time, but I can use illusion formations to make the false indistinguishable from the real.’

‘In this life, I will gather enough seeds. Then I will throw all of them into the Illusory Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation.’

‘As long as I plant enough seeds, I refuse to believe that not a single one can mature!’

A sharp glint flashed through Li Fan’s eyes.

‘If I had not devoured Kou Hong’s remnant will in the previous life and seen those scenes through the resulting regression, given my temperament, I would probably have still gritted my teeth and attempted to achieve Dao Integration.’

‘Eternal Remnant Will is far too important. It can awaken the unknown abilities of [Truth].’

‘Equally important are the Three-Pronged Tree and the Clay Figurine left behind by Sun Piaomiao aboard the Immortal Ark. I simply do not know whether these relics will still be useful to [Truth] in this life.’

The Immortal Ark possessed the power of True Immortal seal script, and treasures within the Immortal Compendium of Hundred Tales appeared one after another. It could even control an ancient Desolate God.

Before [Truth] had finished charging, Li Fan would not rashly provoke it.

‘Now that source power essence is abundant, I can deploy Immortal-grade formations to kill enemies at any time.’

‘But if we are talking about my strongest killing divine ability, it is still the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger.’

Within the Great Xuan Dao Lecture Platform, three figures lay unconscious.

One large and two small, two males and one female.

The smaller figure was naturally Ou Shangtian.

As for the other two, they were the same as Ou Shangtian. The Foundation Establishment treasures within their bodies also seemed to originate from True Immortal remains.

‘In the previous life, I glimpsed quite a few scenes from the flesh and blood of a True Immortal.’

‘I wonder if I can see more this time.’

The strange treasure within Ou Shangtian’s body was the Kun-Qian Bone Hand.

The other man and woman respectively possessed the Wind-Treading Foot and the Phantom-Seer Divine Eye.

The Wind-Treading Foot not only allowed its bearer to travel through the air at tremendous speed, it could also absorb the destiny and fortune of every person they killed. Using all living beings as stepping stones, they could ascend step by step toward the heavens and overlook the world from above.

The Phantom-Seer Divine Eye could not only see through the illusions of the world, it could also spontaneously produce visions at certain crucial moments. These could be warnings about the future or perceptions of hidden treasures in the surrounding area. Its uses were simply too wondrous to enumerate.

In fact, when Li Fan previously captured the female cultivator who possessed the Phantom-Seer Divine Eye, she seemed to have sensed something even before he acted. Her expression changed drastically. However, the disparity in strength between her and Li Fan was simply too great. Even though she had sensed danger, she had no time to react before Li Fan captured her.

The bearers of the three supreme treasures floated quietly in the air.

Li Fan had finally completed his preparations.

His brush moved like a dragon and snake, and the [Ancient] character suddenly appeared within the scene.

The mysterious power of reversing the past illuminated the True Immortal remains within the bodies of the three figures.

True Immortal flesh and blood began to emerge from them.

It was as though the True Immortal who had once died was truly about to be resurrected.

Li Fan manipulated strands of golden threads like ropes, drawing the three masses of flesh and blood closer together.

As if they truly originated from the same source, they instantly attracted one another despite still being some distance apart.

Li Fan looked at the grotesque mass of writhing flesh not far away. A character he had prepared long ago drifted into existence.

This character was not a True Immortal seal script character. Instead, it was a formation Li Fan had engraved himself.

The formation was connected to the small world of the You Clan people.

The simulated heavenly mandate suppressing that place was responsible for channeling everything affected here into the leg bone of the Nameless True Immortal.

Before the formation had fully unfolded, only strands of its aura leaked out.

The grotesque mass of flesh immediately began trembling violently, as though it had encountered some terrifying monster.

It rapidly retreated, trying to flee into the distance.

How could Li Fan possibly allow it to do as it wished?

He manipulated the character and lightly suppressed it onto the mass of flesh.

Even though the formation had not been completely connected, the character still pressed the True Immortal flesh firmly into place.

It was as though it had instantly lost all spirituality and become a mass of dead flesh, completely unable to move.

Only then did Li Fan hold another character and slowly approach.

Under the deterrent aura that very likely originated from the Nameless True Immortal, even though Li Fan was merely a mortal existence beneath the Immortal level, the True Immortal flesh showed no abnormal reaction when he approached.

It allowed Li Fan to touch and examine it freely.

All kinds of strange properties seemed to have completely lost their effect.

Li Fan nodded slightly and separated a strand of divine sense, sending it into the True Immortal flesh.

Boom!

After all, Li Fan himself was not the Nameless True Immortal.

Using borrowed authority to intimidate the tiger could only suppress this mass of True Immortal flesh on the surface. Once he truly attempted to use mortal means to probe an immortal, the backlash that should come would still descend.

But this time, perhaps because Li Fan had already glimpsed these memories before, the backlash he suffered was far weaker than when he first encountered them in his previous life.

His hair did not turn white in an instant. Instead, his life force was being consumed at merely two or three times the normal rate of aging.

This was completely within the range Li Fan could accept.

With an indifferent expression, Li Fan watched the scenes emerging before him one after another.

At the very beginning, there were scenes similar and connected to what he had seen in his previous life.

"...Qionglang Star Region... annihilation... garisson..."

"...Target located."

"This subject accepts the command."

They were still conversations from the Immortal Realm.

Only this time, there was also the lingering reluctance in the gaze of that True Immortal before leaving the Immortal Realm for the lower realm.

Because of this, Li Fan was finally able to truly see the legendary Immortal Realm with his own eyes.

It was as if there were countless waves appearing simultaneously across a vast ocean. Each wave was a star region of the Immortal Realm.

Within the star regions, True Immortals were as scarce as stars. The overwhelming majority were creations made by True Immortals.

Magnificent and sacred palace images appeared simultaneously within every wave.

Seated within those palaces seemed to be great figures who ruled over entire Immortal Regions.

Even that True Immortal descending to the lower realm did not dare to look directly at them.

In Li Fan's impression, there was only an indistinct phantom.

The Star Sea surged, and all the waves disappeared beneath the horizon.

The True Immortal had arrived in the lower realm, Xuanhuang.

...

Even though it was merely a fleeting glimpse, the vigorous vitality and boundless scenes of the Immortal Realm that Li Fan witnessed still left his mind shaken.

'It is said that the Immortal Realm is a supreme holy land with inexhaustible resources. Now it seems that the rumors are indeed true.'

'That ocean is simply too vast. The star regions contained within each wave are practically endless.'

'It is simply inconceivable.'

Li Fan's mind trembled, and his brows furrowed tightly. What he had seen from that single glimpse of the Immortal Realm had completely exceeded his understanding.

The memory scenes originating from the True Immortal of the Immortal Realm continued.

He was guarding Xuanhuang, seemingly waiting for something.

The Star Sea rose and fell. No one knew how much time had passed.

Even this True Immortal could not help but experience fluctuations in his emotions.

'Five hundred years have already passed since the calculated time.'

'It still has not appeared...'

The constant trembling of the scene was enough to show how restless this True Immortal had been at that time.

'Let us wait a little longer.'

Within the Xuanhuang Realm, the sun rose and the moon set. Once again, no one knew how much time passed.

'Fifteen hundred years.'

'This has completely exceeded the range that could be explained by an error...'

'The thing I feared most has still happened. That thing...'

'It probably will not come.'

As this thought emerged, the entire world instantly became gloomy.

It was as if the last straw that could save his life had disappeared. The True Immortal closed his eyes, endless despair surging within his heart.

Yet, for some unknown reason, he seemed to think of something else, and the despair in his consciousness gradually receded.

'Great figures have the thoughts of great figures.'

'Ants have their own way of surviving.'

'...'

The True Immortal's gaze swept across the Xuanhuang Realm of that era, as well as the entire Star Sea.

Boom!

The scene suddenly shattered.

...

'Even a True Immortal is still an ant?'

'Then what sort of existence was the great figure he spoke of?'

'The Nameless True Immortal?'

'Is the difference between proving the Dao with a name and proving the Dao without a name truly that enormous?'

Li Fan's mind trembled violently once again.

The memories of the True Immortal himself were naturally millions of times more trustworthy than a baseless speculation.

Because of this, Li Fan had gained the beginnings of an understanding of the Immortal Realm.

As he probed these memories, the rate at which his lifespan was being consumed became two or three times faster than before.

Strands of white appeared in his hair, but Li Fan still did not give up on continuing his investigation.

He had a premonition that the most important information was about to appear.

...

The scene shifted again.

The True Immortal was no longer looking down upon the Xuanhuang Realm.

Instead, he was sitting beside a stone table near a pool, drinking tea together with someone.

That figure was indistinct.

But judging from the True Immortal's attitude, the other party was certainly an extraordinary great figure.

What shocked Li Fan even more was the pool beside the stone table where the True Immortal sat.

He was extremely familiar with it.

It was precisely the Fishing Pond!

A voice came from the indistinct figure opposite him.

The True Immortal repeatedly nodded respectfully, yet no trace of the conversation remained within the memory.

After finishing a cup of tea, the figure opposite him quietly disappeared.

The tense emotions that had gripped the True Immortal also relaxed.

The stone table, the stone chairs, and even the cup of tea he had just drunk all disappeared together with that figure.

It was as if everything had been an illusory dream from beginning to end, as though it had never happened at all.

Yet Li Fan could still sense the excitement within the True Immortal's emotions in the memory.

He looked toward the calm pool of water nearby.

With a flick of his finger, he tossed a certain ball of light into it.

The ball of light entered the water without creating the slightest ripple. In the blink of an eye, it was swallowed and disappeared.

The True Immortal then closed his eyes and sensed something.

After a long while, he slowly walked to the edge of the pool.

He lowered his head and looked at his own reflection in the water.

Boom!

A face appeared within Li Fan's mind.

The mass of True Immortal flesh suppressed by the Nameless Immortal's leg bone suddenly erupted violently.

Li Fan's hair instantly turned completely white.

He abruptly withdrew from the memory.

'It is only the aging of my body. I still have more than three hundred years of lifespan, so there is no major problem.'

'The True Immortal flesh also quickly calmed down. It should merely be a brief resonance caused by the True Immortal's face appearing within the memory.'

Li Fan quickly reached his conclusion.

That mass of flesh remained firmly suppressed beneath the Nameless True Immortal's leg bone.

Li Fan, however, had still not recovered from what he had just witnessed. His expression was somewhat dazed.

In the reflection on the surface of the Fishing Pond, he had seen the face of the True Immortal.

Yet what left him confused and horrified was that the face... was exactly identical to his own!

Chapter 1387: Infinite Return

In fact, the moment Li Fan saw his own face reflected in the waters of the Fishing Pond, countless thoughts flashed through his mind.

'Could this body that I transmigrated into and possessed actually be the reincarnation of that True Immortal who descended to the lower realm back then?'

'Could it be that I did not awaken [Truth] because of [Transmigration], but because I possessed this original body and took the treasure that belonged to it?'

The thought spread uncontrollably through Li Fan's mind.

But...

It seemed to have sensed Li Fan's thoughts. [Truth] actually seemed to let out a faint trace of mockery.

Li Fan was slightly stunned, then suddenly came to his senses.

'No. The original body I replaced was far too ordinary. How could there have been even the slightest hint of a True Immortal's bearing?'

'Without my intervention, he probably would not even have been able to pass the imperial examinations in his entire life. He would have remained nothing more than a weak, powerless scholar until his death.'

'And even I, if I had not possessed [Truth]...'

Li Fan recalled the end of his first life after transmigrating.

'Although I had children and grandchildren filling the household, I was ultimately still just an ordinary mortal who lived a mediocre life and died.'

'I was able to use a portion of [Truth] to establish my Foundation, and after so many reincarnations, there has been so much interaction and resonance between me and it...'

'It is absolutely impossible that I am the reincarnation of a True Immortal, nor was [Truth] some contingency left behind by a True Immortal.'

'That leaves only one possibility...'

'Could it be that even in my memories, the Fishing Pond reflected my original appearance?'

After eliminating the answer that would have been truly horrifying, Li Fan did not feel relieved. Instead, his heart grew even colder.

He abruptly raised his head and looked toward the Fishing Pond in reality.

'Proving the Dao without a name, becoming one with the Dao. No matter when or where the Fishing Pond exists, it represents that True Immortal.'

'Could what happened just now mean that the Nameless True Immortal also saw me through the waters of the Fishing Pond?'

Li Fan's heart jolted.

The more he thought about it, the more horrified he became.

For example, could this have been a scheme set up by that True Immortal from back then together with the Nameless, meaning that the fact that he possessed [Truth] had already been exposed?

Even worse, [Truth] had not finished charging yet and could not be activated. If that Nameless True Immortal came after him, then even with his supreme movement techniques, he would probably be unable to escape this calamity.

Li Fan could not help but curse inwardly.

He had originally thought that he had basically figured out the Star Sea within the High Wall. As long as he did not deliberately provoke those few existences, he should not encounter any danger.

Yet he had never expected that merely studying True Immortal flesh and blood would inexplicably lead to so many complications.

Although the events of his previous life seemed to indicate that even if Li Fan died, [Truth] could still activate on its own...

But first, Li Fan had never truly died and experienced [Truth] activating on its own. Second, he had no idea whether [Truth]'s autonomous activation would still work when its charge had not yet reached one hundred percent.

Cold sweat began to appear on his forehead.

It seemed that he was facing the greatest crisis in his history, yet Li Fan did not choose to sit and await death.

In the blink of an eye, Li Fan thought of numerous possible ways to salvage the situation.

'Head toward the center of the Star Sea and using the momentum of ascending to descending to trigger the black qi of the Dao Annihilation Calamity.'

'Go to a weak point in the High Wall and attack it, drawing the attention of the existence beyond the High Wall.'

'If I am captured into the Fishing Pond, find a way to locate Cat Treasure.'

...

But no matter which method he chose, before the realm of the Nameless True Immortal, they all seemed to be nothing more than futile struggles.

'If it were merely a True Immortal, these clever tricks might still work.'

'But the Nameless Realm.'

Recalling the fear and reverence toward the Nameless in the memories of that True Immortal who had descended to the lower realm, Li Fan felt a deep sense of powerlessness.

'In the end, I can only rely on [Truth].'

Li Fan ultimately did only one thing. The phantom of the Wooden Sword emerged from its sheath, and he flew toward the Xuan Immortal Ark at the frontier of the Star Sea.

Silently infiltrating the ark, he retrieved the figurine hidden on the first layer of the Treasury.

In his previous life, he had assisted in rebuilding the Immortal Ark's entire defensive system. Thus, he entered as if no one were there, successfully retrieving one of Sun Piaomiao's relics, the figurine, without alerting anyone on the ark.

To Li Fan's surprise, even though it had already devoured it once before, [Truth] still felt a desire to consume the figurine.

He impatiently fed it to [Truth]. Watching the charging progress increase to one hundred and fifty percent, Li Fan could not help but let out a long sigh of relief.

'The effect has diminished, but judging from [Truth]'s reaction, it can actually consume it one more time.'

'If that is the case, perhaps the Three-Pronged Tree is the same.'

'An item that can continuously allow [Truth] to devour it three times...'

'Just what is the origin of these things left behind by Sun Piaomiao?'

Li Fan's brows furrowed tightly.

Suddenly, an idea emerged in his mind.

'The Three-Pronged Tree can inexplicably give [Truth] one additional simulation.'

'And perhaps this figurine is also related to the power of simulation.'

The scene of the Immortal Realm that he had glimpsed not long ago once again appeared before Li Fan's eyes.

'Before I transmigrated, I once heard that if the scale of time were extended to an unimaginably long span, the smallest particles composing everything in existence, after undergoing countless combinations and rearrangements, would eventually reproduce everything that had once existed. This is [Truth], and it is also fate.'

'True is false, and false is true. Every simulation of [Truth] can be regarded as another [Truth] of all things.'

'The infinity of the timescale means the infinity of energy...'

Li Fan's thoughts once again drifted toward the unfathomable unknown beneath the floating ocean of the Immortal Realm.

'Perhaps this figurine is the key to prying open that infinite power.'

'Or perhaps it is a projection of the Great Dao related to infinite power.'

At this moment, Li Fan became completely immersed in his thoughts, unable to extricate himself.

It was not that he had forgotten the fatal crisis of being pursued by the Nameless True Immortal.

Rather, if Li Fan had flown all the way to the Xuan Immortal Ark and the Nameless True Immortal still had not descended...

Then it would not come again.

It had merely been a false alarm. Nothing had happened.

When Li Fan slowly returned to his senses from his contemplation, however, he did not feel much relief at having survived the calamity.

'Wherever the power of a True Immortal reaches, it is as if the True Immortal itself has personally arrived.'

'The Nameless Realm should be even more so.'

'In the memories of that True Immortal who descended to the lower realm, it looked directly at me, yet nothing happened.'

'Either even a Nameless True Immortal cannot see or perceive the [Truth] within my body.'

'Or perhaps...'

'The circumstances of that Nameless Immortal Fisher are not very good.'

At the end of the life before last, when Cat Treasure had appeared out of nowhere and effortlessly captured the Hunger Immortal, Li Fan had already developed two possibilities.

Either Cat Treasure was the work of the Nameless Fishing Immortal, created to capture True Immortals who were about to prove the Dao of Namelessness, thereby achieving some form of feeding.

Or perhaps, the fisherman could also become the fish. Cat Treasure had been deliberately placed into the Fishing Pond by an unknown force beyond the High Wall. Its purpose was to follow the trail and locate the Nameless Fishing Immortal the moment the latter revealed even the slightest trace.

Judging from everything happening now, it seemed that matters were indeed developing according to Li Fan's second speculation.

Even after Li Fan had exposed such a huge flaw, the Nameless Fishing Immortal still had not appeared. It was precisely the appearance of a person who treated every blade of grass and every tree as a potential enemy.

Li Fan took a deep breath.

In this short period of time, the blood of a True Immortal had brought too many things to light.

They were still far beyond the scope of what Li Fan could currently control.

Whether it was a True Immortal or a Nameless True Immortal, neither was an existence he could possibly contend with.

Li Fan's desire for Dao Integration grew even stronger.

'After merging with the Dao through the Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth, at the very least, I will go from being an ant completely incapable of resisting to becoming a vicious wolf capable of taking a savage bite.'

'Moreover, I have a feeling that once I touch the level of the Immortal, [Truth] will also undergo an unprecedented transformation.'

A sharp glint flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

This premonition was also a trace of reassurance that [Truth] seemed to have conveyed just now after sensing his wild thoughts. Or perhaps it was some form of encouragement and promise.

It made Li Fan feel considerably more at ease.

'It seems that in this life, I should still try my best not to create any more complications.'

'It is best to achieve Dao Integration as soon as possible.'

As he pondered, Li Fan had already made up his mind.

'The second layer of the hidden treasury has already been protected by Heavenly Star Light Lotuses. Since I have yet to find a way to break through them, I will not force my way in for now.'

'First, I will search through the first layer of the hidden treasury.'

There was an old saying that a thief never leaves empty handed.

Since he had already entered the hidden treasury of the Immortal Compendium of Hundred Tales, how could Li Fan possibly leave empty handed?

After carefully selecting once again, he moved away everything that could be useful.

Before the people of the Xuan Immortal Ark could discover him, he leisurely departed.

As for the Xuan Immortal Ark, which would soon discover that its hidden treasury had been inexplicably robbed and once again fall into turmoil, nearly resulting in a second internal split, that was another matter.

After returning with a full haul, the first thing Li Fan did was once again recreate his two Supreme combat puppets.

Arriving at the frontier of the Star Sea, Li Fan held the liquid long sword in his hand and performed the [Taijia Divine Art], which had been improved by the Elders of the Xuan Immortal Ark.

In this life, ten thousand years had already passed without any cultivator coming into contact with the consciousness of the Star Sea. With the goodwill accumulated by the Taijia Realm as his foundation, Li Fan's communication with the Star Sea was even smoother than in the previous life.

It did not feel the slightest anger at having its power siphoned away. Instead, it was even astonished that an ant like Li Fan could actually unleash such a divine ability.

At the same time, the Star Sea's Infinite Power infused this time was faintly different from that of the previous life.

Under the combined power of the Equal Art and the Shape of Living Beings.

A new Qiushui was slowly born.

'Thank you, Great Master, for granting me life!'

It was still the sword spirit, completely unclothed, kneeling gracefully in worship.

However, the Qiushui of this life possessed lively eyes and seemed much more like a true living being.

Li Fan nodded slightly. After bestowing upon him the name he had already decided upon, he immediately hurried back to the Xuanhuang Realm.

Eternal Remnant Will, True Immortal flesh and blood, black star stone, bronze-cast immortal crane...

Together with the battle memories of [Ancestor].

The key materials were now complete.

While refining Tianyang, Li Fan also had Qiushui continuously infuse him with the Star Sea's Infinite Power.

The puppet's aura surged violently. If Li Fan had not concealed it with an Immortal-grade formation, it would probably have alarmed the numerous powerful beings within the Xuanhuang Realm long ago.

After a great deal of effort, Supreme Tianyang once again emerged into the world.

In this life, although he no longer possessed the battle insights gained from fighting the Ancient Desolate Gods, he had instead received an endless infusion of Star Sea power.

Like the Qiushui Sword, Tianyang was now speckled with starlight, appearing incomparably sacred.

With this, his two Supreme Guardian Protectors were finally in place, and Li Fan could at last breathe a sigh of relief.

'Even if a True Immortal descends again, I will have nothing to fear.'

After watching Tianyang and Qiushui spar with each other, Li Fan thought this to himself.

Li Fan sat atop the Great Xuan Dao Lecture Platform.

One treasure after another obtained from the Xuan Immortal Ark's hidden treasury was arranged like stars filling the heavens.

'Some treasures possess the power to nourish worlds. They can be integrated into the small worlds.'

'When those small worlds return to the Xuanhuang Realm, they can serve as nourishment for Xuanhuang's ascension.'

'As for those divine weapons and sharp treasures, they can be distributed to the living beings exploring the Carefree Dreamscape. Most of them are World Artifact level treasures, which can greatly accelerate their exploration.'

...

As Li Fan's thoughts moved, streaks of starlight flew toward different small worlds.

Feeling the countless points of light within his sea of consciousness becoming increasingly brilliant, waves of insight surged into Li Fan's mind.

'The pill is the transformation of the Great Dao of Heaven and Earth. Medicine is the cure for the ailments of all things beneath heaven. The Great Dao is formless, standing alone and unchanging, circulating endlessly without exhaustion. Through pills it is unified, through medicine it is manifested. Is Heaven and Earth itself merely a single pill formula...'

'The Dao Refining Medicine King Scripture truly is extraordinary!'

If in his previous life, Li Fan had pushed the ascension of Xuanhuang as though he were merely carrying out a step by step task.

Then now, Li Fan had begun to feel as if he were using the Heaven and Earth of Xuanhuang itself to refine an unparalleled supreme pill.

'First, use a gentle flame and slowly refine it.'

'The auxiliary materials are still somewhat lacking.'

As his eyes flickered, Li Fan once again resumed some preparations he had made in his previous life.

In addition, he secretly siphoned away a small amount of the vitality scattered throughout the ravines and depressions of the Star Sea.

By controlling the rate at which this immense vitality was infused, only a small number of people vaguely sensed the abnormally rapid transformation of the Xuanhuang Realm.

But how could they possibly discover the true culprit behind everything, Li Fan?

Of course, Li Fan had also not forgotten to plant seeds in advance before Xuanhuang's ascension.

For example, the ancient Immortal Mortal Miasma.

It was hidden within an underground cavern beneath Qiling Prefecture.

Li Fan had already verified in his previous life that, as part of the power of the Xuanhuang Realm's laws, the Immortal Mortal Miasma would continuously grow stronger as the power of the Xuanhuang Realm increased.

But in that life, because he had hurriedly returned to [Truth], he had hardly had the chance to witness Immortal-level Immortal Mortal Miasma.

Naturally, he intended to make up for that regret in this life.

Apart from the Immortal Mortal Miasma, Li Fan also extrapolated from this principle and collected various objects within the Xuanhuang Realm that could inflict tremendous damage upon cultivators, and even upon the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao itself.

For example, the Heaven-Rending Arrow, forged around a core of strange and mysterious power.

It had first appeared in the life when the Mysterious Net had replaced Heaven's authority. It could influence and distort the consciousness of the Heavenly Dao over a vast area.

Another example was the Myriad Xuanhuang World-Destruction Transformation.

Li Fan had already confirmed in his previous life that the World-Destruction Transformation was extraordinarily effective against Mo Sha.

This time, in order to hunt down Mo Sha as thoroughly as possible, he naturally had to prepare in advance.

Countless forces of Heaven and Earth's transformations were mixed together within a ball of light. Li Fan secretly integrated them into the Heaven and Earth of Xuanhuang, just like the other fragmented cultivation worlds that the Heavenly Doctor had transplanted.

According to common sense, the grafting and stitching together of such foreign objects would inevitably provoke rejection from the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.

Various calamities would descend, and through the cycles of destruction and rebirth, the foreign objects would slowly merge together.

But the wonderful part was that the World-Destruction power of Xuanhuang that Li Fan had implanted originated from the Xuanhuang Realm itself.

Therefore, the Xuanhuang Realm would not notice this suddenly enlarged piece of 'flesh' that had appeared upon its own body.

Chapter 1388: Refining The Xuanhuang Realm

Time flew by. In the blink of an eye, the Xuanhuang Realm once again arrived at Anchor Year 15.

On this day, Li Fan repeated his old trick and once again captured the Medicine King Cauldron after it returned from beyond the heavens.

As before, he subdued everyone from the Medicine King Sect and forced them to work for him.

At the same time, he secretly captured Ruan Tianxiao and returned to the former site of the Medicine King Sect, where he once again had him swallow that "Stone Pill."

Just like in the previous life.

After swallowing the pill, Ruan Tianxiao's figure and bearing became ethereal and otherworldly, resembling an exiled immortal descended from the heavens.

At the same time, he began lecturing those around him on the [Dao Refining Medicine King Scripture].

The profound sounds continued without end.

Even though this was not the first time Li Fan had heard this peerless scripture, all kinds of profound insights still surfaced within his mind.

It was as if his understanding of the Dao of alchemy had unconsciously advanced another step.

The lingering echoes continued for a long time.

Combining his newly gained understanding of the Medicine King Scripture, Li Fan once again made some minor adjustments to his plan for sublimating the Xuanhuang Realm.

"After more than ten years of nurturing and the nourishment provided by various hidden means, the Xuanhuang Realm has gradually recovered from its former weakness."

"The conditions are ripe. It is time to begin the first step of refining the pill."

A faint glint flashed through Li Fan's eyes. His gaze pierced through the firmament of the Xuanhuang Realm, revealing the countless small worlds connected to it.

"All worlds under heaven shall return to Xuanhuang."

"All laws shall return to one, and all under heaven shall become one!"

There was a faintly strange quality to his voice. With these soft words, Li Fan determined the fate of those countless small worlds.

At this very moment, the simulated Heavenly Mandates within these small worlds began to mobilize the power of their respective worlds.

Their world forms expanded on their own, like countless tentacles extending along the passages Li Fan had already arranged.

They touched and connected with the Xuanhuang Realm.

First, a single point of light in the darkness became tinged with the color of Xuanhuang.

Then, hundreds and thousands of golden stars soon lit up one after another. They surrounded the Xuanhuang Realm, shining brilliantly and dazzlingly.

"Reverse the principles of heaven and earth..."

At this moment, Li Fan separated a figure from himself and drifted toward the sky.

At the same time, he softly chanted.

The return of so many small worlds naturally required the cooperation of the Xuanhuang Realm as well.

Otherwise, there was a high chance that the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm would regard them as attacks from unknown enemies beyond the realm.

"Although the power of any single small world is almost negligible compared to the Xuanhuang Realm, there are simply too many small worlds surrounding the Xuanhuang Realm. A quantitative change is enough to produce a qualitative change."

"Like a surging flood directly injected into the Xuanhuang Realm, it might trigger a backlash."

"The same approach is still needed. We require a [medicinal primer]."

As Li Fan's thoughts moved, figures resembling hazy Spirits of Heaven and Earth descended one after another.

They stood there in a daze for a moment before quickly flying toward various parts of the Xuanhuang Realm.

They were taking on their "Heavenly Duties" and would absorb the small worlds that were returning to Xuanhuang.

Li Fan roughly divided the regions they were each responsible for. Given the carrying capacity of these Spirits of Heaven and Earth, absorbing and incorporating dozens of small worlds into themselves was not a problem.

Even so, in order to complete the initial stage of Li Fan's plan, hundreds of Spirits of Heaven and Earth were continuously generated at this moment.

It was truly like Heavenly Demons descending upon the world, causing the atmosphere throughout the Xuanhuang Realm to churn violently.

Compared to normal Spirits of Heaven and Earth these Spirits of Heaven and Earth that Li Fan had artificially summoned had much hazier figures.

They did not even contain much concentrated power of laws.

They were more like empty shells, serving as vessels to bear the return of the myriad worlds into Xuanhuang.

But they still belonged to the category of Spirits of Heaven and Earth.

Such an unusual disturbance, like a procession of countless ghosts roaming through the night, naturally attracted the attention of cultivators throughout the Xuanhuang Realm.

As a result, more and more people began to discover the changes occurring throughout the world.

Was this a transformation originating from the Xuanhuang Realm itself, or was someone manipulating and orchestrating everything from behind the scenes?

The people of the world were uncertain.

But even more cultivators began to stir, wanting to hunt these Spirits of Heaven and Earth.

After all, for the vast majority of cultivators, being able to achieve Dao Integration was already something they could only dream of. As for the quality of the Spirit of Heaven and Earth used for Dao Integration, that was simply beyond their consideration.

Just as the cultivators gathered in groups of three or five, calling upon their friends and tracking the traces of the Spirits of Heaven and Earth.

Boundless dark clouds suddenly covered the skies of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Night descended upon the land.

All the cultivators felt various ominous premonitions rise within their hearts.

Yet they did not know where this unease came from.

Very soon, the dark clouds disappeared.

The countless living beings continued what they had been doing.

Everything seemed to have returned to normal.

However, in Li Fan's eyes, the living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm had already fallen into an endless dream.

The [Illusory Xuanhuang, Multitudinous Living Beings] Grand Formation had truly descended upon the living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Apart from a very small number of locations such as Daoyuan Prefecture and the Fishing Pond, every living creature in the Xuanhuang Realm had already entered the formation.

With the support of the boundless power of the Star Sea, combined with the massive amount of source power essence accumulated by the returning You Clan over the past ten years.

Li Fan was able to unleash this peerless Immortal-grade formation that enveloped the entire Xuanhuang Realm.

Compared to the previous life, when this formation had trapped the Heavenly Doctor, it had advanced another step.

Although the deductions of the Final Dissociation Disc had already fallen into a bottleneck.

But Li Fan had also incorporated his own insights into refining the Dao and the Transformations Between Truth and Falsehood into the formation.

He further upgraded the [Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation].

It was no longer merely a simple illusion formation.

If someone happened to die within the illusion formation, then death would truly descend upon them in reality.

On the other hand, if they experienced various things within the illusion and gained something as time passed, those gains would not be synchronized with reality.

Instead, they would be absorbed by this peerless illusion formation, becoming nourishment that was offered up to Li Fan.

Under the shroud of the Immortal Formation, from this day onward, all living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm could only retreat, never advance.

Every bit of their evolution toward a "better" state would be intercepted and harvested by Li Fan.

As long as the formation remained unbroken, they would serve as diligent slaves working for Li Fan for all eternity.

Yet Li Fan would not keep all the essence he harvested for himself.

He would even retain only a small portion.

The vast majority would be handed over to the Xuanhuang Realm.

This was certainly not because Li Fan had suddenly reformed and developed a great compassion.

First, it was to gain even more of the Xuanhuang Realm's trust.

After all of Li Fan's various actions in this life, his favorability in the eyes of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao had already reached a level almost unprecedented in history.

With the arrival of the Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation, which had captured all the cultivators who were parasites upon heaven and earth in one sweep, this goodwill had reached an entirely new peak.

Just moments ago, Li Fan had manipulated the laws of heaven and earth and summoned tens of thousands of Spirits of Heaven and Earth. Yet the Xuanhuang Realm Heavenly Dao had not shown the slightest trace of anger.

Instead, it had sent over an indistinct, almost fawning connection, as if asking whether Li Fan wanted more.

"With every additional moment that the Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation operates, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao will trust me a little more."

"Until..."

"Heh heh heh."

Li Fan sneered coldly in his heart.

He completely ignored the affectionate thoughts transmitted by the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao. Narrowing his eyes, he gazed into the Xuanhuang Realm beneath the formation.

"As for the Five Elders Association, aside from those protected by the Carefree Paradise, none of them escaped."

"The moment the formation descended, Carefree seemed to want to split his power and protect every living being within the entire Five Elders Association, just as he did when the World-Destruction Immortal Formation descended before."

"But for some reason, he ultimately backed down."

Li Fan pondered for a moment. He had no intention of confronting Carefree head-on.

"As for the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance..."

"The Tianxuan Mirror at the Immortal Alliance headquarters seems to have avoided the formation's invasion. As expected of an Immortal Artifact."

"There are also several other places that actually escaped the influence of the Immortal Formation."

Li Fan became interested and inspected them one by one.

He discovered that most of them had escaped because of their special spacetime locations.

Some were secret realms, while others were remnants of ruined cultivation worlds that had been devoured and fused into the Xuanhuang Realm.

"With only a slight improvement, they can all be covered next time."

Li Fan paid little attention to these exceptions.

There was not even a Dao Integration cultivator among them. They could not cause any trouble at all.

Among all the exceptions, there was only one that made Li Fan take it somewhat seriously.

In Liuguang Prefecture of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, there was an ordinary mortal town where nearly a hundred people had barely been affected by the illusion formation.

It was not that they had escaped completely.

They had indeed been captured by the Immortal Formation and fallen into boundless illusions.

Yet very soon, these nearly one hundred people actually broke free from the illusion formation.

One had to know that even the Heavenly Doctor had not awakened so quickly!

Li Fan proceeded extremely cautiously, separating a strand of his consciousness to investigate them carefully.

"There are truly many strange things in this world. What the storyteller once told us has actually come true!"

"But a dream is still a dream. The storyteller told us back then that we only needed to constantly remember that whenever something was too agreeable to our hearts, there must be something wrong with it. Then we would be able to awaken from the dream!"

"Wait. Hiss, according to what you just said, isn't the fact that we awakened so smoothly also something that is 'too agreeable to our hearts'? Could it be that we are still dreaming?"

...

Before the words had even finished.

The several hundred people in the small town were once again enveloped by the power of the Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation, falling back into the illusion formation.

"The storyteller."

Li Fan pondered thoughtfully. His divine sense swept across the area, and he quickly found the person everyone had mentioned.

At this moment, the storyteller had also awakened from the illusion formation.

His expression showed neither surprise nor fear.

Instead, as he looked at the seemingly frozen world around him, a trace of delight appeared on his face.

"This person..."

"Even I cannot see through his cultivation."

"Could it be that there is still an expert hidden within the Xuanhuang Realm?"

"Impossible. During the previous two world-ending calamities, this person never displayed anything unusual."

Li Fan shook his head slightly, refusing to frighten himself with his own suspicions.

He simply reached out and pulled the storyteller toward him.

"Greetings... greetings, Immortal Master."

The storyteller was startled at first. Then, instead of showing fear, he seemed somewhat pleasantly surprised as he respectfully greeted Li Fan.

Li Fan confirmed that the other party truly was an ordinary mortal who could not even tie a rooster.

"How did you awaken from the illusion formation?" he asked slowly.

The storyteller shook his head somewhat blankly.

"I do not know either. I simply felt that there was something indescribably discordant about the world before my eyes."

"Discordant?"

The storyteller pondered for a moment. Looking at Li Fan, he hesitated before explaining.

"Although a dream may seem real, it is still different from reality."

"I know my own abilities. No matter how hard I try, at most a hundred people would come to support my storytelling. Yet within the dream, nearly half the people in the entire town came to listen..."

Upon hearing this, Li Fan immediately frowned.

The Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation could not possibly make such a low-level mistake.

"What is interfering with the Immortal Formation's judgment?"

A thought stirred in Li Fan's mind, and he once again carefully searched the storyteller's body.

Chapter 1389: Several Visitors Of High Wall

Once, twice.

Li Fan swept his divine sense over the storyteller repeatedly, but he still could not find the reason that had caused the Immortal Formation to misjudge him.

'Perhaps it is not because of him personally...'

With his brows furrowed, Li Fan carefully searched through the objects nearby.

In the end, his gaze fell upon the storyteller's wooden clapper.

'This thing...'

At first glance, it seemed completely ordinary, merely a black piece of wood.

But when Li Fan drew it into his hand, the moment he came into contact with it, his soul actually felt a faint, refreshing coolness.

'Hm?'

Ever since comprehending the [Limitless Fullness and Emptiness Technique], Li Fan's soul had remained in a state of 'perfection', constantly existing at the very limits of what he himself could achieve. Even if it suffered any damage, it could instantly heal through the circulation of the Five Elements and the flow of Primordial Unity.

His soul had already become powerful to a certain extent. Only breakthroughs in his major cultivation realm could allow its strength to increase by another step. In fact, ever since he advanced to the Soul Transformation Realm, his soul had not grown any stronger even after all these years.

Yet now, as that cool sensation seeped into him, Li Fan actually felt his soul slowly becoming more solid, and the bottleneck that had restrained it was beginning to loosen.

'Hiss... What kind of treasure is this wooden clapper?'

Li Fan was pleasantly surprised, but even more wary.

One had to know that the strength of Li Fan's soul could now already be compared to that of a cultivator in the Xuanhuang Longevity Immortal realm.

Once one had reached the limit, advancing even a single step further was no longer something that could be accomplished through effort alone.

'There are countless treasures hidden within the Immortal Ark. Yet I have encountered none that were useful to me. Who would have thought that the Xuanhuang Realm itself would still be hiding something like this...'

Li Fan cautiously set up an Immortal Formation, isolating the black wooden clapper from the outside world.

Then, he searched through the storyteller's memories for the origin of the wooden clapper.

It was not some mysterious ancestral object with an unknown origin. Rather, the storyteller had simply cut a piece of wood from the tree in his own courtyard and polished it into its current form.

Li Fan brought the storyteller, whose name was Ge Daoquan, back to his home.

In the courtyard, that lush and verdant tree still stood tall.

The moment he entered the courtyard, Li Fan sensed something unusual.

It was like walking beneath the scorching sun on a sweltering summer day for a long time, only to suddenly step into a patch of shade.

There was only one word for it.

Comfortable.

For an ordinary cultivator, the contrast between before and after might have been enough to make them groan aloud on the spot.

Li Fan took a deep breath. He did not lower his guard and slowly approached the tree.

The leaves suddenly began moving without any wind, producing a rustling sound.

Throughout his countless reincarnations, Li Fan had encountered quite a few extraordinary trees.

Within the Xuanhuang Realm, there were the three ancient Xuanhuang trees, Wanling, Tianhua, and Earth Vein, as well as Ruomu, which serves as the ultimate source of all living beings.

Within the Xuan Immortal Ark, there was also a divine tree originating from the Ancient Divine Wood Sect.

But all of them were different from the tree before him.

Whether it was the three ancient trees or Ruomu, they all possessed their own consciousness. They gave Li Fan the strange and uncanny feeling of plants having cultivated intelligence.

But this tree in the courtyard...

It was simply a tree.

Purely a tree, yet far from ordinary.

The crisp sound of the leaves striking against one another slowly relaxed the tension that had remained in Li Fan's heart throughout this life.

Li Fan did not know the name of this tree.

At this moment, he no longer had any desire to investigate its origins. He simply sat cross-legged beneath the tree and meditated quietly, as if comprehending the Dao.

Another breeze swept past.

Dozens of emerald-green leaves drifted down from the tree.

Like streams of flowing light, they flew into Li Fan's body.

Li Fan slowly closed his eyes.

When he opened them again, ten days had already passed.

The struggles and desperate battles he had experienced throughout a hundred reincarnations, the constant need to fear some monstrous existence with peerless cultivation suddenly emerging from nowhere, the countless times he had narrowly escaped death and the lingering fear that followed...

All the exhaustion accumulated within his heart had been completely erased.

It was as though he had simply enjoyed a long, satisfying sleep.

His entire body and mind had been renewed.

When Li Fan stood up again, he felt that his mental state had never been better.

He gazed at the tree in the courtyard.

All its former splendor had completely faded from his eyes. It now seemed no different from the most ordinary tree imaginable.

Li Fan recalled the images that had flashed through his mind during those ten days of sleep.

They were memories originating from the tree itself.

A streak of light tore through the sky and fell near the tree.

It seemed to have lost all signs of life, remaining motionless like a dead object. From the outside, it appeared to be a round sphere covered in bloodstains, with more than half of its surface charred black.

As time slowly passed, the decayed outer shell of the sphere gradually peeled away.

A baby crawled out from within.

The baby did not cry incessantly upon being born. Instead, it looked around, then chose a direction. With a resolute gaze, it slowly crawled forward.

Before long, it disappeared from the tree's field of vision.

As for the outer shell of the sphere, it was gradually dissolved by the wind, sun, and rain, eventually transforming into nourishment that was absorbed by the tree.

...

In the sky, terrifying tremors and flashes of fire could be seen everywhere. It seemed that a brutal war was taking place.

A figure silently arrived near the tree.

"Why is it a tree?"

"Could the lock have gone wrong?"

"This damn place..."

Standing on the man's hand was a small mechanical figure with a single eye. Golden light shone from its eye as it pointed toward the tree ahead.

The man's expression was filled with confusion and anxiety. He fiddled with the little mechanical figure several times, but the direction in which it gazed never changed.

The man cursed loudly in anger and directly threw the mechanical puppet onto the ground.

It seemed that some cultivator in the sky had noticed the man's presence below.

The man's expression changed slightly. He transformed into a streak of golden light and fled.

An unknown number of days passed.

The mechanical puppet had already been buried deep underground.

The sun rose and the moon fell. The traces of that earth-shattering battle were gradually erased by the passage of time.

Whenever an ordinary mortal happened to pass by this place, they would always feel an indescribable sense of peace.

Thus, some people eventually chose to settle here, and a small mortal town gradually emerged.

Ten generations of people lived near this tree.

All of them possessed remarkably good dispositions.

Although they lived ordinary lives, they were content with what they had and found happiness in simple things. Even when they encountered difficulties, they would simply smile and let them pass.

Until the descendants of the eleventh generation chose to become a storyteller to make a living.

He happened to be lacking a good wooden clapper, so he cut a piece from the tree in his family's courtyard.

...

Thoughts surged through Li Fan's mind.

The first thing he did was start digging around the tree.

Knowing that searching with his divine sense was useless, Li Fan had no choice but to investigate personally.

Before long, he indeed found the mechanical figure that the man had casually discarded hundreds of years ago.

Despite having been buried beneath the earth for so many years, it still looked brand new.

Not the slightest trace of time had left its mark upon it.

However, for some unknown reason, the mechanical figure's third eye was already closed.

No matter how Li Fan tried to activate it, there was not the slightest response.

Li Fan toyed with the mechanical object in his hand and sensed a familiar aura from it.

'Descends into Mortal World...'

Li Fan's expression gradually became solemn.

After pondering for a moment, Li Fan made his decision.

He took out the white ring, [Descends into Mortal World], and directed it toward the mechanical figure.

Descends into Mortal World was the physical manifestation formed from the Great Dao Law of [Innate].

For over a decade, Li Fan had kept the white ring in his hand, constantly recalling the manifestation he had seen on the Wordless Stele in his previous life.

He wanted to comprehend this Great Dao.

But to his slight disappointment, no matter how he tried to comprehend it, he was unable to form his own understanding of it like he could with the other True Immortal seal script characters.

It was as though...

The principles of the Innate in this world had already all converged into one place, leaving no room for outsiders to meddle.

Li Fan did not force the matter. After all, with [Truth] already bound to the white ring and bringing it into the mortal world, he could currently invoke it and comprehend it at any time. The difference was not particularly significant.

At this moment, the white ring's radiance locked onto the mechanical humanoid.

Under the white light, the humanoid, which should have been decomposed and reduced to nothingness, was actually completely unharmed.

It was not because its level of existence surpassed Descends into Mortal World and allowed it to resist the decomposition effect.

Rather, after the radiance released by the white ring sensed the mechanical humanoid, it suddenly turned green.

The mechanical humanoid thus avoided the fate of being decomposed.

After being illuminated by the white ring, the mechanical humanoid, which had remained dormant all this time, came alive once more.

It flew up and hovered above Li Fan's palm before opening its third eye.

It seemed to be searching for something, constantly rotating.

Yet for some unknown reason, the speed of its rotation grew faster and faster.

It was as though it had gone out of control, spinning wildly without stopping.

It became like a spinning top.

"Is it broken?"

Li Fan frowned slightly.

He did not stop it for the time being and continued allowing the little humanoid to spin.

Li Fan first looked toward the green tree in the courtyard.

"A hundred years ago, the reason the little humanoid pointed toward this tree was because this tree had absorbed that layer of outer skin that contained the infant."

"That substance should have the effect of awakening intelligence and granting enlightenment."

"However, with the passage of time, especially after I absorbed it previously, its effect has now become extremely weak. That is why the little humanoid continued pointing toward other places."

"The effect has weakened by who knows how many times, yet it can still have such an astonishing effect on me. It is difficult to imagine what it was like in the beginning."

Li Fan's eyes flickered as he continued pondering.

"The white ring Descends into Mortal World can sense the mechanical humanoid. This is enough to confirm that they originate from the same source..."

"If so, then my speculation from my previous life was indeed correct. The one suppressed in the deepest depths of the Nether Prison truly came from beyond the High Wall as well."

Li Fan's expression immediately became solemn.

Indeed, the male figure that had appeared in the tree's memories was precisely the skeleton Li Fan had seen in the deepest depths of the Nether Prison in his previous life.

The cultivator who called himself Qin Zhuang.

"I searched his soul, yet this recent memory was not there."

"Clearly, he used some secret technique to conceal and fabricate his experiences. What a skillful method."

Li Fan secretly praised him. Rather than feeling angry at having been deceived, he instead felt a faint excitement.

"He thought his actions were flawless, but he never imagined that whenever something exists, it must leave traces."

"Under ordinary circumstances, these traces would be extremely difficult to find. But in front of the Illusory Xuanhuang Formation, where all living beings are equal, it has finally revealed itself!"

Li Fan recalled the image from the tree's memories, the infant crawling out from the sphere.

"Qin Zhuang... I will temporarily call him that."

"He came to the High Wall's inner side seemingly to search for traces of that infant."

"If so, does that mean the infant also came from beyond the High Wall?"

"Qin Zhuang is connected to the Heavenly Sword Sect. Could this infant also be a descendant of the Heavenly Sword Sect?"

In an instant, countless questions surged through Li Fan's mind.

In this life, the Immortal Alliance Nether Prison had already been enveloped by the Illusory Xuanhuang, Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation. Qin Zhuang had inevitably fallen into the illusion formation as well.

But judging from the results of his previous life's probing, Qin Zhuang probably would not reveal any flaws.

"Two consecutive failures..."

"It seems the methods capable of resisting the illusion formation from beyond the High Wall have already become quite widespread."

Li Fan pondered for a moment but did not hurry to capture and interrogate Qin Zhuang.

"If he can even evade an Immortal-grade formation, then other physical punishments should be useless as well."

"I need to upgrade to even more specialized methods. Perhaps after I achieve Dao Integration, I will have new ways of dealing with him."

...

Gathering his thoughts, Li Fan once again looked at the constantly spinning mechanical humanoid.

It still showed no sign of stopping.

Li Fan pondered as he carefully observed it.

"It appears to be rotating, but there is a different interval between each rotation."

"This appearance is almost as if..."

"It has simultaneously found many different targets. And these targets are scattered throughout various locations in the Xuanhuang Realm?"

Li Fan arrived at an inconceivable conclusion.

"Wait, could it be..."

In an instant, a thought flashed through Li Fan's mind like a bolt of lightning.

To verify his speculation, Li Fan held the mechanical humanoid and slowly flew toward a certain location.

As he continued approaching, sure enough, the frequency with which the little humanoid turned toward Li Fan's direction of travel increased.

Eventually, Li Fan arrived at his destination.

Looking at the little humanoid that had finally stopped spinning, Li Fan smiled meaningfully.

On the wooden plaque before him were three large characters.

Qianli Hall.

The mechanical humanoid's third eye stared straight into the hall, where Jiao Xiuyuan had already fallen into a deep sleep.

Then, as if it had exhausted its energy once again, it slowly closed its eye.

"So that infant from back then was actually him."

"Jiao Xiuyuan came from beyond the High Wall?"

"But unlike that Qin Zhuang, he cannot resist the Illusory formation..."

Countless thoughts churned within Li Fan's mind.

He then closed his eyes and stood silently, carrying the mechanical humanoid with him as he entered the Illusory Xuanhuang Formation.

Within the illusion formation, Jiao Xiuyuan continued as usual, constantly calling out to customers and conducting his business.

The instant Li Fan appeared before him, Jiao Xiuyuan seemed to sense something as well. His sales pitch abruptly stopped, and his gaze fell upon the mechanical humanoid in Li Fan's hand.

Li Fan pretended to turn around and leave.

"Fellow Daoist, please wait!"

Jiao Xiuyuan hurriedly called out and walked over to stop Li Fan.

"Since you have already come, why pass through the door without entering? Come in and sit for a while."

Jiao Xiuyuan spoke with a broad smile. His dark complexion revealed a trace of simple and honest sincerity.

Possessing the absolute professionalism of a merchant, he did not look at the little humanoid in Li Fan's hand again.

Li Fan put away the little humanoid and sighed.

"It is an ancestral item. I originally intended to sell it. But after thinking it over again and again, I decided it would be better not to."

"Farewell."

Li Fan cupped his fists and once again prepared to leave.

"Fellow Daoist, don't be in such a hurry to leave. There is something about your face that makes me feel familiar. Whatever difficulties you have, feel free to tell me. If it is within my ability, I will certainly help you."

Jiao Xiuyuan thumped his chest loudly, looking like a man of great loyalty and righteousness.

Li Fan hesitated for a moment before finally sitting down.

Without making a sound, Jiao Xiuyuan closed Qianli Hall and shut the door.

He focused entirely on Li Fan.

"To be honest, Fellow Daoist, ever since I was born, I have always had the same recurring dream."

Li Fan pondered for a moment. The moment he spoke, he immediately captured Jiao Xiuyuan's attention.

"In the dream, I see a radiance descending from the heavens. An infant crawls out of a sphere..."

As he spoke, Li Fan carefully observed Jiao Xiuyuan's reaction.

Jiao Xiuyuan listened with great interest, yet contrary to Li Fan's expectations, he showed no abnormal reaction whatsoever.

"I suspect this dream may be related to this little humanoid that has been passed down through my family."

Li Fan spoke once more.
