Chapter 1390: The Dust Abyss Life And Death Dao

Li Fan's expression was somewhat ferocious as he gritted his teeth and said, "Fellow Daoist, do you know how terrifying it is to spend your entire life trapped in the same dream?"

"These strange little humanoid are to blame! I want to completely rid myself of these nightmares, which is why I came to your Qianli Hall."

"But this is, after all, an ancestral possession. The instructions left by my ancestors clearly state that this object must be properly preserved..." Li Fan's expression became conflicted.

Hearing this, Jiao Xiuyuan nodded along with him, frowning. "The ancestral instructions may be important, but your own life is more important."

"This thing really is extremely sinister. It is an ominous object. But Fellow Daoist, rest assured. Our Qianli Hall has always been fair. We will not deliberately lower the price because of this."

Li Fan hesitated for a while before slowly saying, "I can sell it. But preferably, we should first figure out what secrets lie behind this little man. Otherwise, it will be difficult for me to explain myself to my family."

"Could you let me take a closer look?" Jiao Xiuyuan asked tentatively.

Li Fan hesitated slightly, but in the end, he handed the mechanical humanoid over.

The earlier search had exhausted the humanoid's energy. Thus, even after falling into Jiao Xiuyuan's hands, it showed no reaction whatsoever.

Jiao Xiuyuan examined it from top to bottom, occasionally furrowing his brows.

"Can you tell anything?" Li Fan asked.

"Judging from the appearance of this puppet, it seems to be someone from the ancient cultivation world known as the Dust Abyss. It is said that the cultivators of this world all possessed True Immortal bloodlines and were born with three eyes. They also possessed many innate divine abilities..."

"The strange thing is, I have never seen the material this puppet is made from." A peculiar expression appeared on Jiao Xiuyuan's face.

"The Dust Abyss Realm?" Li Fan pretended as though he had never heard of it before.

"It is an ancient secret, and this realm was destroyed long ago. It is perfectly normal that Fellow Daoist does not know about it." Jiao Xiuyuan waved his hand, showing no intention of elaborating. His attention remained focused on the mechanical little man.

At this moment, Li Fan secretly manipulated the illusion formation.

The mechanical little man seemed to suddenly open its third eye. A beam of brilliant light shot straight out, directly toward Jiao Xiuyuan.

Both Jiao Xiuyuan and Li Fan cried out in surprise at the same time.

By the time they reacted, the golden light had already disappeared, as though it had merely been an illusion.

"F... Fellow Daoist, are you alright? That golden light just now, it was not an illusion, was it?" Li Fan asked, his expression filled with uncertainty.

Jiao Xiuyuan nodded solemnly. "I saw it too. It actually came for me..."

His words seemed to remind Li Fan of something. He suddenly said, "That's right! Previously, whenever I thought about selling this mechanical humanoid, I would become restless and find it difficult to make up my mind. It was only after I came near your Qianli Hall that I finally became determined."

Li Fan's expression became somewhat horrified. "Could it be that Fellow Daoist really has some inexplicable connection with this mechanical humanoid?"

This time, Jiao Xiuyuan did not answer. He carefully examined the three eyed puppet with his hands.

Having seemingly discovered something, his expression became increasingly solemn.

"This thing... may be alive."

After a long silence, Jiao Xiuyuan suddenly spoke, his words causing a sensation.

"Ah?" Li Fan appeared startled, staring at the puppet in disbelief.

"It seems that through some unimaginable supernatural means, a living cultivator from the Dust Abyss Realm was sealed and refined into an object."

"Although it has transformed into an object, it still retains all the magical power and divine abilities it possessed as a powerful cultivator with a True Immortal bloodline!" Jiao Xiuyuan concluded.

"This... This is impossible, right? Even if one could transform a person into an object, I fear that even the Immortal Ancestor could not accomplish such a feat. Besides, didn't Fellow Daoist say that the Dust Abyss Realm had already been destroyed?" Li Fan said doubtfully.

"Beyond Xuanhuang?" Jiao Xiuyuan muttered first.

Then, seemingly wanting to verify his claim, he took out a green bottle from somewhere.

With great reluctance, he poured out a single drop of thick green liquid and fed it to the mechanical little man.

"This bottle contains pure life essence. If it were a dead object, it would certainly show no reaction."

"But if it still possesses the attribute of life, it will instinctively absorb it."

As if proving Jiao Xiuyuan's words, the moment the green liquid approached, the mechanical humanoid's two normal eyes suddenly opened. It quickly absorbed the liquid.

Li Fan still could not sense the slightest aura of a living being from it, yet he watched with his own eyes as the little humanoid gradually came to life.

The target locked onto by the little man was indeed still Jiao Xiuyuan.

Its third eye shot out a beam of golden light. Like chains, they tightly wrapped around Jiao Xiuyuan.

"Fellow Daoist, are you alright?" Li Fan asked nervously, but he had absolutely no intention of helping. He merely watched from afar.

Bound by the golden chains, Jiao Xiuyuan could not move at all. His expression seemed frozen as well, and he gave no response whatsoever.

"Don't worry. How could such a trivial trick possibly hurt me?" The voice was still Jiao Xiuyuan's, but it came from another corner.

Li Fan looked toward the direction of the voice. He saw that, at some point, a withered yellow branch had grown out of the ground in the corner.

The branch continued to extend and transform.

Before long, another Jiao Xiuyuan suddenly emerged from it.

"You... Are you human or a ghost?" Li Fan shuddered in fright, his face filled with terror.

"Hehehe, it is merely a small clone technique." Jiao Xiuyuan reassured him.

He had barely finished speaking when the third eye of the Dust Abyss mechanical humanoid once again shot out a beam of golden light.

It locked onto Jiao Xiuyuan.

Once again, Jiao Xiuyuan had no ability to resist and was captured.

"Fellow Daoist!" Li Fan cried out in a trembling voice, his legs shaking as if he were about to flee.

"Don't panic!" Another voice appeared.

A third Jiao Xiuyuan appeared inside Qianli Hall.

His fate was the same. He was likewise bound by golden chains.

"Let's see how many of me you can capture!"

A hint of anger could be heard in his voice, and ten voices appeared simultaneously.

Branches sprang up everywhere throughout Qianli Hall. Ten identical Jiao Xiuyuans appeared one after another.

Faced with such a strange scene, the three eyed little man seemed momentarily stunned.

Only after a while did it shoot out golden chains to capture its targets.

But after releasing only three chains simultaneously, it seemed to have reached its limit.

As if completely drained of energy, it once again returned to its previous dormant state.

"Trying to catch your Uncle Jiao? You're still far too inexperienced!" Jiao Xiuyuan snorted smugly.

Seven voices rang out one after another.

After saying this, six of them once again transformed into withered branches, withering away and retreating back into the ground.

Only one remained, staring at the six captured versions of himself.

He slowly approached and reached out to touch the golden chains.

"This thing..."

The chains seemed to be mere phantoms. Jiao Xiuyuan's hand passed directly through them.

Seeing this, Li Fan also became curious and tentatively reached out to touch them.

He likewise could not touch them.

"They seem to have been formed from an innate divine ability of a cultivator from the Dust Abyss Realm."

"Quite extraordinary indeed."

After experimenting for quite some time and still being unable to touch their true form, Jiao Xiuyuan could not help but sigh in admiration.

"Jiao... Fellow Daoist Jiao. It seems that the target of this mechanical humanoid really is you?"

“Could it be that the infant who appeared in our dreams for generations was you? And the mechanical humanoid came to our world to hunt down Fellow Daoist Jiao as well?” Li Fan's expression was somewhat fearful, and his tone became increasingly alarmed.

“But that does not seem right either. Fellow Daoist, you do not look very old. The timeline does not match either. Could you be a descendant of that infant?” Li Fan sized up Jiao Xiuyuan, his expression filled with uncertainty.

“I should... be that very infant,” Jiao Xiuyuan said frankly.

“What?” Li Fan's eyes widened.

“Old Jiao here has lived far longer than ordinary people. It is just that for the vast majority of that time, I was in a state of ignorance, acting purely on instinct,” Jiao Xiuyuan said indifferently.

“In fact, I still have some vague memories of what happened during my childhood. They were merely sealed deep within my mind, and I had almost forgotten them completely. After what happened today, I have managed to recall some of them.” Jiao Xiuyuan's tone became somewhat distant and uncertain.

“Fellow Daoist Jiao, are you truly a cultivator from beyond the realm?” Li Fan stared intently at Jiao Xiuyuan, as if trying to see through him. His expression was filled with curiosity and excitement.

“I should... be, I suppose.” Jiao Xiuyuan hesitated before finally nodding.

“I have no recollection whatsoever of what happened before I crawled out of that sphere. But since the puppet that was tracking me came from beyond the Xuanhuang Realm, I suppose my homeland must have been beyond the Xuanhuang Realm as well.”

“No wonder I instinctively wanted to cultivate a technique that could transform my body into countless incarnations. Was it to evade pursuit?” Jiao Xiuyuan said with an indescribable tone.

Li Fan, meanwhile, was filled with amazement. He stared at Jiao Xiuyuan and sighed, “It is truly difficult to imagine how Fellow Daoist managed to survive alone from infancy until now, and even establish the Qianli Hall business.”

Jiao Xiuyuan waved his hand. “Actually, it was nothing difficult. In truth, ever since I gained my memories, as long as I acted according to my heart, I almost never encountered any difficulties. Every obstacle would somehow resolve itself. Of course, doing business is an exception.”

“Making money is genuinely difficult!” Jiao Xiuyuan suddenly lamented, completely out of place with the situation.

“I originally wanted to resolve my own calamity, but I never expected to implicate Fellow Daoist Jiao in the process. If not for me, this puppet would have lost its power and probably would not have come looking for you.” Li Fan's face revealed a trace of guilt.

Jiao Xiuyuan, however, took it quite calmly. “What is destined to happen cannot ultimately be avoided. Besides, this time, I may have actually gained a blessing in disguise.”

Li Fan was somewhat surprised. “What do you mean?”

“I have lived in the Xuanhuang Realm for far too long. Being constantly influenced by my surroundings, I inevitably followed the path of defying the principles of Heaven and Earth.”

“It indeed helped me tremendously. In fact, if not for the new cultivation method of the Heavenly Sovereign, I probably would have already lost my life when I was young.”

“But because of that, some of the methods from my homeland were also sealed away, making them even more difficult to recall.”

“If not for what happened today...”

Jiao Xiuyuan's expression became somewhat dazed.

It was as if he were trying to recall some crucial information buried deep within his mind. His brows occasionally furrowed.

His eyes grew increasingly bright.

Li Fan also faintly sensed an extraordinarily profound aura emerging from Jiao Xiuyuan's body, fluctuating unpredictably.

Jiao Xiuyuan seemed to notice something. He looked around.

A trace of astonishment gradually flashed through his eyes.

“Freeze!”

Just as he was about to see through the illusion formation, Li Fan spoke coldly.

The scene before Jiao Xiuyuan shattered with a thunderous crash.

“Fellow Daoist Jiao, Fellow Daoist Jiao!”

“Why are you spacing out? What about those Little Medicine King Cauldrons we agreed on? Are you selling them or not?”

An impatient voice urged him from beside his ear.

Jiao Xiuyuan was slightly stunned. In an instant, information surged into his mind like a tide.

It turned out that he had finally managed to excavate some exceptionally well-preserved Little Medicine King Cauldrons from the ruins of the Medicine King Sect.

They could not only be used as storage treasures, but also contained their own spiritual energy spaces where various spiritual plants and medicinal herbs could be cultivated. Their value was extraordinary.

“Selling them, of course I am selling them...” Jiao Xiuyuan instinctively replied.

But at that moment, he suddenly remembered that he had already learned from a cultivator highly skilled in deduction that, before long, a meteor would fall back into the Xuanhuang Realm.

The true nature of that meteor was very likely the Medicine King True Cauldron that had carried the entire Medicine King Sect away back then.

At that time, the surviving Little Medicine King Cauldrons in the world would be the keys to entering the True Cauldron. The Medicine King True Cauldron was filled with the essence and treasures that the Medicine King Sect had taken away in the past.

As the keys to the True Cauldron, the value of the Little Medicine King Cauldrons would inevitably soar!

“Not selling!” The moment he thought of the enormous profits he would soon obtain, Jiao Xiuyuan's heart began pounding. He immediately changed his answer.

“Fellow Daoist Jiao, how can you go back on your word?” The cultivator opposite him became anxious.

Jiao Xiuyuan, however, simply gathered up all the Little Medicine King Cauldrons in one go and directly closed the door on his customer.

His mind was already calculating how to drive up the price of the Little Medicine King Cauldrons as much as possible.

“Hmm?”

Jiao Xiuyuan vaguely felt that he seemed to have forgotten something extremely important.

But faced with enormous commercial profits, he decided to put it aside for the time being.

...

Outside the illusion formation, in the real Xuanhuang Realm.

Li Fan looked at the several golden locks before him, his expression deep and contemplative.

Although everything that had just happened had occurred within the illusion formation, reality and illusion had been intertwined. On the three-eyed puppet, those events had also truly manifested.

It had indeed received a massive infusion of life force and had briefly come back to life. However, that life force had not come from the green bottle taken out by Jiao Xiuyuan. Instead, it had been derived from the power of the Immortal-grade formation.

The stimulation it received was real, so the golden chains shot out by the three-eyed puppet were naturally real as well.

At this moment, they were frozen in midair, and at first glance, they seemed somewhat similar to the golden threads wielded by the Heavenly Doctor.

In truth, however, there was a fundamental difference.

The Heavenly Doctor's golden threads were the “power to drive and alter laws” that the Heavenly Doctor had cultivated after comprehending and penetrating the laws of Heaven and Earth.

But the golden light shot out from the puppet's third eye...

“It is itself a certain kind of law.”

“It seems that it truly originates from the divine abilities of cultivators from the Dust Abyss Realm.”

Li Fan was not particularly interested in this mysterious three-eyed race.

No matter how powerful they had once been, they had now fallen to the point of being refined into puppets.

What interested Li Fan more was the heaven-defying method of transforming life into objects, as well as the force behind it.

“Cat Treasure, Descends into Mortal World, and this three-eyed puppet.”

“Beyond the High Wall, life transformed into objects, laws transformed into objects...”

“They truly have brought the Dao of external objects to its absolute extreme.” Li Fan's heart was heavy, yet he was also filled with awe toward the unknown civilization beyond the High Wall.

“Compared to the White Ring, the method used to forge this puppet is relatively crude. Perhaps this could be a breakthrough point.”

Chapter 1391: Immortal Characters Appear On The Stone Stele

"Clumsy" was only relative to the naturally formed, traceless white ring, [Descends into Mortal World].

In truth, the three eyed humanoid's method of refining humans into objects had already completely surpassed Li Fan's existing system of understanding.

Even with the actual object placed before him, Li Fan was practically at a loss as to how he should begin studying it.

Among all the theories he had encountered throughout his life, the only one that bore even a slight resemblance was the [Dao Refining Medicine King Scripture] personally transmitted by Sun Piaomiao.

But even that resemblance was limited.

"Transforming a human into an object, while retaining the living properties of a human."

"At the same time, it possesses the properties of an [object]."

"......"

Li Fan conducted a series of experiments on the three eyed humanoid he had obtained.

The first thing he confirmed was that the humanoid's self awareness had already been erased. It could only act according to predetermined rules.

Li Fan then tested the little man's resistance to physical attacks.

After the three eyed humanoid became ineffective, Qin Zhuang had casually discarded it. Clearly, outside the High Wall, it was not considered a particularly valuable object.

Yet for such a tiny thing, Li Fan had practically brought out his ultimate techniques. Only the Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger could inflict obvious damage upon it.

"If they were merely cultivators of the Dust Abyss Realm, then even if they possessed the True Immortal bloodline spoken of in the rumors, they would not be capable of achieving this. It has gained an additional layer of an object's properties, and the two have been perfectly integrated without any weakness. That is what has caused its defensive power to increase so drastically..."

The existences from beyond the High Wall seemed to possess an extraordinary resistance to illusion formations.

Li Fan used the three eyed humanoid to test nearly all of the Immortal grade formations he currently possessed, one after another. He discovered that even when unconscious, the humanoid could repeatedly evade the fatal attacks of the Immortal formations. It moved through them with ease, as if completely at home.

"Besides the properties of a human and an object, there seems to be a third property layered onto it."

As Li Fan observed, he continuously adjusted the Immortal formations according to the three eyed humanoidn's evasive movements.

He then used the newly modified formations, optimized with the Final Dissociation Disc, to conduct another round of tests.

The result remained unchanged. The humanoid still effortlessly evaded them.

Li Fan did not become impatient. He continued with another round of iteration.

After the formation had undergone fifty improvements, the three eyed humanoid's flawless evasive movements finally developed flaws. It occasionally began to be caught by the operating Immortal formation.

A bright light suddenly flashed in Li Fan's eyes.

"My Immortal formations are like a giant net that I have woven."

"Although they appear to have no enemy within the Darkest Star Sea, and once deployed, the formation can encompass all living beings, in the eyes of an object created beyond the High Wall like the three eyed humanoid, every single gap in this great net is a flaw!"

"But as I gradually seal these flaws one by one, making the net denser and denser, with smaller and smaller openings..."

"It will no longer be so easy for it to rely on instinct to resist the formation!"

"In short, although my attainments in formation Dao have not undergone a qualitative improvement, my formations are becoming increasingly difficult to break through!"

Li Fan stared intently at the Dust Abyss race humanoid within the Immortal formation, his thoughts surging.

He applied all the detailed modifications from the upgraded and iterated formations to every great formation he possessed.

It was like an originally crude sketch. As more and more details were added, the reproduction became increasingly meticulous.

"Perfecting formation details to this degree is absolutely impossible for one person to accomplish in a short period of time. Only through generations of research, with people of the Immortal Ark taking up the work one after another and continuously studying it, could such attainments be achieved!"

For a moment, Li Fan seemed to see countless figures working day and night without rest, tirelessly studying the Dao of formations.

"The reason I can complete these additions so quickly is merely because I am directly taking them and using them. In truth, without the assistance of the Dissociation Disc, I would never have been able to iterate the formations this rapidly!"

"The three eyed humanoid was brought from beyond the High Wall by Qin Zhuang five hundred years ago."

"Yet the White Ring and Cat Treasure are creations from only recently."

"Has the technology beyond the High Wall truly advanced so enormously over these five hundred years?"

Li Fan's mind stirred. He took out [Descends into Mortal World] and threw it toward the formation that was evolving before him.

He wanted to compare the differences in how it and the three eyed humanoid responded when faced with the constantly changing formations.

However, just as Li Fan expected, [Descends into Mortal World] was immune to every formation technique applied to it.

His observation plan had failed before it had even begun.

"I could not even see any evasive movements similar to those of the three eyed humanoid within the formation."

"Instead, it is as if every Immortal formation I currently possess simply has no effect whatsoever!"

"It seems to exist on an entirely different level of underlying principles..."

Li Fan's eyes flickered as he pondered.

"It seems that over these five hundred years, the technology beyond the High Wall has undergone a qualitative leap."

Previously, inspired by the phenomenon of different time flows within the Darkest Star Sea, Li Fan had speculated that the flow of time beyond the High Wall might also be far faster than within the High Wall.

More than ten thousand years had already passed within the Darkest Star Sea since the Immortal Realm's great catastrophe descended. Perhaps millions of years had passed beyond the High Wall.

"The difference between the three eyed humanoid, which arrived in the Xuanhuang Realm earlier, and the other creations seems to corroborate my speculation from another angle."

"Of course, it is also possible that Cat Treasure and the white ring are extremely rare existences even beyond the High Wall. Perhaps this is simply a difference in the value of what is commonly available..."

However, because Cat Treasure and the white ring had both been fished out of the Fishing Pond, Li Fan instinctively believed that these existences, which served as "bait", should not be particularly rare objects.

"With the three eyed humanoid helping me correct my formations and reduce their flaws, perhaps in this life, I will have a chance to completely perfect them."

"And extract some useful information from Qin Zhuang's mind."

The experiment had already entered a stable phase, and there was almost no possibility of further complications. From this point onward, it would merely be mechanical repetition.

Li Fan separated out a simulated personality to handle the improvement of the complex formations.

Next, he began studying the several streaks of golden light shot out by the three eyed humanoid, the same golden light that had been used to capture Jiao Xiuyuan.

It had already been confirmed that this golden light was an innate divine ability of Dust Abyss cultivators, representing a certain law itself.

And what could possibly be easier to analyze laws with than the leg bone of the Nameless True Immortal?

Wrapped in the golden light, Li Fan flashed into the small world of the You Clan.

With the protection of Li Fan's phantom statue, the You Clan members, who had once been on the verge of extinction, had already once again occupied most of the territory within the small world.

However, at certain intervals, the terrifying stone stele at the center of the world would erupt with boundless calamity, taking the lives of nearly half of the You Clan members.

Because of the existence of the stone stele and the phantom, the You Clan members lived forever under fear and devout prayer.

After arriving before the leg bone of the Nameless True Immortal, Li Fan first glanced at the progress of the manifestation of the True Immortal seal script characters on the stele.

Perhaps it was because a quantitative accumulation had triggered a qualitative transformation. After devouring a massive amount of the You Clan members' flesh and blood, the blank stele was manifesting characters far faster than Li Fan had anticipated.

The mysterious character had currently revealed less than one fifth of itself. Yet Li Fan could already faintly sense a unique might emanating from it.

It was different from the characters for "Hunger" and "Innate."

The True Immortal seal script character related to the transformation between immortality and mortality was clearly extraordinary. When it appeared on the stone tablet, it could actually penetrate the restraints imposed by the stele's power to a certain extent, radiating its own might toward the outside world.

It was precisely because of this faint influence that, even without Li Fan personally urging it on, the You Clansmen's process of returning to their ancestral bloodline had continued to advance slowly.

All of this had happened silently.

Even the artificial personality that had been continuously monitoring the situation had failed to notice.

Only now, with Li Fan personally present, had he keenly detected the changes taking place here.

Li Fan slightly furrowed his brows and decisively set up layer upon layer of Immortal-grade formations around the stone stele, isolating the influence of the True Immortal seal script characters on the outside world.

"It is not that the level of this Immortal-Mortal Transformation seal script character has already surpassed that of the Nameless True Immortal."

"Rather, this particular seal script character itself possesses certain special properties. The Great Dao it involves may have even influenced the Nameless True Immortal while he was still alive."

"And this stone stele is not the complete Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar. It is merely a fragment of a leg bone."

"Such a change is therefore not unexpected."

"But when True Immortals are involved, there really are pitfalls everywhere. I cannot afford the slightest carelessness."

Li Fan secretly warned himself.

He then began the real task.

He projected a still strand of golden light toward the stone stele.

The instant it approached, the stone stele absorbed it.

The imprint of an entirely new True Immortal seal script character began to appear in a corner of the stone stele.

However, what puzzled Li Fan was that the characters for "Hunger" and "Innate", as well as the still-forming Immortal-Mortal Transformation character, had all appeared successively in the central region of the stone tablet.

Yet this new character had ignored that large central area and instead squeezed itself into the very corner.

Li Fan tried to recall which True Immortal seal script characters had appeared in the corresponding area of the Wordless Stele in his previous life. Unfortunately, he had only caught a fleeting glimpse of it back then, and not even an impression had remained in his memory.

Thus, after pondering for a long while, he still could not find the slightest clue.

He simply stopped worrying about it and continued feeding it golden light.

As expected of a pure manifestation of laws, it was far more efficient than simply feeding it physical materials and then analyzing them afterward.

With only one strand of golden light remaining unconsumed, the True Immortal seal script character on the stone stele had already been fully revealed.

"This is..."

"Restrain?"

Like all True Immortal seal script characters, the moment Li Fan saw it, its true meaning immediately surfaced in his mind.

This character was not particularly complicated either.

Yet in Li Fan's eyes, it possessed a somewhat different quality.

After coming into contact with a large number of True Immortal seal script characters, Li Fan had once made a simple classification of them.

He did not classify them according to the strength of their might, but according to their functions.

The vast majority of True Immortal seal script characters were annotations of the Great Dao laws of heaven and earth. However, a small portion had evolved from decrees issued by the Immortal Realm.

For example, there was the [Return] Character that had previously caused the Nine Star Red Bead, the core of an ancient Immortal formation in the Xuanhuang Realm, to mysteriously disappear.

And the [Restrain] Character Art that had now appeared before Li Fan belonged to this same category.

"The Dust Abyss Realm possesses a True Immortal bloodline. This is probably not an exaggeration."

"A True Immortal descending into the lower realm comes at an enormous cost. The Immortal Realm also needs to find agents in the lower realms to carry out its will. The cultivators of the Dust Abyss Realm probably served as the Immortal Realm's enforcers in the lower realm..."

Li Fan suddenly recalled that, according to rumors, the Dust Abyss Realm had been among the first cultivation worlds to be affected when the great catastrophe of the Immortal Realm descended. It should have been destroyed long ago.

Yet many years later, there still seemed to be surviving cultivators who had been refined into objects by forces beyond the High Wall.

"There are several possibilities."

"First, there may not be only one Dust Abyss Realm in the lower realms. There may be others scattered throughout the Darkest Star Sea."

"The second possibility is that cultivators from the Dust Abyss Realm survived back then and escaped beyond the range of the Darkest Star Sea before the High Wall was established. They then reproduced and established themselves beyond the High Wall. Judging from the current situation, however, their circumstances are probably not very good."

Li Fan gathered his thoughts and began experimenting with the newly acquired [Restrain] Character seal script.

It had an effect remarkably similar to the [Insect Binding] divine ability he had obtained long ago.

Or perhaps it was simply an advanced replacement for the Insect Binding divine ability.

Insect Binding still required the caster's strength to exceed that of the target.

But under the [Restrain] Character seal script, as long as the target could not resist the might of the True Immortal seal script, they would be instantly restrained.

Their body, soul, and thoughts would all fall into a state of frozen stillness, completely at the mercy of others.

Li Fan summoned Qiushui and Tianyang and conducted a series of experiments.

Both belonged to the Supreme realm.

However, perhaps because Tianyang had once absorbed the combat experience of the Immortal Puppet and had consequently acquired some of its characteristics, he performed extremely poorly under the [Restrain] Character seal script.

He had to unleash almost his entire strength just to barely break free.

Qiushui's response was considerably better. By relying on the boundless power of the Star Sea, he could reduce the influence of the [Restrain] Character seal script to a minimum.

"The True Immortal seal script characters evolved from Immortal Realm decrees seem to have a different origin from those copied from the Great Dao laws."

Having personally experienced the might of the [Restrain] Character seal script, a thought flashed through Li Fan's mind.

"Aside from their normal might, they also possess particularly strong suppressive effects against certain existences."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes slightly.

He had once been fortunate enough to glimpse the entirety of the Immortal Realm.

Within that boundless and vast ocean, True Immortals were still only a minority. Most regions of the Immortal Realm were filled with Immortal Puppets, Immortal Servants, and other creations of True Immortals.

"Perhaps the Immortal Realm's decrees are precisely a means of granting authorized control over these beings."

"They might even be effective when used from a higher level against a lower one."

By "higher against lower," Li Fan did not mean merely True Immortals against mortals.

It also included that towering figure from the memories of the True Immortal who had descended into the lower realm, acting against True Immortals.

"Subject..."

As he recalled fragments from the memories of that True Immortal who had descended into the lower realm, Li Fan gradually understood something.

"I do not know its name, so for now I will call it the Dominator. In the Dominator's eyes, even True Immortals are no more than ants. Perhaps this has something to do with the strict hierarchy of Immortal Realm decrees..."

"It is like an imperial edict in a mortal dynasty. With a single decree, an entire family can be exterminated."

"But an imperial edict derives its authority from the emperor. As for the Immortal Realm's decrees..."

Li Fan wrote another [Restrain] character.

"It seems... something is missing."

Li Fan slightly furrowed his brows.

It was not that the [Restrain] Character seal script manifested by the stone stele was incomplete. Rather, Li Fan faintly sensed that while writing the [Restrain] Character seal script, certain restraints were missing.

"Under normal circumstances, not everyone possesses the authority to write the [Restrain] character."

"But after the Immortal Realm was destroyed and the Dominators who ruled over the True Immortals all turned to ashes, this restriction disappeared along with them."

Li Fan keenly sensed the precious aspect of these True Immortal seal script characters derived from Immortal Realm decrees.

"As long as one understands their composition, one can activate their power."

As his thoughts surged, Li Fan could not help but raise his head and look toward the sky.

He wondered about using the [Restrain] Character seal script against the True Immortal from the Immortal Ruins above and seeing what effect it would have.

Chapter 1392: The Xuanhuang Serving Heart

After letting his imagination run wild for a while, Li Fan ultimately forced this thought down.

That day would come, but not now.

In this life, the goal of merging with the Xuanhuang Heaven and Earth Celestial Spirit to attain the Dao took precedence over everything else.

“Besides the Hungry Immortal of the Immortal Ruins, I can also use that Watcher, and even the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, for an experiment. In theory, since they hold official positions bestowed by the Immortal Realm, the restrictions placed upon them should be even deeper.”

Li Fan was extremely satisfied with what he had gained this time. Not only had he greatly made up for the deficiencies in his Immortal formations, he had also grasped a True Immortal seal script character representing an Immortal Realm imperial edict.

And all of this had merely come from an inadvertent glimpse into the secrets beyond the High Wall.

It was truly difficult to imagine what the world beyond the High Wall had become by now.

“As for Jiao Xiuyuan's identity...”

Li Fan had genuinely never considered that Jiao Xiuyuan might very well be an orphan left behind beyond the High Wall.

“When Jiao Xiuyuan was first cast into the High Wall, he should have been only a newborn. For someone in such a situation to be separated from his homeland and relatives...”

“A major upheaval must have occurred. The force represented by Qin Zhuang also found clues and tracked him down only many years later.”

Li Fan's expression was complicated.

“Why would they choose to entrust the life of such a young member of their bloodline to be sent through the High Wall into the Xuanhuang Realm?”

“To them, was the Xuanhuang Realm a pure land where they could escape the conflicts of the outside world? Or is there some treasure hidden within this land that even those beyond the High Wall covet?”

“And more importantly, it seems that those beyond the High Wall can observe the situation within the High Wall to some extent. At the very least, they can determine that the Xuanhuang Realm has not yet been devoured or destroyed by the Immortal Ruins. Otherwise, casting Jiao Xiuyuan here would be no different from sending him to his death.”

A mere drop of the substance contained within the spherical shell that had enveloped young Jiao Xiuyuan could nurture an extraordinarily mystical tree capable of evading the effects of Immortal formations. It was easy to imagine that Jiao Xiuyuan himself, having absorbed most of that substance, would possess even more extraordinary characteristics.

This was also why Li Fan had not immediately searched his soul at the slightest disagreement, instead using the illusions of the Immortal formation to test him.

“However, Jiao Xiuyuan has lived in the Xuanhuang Realm for so many years that it would be no exaggeration to call him a native of this world. That special ability seems to have gone dormant...”

Li Fan's divine sense swept over Jiao Xiuyuan, who was still lost within the Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation. For the time being, he abandoned the idea of helping Jiao Xiuyuan awaken his latent potential.

When Jiao Xiuyuan had nearly awakened earlier, the aura that unconsciously emanated from him had made even Li Fan feel waves of unease.

This unease did not come from the overwhelming pressure of a sudden increase in strength.

Rather, it was more like an instinctive warning upon detecting some kind of danger signal.

“Since Jiao Xiuyuan originally came from beyond the High Wall, then when I eventually wish to explore the world beyond the High Wall, perhaps I can have Jiao Xiuyuan lead the way.”

“Given the special nature of his identity, the vortex he stirs up should be sufficiently turbulent. The more turbulent it becomes, the more secrets I will be able to glimpse.”

“Of course, I still need to make the final decision based on the information obtained from Qin Zhuang's mind.”

“The Heavenly Sword Sect...”

Thinking of one of the former Ten Great Immortal Sects that had escaped by using the World-Rifting Divine Weapon, Li Fan's heart suddenly stirred.

“Could the source of Jiao Xiuyuan's bloodline also be one of the forces that escaped from the Xuanhuang Realm in the past?”

“Even if it is not, it must have an extremely deep connection with the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“When the scale of time is stretched out, those Immortal Sects that fled back then have probably developed to astonishing heights by now. I wonder whether they still recognize their old relatives in the Xuanhuang Realm...”

His thoughts churned endlessly.

The more information Li Fan learned about the world beyond the High Wall, the more impatient he became to venture outside it.

But first, he still needed to increase his ability to protect himself.

“Soon.”

“After fifteen years of gentle nurturing, it is time to switch to fierce fire!”

Li Fan's gaze fell upon the Xuanhuang Realm.

With the vast majority of living beings in the Xuanhuang Realm trapped within the peerless illusion formation, the Xuanhuang Realm had become empty.

Without the influence of humans and cultivators, the speed at which the Xuanhuang Realm rested and recovered its vitality was almost a hundred or even a thousand times faster than usual.

Especially within the illusion formation, cultivators were constantly dying.

After their deaths, the cultivators continuously returned to the Dao and replenished Heaven. This was no different from one dose of nourishment after another. Although each dose was extremely weak, there were simply too many of them, and they arrived continuously without end.

Moreover, what cultivators had devoured in the first place was a portion of the power of Heaven and Earth. Thus, the Xuanhuang Realm could absorb it without the slightest obstruction.

The nourishment returned by cultivators, the return of the various small worlds, the infusion of vitality from the underground rivers within the earth fissures, and the nourishment provided by the boundless power of the Star Sea.

The Xuanhuang Realm was becoming increasingly “solid” and “robust” at a speed visible to the naked eye.

“The foundation has already become sufficiently substantial. Compared to the preparations I made in my previous life, it is far superior. It is enough to withstand the upheaval that is about to come.”

A faint glimmer flashed through Li Fan's eyes. Dozens of figures instantly flew out from the illusion formation.

All of them were Dao Integration cultivators of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Li Fan's plan was actually not much different from that of his previous life.

When the immense power capable of causing the entire Xuanhuang Realm to undergo sublimation was infused into it, some medicinal catalysts would still be needed to serve as a buffer.

These Dao Integration cultivators were the perfect choices.

Golden light flashed repeatedly. Even beings as powerful as Dao Integration cultivators had absolutely no room to resist in Li Fan's hands.

They were unconscious and sunk deep within illusory dreams, like insects that Li Fan could manipulate at will.

“The Immortal Domain that was not unfolded in this life cannot possibly be supported by the mere traces of immortal spiritual qi left behind by the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable's legacy.”

“Fortunately, I can now communicate with the Star Sea and draw upon its infinite power. This is enough to support the long period of quantitative accumulation before the critical point of qualitative transformation arrives.”

“What I need to do is unleash the immortal spiritual qi at the final moment, fuse it into the Xuanhuang Realm, and push it across that final threshold.”

“Afterward, I will use the nameless True Immortal's leg bone to temporarily anchor the ‘momentum’ of the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“Once the Xuanhuang Immortal Domain descends, with the immense merit I have accumulated from almost single-handedly driving this sublimation, summoning Ink Death through the Method of False Misconversion should not be difficult.”

“Then I will use the countless Xuanhuang World-Destruction Transformations that I prepared in advance and implanted within the Xuanhuang Heaven and Earth, allowing them to transform alongside it, to kill Ink Death Celestial Spirit of Heaven and Earth.”

As Li Fan manipulated these Dao Integration cultivators, he rapidly deduced the general process of attaining Dao Integration in his mind.

After confirming that there were no major flaws, he looked at the Dao Integration cultivators before him, each wrapped tightly in golden threads like a cicada chrysalis.

Li Fan casually drew one of them through the air, then threw him back into the Immortal formation spread throughout the Xuanhuang Realm.

The cultivator merged with a formation node. Concealed beneath the aura of the Immortal formation, it would be extremely difficult for anyone else to detect him.

As long as the Xuanhuang Heaven and Earth had not transformed and sublimated into an Immortal Domain, even Heaven and Earth themselves would be unable to detect the existence of these Dao Integration cultivators.

“The Illusory Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation is gradually absorbing the cultivators and returning their energy to the Xuanhuang Realm. As a result, its connection with the Xuanhuang Realm is becoming increasingly close.”

“These medicinal catalysts can take advantage of these connections to be silently implanted into the Xuanhuang Heaven and Earth.”

“First, they will lend the Xuanhuang Realm a helping hand on its path toward sublimation.”

“Second...”

“When necessary, the Bewildering Illusion Formation can instantly transform into an Immortal formation capable of destroying the world. With these medicinal catalysts serving as formation nodes implanted beforehand, it will be equivalent to directly activating the Immortal formation from within the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“By then, even if Xuanhuang has already transformed into an Immortal Domain, it will still suffer terribly from this!”

Li Fan's mind was filled with excitement.

During the preparations for Dao Integration, his understanding of formations and alchemy, through actual practice, had gradually reached a state of thorough integration.

All sorts of strange and ingenious ideas constantly surfaced in his mind.

It had to be said that this perspective of treating heaven and earth, all things, and the myriad living beings as formations and medicinal ingredients was simply too perfectly suited to Li Fan, who possessed [Truth].

Everything he did could completely correspond with what he thought, giving Li Fan an indescribably exhilarating feeling.

Of course, Li Fan did not become carried away or lose himself because of this.

He understood very clearly that the Immortal Formation and the Dao Refining Medicine King Scripture passed down by Sun Piaomiao could adopt such an indifferent attitude, viewing all living beings as mere ants, entirely because their strength had transcended the ordinary.

True Immortals were indeed beings of an entirely different level from worldly living creatures.

As for Li Fan being able to do the same, it was merely because he was relying on the extraordinary power of [Truth].

Therefore, Li Fan's determination to achieve Dao Integration became even more urgent.

'Even if I can perhaps only achieve the appearance of a Half Immortal, I should still become completely different from ordinary mortals!'

He planted all the medicinal catalysts for Dao Integration into the Xuanhuang Grand Formation.

Li Fan nodded slightly and activated the formation, concealing all traces.

He then looked toward one of the few small worlds remaining in the Xuanhuang Realm, the Thirteen Peaks World.

More than ten years had passed, yet Wuming still retained the appearance of a child.

He stood alone atop the mountain peak, having remained motionless for a very long time, as if he had transformed into a statue.

Within the Thirteen Peaks, the other living beings had already come to regard him as a deity.

They did not dare approach him and could only kneel and worship from afar.

Today, following a subtle hint transmitted by Li Fan, Wuming, who had been comprehending the Dao for a long time, finally opened his eyes.

With a single step, he left the small world of the Thirteen Peaks.

He had truly entered the Xuanhuang Realm.

In fact, under Li Fan's secret guidance, Wuming had already comprehended the principles of heaven and earth within the Xuanhuang Realm ahead of time.

But when this youth, who had lived since childhood in a tiny world consisting of only thirteen mountains, suddenly arrived in the vast Xuanhuang Realm, his heart was still filled with endless shock.

He looked up at the heavens and gazed down upon the earth. His vision seemed to rapidly sweep across the entirety of the Xuanhuang Realm.

When he saw the countless living beings sleeping within the world, Wuming was not overly surprised because of Li Fan's prior hints and guidance.

He did not even pay them much attention.

What Wuming truly cared about was this Xuanhuang heaven and earth.

Wuming stood silently in place, observing the Xuanhuang Realm.

Seven days and seven nights passed.

Only then did Wuming open his eyes and begin his journey.

This Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable personally designated by Li Fan did not immediately perform the succession ritual and enter the trial illusion.

Instead, his figure drifted across the land of Xuanhuang.

He observed the mountains and rivers of Xuanhuang, its vegetation, and its gentle winds.

Although Wuming's cultivation realm was still that of an ordinary mortal, and he had not embarked upon the path of the new cultivation method, his degree of compatibility with the principles of heaven and earth within the Xuanhuang Realm grew increasingly profound as he continued his travels.

With every step he took, there was no need to use any spatial movement technique. The heaven and earth of Xuanhuang would actively cooperate, shortening the distance between them.

There was no need to ride the wind. He merely spread his arms slightly, and a gentle breeze would naturally arrive, lifting Wuming into the air.

New cultivation method practitioners had to devour the essence of heaven and earth before they could grasp the power of the principles of heaven and earth.

But Wuming had the active cooperation of the Xuanhuang Realm. With a mortal body, he could perform feats equivalent to Dao Integration.

And what he could command was not merely a single law of heaven and earth.

It was everything within his field of vision.

There was even a faint resemblance to the time when the Heavenly Dao Bai had appeared in the world, when the essence of heaven and earth had rushed toward him at incredible speed, willingly placing itself at his disposal.

Anyone in the world who received such treatment would gradually come to believe, without reservation, that they were the chosen child of the Great Dao.

That becoming the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable was simply something destined by heaven.

But only Li Fan, who stood behind the scenes and orchestrated everything, knew that the reason the Xuanhuang Realm was cooperating with Wuming so wholeheartedly was simply because it sensed the presence of Li Fan behind him.

If Li Fan himself wanted such treatment, the cooperation of the Xuanhuang Realm could become dozens of times more extravagant and varied.

After all, considering the current rate at which the Xuanhuang Realm was recovering, Li Fan's contributions to the Xuanhuang Realm could simply be described as equivalent to giving it a new lease on life.

Watching Wuming happily roam around the Xuanhuang Realm, Li Fan waited until he finally entered the illusion of the succession ritual.

Li Fan smiled slightly.

Wuming truly was an excellent puppet chess piece.

He possessed almost no consciousness of his own and acted purely according to instinct.

Unlike Sun Tianci before him, even after Wuming inherited the position of Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, he would not take any initiative or make any extraordinary moves.

He would simply allow nature to take its course, letting the Xuanhuang Realm continue developing in a favorable direction.

Naturally, there would be no reason for him to obstruct any of Li Fan's plans.

'And when the time comes to obtain that mass of immortal spirit qi, I will not even need to guide him personally.'

'The Xuanhuang Realm itself will urge him to cooperate fully and offer it up. After all, this is the mission of the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable...'

Li Fan pondered this while waiting for Wuming to emerge from the illusion formation.

With Sun Tianci's previous example, there were no complications this time.

A strange rhythm descended upon heaven and earth.

A new Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable was born.

Wuming still appeared to be that pure and innocent child, with clear eyes.

After emerging into the present world, he stood dazed for a moment before moving.

Li Fan secretly followed and observed him.

He discovered that the first place Wuming went was none other than the Great Rift Vortex at the extreme south of the Xuanhuang Realm.

This was the scar left behind when the Nanming demon beasts had once broken through the world boundary and departed.

Even after ten thousand years, it had still not healed, becoming a terrifying forbidden zone that made the vast majority of cultivators tremble at its very mention.

Wuming drifted before the Great Rift Vortex and gazed at the scene of raging wind and rain and continuous thunder before him.

He gently struck out a ray of white light.

The warm radiance seemed like a clear, soothing melody capable of calming the anger in one's heart. The violent wind and rain within the Great Rift Vortex gradually weakened.

Ray after ray of white light continued without end.

The wound that had existed within the Xuanhuang Realm for ten thousand years was slowly healing.

Li Fan watched clearly from the side.

The white light Wuming released was precisely the vitality of the Xuanhuang Realm being summoned.

Under normal circumstances, the vitality of the world was distributed relatively evenly and would not be concentrated in such a manner.

However, after being summoned by the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, it could be gathered into a single location.

Under the effect of this concentrated and abundant vitality, the wound was rapidly repaired.

Chapter 1393: The Heavenly Beast Dies And Revives

Within the Great Rift Vortex, the wind and rain gradually subsided.

After Li Fan's various methods of nourishing it during this period, the vitality of the Xuanhuang Realm was far more vigorous than before. At this moment, with the newly appointed Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, Wuming, drawing upon its power, the wound that had existed for ten thousand years was rapidly healing at a speed visible to the naked eye.

The violent energy was gradually calming down, and the severed line of sight was temporarily restored.

Li Fan seized this fleeting opportunity and stared intently at the final sliver of the rift that had yet to completely disappear.

Previously, through the Boundless Mirror Spirit Sun Luyao, Li Fan had once glimpsed the scene from ten thousand years ago when the entire demon beast race, led by Emperor Yi, had torn through the world boundary and departed.

Emperor Yi had revealed his divine face and used the key hidden within the giant serpent coiled around Nanming Sacred Mountain to activate the terrifying energy contained within Nanming Sacred Mountain, directly breaking through the shackles of spacetime.

That force was like a sharp sword. At the same time as it pierced through the spatial passage, it had also left behind a trace of its own imprint within it.

At this moment, Li Fan caught a fleeting glimpse. Within the rift that was about to close, he vaguely captured some blurry scenes.

Unfortunately, before he had time to examine them carefully, the rift of the Great Rift Vortex had already completely healed.

After finishing the repair of the wound here, Wuming did not leave immediately.

Instead, he continued with further reconstruction.

The endless vitality continued to pour in from all across the Xuanhuang Realm. On the tranquil surface of the sea, rumbling sounds rang out without pause. One island after another rose from beneath the sea.

On the originally barren seabed, greenery began to sprout. Under the gentle sea breeze, vegetation gradually covered the surfaces of these newly born islands.

They were like crystalline pearls, adorning the ocean.

Li Fan also sensed that within the other waters connected to this sea region, countless living beings were currently rushing toward this place, competing for this newly born perfect homeland.

From this point onward, the Xuanhuang Realm had lost one dangerous and desolate region and gained another land of flourishing vitality.

The Xuanhuang Heavenly Blessing upon Wuming increased by several degrees. However, this time it did not originate from Li Fan, but from Wuming's own contributions to Heaven and Earth.

Once the Great Rift Vortex was dealt with, Wuming immediately rushed toward the next destination.

Judging from his destination, it was the Cangwu Abyss in the southwestern corner of the Xuanhuang Realm.

The scale of this enormous abyss was far greater than that of the Great Rift Vortex. It was a temporary dumping ground for the various materials created by the Immortal Ancestor and Heavenly Doctor during their reconstruction and stitching together of the Xuanhuang Realm.

According to the normal course of history, this abyss might only have been filled after the Heavenly Law Realm truly reincarnated through another vessel. But now, Wuming had taken the initiative to resolve this persistent problem.

With the ability to draw upon nearly the entire power of the Xuanhuang Realm, eliminating the Cangwu Abyss was by no means difficult for Wuming.

However, this also meant that Wuming's actions would inevitably alert Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor, who were still on the other side of the Star Sea.

In fact, ever since the Xuanhuang Realm had been sealed off, the group of Dharma-Transmitters hiding within the Tianxuan Mirror had continuously attempted to establish contact with Immortal Ancestor.

Yet no matter how they tried, they ultimately possessed nothing more than mortal methods. How could they possibly break through the Immortal Formation arranged by Li Fan?

Thus, Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor were still completely unaware of the drastic changes taking place within the Xuanhuang Realm.

They had not even noticed anything before Wuming's actual succession as the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, which still required a three year waiting period.

It was not that these two Supreme Ones were incompetent.

Rather, the power of the Immortal Formation had already surpassed the mortal world. Even if a Supreme personally arrived, they would still be deceived. Not to mention the minor methods they had left behind.

"Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor arriving ahead of schedule would only disrupt my plans. As for the Cangwu Abyss..."

"We will deal with it later."

Li Fan spoke indifferently.

There was no one around him, but he was not talking to himself. Instead, he was communicating with the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.

Li Fan keenly sensed the resistant will of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao. It seemed that the existence of the Cangwu Abyss truly made it extremely uncomfortable.

"Rest assured. I will compensate you. Moreover, what you receive will be even better."

There was a hint of temptation in Li Fan's calm voice.

The Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao seemed to struggle for a while. Perhaps because of its trust in Li Fan, it ultimately chose to agree.

Strands of profound fluctuations descended from the heavens.

Wuming, the Great Celestial Venerable, sensed their meaning, and for the first time, a trace of astonishment appeared on his face.

His rapidly flying figure came to a halt.

He raised his head toward the sky, his face filled with confusion.

The Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao naturally had no intention of explaining anything. It merely continued to express its request.

Although Wuming could not understand it, he did not go against the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao's wishes. He changed direction and rushed toward another dangerous region of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Judging from his direction, he was heading toward the Ten Thousand Li Flame-Burning Shoals, a vast stretch of scorched earth.

This place had originally been full of life, but a thousand years ago, it had suffered an inexplicable calamity and had become the barren red wasteland it was today.

Compared with the Cangwu Abyss and the Great Rift Vortex, the Ten Thousand Li Flame-Burning Shoals was indeed much easier to deal with. Wuming should not need to spend too much time there.

Afterward, he should travel throughout the Xuanhuang Realm and gradually heal the various wounds upon the land.

Li Fan merely had the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao transmit the relevant scenes to him whenever it sensed something. He no longer personally monitored or followed Wuming.

Instead, he intended to fulfill the "benefits" he had previously promised the Xuanhuang Realm.

With a thought from Li Fan, countless flickering images within the Living Beings Grand Formation all appeared in his sea of consciousness.

All living beings had entered the illusion formation, and everything they thought and imagined was simultaneously perceived by Li Fan.

Thus, they had practically no secrets left before him.

Combined with the secret search he had conducted throughout his previous life, Li Fan was able to gather all the half-Immortal artifacts currently located within the regions of the Xuanhuang Realm under his control.

The reason they were called half-Immortal artifacts was because all thirteen of these objects were similar to the Boundless Mirror.

Although they had once been Immortal artifacts, after experiencing countless calamities, all their Immortal spiritual energy had been lost. What remained were only fragments of the various miraculous abilities they had once possessed as Immortal artifacts.

For example, there was a fan capable of peering into and altering a person's emotions.

There was also a blank painting capable of slowly bringing whatever it reflected into reality.

There was even a layer of skin capable of transforming almost completely into another person, with both their appearance and soul aura becoming extremely similar. Ordinary methods would find it exceedingly difficult to distinguish the difference.

Although half-Immortal artifacts were extraordinarily miraculous, in Li Fan's eyes now, they no longer possessed much value.

He might as well collect all of them and return them to the Xuanhuang Realm.

Thirteen balls of light slowly floated out from the illusion formation, passing from illusion into reality.

Within the illusion formation, their owners still possessed their respective treasures.

But in reality, those treasures had silently fallen under Li Fan's control.

The thirteen balls of light gathered together, and the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao seemed to sense what was about to happen.

An extremely excited emotion was transmitted over. The slight dissatisfaction it had previously felt toward Li Fan had long since vanished without a trace.

Li Fan did not immediately refine these Immortal artifacts.

Instead, he carefully observed them for a while.

"Just like the Boundless Mirror, every Immortal artifact contains more or less traces of the Obliterating Wind Calamity."

"Some even retain quite a substantial amount of the residual Obliterating Wind Calamity."

After pondering for a moment, Li Fan still followed the method he had used previously.

Using source power essence as bait, he drew out all the Obliterating Wind Calamity hidden within the thirteen Immortal artifacts.

He carefully gathered it in one place, then used strands of golden threads to seal it away and preserve it.

"The Obliterating Wind Calamity seems to be specially directed toward Immortal artifacts. But regardless, it is a terrifying force capable of destroying Immortal artifacts. Anyone beneath the True Immortal realm would have to avoid it."

"Even if I do not use it to enter the Dao Annihilation Calamity, collecting a large amount of it could still serve as a trump card."

Recalling the reactions of Immortal Ancestor and the other Supremes when they witnessed the Obliterating Wind Calamity erupt in his previous previous life, Li Fan could not help but think this to himself.

Without the Obliterating Wind Calamity, these half-Immortal artifacts became increasingly delectable in the eyes of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.

They urged Li Fan to hurry up.

Li Fan remained motionless, quietly standing there for more than half a day, deliberately whetting the appetite of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Only after the incessant demands from the Xuanhuang Realm did he finally proceed to the next step.

"Xuanhuang World-Destruction Transformation, the passage of years, the changing of seas and mulberry fields!"

This was a transformation that would only be born when the Xuanhuang Realm faced the threat of destruction. At present, the Xuanhuang Realm was flourishing with vitality, so this transformation did not yet exist.

It was exactly the same as when he had previously refined the Boundless Mirror.

Under the enveloping mysterious power, the flow of time in the space containing the thirteen half-Immortal artifacts seemed to accelerate by hundreds or even thousands of times.

The power of heaven and earth continuously churned, like a stomach digesting these half-Immortal artifacts.

The half-Immortal artifacts gradually became dim and indistinct.

Li Fan slightly raised his head. He also sensed that the Spirit of Heaven and Earth, which was specifically responsible for transforming Immortal artifacts into wondrous treasures of heaven and earth, had appeared once again.

His heart stirred as he secretly observed the transparent figure's actions.

Previously, it only needed to "transport" the remains of one Immortal artifact at a time, or perhaps two at most.

Now, however, there were thirteen of them placed together before it. The transparent Spirit of Heaven and Earth seemed somewhat troubled.

"It's fine. I am watching over you."

Li Fan transmitted a friendly thought toward it.

The transparent Spirit of Heaven and Earth was the manifestation of the Xuanhuang Realm's Laws, so it naturally inherited its relationship with Li Fan.

After slightly nodding toward Li Fan, it made another selection. Then, carrying three half-Immortal artifacts, it once again merged into the Xuanhuang Heaven and Earth.

Seeing this, Li Fan also became more attentive.

According to the scenes he had observed previously, the transparent Spirit of Heaven and Earth would "transport" the half-Immortal artifacts it had devoured into the bodies of newborns within the Xuanhuang Realm, turning them into companion wonder treasures of newly born life.

But now, under the Immortal Formation's shroud, the vast majority of living beings in the Xuanhuang Realm had fallen into slumber. What would it do now?

What happened next proved that humans, and even animals and plants, were merely a part of heaven and earth. Moreover, they were not an indispensable part.

Even without their help to "digest" things for the Xuanhuang Realm, the Xuanhuang Realm still had other methods.

In Nine Mountains Prefecture, the nine towering mountain ranges stretching across the earth began to shake violently without warning.

Boom! Boom!

As if heaven and earth were collapsing, the nine mountain ranges successively crumbled.

The dust and smoke raised by the collapsing mountains blocked out the heavens and the sun.

The earth continued to tremble from the aftershocks of the destruction.

If not for the protection of the Immortal Formation's power, the sleeping living beings would have been completely defenseless. This terrifying disaster alone could probably have killed more than ninety percent of the living beings in Nine Mountains Prefecture.

Li Fan watched this scene of the Xuanhuang Realm destroying itself with great interest.

Not long afterward, a sharp glint suddenly flashed through his eyes.

He no longer watched from afar. The wooden sword left its sheath, and he personally arrived within Nine Mountains Prefecture.

The dust gradually settled. On the land that had been reduced to rolling hills, a peculiar lifeform was being born.

From within its body, Li Fan saw traces of the three half-Immortal artifacts that the transparent Spirit of Heaven and Earth had transported earlier.

What attracted Li Fan's attention even more was that the appearance of this newly born lifeform was seven or eight parts similar to the Xuantian Sect's Sacred Beast, the Heavenly Beast.

Despite having just been born, it was already one-fifth the size of Nine Mountains Prefecture.

It seemed to still be sound asleep, its snoring shaking the heavens.

Li Fan keenly noticed that as this little Heavenly Beast continued to grow in its sleep, its body was actually becoming smaller and smaller.

It was continuously compressing itself.

Li Fan was immensely delighted.

'In my previous life, I learned from Mo Rubin that the Heavenly Beast was actually formed from a piece of jade brought down from the Immortal Realm by the Xuantian King.'

'Although the Heavenly Beast later died in battle and transformed into the Nine Mountains, it seems now that it may have merely exhausted its power and returned to its jade pendant form.'

'When the Xuanhuang Realm was searching for a vessel to digest the Immortal artifacts, almost all cultivators were asleep. Thus, it naturally found the sleeping Heavenly Beast.'

While Li Fan's thoughts raced, the little Heavenly Beast quickly shrank until it was only the size of an adult's palm.

In this short period of time, the three half-Immortal artifacts within its body had already become almost impossible to see.

'As expected of a lifeform from the Immortal Realm. Its digestive ability is truly terrifying.'

Even Li Fan was astonished. He concealed all his aura and slowly approached the little Heavenly Beast.

He picked up the sleeping creature.

Even in its juvenile stage, the little Heavenly Beast gave Li Fan a feeling no weaker than that of a Dao Integration cultivator of the Xuanhuang Realm.

With every breath, faint sounds resembling wind and thunder seemed to rumble.

After falling into Li Fan's hands, the little Heavenly Beast instinctively became alert.

But it still could not open its eyes. Its body merely writhed continuously, trying to escape Li Fan's grasp.

Li Fan nourished it with his own spiritual power, but the little Heavenly Beast completely disdained it and hid even farther away.

He then switched to a higher level of source power essence.

The little Heavenly Beast poked its head out and carefully sensed it. Then it quickly withdrew again.

No matter how Li Fan tempted it, it was no longer interested.

Li Fan frowned slightly. After thinking for a moment, he tried the power of the Boundless Star Sea, followed by the vitality from the ravine basin, one after another.

Although the little Heavenly Beast no longer resisted, it remained only mildly interested.

'Could it be that only immortal spiritual qi will work?'

'This little bastard is really picky. Even I have to rely on the Great Celestial Venerable's legacy just to obtain immortal spiritual qi. Where am I supposed to find food for you?'

Li Fan cursed inwardly.

Suddenly, he thought of something, and his gaze flickered.

With a flip of his hand, he took out a gray Go piece.

It was precisely the hidden measure left behind by Sun Piaomiao for reviving the Immortal Domain.

In this life, Li Fan had no intention of collecting all the Go pieces and causing the Immortal Domain to reappear.

However, he had still gathered most of the Go pieces scattered throughout the Starry Sky.

He had merely suppressed them in different locations.

'The only thing I need to guard against is the Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar.'

'If each Go piece is unfolded individually, it will not appear.'

'In my previous life, the Immortal Ark unfolded one of them, creating the keratin substance attached to the surface of the Immortal Ark...'

'But that is only theoretically the case. Originally, there was no need for me to take this risk.'

'However...'

The moment it sensed the aura emanating from the Immortal Domain Go piece, the little Heavenly Beast reacted as if it had smelled some unparalleled delicacy.

It rolled and crawled toward it at astonishing speed.

Opening its mouth, it began gnawing at it incessantly.

However, the Immortal Domain Go piece was protected by Li Fan's defensive measures, and the little Heavenly Beast's biting could not keep up with its rate of recovery.

After gnawing for a long time without getting any of what it wanted, the little Heavenly Beast began to grow anxious.
