Chapter 1394: The Xuanhuang Rebirth Transformation

However, it also understood who was truly in control of the current situation.

It began rubbing against Li Fan's palm, showing goodwill toward him.

"The Heavenly Beast is a creation of the Immortal Realm. Judging from how eager it is, it seems that it can devour the Immortal Domain Go pieces..."

"If the Xuanhuang Realm cannot swallow these stones directly, then they can simply be processed through this little turtle."

"Once the little thing has grown fat and strong, I can kill it and offer it as a sacrifice to Heaven!"

A glint flashed through Li Fan's eyes. He immediately withdrew the protection surrounding the Immortal Domain Go piece.

The little Heavenly Beast became extremely excited and began gnawing away at it with great enthusiasm.

The continuous sound of something resembling brittle bones being crushed inch by inch rang out. Li Fan narrowed his eyes, carefully observing the drastic changes occurring within the Immortal Domain Go piece.

Based on his previous observations, the Immortal Domain Go pieces were actually composed of countless True Immortal seal script characters representing the laws of the Immortal Realm. When a Go piece suffered external damage or was stimulated, the True Immortal seal script characters folded within it would unfold once again.

Revealing a corner of the Immortal Domain.

However, the True Immortal seal script characters contained within a single Go piece were incomplete. They were merely fragments that had been severed apart. Therefore, when they unfolded into the world, what appeared would not be the scenery of the Immortal Realm from the past.

Only when all the Go pieces were gathered together and these fragments were pieced back into complete True Immortal seal script characters would the true Immortal Domain containing the Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar descend into the mortal world.

But it was still a part of the Immortal Realm.

Even merely unfolding and changing its form required an enormous amount of energy, let alone destroying it. It was certainly not something an ordinary person could accomplish.

Yet now, under the little Heavenly Beast's chewing, the fragments of True Immortal seal script characters that composed the Immortal Domain Go piece actually began to disintegrate even further.

They transformed into tiny fragments of energy, which the little Heavenly Beast happily swallowed into its stomach.

Having only just been born, the little Heavenly Beast could not eat for very long before it became somewhat overstuffed. However, when it saw that the Immortal Domain Go piece had barely been depleted at all, the little thing simply could not bear to let go.

It persisted in gnawing at it for a while longer.

In the end, when it truly could not eat anymore, it reluctantly pressed the Go piece beneath its body, afraid that Li Fan would take it back.

After having its fill, the little Heavenly Beast fell into a deep sleep.

The fragments of the Immortal Realm's laws that it had swallowed were also silently transforming its body.

Its shell became even harder, while its body grew increasingly sturdy.

The most obvious change occurred in the little Heavenly Beast's eyes.

Although it still could not open them, Li Fan could already faintly sense the extraordinary nature hidden within them.

Even while the little Heavenly Beast was asleep, those eyes seemed to remain vigilant, observing everything around it. Most of the time, its attention was concentrated on Li Fan.

It seemed to have already sensed Li Fan's malicious intentions.

"The Eyes of the Heavenly Beast. Interesting."

"Xuantian King fled from the Immortal Realm and obtained countless things. But whether what he fed the Heavenly Beast was better than what I am feeding it remains to be seen. After all, what I am feeding it consists of genuine fragments of the Immortal Realm. Even a True Immortal might not be willing to part with such things."

Li Fan looked forward greatly to seeing how the Heavenly Beast would develop in this life.

It was not because he needed the Heavenly Beast's combat strength.

After all, according to Mo Rubin, a fully grown Heavenly Beast was only comparable to the Twelve Dharma Kings. For Li Fan, that was of little use.

What Li Fan truly cared about was the Eyes of the Heavenly Beast.

In his previous life, Li Fan had followed Mo Rubin into the Eyes of the Heavenly Beast. Within countless overlapping worlds, he had seen a hidden humanoid character.

This character was not the work of the Dao Inscription Immortal. Rather, it was another attempt to "inscribe the Dao."

Although the perfection and intricacy of its Dao inscription could not compare with the Dao Inscription Immortal's work at all, the Dao laws depicted by this character possessed an extraordinarily high level of existence.

As a result, the humanoid character gave Li Fan a feeling that was almost comparable to the power of the Immortal-Mortal Transformation.

"The Heavenly Beast was transformed from a jade pendant, yet it is so lifelike that it is completely indistinguishable from a true living creature. This kind of method..."

When Li Fan had previously comprehended the Shape of Living Beings, he had already faintly suspected that the pattern engraved at the very bottom of the Star Sea originated from that humanoid character.

Now, as he gently stroked the little Heavenly Beast and compared the faint aura emanating from its body with Qiushui, the speculation in his heart received further confirmation.

"Now it seems that the Shape of Living Beings is actually a simplified version of the humanoid character. The methods of the Immortal Realm truly cannot be compared with those of the mortal world."

"But even a version simplified by who knows how many times is already this complicated..."

Li Fan recalled what he had seen in the depression beneath the earth fissure in his previous life, and could not help but frown slightly.

"The Spirit-Gathering Ascension Immortal Formation in the Dark Sea secretly contains the Immortal-Mortal Transformation."

"The Eyes of the Heavenly Beast contain the complete Shape of Living Beings."

"Could the other two formations within the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation also contain their corresponding True Immortal seal script characters?"

A thought suddenly surfaced in Li Fan's mind.

"The Golden Chains Across the Void Formation, the Root of Heaven and Earth."

Li Fan had visited the space of the Root of Heaven and Earth more than once, but had never discovered any traces of True Immortal seal script characters.

It relied upon the power of an ancient Immortal formation that had been born alongside the Xuanhuang Realm.

As for the Golden Chains Across the Void, they had already been completely destroyed during the era of the Ten Great Immortal Sects. They no longer existed within the Xuanhuang Realm.

"It should be that I am overthinking it. The Immortal-Mortal Transformation and the Shape of Living Beings are both high-grade existences among the countless True Immortal seal script characters. Even if the Xuantian King returned from the Immortal Realm with an abundance of treasures, obtaining these two seal script characters should already have been his limit..."

Li Fan thought to himself.

His thoughts returned to the little Heavenly Beast before him.

"The Shape of Living Beings engraved within the Star Sea is far too vast. Probing it would consume an enormous amount of time."

"And the one within the Eyes of the Heavenly Beast was not particularly well inscribed in the first place. Furthermore, it exists within the formation established by Xuantian King, making it far too distorted..."

"By comparison, the one on this little thing may be the closest to its original form."

Thinking of this, Li Fan could not help but reach out and stroke the little Heavenly Beast again.

He released his goodwill, but not only did the little Heavenly Beast's eyes refuse to accept it, they instead grew increasingly wary. It even showed signs of waking the little Heavenly Beast from its slumber.

One had to admit, as expected of a creation of the Immortal Realm, its senses were remarkably sharp.

Li Fan did not press it too hard either. He still had plenty of time to deal with this little thing.

It was merely an artifact spirit. Even if it were a true living being, Li Fan had plenty of ways to bring it under control.

With a thought, blue light flashed, and Qiushui appeared beside Li Fan.

He immediately sensed the existence of the little Heavenly Beast. Perhaps because they belonged to the same kind, the little Heavenly Beast's vigilance toward Qiushui was greatly reduced.

"Take care of this little fellow for now. Look after it properly," Li Fan instructed.

"I shall obey, Great Master!" Qiushui did not dare be negligent. He approached and picked up the little Heavenly Beast.

At the same time, he discovered the Immortal Domain Go piece that had been pressed beneath the little Heavenly Beast.

After all, he was not a creation of the Immortal Realm. Qiushui could not sense the extraordinary nature of the Go piece as the Heavenly Beast could.

Moreover, he possessed the power of the Infinite Star Sea, so he had no interest in an entire world to begin with. He merely faithfully carried out Li Fan's orders.

After discovering that the little Heavenly Beast was not interested in his Infinite Star Sea power, Qiushui's expression turned bitter.

"It has that Go piece to gnaw on. That will be enough. You do not need to feed it anything else."

"Just take it around the Xuanhuang Realm and the Star Sea. Let it wander around everywhere," Li Fan said indifferently.

Qiushui immediately breathed a sigh of relief. Carrying the little Heavenly Beast, he accepted the order and departed.

"Given how sensitive that little thing is, perhaps it may discover something unexpected." With Qiushui's cultivation at the Supreme realm, coupled with his ability to communicate with the true intent of the Star Sea's origin, Li Fan was not worried about the safety of the two.

His attention returned to the transparent Spirit of Heaven and Earth.

After a total of five transfers, 3, 2, 3, 2, 3, the transparent Spirit of Heaven and Earth finally finished incorporating all the Half-Immortal Artifacts into the Xuanhuang Realm.

Upon the land of the Xuanhuang Realm, besides the little Heavenly Beast, four other peculiar forms of life had appeared: the Human-Faced Snow Mountain, the Thousand-Mile Dragon Insect, the Flowing Light Rainbow Cloud, and the Frenzied Running Giant Tree.

Of these, the most noteworthy was the strange cloud floating in the air and radiating seven-colored light.

The cloud emitted its own light and shadows, constantly changing.

Most of the scenes it displayed came from within the Xuanhuang Realm. Yet, in fleeting moments, it would also reflect scenes from the Immortal Realm of the past.

It was precisely because Li Fan had once glimpsed the appearance of the Immortal Realm through the memories of a True Immortal that he was able to notice this.

"It should have been caused by devouring three Half-Immortal Artifacts."

Whenever it manifested a scene of the Immortal Realm, even if only for an instant, it would suffer the same fate Li Fan had experienced. The cloud would boil and churn violently. Seven-colored radiance would flash without end, and the entire cloud seemed as if it were about to be evaporated and disappear.

After returning to its normal form, the Flowing Light Rainbow Cloud had shrunk by a full tenth.

Yet for some unknown reason, not only did it fail to stop reflecting scenes of the Immortal Realm, it began doing so even more frequently.

Every reflection consumed its own life force.

After repeating this eight times, the Flowing Light Rainbow Cloud completely vanished without a trace.

Vaguely, Li Fan seemed to see the laws contained within the Half-Immortal Artifacts it had devoured drifting out and merging into the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm.

By then, only half a month had passed since the Flowing Light Rainbow Cloud was born.

"Clouds disperse and vanish. Half a month is already a long lifespan for a cloud. But for a transcendent creation, it is practically an untimely death."

Li Fan looked toward the other three creations.

The Spirit of Heaven and Earth hung high overhead, while the Human-Faced Snow Mountain was transforming into a Flaming Mountain.

The Thousand-Mile Dragon Insect continuously split its own body, one becoming two, two becoming four. After half a month, it had already multiplied into tens of billions of tiny insects.

However, these tiny insects had no ability to survive on their own. They could only eat and then split themselves again.

Once the size of their divided bodies became too small to support their ability to find food, the extinction of the swarm would not be far away.

As for the Frenzied Running Giant Tree, it continued charging forward without end. Its leaves had withered, and its branches snapped apart amid its mad sprint.

Its death was likewise approaching.

Of the four great creations, only the little Heavenly Beast remained peacefully asleep.

"This is the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm deliberately doing this..."

"Perhaps it discovered that the little Heavenly Beast's lifespan was too long, and that allowing it to complete the devouring of the Immortal Artifact laws would take too much time. That is why it gave rise to such a peculiar change."

Li Fan saw through the crux of the matter.

"It really did find a new path. From now on, the internal cycle of the Xuanhuang Realm will probably accelerate greatly."

"Correspondingly, strange living beings within the Xuanhuang Realm will also emerge one after another."

This was a peculiar change that had never appeared in the Xuanhuang Realm, even when it was facing the crisis of world destruction.

Li Fan was extremely interested and recorded it carefully.

Chapter 1395: Refining The Great Pill Of Heaven And Earth

The Xuanhuang Realm's method of transforming itself was extremely unique.

The change known as [Techniques Cannot Be Cultivated Together], which had caused ancient cultivators to slaughter one another and countless sects to perish, was actually the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao's retaliation against the new cultivators who devoured heaven and earth.

It had indeed been highly effective. In one stroke, it wiped out more than ninety percent of the cultivators at the time, plunging the Xuanhuang Realm into a wasteland of cultivation that lasted for thousands of years. It was only after the return of the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor, with forces above the Heavenly Dao participating, that cultivators began to flourish once again.

It could be said that in its struggle against cultivators, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao had actually emerged victorious. It was only later that the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor intervened and reversed the outcome.

Since the change of [Techniques Cannot Be Cultivated Together], the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao had never produced another targeted transformation.

For a long time, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao's state of being at the mercy of others had caused the vast majority of cultivators in the world to lose their reverence toward it.

At this moment, as Li Fan watched the turbulent scenes unfolding throughout the Xuanhuang Realm, he sighed inwardly.

'From today onward, the positions of offense and defense have been reversed. I fear that in the confrontations to come, it will be the cultivators who find themselves at a disadvantage.'

'If they even have a future.'

Perhaps only Li Fan in the entire Xuanhuang Realm knew why the Xuanhuang Realm had produced no new transformations for ten thousand years after the change of [Techniques Cannot Be Cultivated Together].

It was precisely because Mr. Bai had sealed away a portion of the Xuanhuang Evil Thought back then.

From that point onward, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao was no longer complete. As a result, it had lost a certain "characteristic."

In this life, Li Fan had long since returned the Xuanhuang Evil Thought to heaven and earth. Combined with the nourishment provided by various methods, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao's long-standing deficiency had gradually been restored.

Now, it was finally beginning to reveal its edge.

Li Fan's eyes flickered as deductions raced through his sea of consciousness.

'Without the intervention of some overwhelming external force, the Xuanhuang Realm will evolve all kinds of extraordinary changes to eliminate cultivators.'

'Perhaps the [strange phenomena] that originally existed only within certain regions will eventually spread throughout the entire Xuanhuang Realm. There may even be more unique lifeforms similar to the Flowing Light Rainbow Clouds...'

The adaptability of the complete Xuanhuang Realm did not particularly surprise Li Fan.

After all, if this was truly an experimental ground seemingly created by the Immortal Realm, then it would be strange if it behaved just like an ordinary cultivation world.

What interested Li Fan more was how this power of transformation actually worked.

Time passed.

The grand formation left behind by the Immortal Realm in the past had long since lost its effectiveness. Even the Nine Star Red Bead at the core of the formation had disappeared without a trace.

'It seems that the Xuanhuang Realm is able to produce these transformations entirely because of its own innate characteristics.'

Li Fan raised his head and narrowed his eyes, observing with great interest.

Because his favorability with the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao was sufficiently high, it did not conceal anything from him at all, allowing Li Fan to observe to his heart's content.

The fusion of the Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood with the power of the Immortal Formation allowed Li Fan to create all kinds of artificial simulated personalities.

They could range from consciousness clones of himself, completely loyal and carrying out his commands, to replacing various half-Immortal artifacts, and even the original consciousnesses of small worlds, becoming extensions of Li Fan's control.

The possibilities were virtually endless.

However, Li Fan had already conducted nearly a hundred million experiments, yet there was one bottleneck that he had never been able to overcome.

And within the foreseeable future, there seemed to be no possibility of making any progress.

That was, all the artificial personalities he created could only mechanically execute the settings Li Fan had established at the beginning.

It was not that this situation was necessarily bad. At the very least, it guaranteed that these creations would never run out of control.

But Li Fan actually did not care much about whether they would run out of control.

What he wanted even more was for these artificial personalities to be able to bring him some unexpected surprises.

Unfortunately, judging from the current situation, none of them had been able to accomplish this.

'Like the Xuanhuang Realm.'

'While maintaining its own inherent characteristics, it can naturally produce corresponding changes according to the circumstances of reality.'

'That is what I want.'

Li Fan connected his thoughts with the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, attempting to peer into the source of this power of transformation.

He was certain that this mysterious power must have originated from the methods of the Immortal Realm back then.

If he could comprehend it...

'Even if there are no living beings left in the Star Sea, I would still have an inexhaustible supply of subordinates who could go forth one after another, fearless of death, to explore beyond the High Wall!'

At the thought of this, Li Fan's heart burned with excitement.

However, after conducting a careful investigation, Li Fan discovered that even the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao itself did not understand what this ability to transform actually represented.

It merely regarded it as something it had possessed since birth and had no knowledge of its origin.

'If I want to study it thoroughly, I am probably going to have to completely dissect the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao itself.'

'There probably will not be enough time in this life. I will wait until the next life.'

Li Fan shook his head slightly, somewhat regretfully.

Completely unaware that it had narrowly escaped disaster, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao was currently becoming increasingly vibrant as the Great Celestial Venerable Wuming traveled throughout the realm, continuously eliminating threats and repairing its wounds.

It was like a rough stone that, after being continuously polished by countless forces, was finally beginning to reveal the jade hidden within.

'The Great Celestial Venerable is already in position. We can proceed to the next step.'

'After being roasted over a fierce fire for so long, it is time to add the supplementary ingredients for refining the pill...'

Li Fan flew to the center of the Xuanhuang Realm and stood in midair with his hands behind his back.

With a slight movement of his mind, the spiritual power of heaven and earth spontaneously surged toward him and came under his control.

The Xuanhuang Realm's Heavenly Dao trusted Li Fan far too much now. With merely a slight greeting from him, the Xuanhuang Realm gave him its full support.

The spiritual energy veins throughout the entire Xuanhuang Realm surged toward the place where Li Fan stood.

A gigantic illusory brush appeared before Li Fan.

Like a giant whale sucking in water, it absorbed all the spiritual power of the world.

The illusory brush gradually became solid.

Then, under the urging of Li Fan's thoughts, he swept it across the void in a single stroke.

A second great sun suddenly rose within the Xuanhuang Realm.

The moment this sun appeared, the Xuanhuang Realm seemed to have passed from the depths of winter into spring and summer.

A different kind of vitality surged from that mysterious character and quietly flowed toward every corner of the Xuanhuang Realm.

It was precisely the [Dawn] character that Li Fan had learned from the Xuan Immortal Ark.

Like the sun rising in the east, its energy reverberated throughout the world, and all things revived.

Under Li Fan's precise control and regulation, the power of the character was just right.

It was like feeding the Xuanhuang Realm a powerful tonic.

Li Fan could clearly see all kinds of strange phenomena appearing throughout the world as vitality began to sprout.

Yet Li Fan did not stop.

He once again drew over the vitality from the depression in the Star Sea fissure.

Although both sources were vitality, their natures were different.

The vitality of the character came from the outside and entered within, passively stimulating life. If not controlled properly, it was like playing with fire and burning oneself. Vitality could turn into a graveyard.

The vitality within the depression of the Star Sea earth fissure, however, came from within and spread outward, nourishing everything silently.

Even if too much was absorbed and temporarily exceeded what one's body could endure, it would merely be stored away and would not harm the body itself.

Its disadvantage was that it changed things far too slowly, requiring gradual progress.

The two forms of vitality, one Yin and one Yang, complemented each other.

Under Li Fan's secret urging and combination of the two, they gradually became truly integrated into the Xuanhuang heaven and earth.

The sky of the Xuanhuang Realm seemed to become even clearer.

As the character in the sky gradually dispersed, the enormous amount of spiritual power drawn over by Li Fan also scattered once again, returning to every corner of the world.

After this operation by Li Fan, the deficit accumulated over ten thousand years from the continuous consumption of the Xuanhuang Realm by cultivators had been completely replenished.

The scorching vitality between heaven and earth was almost visible to the naked eye.

All things competed to flourish, each striving to display its splendor.

Yet Li Fan's process of refining the pill was still continuing.

'Act according to the circumstances and strike while the iron is hot.'

As vitality flourished throughout the Xuanhuang Realm, all kinds of transformations naturally began to emerge within it.

The birth of living beings within the realm was completely insignificant.

What truly mattered was the gradual evolution of the numerous Cave Heavens.

Now that vitality had arrived, nurturing new Cave Heavens was as natural as flowers blooming and bearing fruit. It was simply the inevitable result of the process.

However, the birth of every Cave Heaven would naturally consume a portion of the Xuanhuang Realm's own power.

Li Fan intended to use the Xuanhuang Realm itself to refine a Great Pill. How could he possibly allow such a thing to happen?

Just as he had previously severed the birth of the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven.

Wherever Li Fan's gaze passed, numerous Cave Heavens were reduced to dust, transforming back into nourishment and merging into the Xuanhuang heaven and earth.

Explosive sounds continued to resound.

Yet the Xuanhuang Realm's Heavenly Dao showed not the slightest reproach toward Li Fan for destroying the Cave Heavens.

Instead, faint traces of joy were transmitted from it.

It was clear that It was also dissatisfied with the countless Cave Heavens that had evolved from its own body. However, because of its own limitations, it could only let them be.

Now that Li Fan had stepped in to eliminate these "parasites" for it, it naturally could not have been more pleased.

Ignoring the increasingly ingratiating thoughts transmitted by the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, Li Fan calmly observed the world.

Things were nowhere near as wonderful as the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao seemed to believe.

Within the Xuanhuang Heaven and Earth, an enormous amount of vitality had suddenly erupted. The beginning of Cave Heaven evolution was one way of releasing and dispersing this immense vitality. But now, Li Fan had ruthlessly cut off this outlet.

The result was that the Xuanhuang Realm could only forcibly swallow all the vitality itself.

It grew more and more bloated.

More and more.

Until finally...

Boom!

It suddenly exploded!

It was like refining pills. If one only kept adding medicinal materials without controlling the heat properly, it would eventually cause the furnace to explode.

Of course, Li Fan would not simply sit by and watch such a thing happen.

Before the Xuanhuang Realm was burst apart by the overwhelming vitality, he would decisively activate his Ascension Plan.

Although there seemed to be more than enough vitality right now, as long as the "momentum" of the Xuanhuang Realm rose even slightly, this vitality would be consumed in massive quantities.

It would not be enough at all.

"High pressure. Suitable for adding supplementary materials."

Li Fan observed for a while, ensuring that the Xuanhuang Realm had entered a temporary state of balance.

He then flashed to Luoyan Prefecture.

This place had once been one of the Heavenly Law Realm. It had now been silently implanted into the Xuanhuang Realm by the Heavenly Doctor.

The rejection between the two worlds had already nearly disappeared. The fusion of the two worlds was about to be completely finished.

Li Fan lightly stamped his foot on the ground.

From the hidden Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation beneath the earth, a figure flew out.

It was one of the Dao Integration cultivators who had previously been selected as a medicinal catalyst.

"Let the ruined world be the medicine and inject it into Xuanhuang."

As Li Fan softly chanted, his figure seemed to rise infinitely higher.

He had already deployed the Ascension Formation.

However, instead of using the Divine Ability, Nine Heavens Descending Mortal Finger, he took out a fragment of a world obtained from the Remnant World Great Wall while viewing everything from his elevated perspective.

In Li Fan's current field of vision, the Xuanhuang Realm was only about the size of an ordinary person.

The fragment of the remnant world, meanwhile, was shaped like a pill.

Holding it gently between his fingers, he slowly pressed it into the body of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Having ascended to the higher momentum, the aura emanating from Li Fan caused the living beings within the Xuanhuang Realm to tremble in fear even in their dreams.

Even the Xuanhuang Realm itself no longer dared to transmit even the slightest ingratiating thought.

It could only obediently cooperate.

It was as if some ancient memory from the distant past had been awakened within it.

Carefully and cautiously, it successfully allowed the fragment of the remnant world to be implanted.

Li Fan's momentum immediately plummeted.

"Go!"

He lightly pointed at the Dao Integration cultivator waiting obediently nearby.

The Dao Integration cultivator exploded uncontrollably with a thunderous boom.

There was no rain of flesh and blood. Instead, a phantom resembling the Spirit of Heaven and Earth instantly expanded millions of times.

It formed a thin membrane that completely wrapped around the fragment of the remnant world implanted by Li Fan.

"Turn!"

Li Fan shouted again.

Streams of hazy light rapidly circulated within the membrane-like phantom.

Using the power of the Immortal Formation, Li Fan was helping the phantom devour and digest the ruined world fragment wrapped within it.

A fragment of a world that had survived ten thousand years of calamities was now transformed into streams of flowing light, surging into the membrane-like phantom.

But this was not its final destination.

It was merely a transit point.

High in the sky, the phenomenon accompanying the fall of the Dao Integration cultivator began to manifest.

Compared to normal circumstances, however, this phenomenon appeared exceptionally slowly.

Its duration was also extraordinarily long.

As the phenomenon continued, the process of the Dao Integration cultivator returning the Dao to Heaven proceeded simultaneously.

When the phenomenon completely disappeared, it would also be the moment when the remnant world fragment was completely digested by the Xuanhuang Realm.

This was Li Fan's method of using a Dao Integration cultivator as a medicinal catalyst and buffer, while using the remnant world fragment as medicine to nourish the Xuanhuang Realm.

The concept and method had been learned from the Heavenly Doctor.

But there was no doubt that Li Fan had already surpassed his teacher.

Although the Dao Integration cultivator served as one layer of buffering, compared to allowing the Xuanhuang Realm to slowly devour the remnant world on its own, this method was still far too violent.

If the Xuanhuang Realm had still been in its previous weakened state, it certainly would not have been able to withstand it.

Only after this life, with Li Fan's numerous methods and preparations accumulating together and strengthening the constitution of the Xuanhuang Realm to a sufficient degree, could such a medicinal formula be used.

And that was only the prerequisite.

Setting aside the compatibility between the remnant world and the Xuanhuang Realm, obtaining suitable remnant worlds from the Remnant World Great Wall was itself no easy task.

Rashly extracting a remnant world would cause disturbances throughout the Remnant World Great Wall and even the entire Star Sea. He had to act at an appropriate time.

The reason Li Fan's actions in this life had proceeded so smoothly was also because he had the experience from his previous life to rely upon.

More importantly, treating a remnant world as a pill and manipulating something so enormous with such ease was something that even the Star Sea Supreme might not necessarily be able to accomplish effortlessly.

Only with the assistance of True Immortal flesh and the Immortal Formation could Li Fan make it appear so effortless.

After completing one case, Li Fan immediately continued without stopping.

He continuously implanted the prepared remnant worlds into various locations of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Even though the power within these remnant worlds had yet to be absorbed by the Xuanhuang Realm, Li Fan could already faintly sense the changes that were about to erupt throughout Heaven and Earth.

"The Xuanhuang Realm is an extremely special existence within the Star Sea. But that does not mean the Xuanhuang Realm possesses every single Law."

"Compared to the Laws permeating the Star Sea, there are still some things missing from it."

"But these deficiencies can be supplemented by devouring the remnant worlds I provide."

"The principle is similar to the way it devours Immortal Artifacts."

Li Fan's eyes burned brightly as his movements continued.

He did not stop until he sensed that the Xuanhuang Realm had reached its limit.

"Hmm. As it continues to grow stronger, it will be possible to continue after some time."

"Repeat this process until it reaches its true limit."

"At that time, it will be time for its transformation."

Chapter 1396: On The Verge Of Overturning The Star Sea

At this point, nearly all the preliminary preparations for refining the Xuanhuang Ascension Immortal Pill were complete.

All Li Fan needed to do next was wait.

Wait for Wuming to truly inherit the authority of the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable, and wait for the Xuanhuang Realm to absorb the many essences and reach its limit.

'At most three years. Perhaps as soon as one year.'

Whether he succeeded or failed, there was not much time left in this life.

It was also time to put the plan Li Fan had devised earlier into action.

First, he flashed to the small world of the You Clan.

The character [Restrain] sat incongruously in a corner of the stone tablet. Characters of the Immortal-Mortal Transformation gradually spread across its surface. It was impossible to determine how much of it had already manifested.

But Li Fan had a faint premonition that the complete manifestation of this mysterious character was not far away.

Li Fan swept his divine sense across the small world. As expected, during the period when he had not been supervising them, the physiques of the You Clan members had continued to grow stronger.

After carefully examining the bodies of every You Clan member, he selected the strongest one.

He separated a strand of divine sense and used the Dao Pill method to seize control of its body.

Then, avoiding the other You Clan members, Li Fan slowly passed through the immortal formation and arrived before the stone stele.

Using the You Clan member's body, he gazed from afar at the few characters revealed on Nameless True Immortal's leg bone. Li Fan sensed his own blood gradually surging.

It was as if some scorching source was constantly throbbing and roasting him, as though it wanted to boil all the blood in this body.

Li Fan could not help but avert his gaze.

Yet the disturbance within his body continued, like the incessant pounding of drums.

'It seems that merely glimpsing that True Immortal seal script touches upon some kind of taboo.'

'But I insist on trying!'

Li Fan snorted coldly. Although he was attached to the You Clan member's body, his expression became increasingly devout.

He bowed his head and focused on sensing the minute changes within his body.

Having gained experience from glimpsing the characters of the Immortal-Mortal Transformation in his previous life, Li Fan smoothly sensed that mysterious and profound trace this time.

The body of the You Clan member seemed to have suffered the wrath of Heaven.

Time rapidly passed over its body. Its hair turned snow-white in the blink of an eye, while its life force was rapidly consumed.

Li Fan remained completely unmoved. He simply concentrated his mind and probed the traces of the Immortal-Mortal Transformation.

With the portion already manifested on the stone stele as a reference, Li Fan excluded what he had already seen and only needed to probe the remaining traces of the characters.

Having made sufficient mental preparations, Li Fan's speed in probing this seemingly endless True Immortal seal script in this life was somewhat faster than in his previous one.

Yet it was still almost fleetingly brief.

That short period was simply insufficient for Li Fan to glimpse the character's complete form.

The You Clan body he possessed was burned to ashes as if consumed by flames.

At the same time, Li Fan's true body flashed to the stone stele and struck it with all his accumulated insights.

Just as the Hunger Immortal of the Immortal Ruins had done in his previous life.

On the stone stele, that mysterious character rapidly extended. In an instant, it expanded outward by more than double its previous extent.

Li Fan sensed that after all his insights regarding the Immortal-Mortal Transformation had been completely devoured, the stone stele actually intended to absorb him as well.

Having witnessed the true might of the Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar, how could Li Fan possibly be unprepared?

The phantom of the Wooden Sword unsheathed itself, helping Li Fan successfully evade the stone stele's absorption.

But in that brief instant of contact, Li Fan was horrified to discover that his cultivation, which had originally been at the peak of Soul Transformation, had already fallen to the middle stage of Soul Transformation.

If he had hesitated even slightly longer, he might have been completely drained into an ordinary mortal.

'Everything related to Nameless True Immortal is indeed terrifying. It must never be underestimated.'

Li Fan took a deep breath and gradually calmed himself.

He carefully examined what had manifested on the stone stele.

Aside from the Immortal-Mortal Transformation character having advanced another step, there were also some mottled shadows.

These shadows connected into a ring, astonishingly resembling the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven.

'The Dao of the Five Elements...'

Unfortunately, the traces were simply too faint, making it impossible to discern anything meaningful.

Only then did Li Fan turn his gaze toward his true target.

'Among the True Immortal seal scripts I know, Hunger, Chaos, and the others belong to one level.'

'Innate and Creation belong to a higher level.'

'Above those are the Immortal-Mortal Transformation and the Shape of Living Beings.'

Li Fan compared the two he already knew. After using them to corroborate each other, his heart finally settled somewhat.

'I have already deduced eighty percent. At the current rate of sacrificing You Clan lives, it should be enough.'

'If I am still short by a little at the very end, I can sacrifice all the You Clan members together.'

Li Fan nodded inwardly.

Then his gaze turned toward the complete Shape of Living Beings, and his brows furrowed slightly.

If his conjecture was correct and the two were beings of the same level, then the shape Li Fan had currently comprehended was probably less than one fifth of the complete shape.

'Merely glimpsing its complete outline is already this difficult. Let alone comprehending the Dao contained within it.'

However, Li Fan did not currently demand that he understand its underlying principles. It would be enough if he could simply use it like the Xuantian King had.

'The little beast was transformed from a jade pendant. I wonder whether throwing it directly to this stone tablet would allow its form to manifest?'

A sudden thought stirred Li Fan's heart.

But after narrowing his eyes and carefully considering it, Li Fan still suppressed the impulse.

'I'll raise the little Heavenly Beast a little more first. If that truly does not work, then I can rely on the stone stele.'

It was not because Li Fan had suddenly developed compassion. Rather, in this life, stability was his priority.

Ordinary mortal objects could be fed to Nameless True Immortal's leg bone without much concern.

But the Heavenly Beast was a creation of the Immortal Realm. It contained an unknown and enormous amount of energy. If he allowed that leg bone to consume its fill all at once...

Who knew what kind of change might occur?

Li Fan had not forgotten the scene at the end of his previous life, when the Wordless Stele exploded and that leg bone inexplicably flew toward him.

'It absolutely cannot be ignored.'

'I cannot let temporary gains cloud my judgment.'

In truth, there were still many things Li Fan wanted the stone stele to devour and then manifest their principles.

Including the Azure Firmament Pearl, which was still buried deep at the end of the fissure depression.

Although according to Xu Ke's description in his previous life, the supreme treasure had turned to dust the moment he touched it because its energy had been exhausted.

Li Fan was certain that at this point in time, the Azure Firmament Pearl still maintained its final indestructible form.

Ordinary mortals could not collect it.

But Nameless True Immortal's leg bone probably could.

'This stele is a naturally formed machine for assisting comprehension.'

'Anything dangerous can be fed to it first, then used as an intermediary for comprehending its principles.'

'Even...'

Li Fan's gaze left the stone stele as he raised his head and looked toward the depths of the starry sky.

'Burying the entire Darkest Star Sea, and even the High Wall along with it, would not be impossible.'

'The entirety of a star sea should be enough to cause sufficient laws to manifest on the stone stele.'

At the thought of that scene, Li Fan could not help but feel his blood stir with excitement.

'That day will come, but not now.'

'At the very least, I must first possess the power to protect myself. Only then can I accomplish such a feat.'

Chapter 1397: The Three-Pronged Derives A New Era

The leg bone of the Nameless True Immortal continued to be used according to plan, with the flesh and blood of the You Clan members serving as material for analyzing the Immortal-Mortal Transformation characters.

Li Fan first made targeted improvements to the simulated personality overseeing this place. He gave it a more detailed understanding of the degree to which the bloodline of the You Clan member could be unsealed. Only after ensuring that the You Clan people would not lose control even at the final moment of this life did Li Fan finally flash away.

Upon returning to the Great Xuan Dao Lecture Platform, he first reviewed the overall progress of all living beings exploring the Carefree Paradise over the past decade or so.

The complexity of the Carefree Dreamland truly exceeded all imagination.

Nearly a million people had been sent in one after another, yet even now, there had been no qualitative gains.

The person who had explored the deepest had already reached Exploration Level 7 in the Paradise.

Within the dream, he could now casually destroy an entire world with a wave of his hand. Such terrifying destructive power was already comparable to the Longevity Immortal realm of the Xuanhuang Realm. It was even somewhat superior.

This Level 7 explorer was named Hou Mingwu.

His cultivation talent in the real world was not particularly high. He had listened to the projection of the Dao lecture for more than a month before barely breaking through the Qi Refining stage.

Unexpectedly, after Li Fan sent him into the dreamland of the Paradise, he encountered an extraordinary opportunity in his very first dream world and obtained an unbelievable treasure called the Reunification Mirror, which could reconstruct shattered and deactivated magic treasures.

In the Carefree Dreamland, almost all powerful magic treasures had a certain limit on the number of times they could be used.

Once all their uses were exhausted, there were two ways to activate them again. The first was to spend a large amount of Paradise Coins to recharge them. The second was to use other lower-rank magic treasures as nourishment to recharge them.

The cost of reactivating them was simply too great, and sometimes the expenditure could even outweigh the benefits. Therefore, some people chose to publicly sell these deactivated treasures at low prices. At least they could recover part of their investment.

Hou Mingwu used the incredible property of the Reunification Mirror to repair these treasures and then sell them again.

After several transactions, he made a fortune.

The dreamland of the Paradise was simply too vast. Every time Hou Mingwu completed a transaction, he would change the large dream region where he usually operated.

Thus, for a very long time, no one discovered his secret.

By the time news that Hou Mingwu possessed the Reunification Mirror finally leaked out, he had already grown strong enough.

The treasures he possessed were practically endless. The number of treasures carried by him alone could even rival those possessed by the top teams in the Paradise.

Whenever he undertook a mission in a dream world, Hou Mingwu could use his treasures without regard for cost, bombarding everything in his path.

Even in bizarre worlds where physical force and ordinary attacks were ineffective, he could rely on his numerous magic treasures to turn danger into safety time and time again.

As a result, Hou Mingwu's efficiency in clearing dream worlds was far beyond that of ordinary people. No matter how intense their greed was, there was nothing the others could do.

From beginning to end, Hou Mingwu had always acted alone, refusing every invitation to cooperate or form a team.

Once, several major teams joined forces and used a tracking magic treasure to forcibly follow him into a mission.

They intended to conspire together and seize the Reunification Mirror.

Yet Hou Mingwu seemed to have detected their pursuit long beforehand and had already laid an ambush inside the world.

After all the trackers had gathered, before they even had time to make a move, the entire world suddenly plunged into a terrifying apocalyptic destruction.

Where would they have the time to pursue him?

The several major teams scattered like frightened birds and beasts, suffering heavy casualties.

Afterward, they first suspected that there had been a mole within their cooperating teams.

Later, they speculated that Hou Mingwu must possess another supreme treasure capable of predicting the future and avoiding misfortune.

After this incident, the schemes targeting Hou Mingwu within the Carefree Paradise temporarily disappeared.

In truth, their guess was correct.

Apart from the Reunification Mirror, Hou Mingwu indeed possessed another supreme treasure.

However, this treasure did not come from the dreamland.

It was Li Fan's attention.

As the vanguard Li Fan had sent to explore the Carefree Dreamland, how could Li Fan possibly allow Hou Mingwu to be harmed so easily?

The million people sent into the dreamland were essentially a million pairs of eyes belonging to Li Fan.

Some of them were even members of the very teams plotting against Hou Mingwu.

They simply had no awareness that they were traitors.

With Li Fan's protection, Hou Mingwu had virtually no danger of losing his life within the Carefree Paradise.

And Hou Mingwu had not disappointed Li Fan.

The several worlds he had experienced in the deeper layers of the dreamland had confirmed Li Fan's judgment.

The range of the Carefree Paradise's dreamland had already extended beyond the Xuanhuang Realm and spread into the starry sky.

Because within those several worlds, Li Fan had clearly seen traces of the Xuan Immortal Ark.

They were not merely manifestations of the Immortal Ark itself, but individual concepts such as the Thousand-Eyed Desolate God, Heavenly Star Light Lotus, Duan's Divine Arm, and the Dao Pursuing Giant.

'The people of the Immortal Ark should be completely unaware of this matter. The Carefree Dreamland has not forcibly dragged the people of the Immortal Ark into its illusions either. It is merely using the fragments that inadvertently emerge within their consciousness as the foundation for constructing the dream worlds.'

'The people of the Immortal Ark are no ordinary beings. Yet even so, Carefree was able to effortlessly capture their thoughts and perceptions. Carefree... is he really this powerful?'

Li Fan could not help but frown slightly.

'However, one thing can be confirmed. There really are things that have not been sensed by him. Perhaps the Xuan Immortal Ark fell prey to Carefree's schemes at some point.'

Li Fan gazed into the distance. His vision seemed to pass through the boundless starry sky and arrive beneath the High Wall.

'The Immortal Ark has already been enveloped within its range. Perhaps it is not far from breaking through the High Wall's restrictions.'

'No wonder Carefree has always seemed rather unconcerned with everything within the Xuanhuang Realm. Even when the Xuanhuang Realm was destroyed several times, he merely hid and did not contribute to stopping it. Could he be trying to save the country by taking a circuitous route, using an alternative method to pass through the High Wall?'

His previous discoveries had already almost confirmed that the High Wall's restrictions seemed to have a weaker effect on consciousness and spiritual energies.

Li Fan had long vaguely suspected that Carefree Paradise was making some moves in secret. He had simply received confirmation of his suspicions only now.

'If his true body were to leave the High Wall, it would be far too dangerous. Perhaps I can use the power of the Carefree Dreamland to investigate the situation first...'

This thought flashed through Li Fan's mind.

'The people I placed the greatest hopes on, such as Sun Erlang, cannot match the exploration progress of this unknown nobody named Hou Mingwu. As expected, I still have to make the best use of everyone and let them do what they are good at.'

Li Fan shook his head slightly and divided another portion of his consciousness to monitor Hou Mingwu's every movement.

In this life, Li Fan still had no intention of making contact with Carefree.

Although Li Fan was certain that Carefree had already discovered that he, the Xuanhuang Formation Master, was the mastermind behind sending a million people to invade the dreamland, for some unknown reason, Carefree clearly had the ability to instantly kick all these people out of the dreamland, yet had still not done so.

'It seems that after attaining a certain degree of transcendence, he simply no longer cares.'

'Interesting.'

'Unfortunately, with his current strength, his consciousness still cannot exist entirely on its own. If I destroy his physical body in the present world, the Carefree Dreamland will also cease to exist.'

Li Fan likewise developed an imposing confidence.

Carefree did not care about the intruders in his dreamland, and Li Fan likewise did not care about Carefree.

'I only need to proceed step by step and steadily achieve Dao Integration.'

His thoughts gathered again, and Li Fan's gaze became deep and profound.

Fortunately, in this life, when he envisioned and deduced the scene of achieving Dao Integration not long from now, that ominous sense of mortal danger did not appear again.

'There should not be any major changes.'

However, for the sake of caution, Li Fan still needed to make a trip to the Xuan Immortal Ark.

'Since that bowing figurine can still produce a certain effect, perhaps the Three-Pronged Tree can do the same.'

The possibility of getting another free simulation was enough to make even Li Fan's heart stir.

After all, judging from the situation in his previous life, the simulation process did not seem to require Li Fan to personally experience it.

Instead, everything would flash through his mind like a series of slides.

With the enhancement of the Wooden Sword projection, Li Fan soon arrived outside the Xuan Immortal Ark.

'The Three-Pronged Tree is on the second layer of the Immortal Ark's secret vault. The Heavenly Star Light Lotus is guarding it. If I forcefully take it, I will inevitably have to confront the Immortal Ark directly...'

'First, I should see what the current situation inside the Immortal Ark is.'

With this thought, Li Fan's body became as elusive as a ghost and silently slipped into the Xuan Immortal Ark.

Compared to more than a decade ago, the Ark's protective measures had improved somewhat.

But not by much.

At the very least, to Li Fan, they remained completely useless.

After investigating the Immortal Ark for a while, Li Fan basically understood its current situation.

Ever since his previous life, when he had plundered the Immortal Ark's secret vault and taken away most of the useful treasures from the first level of the Immortal Compendium of Hundred Tales, the Immortal Ark had first gone through a period of internal turmoil and nearly split apart.

Even after the turmoil finally ended, the tense atmosphere within the Immortal Ark had never eased.

The loss of such a massive amount of resources had immediately made the survival of the people of the Immortal Ark a serious problem.

Even though their total population had decreased somewhat after the internal conflict, they were still living in extreme hardship.

The scarcity of resources had not caused the conflict between the Severed Immortal Tower and the Celestial Pivot Institute to disappear.

Instead, their struggle had become even more intense.

Although no elders had fallen, many of their disciples had died.

In the previous life, Li Fan's sudden appearance as an outsider had diverted the internal conflicts within the Immortal Ark.

After learning that other civilizations existed in the Star Sea, the people of the Immortal Ark had become exceptionally united.

Even the vast majority of the elders had been willing to sacrifice their lives for the future of the Immortal Ark.

But in this life, there was no external event to divert their attention.

The internal contradictions had even intensified.

What the Immortal Ark showed Li Fan had changed from the goodness of human nature to the evil of human nature.

Of course, to Li Fan, so-called 'good' and 'evil' were actually no different.

What he cared about was merely the treasures within the Immortal Ark's secret vault.

The treasures on the second layer of the secret vault were all preserved within the seeds of the Heavenly Star Light Lotus.

Heavenly Star Light Lotus was a wondrous object that the Immortal Ark had collected in ancient times. It had parasitized the Star Sea and survived countless calamities, yet its life force remained intact.

With Li Fan's current strength, destroying it would not be difficult.

However, destroying it while simultaneously extracting the treasures preserved within nearly a hundred lotus seeds was considerably more difficult.

Li Fan concealed himself within the second layer and observed the Heavenly Star Light Lotus at close range for a long time. He finally determined a method to break through its defenses.

Although the Heavenly Star Light Lotus appeared incredibly mystical, at the height of its existence, its main body had been even larger than more than a hundred cultivation worlds combined.

But ultimately, it still belonged to the category of living beings.

Since it was alive, it must have its own weaknesses.

Li Fan did not need to search for those weaknesses himself.

He had the Dao-One Insects.

The Dao-One Insects were a peculiar species of exotic beast capable of generating spiritual energy.

Li Fan extended his palm. A vague shadow slowly flew closer, attempting to infiltrate the dreamlike radiance of the Light Lotus.

What Li Fan released this time was a variant of the Dao-One Insects.

Its ability to produce spiritual energy had been reduced by half. In exchange, its adaptability and survivability had become astonishingly powerful.

Yet the instant it approached, the faint light emitted by the Light Lotus vaporized the Dao-One Insect without leaving a trace.

Li Fan did not care and released two more Dao-One Insects.

Their fate was no different.

Compared to the Heavenly Star Light Lotus, creatures like the Dao-One Insects were simply far too insignificant. The disappearance of their lives did not cause even the slightest ripple.

Li Fan remained persistent and released four more at once.

Although they still vanished in an instant, only Li Fan noticed that the amount of time the Dao-One Insects managed to endure had increased by the slightest margin.

The Dao-One Insects that advanced one after another did not die in vain. They would transmit information about the Heavenly Star Light Lotus back to their species.

Those that came afterward would then alter themselves based on this information, seeking to adapt and survive within the radiance of the Heavenly Star Light Lotus.

The number of Dao-One Insects increased exponentially.

When the population as a whole reached one million, the Dao-One Insects were already capable of evolving themselves and merging into the dreamlike radiance of the Heavenly Star Light Lotus.

'It seems that although this Star Sea creation has developed its own intelligence, it ultimately has not escaped the category of spiritual energy. After tens of millions of generations of evolution, the Dao-One Insects can complete its analysis.'

Looking at the continuous shadows, resembling ink, that were gradually infiltrating the Heavenly Star Light Lotus, Li Fan nodded in satisfaction.

'Perhaps only immortal spirit qi, a power that completely transcends everything else and does not even belong to the same conceptual category, can completely prevent the Dao-One Insects from infiltrating it.'

The miraculous abilities of the Dao-One Insects went without saying.

They could create something from nothing and derive spiritual energy. They could even devour Cave Heavens and worlds, replacing them entirely with the collective swarm.

However, as Li Fan's strength continued to rise, the infinitely useful Dao-One Insects had gradually become rather lackluster. Only in special situations like this could they once again prove useful.

Li Fan had once considered cultivating an even more advanced form of the Dao-One Insects.

Unfortunately, after being contaminated by source power essence, the Dao-One Insects would lose their inherent characteristics. As for the level above that, immortal spirit qi...

Li Fan himself did not possess any. He would have to rely on the Great Celestial Venerable's legacy.

'After I achieve Dao Integration, perhaps I will be able to provide the Dao-One Insects with a suitable environment for cultivation.'

Apart from True Immortals, the Immortal Realm also contained countless creations and servants.

Li Fan believed that once he attained the Dao, he too would be able to bring even his chickens and dogs to ascend together.

The Dao-One Insects' infiltration was like spring rain, nourishing everything silently.

By the time the entire lotus seed had been quietly transformed into Dao-One Insects, the main body of the Heavenly Star Light Lotus had not noticed anything at all.

It merely sensed a vague sense of unease, causing the light of the lotus to flicker erratically.

The lotus seed's protection was completely removed.

Li Fan first retrieved his primary target, the Three-Pronged Tree.

Sensing the reaction transmitted by [Truth], Li Fan's heart stirred.

'As expected, it still works.'

'However, it is not enough to support an entire lifetime of simulation.'

'Only twelve hours?'

A sharp glint flashed through Li Fan's eyes, and for once, he felt somewhat excited.

'If my speculation is correct, then after using the Three-Pronged Tree for the simulation, this lifetime of mine will not end immediately.'

'Instead, everything that happens during the following twelve hours within the simulation will appear in my mind as though I had personally experienced it.'

'I wonder if I can bring any gains out of it.'

'Even if I cannot, this is still equivalent to having another life-saving insurance.'

Li Fan forcibly suppressed his urge to use the Three-Pronged Tree immediately.

He continued manipulating the Dao-One Insects, infiltrating and stealing the items preserved within the lotus seeds of the Heavenly Star Light Lotus.

It truly lived up to its reputation as a treasure of the Star Sea entrusted with great responsibility by the Immortal Ark. After Li Fan successively stole three items, the Heavenly Star Light Lotus, driven by instinct, actually curled up on its own.

The second layer of the hidden repository instantly plunged into darkness. Its dreamlike radiance disappeared completely.

Even Li Fan could no longer sense the aura belonging to the Heavenly Star Light Lotus.

It was as though it had completely vanished.

The abnormal movement of the Heavenly Star Light Lotus also alerted the people of the Immortal Ark.

Li Fan vaguely sensed several familiar auras rapidly approaching.

They were none other than the Immortal Ark elders led by Jian Dao Sheng and Zhong Dao Gong.

'There is also a faint trace of the aura of the Thousand-Eyed Desolate God.'

'It seems their prolonged internal conflict has kept them constantly on edge.'

Li Fan smiled faintly. As a dim sword shadow flashed, he escaped the scene of his crime.

The theft of the treasures from the second layer of the Hidden Repository once again triggered a bloody storm within the Immortal Ark.

The Severed Immortal Tower and the Celestial Pivot Institute blamed each other, igniting the conflicts that had accumulated over the past decade.

A brutal battle erupted within the Xuan Immortal Ark.

Meanwhile, the culprit, Li Fan, had already returned to the Great Xuan Small World within the Xuanhuang Realm.
