Chapter 1398: A Flick Of The Finger Across The High Wall

Li Fan did not have time to react before the voice clearly appeared in his mind.

It seemed to have precisely locked onto Li Fan.

Then it quickly faded away, like snow melting into water, leaving not the slightest trace behind.

Only after everything had happened did Li Fan's body begin to stiffen slightly, and his breathing catch.

He cautiously looked around, carefully observing his surroundings.

He stared at the [Truth] interface that had appeared before him. After a long while, Li Fan finally exhaled slowly and silently closed it.

'Fortunately, it was only a false alarm!'

'The target locked onto by the transmission seems to be only the person who destroyed this bronze immortal crane.'

'But this transmission...'

'Could it have come from beyond the High Wall?!' Li Fan was filled with uncertainty.

His eyes narrowed as he carefully recalled the voice he had just heard.

'Tianluo Era, Year 213. Beginning with Shang Zhang Da Yuan Xian, followed by Zuo E Yan Feng, ending with Zhu Yong Chi Fen Ruo and Yan Mao Xuan Yi...'

'...'

'What does this mean?' Li Fan frowned deeply.

It seemed to be nothing more than a jumble of meaningless terms.

Yet the transmission had crossed the High Wall and precisely identified its target.

There had to be some deeper meaning behind it.

'It seems to be referring to certain years.'

'But another layer has been combined with them. What does that mean?'

'Could this be a unique method of recording years used by the Immortal Realm?'

Li Fan pondered for a long time, but still could not figure it out.

The concepts involved in this transmission were things Li Fan had never encountered in any of his previous reincarnations.

'This transmission was triggered only after the bronze immortal crane was destroyed.'

'The bronze immortal crane was left together with the Immortal Realm Go piece...'

'Perhaps it was an important message Sun Piaomiao left for whoever completed the reconstruction of the Immortal Realm.'

For now, this was the only speculation Li Fan could make.

He simply knew far too little. No matter how deeply he investigated, there was no point. Thus, Li Fan could only firmly commit the contents of the transmission to memory for the time being.

What concerned Li Fan more was the fact that this transmission had come from beyond the High Wall and what that implied.

'Could the reason Sun Piaomiao later disappeared without a trace be because he had already gone beyond the High Wall?'

'When he disappeared, the calamity that destroyed the Immortal Realm had yet to occur, and the High Wall did not yet exist. Later, the invisible High Wall suddenly rose from the ground and enveloped the Star Sea. Sun Piaomiao never returned.'

'What exactly does the High Wall represent?'

In an instant, countless thoughts surged through Li Fan's mind.

This transmission from beyond the High Wall had once again aroused his intense curiosity toward that unknown realm.

'Regardless, the Immortal Realm left behind by Sun Piaomiao must be an important clue.'

'My current strength is still insufficient to investigate it.'

'Dao Integration. Immortal Realm!'

As Li Fan continued exploring, the more he came into contact with, the more he felt that endless mysteries and unknowns lay ahead.

His desire to become stronger had also become more intense than ever before.

...

Xuanhuang Realm.

Time passed second by second.

The Great Celestial Venerable Wuming was without name, knowledge, or consciousness. Following the spontaneous operation of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, he continuously repaired the injuries accumulated over tens of thousands of years.

Together with Li Fan's uninterrupted and various methods of secretly nourishing it, three years passed.

The Xuanhuang Realm had already become powerful to an extreme degree.

It had reached the critical point where quantitative accumulation was about to catalyze a qualitative transformation.

Every living being throughout the entire world, even those trapped within the illusion formation, was still infected by the immense momentum naturally born from heaven and earth. They felt anticipation mixed with endless fear.

The three year period had arrived.

Li Fan sensed that the restriction on Wuming had already begun to slowly dissipate on its own.

The true Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable was about to descend into the world once more after an empty interval of ten thousand years!

It was as if an invisible heavy weight had suddenly been placed upon Li Fan's shoulders.

This was the pressure and authority originating from the Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable.

Feeling the restraint upon himself, Li Fan frowned slightly. He had not anticipated this situation. But after carefully considering it, he soon became relieved.

The Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable had been appointed by the Immortal Realm to govern the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao and all living beings of the world.

Although ten thousand years had passed since Mr. Bai's death, the position itself had remained.

The Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor had spread the new cultivation method of devouring heaven and earth throughout all living beings. From absorbing the spiritual essence of heaven and earth to reversing the principles of heaven and earth, the higher a cultivator's cultivation realm, the more deeply they became bound to the world.

By now, cultivators of the new cultivation method and the Xuanhuang Realm had already become inseparable, becoming a part of heaven and earth itself.

The Xuanhuang Heaven and Earth had to obey the commands of the Great Celestial Venerable and could not defy them.

This also meant that when the new Xuanhuang Great Celestial Venerable appeared, all cultivators who practiced the new cultivation method would likewise feel the power of this restraint.

But conversely, although cultivators were a part of heaven and earth, the overall strength of the cultivators in the Xuanhuang Realm was simply too powerful.

Even excluding the Immortal Ancestor, who stood above all living beings, the combined strength of the remaining cultivators was not much weaker than the Xuanhuang Realm itself.

The restriction originating from the ancient Xuanhuang Realm could certainly affect cultivators.

But its effectiveness was limited.

'As the saying goes, the balance between strength and weakness has never been governed by fixed rules since ancient times. The strong can govern the weak, but the weak cannot govern the strong!'

The burden placed upon him was not even comparable to the Go piece carrying a fragment of the Immortal Realm.

For Li Fan, it did not affect his movements in the slightest.

'However, such a drastic transformation of the Xuanhuang Realm cannot possibly be hidden from the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor. They will certainly return to the Xuanhuang Realm immediately.'

'Fortunately, I have also made sufficient preparations during these three years.'

Li Fan's gaze turned toward the outside of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Golden threads wrapped around the boundary of the Xuanhuang Realm's sky, resembling an invisible High Wall that separated the Xuanhuang Realm from the void outside.

Within the concentrated golden radiance, countless different fleeting images seemed to continuously evolve.

Li Fan looked at the creation he had painstakingly prepared and was extremely satisfied.

'The improved Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation, combined with the imitation of the invisible High Wall...'

'And most importantly, the deterrent power of Nameless True Immortal's leg bone!'

'With the support of the power of the boundless star sea, trapping the Heavenly Doctor and the Immortal Ancestor for a period of time will not be a problem!'

In his previous life, the reason the Heavenly Doctor had escaped so quickly was because Li Fan was still only at the mortal level. The immortal formation was merely a downgraded existence maintained through source power essence. It could not truly reproduce the might of an immortal.

Thus, when the Heavenly Doctor vaguely sensed something was wrong within the illusion formation and chose to confront the True Immortal directly, the enormous disparity in strength allowed him to immediately discover the flaw in the formation.

But this life was different.

Li Fan had connected the core of the formation directly to Nameless True Immortal's leg bone.

Even though it was merely a remnant bone left behind by the deceased Nameless True Immortal, the faint aura it emitted was still not much weaker than that of a True Immortal.

The performance of the Immortal Ruins Hunger Immortal and the Southern Immortal Celestial Pillar appearing simultaneously in his previous life had already proven this point.

Under the pressure of an aura no different from that of a True Immortal, the Heavenly Doctor would certainly not recklessly seek his own death.

If he still insisted on trying...

Even at the Supreme level, he would probably be completely unable to resist and would be transformed into characters upon Nameless True Immortal's leg bone!

It could be said that with Nameless True Immortal's leg bone presiding over it, the Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation had already undergone a qualitative transformation to a certain degree.

This was not an evolution of the formation itself, but rather a sublimation brought about by the extraordinary nature of the formation materials!

And this was only Li Fan's first layer of preparations.

In addition to the illusion formation, Li Fan had also used the Art of Drawing Land into a Prison to erect another layer of High Wall outside the Xuanhuang Realm.

This High Wall is indeed incomparable to the invisible High Wall that surrounds the Darkest Star Sea. Yet it was also imitated and constructed after Mo Rubin's insights into the flaws of the High Wall in the previous life, the countless living beings' contemplation of the High Wall in this life, and Li Fan's subsequent improvements.

Li Fan had conducted experiments himself.

To cross this wall, even without reaching the True Immortal realm, one would need to have one's momentum reach the critical point of ninety-nine percent of the way there.

Without a large amount of True Immortal flesh and blood as fuel, and without the assistance of an Ascension Formation, merely relying on the current cultivation realms of the Immortal Ancestor and the Heavenly Doctor, it would be impossible to cross the High Wall within a short period of time.

'My High Wall may appear to differ from the true invisible High Wall by only the slightest degree.'

'But that tiny difference is the difference between heaven and earth.'

'The Heavenly Doctor's strength has already reached the Supreme realm, the limit of the Star Sea. He truly cannot be underestimated. I cannot expect this High Wall to hold them back for too long either.'

'I still have a third method!'

Li Fan withdrew his gaze from the sky.

He looked toward the various regions of the Xuanhuang Realm.

'Once the Xuanhuang Realm begins its ascension, everything undergoing qualitative transformation within it can become my weapon. The Super Immortal-Mortal Miasma, the countless Immortal Spirits of Heaven and Earth...'

'Before I show any intention of refining Ink Death, all of them can be used by me. After all, I am the greatest contributor to the Xuanhuang Realm's ascension into the Immortal Domain. If it succeeds, I can absolutely be called the reborn parents of the Xuanhuang Realm.'

'The power of the Immortal Domain's laws should be enough to resist even if the Hunger Immortal awakens.'

'Everything is prepared. It is time to begin.'

Li Fan sneered inwardly.

His gaze then locked onto the Great Celestial Venerable Wuming.

Ever since the restrictions of the trial from more than three years ago had been lifted, Wuming had remained completely motionless.

It seemed that he was formally accepting the position of Great Celestial Venerable.

However, his nature of possessing neither knowledge nor consciousness caused his expression to remain extremely indifferent, without joy or sorrow.

The edicts from the Immortal Realm no longer existed. The Great Celestial Venerable's every action was now based on the highest interests of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Under the current circumstances, using the immortal spiritual qi contained within the Great Celestial Venerable's legacy to assist the Xuanhuang Realm's ascension had therefore become the inevitable choice.

Under the urgent urging of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, a vast amount of immortal spiritual qi soon surged forth from Wuming.

Like oil poured onto a raging fire, it drove the Xuanhuang Realm onto the final path of ascension.

Either it would successfully ascend into an Immortal Domain, or it would suffer complete ruin and turn to ashes.

With all the preparations Li Fan had made, success was almost inevitable as long as there was no interference from external forces.

Thus, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao did not hesitate in the slightest.

As wind and clouds surged, it scattered the immortal spiritual qi throughout every corner of heaven and earth.

Even though this was not the first time Li Fan had witnessed true immortal spiritual qi, he was still deeply intoxicated by this incredibly mysterious and extraordinary power.

Even with immortal spiritual qi appearing directly before him, Li Fan was still unable to comprehend the form of its existence.

It was even less possible for him to utilize it.

Perhaps just as Li Fan had predicted, only after ascending to the Immortal realm, even if merely becoming a Half Immortal, could one wield this transcendent power.

But just because Li Fan could not utilize it did not mean that the other objects beside him could not.

'Final Dissociation Disc. Little Beast!'

Li Fan's mind stirred, and two balls of light immediately appeared on either side of his shoulders.

The Final Dissociation Disc had accompanied Li Fan throughout his growth. Its ability to endlessly deduce formations had provided him with tremendous assistance. For a long period of time, the formations deduced by the Final Dissociation Disc had been Li Fan's strongest trump card.

However, it was ultimately still a mortal creation. Constrained by the limitations of its innate material, the Final Dissociation Disc had already reached its limit long ago.

Even though Li Fan continuously infused it with data on Immortal-grade formations, it had only achieved a theoretical breakthrough between the mortal and immortal levels. It could successfully deduce Immortal formations, but in reality, it still could not analyze or create genuine Immortal formations. It could only substitute for them by downgrading Immortal formations.

But now, sensing the immortal spiritual qi permeating heaven and earth, the Final Dissociation Disc trembled uncontrollably.

It was like a cultivator who had suddenly seen the essence of heaven and earth, filled with greed and longing.

The situation of the Little Heavenly Beast was similar to that of the Final Dissociation Disc.

The appetite of this little creature was truly frightening. Only after devouring four Immortal Domain Go pieces in succession did it finally stop eating.

However, it seemed to have overeaten. The Heavenly Beast had yet to undergo its own transformation and evolution, instead remaining in a deep slumber for a long period of time.

After some investigation and a brief communication with the Heavenly Beast, Li Fan speculated that because the Immortal Domain had never fully formed, what it had devoured consisted only of fragments of laws.

These unhealthy ingredients had caused the Heavenly Beast to suffer from poor digestion. It needed pure immortal spiritual qi as a catalyst to assist it in digesting them.

Both of them were at the final step before transformation.

All they needed was for immortal spiritual qi to enter their bodies, and like the Xuanhuang Realm, they would undergo a qualitative transformation.

The immortal spiritual qi permeating heaven and earth grew increasingly dense.

The greed of the Final Dissociation Disc and the Little Heavenly Beast grew increasingly intense. They could barely control themselves and were almost about to break free from Li Fan.

After communicating with Li Fan and receiving his assurances, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, although somewhat reluctant, still separated two extremely thin strands of immortal spiritual qi that were absolutely pure.

They drifted toward Li Fan.

The moment he received the immortal spiritual qi originating from the Great Heavenly Venerable's legacy, Li Fan immediately sensed that the Xuanhuang Realm's goodwill toward him had invisibly decreased by an entire calamity.

Li Fan snorted coldly and temporarily ignored it. Suppressing his urge to investigate the matter, he divided the two strands of immortal spiritual qi and injected them into the Final Dissociation Disc and the Little Heavenly Beast respectively.

A crystalline and dazzling radiance gradually enveloped the two.

Even Li Fan, their master, lost his perception of them. He was even continuously forced backward by the might emanating from the two balls of light.

Two Immortal artifacts seemed to be in the process of gestation.

Li Fan also sensed that the interception formation he had deployed in the center of the Star Sea had already been activated.

The loss of a little immortal spiritual qi did not slow the Xuanhuang Realm's momentum toward ascension.

Li Fan continuously formed hand seals, and vast quantities of writhing True Immortal flesh and blood were rapidly burned.

They served as the driving force that elevated the momentum of the Xuanhuang Realm.

At the center of the Xuanhuang Realm, a towering phantom suddenly appeared.

Its surface was covered in mottled light and shadow, while profound and mysterious characters emerged across it.

It was precisely the stele formed from the leg bone of the Nameless True Immortal.

As a sturdy support that would prevent the Xuanhuang Realm from falling after its ascension, Li Fan had established it long ago.

A tremendous roar resounded throughout heaven and earth.

Countless cracks appeared across the Xuanhuang heavenly canopy.

It seemed as though the world could not withstand the tremendous impact brought about by its ascension and was beginning to split apart.

At this moment, the nourishment Li Fan had provided for more than ten years finally displayed its crucial effect.

Chapter 1399: Truly Turning The Tide

In the heavens and earth of the Xuanhuang Realm, countless viscous seven-colored liquids suddenly appeared out of thin air. They then flowed like trickling streams, pouring into the wounds.

Like some legendary immortal elixir, the torn wounds of the Xuanhuang Realm actually healed in the blink of an eye.

A considerable amount of seven-colored liquid also scattered through the air and flowed across the earth.

The regions touched and illuminated by this seven-colored radiance gradually formed seven-colored halos around them. Strands of sacred aura emerged from within, making them seem detached from the mundane world and completely out of place with the surrounding domains.

Li Fan continued forming hand seals, maintaining the Xuanhuang Realm's ascension momentum. His eyes narrowed slightly as he swept his gaze across the countless halo-enveloped domains that had suddenly appeared throughout the heavens and earth.

In order to concentrate all available strength to the greatest extent and push the Xuanhuang Realm toward sublimation, Li Fan had long since destroyed or merged the overwhelming majority of the burdensome Cave Heavens and small worlds, allowing them all to return to the Xuanhuang Realm.

Yet now, just as the Xuanhuang Realm was about to complete its transformation, new Cave Heavens and blessed lands were being born once again, slightly slowing the Xuanhuang Realm's ascent.

These newly born Cave Heavens and blessed lands were different from those of previous eras. They were not independent entities that had split away after flowering and bearing fruit. They were more like new "organs" evolved by the heavens and earth.

Li Fan's gaze pierced through the protective halos surrounding these Cave Heavens and blessed lands, allowing him to see the unique and profound laws within each of them.

For example, one newly born Cave Heaven had gathered and evolved laws related to "Sight". Li Fan judged that if living beings were eventually born within this Cave Heaven, or if they cultivated there for many years, there was a very high probability that they would awaken related divine abilities under the influence of its unique laws.

There were also a very small number of Cave Heavens that, after briefly appearing in the world, transformed into streaks of rainbow light. After selecting their targets, they directly descended into the living beings below.

These fortunate beings were not sleepers trapped within the illusion formation. They were lives that had been newly born since the Xuanhuang Realm's transformation began.

Thus, the Cave Heavens descended from above and began to walk across the earth.

The Cave Heavens and blessed lands were not isolated from one another. They were faintly interconnected. Some were naturally close to one another, while others harbored an innate hostility toward each other.

Yet by sensing the fundamental connections between them, Li Fan detected that their ultimate destiny was inevitably to devour one another before eventually returning to unity.

In the end, the Cave Heaven or blessed land that unified all under heaven would gather the strengths of all the others, nurturing itself to its utmost limit. It would then split away from the Xuanhuang Realm.

Under normal circumstances, this process might naturally evolve over tens of millions or even hundreds of millions of years. Even if it went against the will of the Xuanhuang Realm itself, it would still eventually occur.

'Is this an unavoidable path for ascending into an Immortal Domain? Is it engraved into the fundamental logic of the Xuanhuang Realm's existence?'

As Li Fan watched the countless bizarre Cave Heavens and blessed lands suddenly descend throughout the Xuanhuang heavens and earth, a trace of enlightenment suddenly emerged within him.

This was a change that would only occur after the Xuanhuang Realm had been pushed to the threshold of sublimation and was truly about to ascend into an Immortal Domain.

It had already been written into the foundation of the Xuanhuang Realm from the moment it was created.

Although the Xuanhuang Realm had always existed merely as an ordinary cultivation world within the lower realm Star Sea, once it was about to return to the Immortal Realm, this hidden "innate trait" that had remained concealed for countless years finally revealed itself.

'The Xuanhuang Realm was created using the methods of forging an Immortal Domain, but with mundane materials from the lower realm. In other words, it can be considered a downgraded form of an Immortal Domain to a certain extent...'

Li Fan thought of the method he had used to replace immortal spiritual qi with source power essence and operate immortal formations. His eyes flickered uncertainly.

'Although the Xuanhuang Realm possesses the innate qualities of an "Immortal", it is constrained by a mundane body. In practice, it is no different from other ordinary cultivation worlds. Only a True Immortal can clearly discern the hidden truth.'

'No wonder the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm has such an unpleasant personality, hated by both people and beasts alike. It turns out to be a fallen princess stranded among commoners. No matter how well one treats it, the moment one does even the slightest thing against its wishes, it immediately shows displeasure and may even turn hostile at any moment. And no matter how harmonious the relationship was before, once a new powerful figure comes along and offers some warmth and concern, there is a very high chance it will immediately throw itself into their embrace...'

Recalling his interactions with Mr. Bai, the Holy Teacher, and himself with the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, Li Fan gradually came to understand.

At its core, this was due to the arrogance ingrained within the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.

No matter how well a mere ant treated it, that being was ultimately still an ant. Perhaps its attitude could change because of its circumstances for a time, but its deepest fundamental view would never change.

Only an Immortal, perhaps even a half immortal, could make the Xuanhuang Realm truly regard them seriously.

These innate characteristics of the Xuanhuang Realm had caused numerous unexpected changes to arise at the most critical moment of its ascension and sublimation.

Li Fan merely snorted coldly as he watched from the sidelines.

'It has the illness of a princess without the fate of being one.'

All kinds of phenomena continued unfolding throughout the Xuanhuang heavens and earth.

Li Fan engraved this dreamlike scene into his memory. Then, almost instinctively, his gaze turned toward a region of the world where nothing had changed at all, an isolated blank area.

Daoyuan Prefecture.

Although the Illusory Xuanhuang Multitudinous Living Beings Grand Formation did not cover Daoyuan Prefecture, it still enveloped it. The power of the immortal formation spread outward, isolating it from the outside world.

Later, Li Fan had even constructed a high wall around the borders of Daoyuan Prefecture, completely sealing the prefecture.

Naturally, this was to prevent that Grand Mage from suddenly jumping out and causing trouble during the final critical moment of the Xuanhuang Realm's sublimation.

In fact, besides the immortal formation and the high wall, Li Fan had also carefully prepared an additional surprise for the Grand Mage.

At the borders of Daoyuan Prefecture, eighteen bronze figures stood hidden within the bewildering Immortal Formation.

Only Li Fan, their creator, could see the two terrifying killing forces concealed within them.

The Obliterating Wind Calamity and the Decaying Greenary.

The Obliterating Wind Calamity had been collected by Li Fan from damaged immortal artifacts within the Xuanhuang Realm.

As long as an immortal artifact still remained in the world, more or less it would contain something similar to the Boundless Mirror.

As for the Decaying Greenary, Li Fan had originally discovered it on the Thousand-Eyed Desolate God.

It burned away the foundation sustaining the vitality of things. Its terrifying destructive power was no weaker than that of the Obliterating Wind Calamity.

The Obliterating Wind Calamity was a special evolution of the Dao Annihilation Calamity targeting immortal artifacts, while the Decaying Greenary was specifically effective against Immortal Servants.

Two years ago, the Immortal Ark, which had been locked in constant internal conflict, gradually descended into madness.

The Celestial Pivot Institute, which had always been at a disadvantage and was approaching the end of its road, ultimately chose to make a desperate gamble and released the Thousand-Eyed Desolate God.

As the Desolate God rampaged, Li Fan also sensed that strange aura originating from a creation of the Immortal Realm. He sent Tianyang to fight it and gain insight.

Tianyang indeed gained some enlightenment.

At the same time, with the support of the massive amount of True Immortal flesh provided by Li Fan, he successfully brought back the attached and corrosive Decaying Greenary.

Using True Immortal flesh as a breeding ground, Li Fan cultivated a large amount of Decaying Greenary.

Although both the Obliterating Wind Calamity and the Decaying Greenary were already extremely terrifying calamities to mortals, their lethality was even more pronounced against beings at the "Immortal" level.

In the previous previous life, when faced with the Obliterating Wind Calamity, the Holy Emperor and the Heavenly Doctor had merely felt horrified, yet they still acted with all their strength to stop it.

But that Grand Mage had directly fled in panic without regard for anything else.

Judging from the Grand Mage's reaction, the extent of their fear toward the Obliterating Wind Calamity was obvious.

And with the Decaying Greenary added to the equation...

'Let me see just what this Grand Mage is really made of.'

The changes within the Xuanhuang Realm gradually settled down.

Aside from the evolution of countless Cave Heavens and blessed lands, four massive mountains also rose at the four corners of the heavens and earth.

The highest peaks of these mountain ranges towered majestically like pillars supporting the heavens, piercing straight into the clouds.

The four magnificent mountain ranges guarded the Xuanhuang Realm.

Once they appeared and stabilized, the heavens and earth, which had been trembling endlessly at the threshold of ascension and sublimation, seemed to suddenly gain support and naturally stabilized.

'Are these the four Immortal Celestial Pillars corresponding to those of the Immortal Realm?'

Li Fan looked at the four mountain peaks and pondered.

The various changes within the world seemed to have stirred the ancient memories of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.

Without deliberately probing it, Li Fan could faintly sense its extreme excitement.

Urged on by it, the Wuming Great Celestial Venerable, who had already released all of his immortal spiritual qi, moved once again.

Wuming extended his left hand.

A small bell glittering with dazzling golden light slowly appeared.

A powerful wind arose throughout the heavens and earth, slowly lifting the golden bell and carrying it upward toward the Nine Heavens.

As its altitude increased, the radiance of the golden bell grew brighter and brighter.

When it reached the sky and became level with the great sun above, the dazzling radiance erupting from the golden bell had already enveloped the sun itself.

Boom...

A clear bell chime resounded throughout the heavens and earth.

The light suddenly contracted, and the Xuanhuang Realm plunged into brief darkness.

When the light reappeared, there was only a single sun remaining in the heavens, and yet...

It was no longer the same as before.

'Great Sun Golden Bell!'

Li Fan's pupils suddenly contracted as he recognized the immortal artifact that had replaced the sun in the sky of the Xuanhuang Realm.

The golden bell transformed into the sun.

At this moment, every living being within the Xuanhuang Realm felt an inexplicable sense of unease in their hearts, as though a sharp sword were suspended above their heads and could fall at any moment.

At the same time, Li Fan felt the "weight" on his shoulders, caused by the manifestation of a true Great Celestial Venerable, become several degrees heavier.

When Li Fan saw that the Wuming Great Celestial Venerable had completed the transformation of the golden bell into the sun, yet continued moving, his expression gradually became solemn.

The second immortal artifact taken out by the Wuming Great Celestial Venerable was an ordinary-looking circular disc.

The moment it left Wuming's hand, it transformed into five colors, white, green, black, red, and yellow, rapidly surging into the heavens and earth like immortal spiritual qi.

As a result, the various colors within the Xuanhuang Realm became even more vivid.

An unusual vitality also began to take shape.

Besides these five colors, Li Fan inexplicably sensed another invisible and formless special force spreading out from the circular disc and flowing toward every corner of the Xuanhuang Realm.

The Illusory Grand Formation that Li Fan had established, which was like shackles firmly clamping down on the Xuanhuang Realm, actually loosened somewhat under the impact of this mysterious force.

Correspondingly, the weight on Li Fan's shoulders became slightly heavier once again.

'Primordial Five Elements Wheel Disc!'

Li Fan narrowed his eyes, yet still did not stop Wuming's actions.

When the Wuming Great Celestial Venerable took out the third immortal artifact, the hurried wailing of a baby suddenly rang beside Li Fan's ears.

Li Fan immediately recognized the source of the voice.

Carefree Heavenly Sovereign.

He merely sneered and paid it no attention.

With a sweep of his hand, Li Fan dispersed the voice.

Li Fan naturally knew why Carefree, who had always avoided the world and pretended to be a coward hiding in his shell, had chosen to appear at this moment.

The power of the Xuanhuang Realm and the cultivators of the Xuanhuang Realm existed in a state of mutual opposition.

Previously, because the overall strength of the Xuanhuang Realm's cultivators was far greater than that of the Xuanhuang Realm itself, even when a true Great Celestial Venerable descended, the impact on the cultivators of the world had been negligible.

However, now that the Wuming Great Celestial Venerable continued to fuse Immortal Artifacts into the Xuanhuang Heaven and Earth, the cultivators were gradually falling into an increasingly disadvantageous position as he kept adding more and more power.

It was as the saying went: the weight of a single Immortal Artifact was greater than that of billions upon billions of living beings.

Even an Immortal Artifact that had been used an unknown number of times, with almost all of its immortal spiritual qi already depleted, was still like this.

Yet there was no doubt that the fusion of the Immortal Artifacts could only benefit the Xuanhuang Realm's formal ascension. Thus, Li Fan continued to allow the Wuming Great Celestial Venerable to proceed.

At this moment, the third Immortal Artifact to be dissolved into Heaven and Earth was the Taixu Blue Heaven Lamp.

The ethereal flames flickered uncertainly, their frequency growing faster and faster until they seemed to become completely still.

At that instant, Li Fan saw the Xuanhuang Heaven and Earth itself flicker slightly.

Then the flames gradually went out, and the Taixu Blue Heaven Lamp turned into specks of ash that scattered with the wind.

'This is...'

Another accumulation of Immortal Artifact power.

The moment this restriction was generated, Li Fan's figure, which had been standing in midair, unexpectedly sank slightly despite himself.

Li Fan paid it no attention. After loosening his body, he raised his head and looked toward the heavens beyond.

At the instant the flames of the Taixu Blue Heaven Lamp went out, or rather, at the instant it fused into the Xuanhuang Realm, Li Fan clearly sensed that the influence of the suction force from the Immortal Ruins had weakened to a certain extent.

Not only the suction force of the Immortal Ruins, but also the effect of the Illusory Grand Formation acting upon the Xuanhuang Realm had been further reduced.

The ascending Xuanhuang Realm seemed like a ferocious beast that was slowly breaking free from Li Fan's control.

When the Wuming Great Celestial Venerable took out the final Immortal Artifact, the Purple Qi Dreamweaving Shuttle, the wailing cry of the Carefree Heavenly Sovereign once again rang beside Li Fan's ears.

Only this time, the voice was much weaker than before. It seemed that the influence suffered by the cultivators of Reverse Principle Longevity Immortal was far greater than what Li Fan experienced.

It was not limited to reality either. Within the Carefree Dream Paradise, the same cry also rang in the ears of every cultivator Li Fan had secretly dispatched to investigate the truth of the dream realm.

Only Hou Mingwu, who had already ventured deep into the eighth-level dream world, managed to avoid it.

Li Fan's expression shifted slightly. After pondering for a moment, he ultimately began communicating slowly with the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm.

'Too much is as bad as too little. The nourishment from three Immortal Artifacts is already sufficient.'

'It would be better to leave the final one for the Great Celestial Venerable to use as a protective treasure.'

'The ascension is imminent. There is no time left to digest it.'

...

Li Fan appealed to both emotion and reason.

The Xuanhuang Realm, which had already devoured three Immortal Artifacts and was now in an extreme state of craving, hesitated in the face of Li Fan's suggestion.

The journey of ascending to immortality was like rowing against the current. If one did not advance, one would retreat.

While it hesitated, the Xuanhuang Realm's momentum, which had been soaring toward the heavens, actually showed signs of slowly falling.

The Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm was immediately startled awake.

It ordered the Wuming Great Celestial Venerable to stop offering up Immortal Artifacts.

The noisy cries of the baby in Li Fan's ears also disappeared at the right moment.

The Wuming Great Celestial Venerable's task was over.

Next, it was Li Fan's turn to take the stage.

Li Fan had already rehearsed the ascension process together with the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm long ago.

He bowed slightly toward the sky of the Xuanhuang Realm.

A jade command tablet immediately appeared in his hand.

This Command Spirit Jade Tablet represented the will of the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm.

With the jade tablet in hand, he could freely mobilize all the power within the world just as the Heavenly Dao itself could.

He no longer needed to borrow the Heavenly Mandate and act in its place.

Li Fan stepped forward.

His body expanded rapidly with the wind. Within a few breaths, he had transformed into a giant who reached from heaven to earth.

A mysterious black and gold robe appeared upon his body. A crown glittering with starlight adorned his head, concealing his facial expression.

Li Fan held the Command Spirit Jade Tablet in both hands and gently swept it across the vast Xuanhuang land below.

The earth veins rumbled, and mountains and rivers trembled.

Wherever Li Fan passed the tablet, the spiritual qi instantly boiled and evaporated completely, forming enormous regions of spiritual qi vacuums.

Then, with the cooperation of the Heavenly Dao of the Xuanhuang Realm, the remaining immortal spiritual qi in Heaven and Earth was carried along by the surrounding spiritual power and poured into these vacuum depressions.

Li Fan manifested the Law of Heaven and Earth. Using the Command Spirit Jade Tablet as his brush, he wrote a single True Immortal seal script character within the Xuanhuang Realm.

[Creation]!

Although Li Fan's current cultivation realm was insufficient to directly mobilize immortal spiritual qi, he could use this method to artificially create special regions and allow the immortal spiritual qi to enter them of its own accord.

This was the largest True Immortal seal script character Li Fan had ever written.

It was also something that could only barely be written with the aid of the power of the supermassive Xuanhuang Realm, which had already been elevated to the critical point.

If he relied solely on his own strength, even with the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven and the Xuanhuang World Destruction Transformation as his foundation, he would have been drained dry in an instant.

But now, the vitality of the depressions in the cracks of the Star Sea was being extracted continuously.

Supreme Qiushui transformed into blue sword shadows, traversing every region of the Xuanhuang Realm and evenly pouring in the boundless power of the Star Sea.

In addition, there were various powers that the Xuanhuang Realm had previously absorbed but had not yet had time to completely digest, such as fragments of ruined worlds.

With all these forces accumulating together, they became fuel, suddenly igniting the [Creation] character.

Creation unfolded within the Xuanhuang Realm.

The four Immortal Pillars once again rose into the heavens, reaching straight toward the sky.

The Cave Heavens and blessed lands were suffused with flowing radiance, while the laws contained within them became increasingly sacred.

The living beings upon the earth enjoyed the benefits without effort. Without having to labor for them, the strength of their souls and bodies advanced by leaps and bounds with each passing day.

As one auspicious phenomenon after another unfolded, the Xuanhuang Realm's momentum toward ascension continued to rise, surging forward at an astonishing speed.

The so called Creation was occurring right before his eyes.

Watching the drastic transformation of the Xuanhuang Realm that he had personally brought about, Li Fan recalled all the differences within the Xuanhuang Realm before and after its transformation.

He also recalled the countless details of his communications with the consciousness of the Xuanhuang Realm's Heavenly Dao at every stage.

Li Fan's expression became slightly dazed.

'Is it Heaven, or is it man?'

'Heaven and man are no different.'

'Heaven can attain Creation, and man can also attain Creation.'

'Seated upon a mountain, one can ascend to Heaven. Seated upon Heaven...'

'One can ascend to immortality!'

Countless flowing characters arranged and rearranged themselves within Li Fan's mind, continuously changing.

In the end, they combined into a dazzling cultivation technique.

Sitting Heaven Art!

Ever since he had deduced the Mountain Sitting Art into the Immortal Sitting Art, Li Fan's primary cultivation technique had entered an extremely awkward state.

The thing restricting Li Fan was no longer his cultivation.

It was the shackles of the great cultivation realms.

No matter how much cultivation he accumulated, if he could not cross that threshold, it would all be useless.

Thus, Li Fan had almost forgotten about his primary cultivation technique.

This could be considered a strange phenomenon in cultivation.

But now, as he observed the Xuanhuang Realm continuously rising and transforming under the power of Creation, inspiration naturally arose within his heart.

Like water flowing into a channel, he smoothly deduced and perfected the Mountain Sitting Art into its next stage.

The Sitting Heaven Art had long been within Li Fan's expectations. At this moment, as he observed the sacred spectacle and comprehended the divine technique, his heart merely stirred slightly.

After all, to Li Fan, improving his cultivation realm was now far more important than increasing his cultivation.

After witnessing the boundless power of the Star Sea and mastering the Equal Heaven Divine Art, as long as his cultivation realm advanced, increasing his cultivation would be an exceedingly simple matter.

Li Fan felt neither joy nor sorrow.

The Sitting Heaven Art was a cultivation technique that Li Fan himself had deduced. He understood it completely.

It shared the same origin as the Mountain Sitting Art. With merely a thought, he had already cultivated it to perfection.

At this moment, as the Xuanhuang Realm advanced rapidly along its path toward ascending into the Immortal Domain, the feedback force from the Sitting Heaven Art also surged forth like mighty rivers.

Li Fan had already reached the peak of Soul Transformation, but the bottleneck had yet to be broken.

Thus, the additional cultivation could only be temporarily stored.

A series of phantom [Calamity Bodies] from the Taishang Sect appeared within Li Fan's body.

And now, Li Fan could faintly sense that these Calamity Bodies had an indistinct connection with someone within the Carefree Dreamland Paradise.

'Even if I am willing to let the chickens and dogs ascend with me...'

'You are not among those chickens and dogs.'

Li Fan shook his head slightly, his expression indifferent.

The Calamity Body in his dantian shattered inch by inch. Then, under the continuous infusion of seemingly endless feedback power, it astonishingly transformed from an image of Li Fan into the form of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Throughout his many reincarnations, Li Fan had not merely dissected the Xuanhuang Realm down to its smallest details. He had practically excavated every inch of it.

With every world-ending calamity, everything within the Xuanhuang Realm would be revealed before Li Fan without reservation.

In this world, when it came to understanding the Xuanhuang Realm, no one could surpass Li Fan.

Even the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao itself did not know about the various means Li Fan had deeply implanted within the Xuanhuang Realm.

Once one's understanding reached a certain level of concreteness, then through the rewriting of thought, the phantom image of the Xuanhuang Realm generated within Li Fan's dantian was actually identical to the real Xuanhuang Realm.

Apart from the absence of living beings within the phantom image, every other detail corresponded perfectly with reality.

What astonished Li Fan even more was that the energy level of this world phantom formed by the feedback power was almost exactly identical to that of the Xuanhuang Realm at this very moment.

In other words, the world phantom formed within Li Fan's dantian through the feedback power of the Xuanhuang Ascension could be regarded as another Xuanhuang Realm.

The only difference was that this Xuanhuang Realm existed purely in the form of energy.

'This... how is this possible?'

'How could there possibly be this much feedback power?'

Even as the creator of the cultivation technique, Li Fan was stunned by the scene before him.

But he had seen enough extraordinary things to quickly regain his composure.

There was no joy on his face. Instead, his expression gradually became solemn.

'The principle behind the Sitting Heaven Art is similar to that of the Mountain Sitting Art. You reap the benefits without doing the work. When you advance, I advance with you.'

'Right now, I have exhausted every means at my disposal. The Xuanhuang Realm is only this close to ascending. It has already been undergoing transformation for so long, yet it still has not achieved that qualitative change...'

'Previously, I had no way to concretely observe the changes in the energy level of the Xuanhuang Realm during its ascension. But now, based on the world phantoms generated within my dantian, I can roughly deduce the changes occurring during the Xuanhuang Realm's ascension.'

Li Fan stared at his dantian.

Not long after one world phantom finished forming, another suddenly appeared.

After only a few breaths, thirteen images of the Xuanhuang Realm had already emerged.

Moreover, judging from the momentum, there seemed to be no sign that they would stop.

'Thirteen times the total energy of the Xuanhuang Realm at the critical point of ascension.'

'That is probably hundreds or even thousands of times the energy of the original ordinary Xuanhuang Realm.'

'Such terrifyingly immense energy is still insufficient to push the Xuanhuang Realm through its immortal transformation...'

'Could it be that I really have to deploy all those Go pieces left behind by Sun Piaomiao and rely on his hidden arrangements to recreate the Immortal Domain in the mortal world?'

'Is the gap between immortal arts really this enormous?'

A faint sense of foreboding suddenly welled up within Li Fan's heart. And Li Fan's premonitions had always been accurate.

When the immortal spiritual qi obtained from the Great Celestial Venerable's legacy was completely exhausted.

When the Creation characters lost their driving force and slowly dissipated.

The upheaval occurring within the Xuanhuang Realm came to an abrupt halt.

For a brief moment, heaven and earth fell deathly silent.

Then something terrifying happened.

As the saying went, the higher one climbed, the harder one fell. Li Fan now witnessed this principle firsthand in the Xuanhuang Realm.

The Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao's frantic, furious, shocked, and terrified will surged toward Li Fan.

It desperately wanted Li Fan to intervene and save it.

But very soon, the will of the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao was drowned out by an indescribably tremendous sound that resounded throughout the world.

The four pseudo-Immortal Celestial Pillars at the corners of the world collapsed with a thunderous crash, like toys being knocked over.

The heavenly curtain seemed to be effortlessly sliced open by a sharp blade, and enormous black cracks instantly spread across it.

Mountains and rivers collapsed. The earth split apart.

Even under the protection of the Illusory Immortal Formation, the living beings of the Xuanhuang Realm silently died one after another from the vibrations of this sound of falling.

Countless methods of salvation flashed through Li Fan's mind in an instant.

Yet none seemed capable of reversing this catastrophe of heaven's collapse.

If the fall of the world still left Li Fan with even the slightest chance of survival.

Then the billowing black qi surging forth from the wounds in heaven and earth as the world disintegrated completely severed that last chance.

Like a tidal wave, it arrived in an instant and engulfed the Xuanhuang Realm.

In a daze, Li Fan saw the Dao Comprehending True Immortal from the Immortal Ruins outside the Xuanhuang Realm fleeing in terror.

Within the Daoyuan Prefecture of the Xuanhuang Realm, the phantom of the Grand Mage transformed into a strange, blurry radiance and attempted to escape. Yet it was effortlessly swallowed by a single wave of the black qi tide, without even the slightest struggle.

The endless Carefree Dreamland Paradise was also collapsing layer by layer.

All the living beings that had survived within the dreams were buried alongside it.

...

The speed of the fall grew faster and faster.

The momentum of the black qi tide became increasingly terrifying.

And beyond this billowing black qi, there seemed to be an even more indescribable existence approaching.

Li Fan sighed softly. He had no choice but to admit that this attempt at ascension had failed.

'I miscalculated after all.'

This thought flashed through his mind.

Then the Dao-Annihilating Black Qi descended violently.

It completely engulfed Li Fan.

...

...

...

The scene suddenly changed.

Li Fan appeared once again, completely unharmed, but his expression was extremely solemn.

Current Time: 24 Hours Before Li Fan's Dao Integration and Ascension to Immortality.

'It actually failed?'

'Everything had already been prepared, yet in the end, all my efforts still fell short.'

'Relying solely on the accumulation of quantity, it seems I can only approach the realm of immortality infinitely.'

'If I want to truly transform into an immortal, I still need another crucial...'

'What exactly is it?'

Having used the Simulation in advance, Li Fan now had very little time remaining in this life.

Chapter 1400: So This Was The Cause Back Then

"In this additional simulation, it seems I did not possess the miraculous treasure [Truth]. Aside from that, everything was no different from what I personally experienced."

Recalling the countless scenes that had suddenly flashed through his mind just moments ago, Li Fan's expression was solemn.

When the Dao Annihilation black qi swallowed the falling Xuanhuang Realm, with nowhere left to escape, he had not attempted to activate [Truth]. He had simply waited helplessly for death.

"But the me in the simulation did not find anything unusual about [Truth]'s disappearance. It was as though the me in the simulation had never possessed this supreme treasure in the first place. From the moment I activated the additional simulation, a branch that excluded [Truth] was created..."

"Interesting. Even when simulating [Truth] itself, as long as it is an additional simulation conducted while the main simulation already exists, the branch simulation still cannot simulate me possessing it?"

Li Fan's thoughts stirred. A flash of inspiration suddenly passed through his mind, and he seemed to understand something.

However, that inspiration was like a candle flame in the darkness. In an instant, it was swallowed by the boundless darkness around him. By the time Li Fan tried to recall it again, he could no longer remember it no matter how hard he tried.

Realizing that he might have missed an opportunity to glimpse the secret of [Truth], Li Fan's expression froze slightly, and for a moment, he felt somewhat melancholy.

But he quickly recovered.

Li Fan believed that as his comprehension of the Transformation Between Truth and Falsehood continued to deepen, and his compatibility with [Truth] continued to increase, there would eventually come a day when he could truly and completely uncover the secret of [Truth].

After taking a deep breath, Li Fan composed himself and carefully contemplated what had happened during the branch simulation.

"The plan for the Xuanhuang Ascension was almost entirely within my expectations. There were no major oversights in the preparations, nor did any unexpected enemies appear."

"The only obstacle preventing the Xuanhuang Realm from ascending was that it remained just a tiny step short of the final qualitative transformation. This is the starting point of the vast divide between immortals and mortals."

"Exactly how can this qualitative transformation be achieved?"

In an instant, countless possibilities flashed through Li Fan's mind.

"The Immortal Mortal Transformation character? Or should I continue using the Immortal Domain Go pieces? Or perhaps use the surviving ancient immortal formation as a foundation and attempt to repair the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation?"

Every attempt involved endless possibilities. Most things related to immortals were completely unknown, and were beyond what Li Fan could deduce at his current level.

Li Fan's head ached from thinking, yet he still could not choose the most suitable solution.

It seemed that every method could work.

Yet it also seemed that every method would fail.

"Could it be that even after another lifetime, I still cannot achieve Dao Integration and ascend to the immortal realm?"

"If all else fails, I can simply try every method once. Sooner or later, I will find the correct path for the world's ascension."

This pessimistic thought quietly arose within Li Fan's heart.

Once it appeared, it was like a great river breaking through its dam, sweeping everything away in an instant. It completely shattered Li Fan's psychological defenses.

His thoughts became like a storm, roaring chaotically without end.

Li Fan stopped thinking about the conditions required for the Xuanhuang Realm to undergo ascension.

Instead, he began considering how to end this lifetime and what plans to make after beginning the next.

The plan was sound.

Yet for some reason, Li Fan remained restless and uneasy.

In theory, everything that happened within a simulation could be reproduced through another simulation. In this world, there was nothing that could truly be considered "lost" to Li Fan.

Except for the changes within Li Fan himself.

Whenever [Truth] activated a simulation and returned him to the predetermined anchor point, everything in the world would be reset.

Even the strength of Li Fan's body and his cultivation realm were reset in the same manner. He needed to rely on [Truth]'s cultivation inheritance function to return to the state he had reached during his previous simulation.

Yet within every reset, there was always one variable that continued moving forward.

That was Li Fan's heart and will.

More specifically, this manifested on the [Truth] interface as the upper limit of Li Fan's psychological age and the default [Truth] charging progress.

Yet both of these had remained unchanged for a very long time...

At this moment, Li Fan was more hesitant than ever before.

Time passed second by second, but Li Fan still could not make his final decision.

Only 20 hours remained before the point in the branch simulation of the Three-Pronged when he had activated the Xuanhuang Ascension.

With an indescribable expression, Li Fan took a step and arrived at the very starting point of everything.

Great Xuan.

The house where this mortal body had lived before his death.

Even though "Li Fan" had mysteriously disappeared, the study remained spotlessly clean, exactly as it had always been.

Clearly, that "aunt" still harbored a faint hope that "Li Fan" would someday return.

Li Fan lay down on the bed and closed his eyes.

It was as though he had returned to the moment when he had first transmigrated into this world.

Time fell into stillness.

Then, like ice cracking apart, it quietly began to flow again.

Across a hundred lifetimes of reincarnation, all kinds of experiences passed through Li Fan's mind once more in an instant.

Li Fan tried to use this method to search for a possibility of breaking through the deadlock.

Daylight turned into darkness.

Li Fan simply lay quietly on the wooden bed.

As though he had completely fallen asleep.

Indeed, Li Fan could use one [Truth] simulation after another, relying on the method of elimination to determine, one by one, the key to achieving that qualitative transformation.

This was also the safest method.

In theory, there was nothing wrong with it.

Yet whenever Li Fan decided in his heart to proceed this way, certain scenes would inexplicably flash through his mind.

There was Mo Rubin's obsession beneath the breach in the High Wall, where he had been willing to risk his very life simply to investigate it.

There was also the Heavenly Doctor within the illusion formation, who had ultimately abandoned his comprehension of the High Wall completely for the sake of the Heavenly Law Realm.

"Once lost, forever lost."

In the darkness, Li Fan suddenly opened his eyes.

He repeatedly whispered these four words.

With [Truth]'s existence, there should indeed be nothing in this world that could truly be lost forever to him.

Unless the item's level of existence surpassed [Truth] itself.

Clearly, merely transforming from mortal to immortal was nowhere near enough to achieve that.

"The true meaning of 'once lost, forever lost' exists within my heart."

"[Truth] can influence everything in the world, yet it alone cannot reverse the changes within me."

As though he had understood something, Li Fan's eyes gradually brightened, seemingly capable of piercing through the darkness.

"The loss of this unknown quality might not affect my ability to step into the True Immortal realm. But as for the path beyond the True Immortal realm, perhaps it will have profound consequences."

After a long period of contemplation, when the first ray of sunlight appeared upon the earth and drove away the darkness, Li Fan finally understood completely.

He finally understood where the uneasiness in his heart had come from.

"Why exactly is this happening?"

"Is it because I have become overly dependent on lost?"

"Or is there some other reason?"

"The path beyond the True Immortal realm is simply too distant for me. Moreover, based on my current understanding, it seems that reaching the Nameless True Immortal realm only requires completely mastering and refining a certain Great Dao. It seems to have nothing to do with this at all..."

Li Fan's brows furrowed tightly, his heart filled with confusion.

"But it seems that aside from exhaustive experimentation, I have no better choice."

...

Li Fan walked out of the house and looked at the rising sun on the horizon.

Continuing to ponder, he stepped out of the Great Xuan small world.

Within the Xuanhuang Realm, he began to wander aimlessly.

The surrounding scenery continuously changed in flickering bursts. Li Fan reflected everything around him into his own mind. Starting from the Congyun Sea in the east, he headed all the way west.

As his thoughts continued to race, the frequency at which the surrounding scenery flickered seemed to grow faster and faster.

Li Fan himself was immersed in a meditation state akin to sudden enlightenment, but this did not affect his ability to interact with the outside world.

The reason he was "traveling" faster and faster was precisely because of Li Fan's special relationship with the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao. Their relationship was almost like that between a reborn parent and child, and the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao held an extremely favorable impression of him.

Thus, without needing Li Fan to ask, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao took the initiative to help him reduce the burden of traveling, almost as if trying to please him.

Even though the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao had no idea why Li Fan was suddenly rushing around the world for no apparent reason.

Perhaps it even mistakenly thought that Li Fan was making preparations for his final work before ascending and undergoing sublimation.

Li Fan naturally noticed the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao's attempts to please him.

However, he did not pay much attention to them.

Previously, when the Great Celestial Venerable Wuming had walked across the world in order to repair the various wounds of the Xuanhuang Realm, the Xuanhuang Realm had also provided him with such conveniences.

With a single step, the distance between heaven and earth would automatically change, as though space itself had been compressed into inches.

However, now that the various anomalies throughout the world had all been resolved, the Xuanhuang Realm had not taken the initiative to do so for a long time.

'What a damn dog!' Li Fan secretly cursed in his heart after seeing the true nature of the Xuanhuang Realm in the branch simulation.

'I possess the supreme movement art. Why would I need such crude assistance from you?'

With a thought, the phantom of the Wooden Sword immediately flew from its sheath and hovered protectively beside Li Fan.

He was just about to fly away and free himself from the Xuanhuang Realm Heavenly Dao's interference, making use of the remaining time to calmly think things through.

But Li Fan suddenly stopped.

He looked at the phantom of the Wooden Sword beside him.

His mind once again recalled how the Xuanhuang Realm had displayed its convenient ability.

A subtle expression gradually appeared on Li Fan's face.

'My supreme movement art was created by combining my understanding of the unstoppable momentum of the Sword Dao, the changes between reality and illusion, and...'

'The teachings of the Xuantian King contained within the soul memories of Ji Yuzhen, the Dharma King of the Xuantian Sect.'

'The core of the Golden Chains Across the Void Grand Formation, the Inch Apart, yet Worlds Away Grand Formation!'

'And the Inch Apart, yet Worlds Away Grand Formation was something the Xuantian King obtained from the Immortal Realm...'

Li Fan quickly recalled what he had witnessed back then.

The Xuantian King had gently said to Ji Yuzhen:

'The Golden Chains Across the Void spans across the heavens. Even if the target is at the far end of the distant Star Sea, as long as it is locked onto, the chains can arrive in an instant and capture it. I told you before that the reason it can achieve this effect is because the Inch Apart, yet Worlds Away Formation Grand Formation is embedded within it. This formation was originally engraved upon the Ascension Platform in the Immortal Realm. When I escaped back then, I brought the entire immortal formation down with me...'

Boom!

The Xuantian King's voice was like thunderous roars, crossing countless ages and piercing through the mist, illuminating Li Fan's mind.

'Wait! Could it be...'

A sharp glint flashed through Li Fan's eyes.

He waved his hand, dispersing the phantom of the Wooden Sword beside him.

Then he continued slowly strolling through the Xuanhuang Realm.

As expected, the moment the Xuanhuang Realm Heavenly Dao sensed Li Fan's movements, it once again began trying to please him.

Li Fan did not expend any effort at all. The Heavenly Dao itself began moving.

The scenery around him once again transformed rapidly.

Li Fan closed his eyes and carefully sensed the changes taking place in the Xuanhuang world around him.

'This feeling...'

'There is no mistake!'

'It is precisely the Inch Apart, yet Worlds Away Formation Reach!'

Li Fan suddenly stopped.

His heart was filled with uncontrollable excitement.

His thoughts raced.

'Although the Golden Chains Across the Void Grand Formation, as one component of the Floating Across Starry Sky Grand Formation, has already been damaged.'

'Every activation of this formation consumes an enormous amount of energy. The cautious Xuantian King had already reproduced three backup copies long ago, in preparation for unexpected circumstances.'

'The Inch Apart, yet Worlds Away Grand Formation itself is not the key. The key is...'

A brilliant light erupted from Li Fan's eyes as he swept his gaze across the entire Xuanhuang world.

'The Ascension Platform! The engraving! The complete one!'

Li Fan's body trembled slightly from excitement at this speculation.

'The Ascension Platform must have originally been a place where the Immortal Realm received cultivators ascending from the lower realm.'

'Since it was called an Ascension Platform, besides the Inch Apart, yet Worlds Away Grand Formation, there must have been other engravings of various powers incorporated into it.'

'At that time, the Xuantian King was also fleeing for his life in a panic. Moreover, he had only just entered the Immortal Realm. He simply did not have the conditions to independently separate the Inch Apart, yet Worlds Away Grand Formation from the entire immortal formation in such a short period of time.'

'Therefore, there is a very high possibility that the three sets of backup engravings left behind by the Xuantian King were actually the complete engravings from the Ascension Platform of the Immortal Realm!'

'This may be the key!'

Although he was not one hundred percent certain, Li Fan had undoubtedly found the existence most likely to provide that final push.

After so many years of experience, Li Fan had never dared to underestimate anything originating from the Immortal Realm.

'Now, the most important question is, where exactly are the three backup imprints left behind by the Xuantian King hidden?'

Li Fan had destroyed the Xuanhuang Realm more than once. The objects that remained until the end within the World-Destruction Formation had never included these engravings.

It seemed that these engravings were not within the Xuanhuang Realm.

If the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao had not inadvertently revealed this clue by taking the initiative to please him, Li Fan might have searched outside the Xuanhuang Realm, within the Eye of the Heavenly Beast, or even inside the Remnant World Great Wall beneath the High Wall, gathering clues one by one.

But now, the Xuanhuang Realm's inadvertent actions had revealed another possibility to Li Fan.

'The engravings from the Ascension Platform may actually be inside the Xuanhuang Realm itself!'

'Because of the influence of those engravings, the Xuanhuang world has imperceptibly learned the Inch Apart, yet Worlds Away Grand Formation.'

'Even some of the innate characteristics of the Xuanhuang Realm that I speculated in the branch illusion to have originated from the Immortal Realm may likewise have been influenced by the Ascension Platform!'

Li Fan forcefully suppressed the urge to turn the entire Xuanhuang Realm upside down and search every inch of it immediately.

He calmed his mind and, seemingly intentionally yet seemingly unintentionally, began communicating with the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao.

He brought up the matter of the Heavenly Dao taking the initiative to please him.

The Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao seemed rather proud of its actions.

It quickly fell into Li Fan's verbal trap.

It revealed everything to him in detail.

'Just as I expected!'

'It somehow learned this on its own!'

Li Fan restrained his impatience and continued asking about the relevant details.

After Li Fan's continuous strengthening, the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao's control over itself had also reached an unprecedented peak.

Thus, under Li Fan's guidance, it gradually discovered the source of this "inexplicable learning" as well.

Following the directions provided by the Xuanhuang Heavenly Dao, Li Fan flashed toward the destination.

He seemed to have descended a million li beneath the earth of the Xuanhuang Realm.

Even the surging earth veins disappeared completely here. All around him was merely a pure accumulation of Xuanhuang power.

Li Fan looked at the somewhat familiar architectural style surrounding him. It resembled an ancient grand formation.

A stone slab was embedded in the center of the formation.
